// http.service.ts
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpHeaders, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable, throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { catchError, retry } from 'rxjs/operators';

export interface ApiResponse<T> {
  data: T;
  message: string;
  status: number;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class HttpService {
  private apiUrl = 'https://api.example.com';

  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}

  // GET请求
  getUsers(params?: any): Observable<ApiResponse<any[]>> {
    const httpParams = new HttpParams({ fromObject: params || {} });

    return this.http.get<ApiResponse<any[]>>(`${this.apiUrl}/users`, {
      params: httpParams,
      headers: new HttpHeaders({
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.getToken()}`
      })
    }).pipe(
      retry(3), // 失败重试3次
      catchError(this.handleError)
    );
  }

  // POST请求
  createUser(user: any): Observable<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.http.post<ApiResponse<any>>(`${this.apiUrl}/users`, user, {
      headers: new HttpHeaders({
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      })
    }).pipe(
      catchError(this.handleError)
    );
  }

  // PUT请求
  updateUser(id: number, user: any): Observable<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.http.put<ApiResponse<any>>(`${this.apiUrl}/users/${id}`, user).pipe(
      catchError(this.handleError)
    );
  }

  // DELETE请求
  deleteUser(id: number): Observable<ApiResponse<any>> {
    return this.http.delete<ApiResponse<any>>(`${this.apiUrl}/users/${id}`).pipe(
      catchError(this.handleError)
    );
  }

  // 错误处理
  private handleError(error: any): Observable<never> {
    console.error('HTTP错误:', error);

    let errorMessage = '发生未知错误';

    if (error.error instanceof ErrorEvent) {
      // 客户端错误
      errorMessage = `客户端错误: ${error.error.message}`;
    } else {
      // 服务端错误
      errorMessage = `服务端错误: ${error.status} - ${error.message}`;
    }

    return throwError(() => new Error(errorMessage));
  }

  private getToken(): string {
    return localStorage.getItem('authToken') || '';
  }
}

// auth.interceptor.ts
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpInterceptor, HttpRequest, HttpHandler, HttpEvent } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

@Injectable()
export class AuthInterceptor implements HttpInterceptor {
  intercept(req: HttpRequest<any>, next: HttpHandler): Observable<HttpEvent<any>> {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('authToken');

    if (token) {
      const authReq = req.clone({
        headers: req.headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`)
      });
      return next.handle(authReq);
    }

    return next.handle(req);
  }
}

// loading.interceptor.ts
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpInterceptor, HttpRequest, HttpHandler, HttpEvent } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { LoadingService } from './loading.service';

@Injectable()
export class LoadingInterceptor implements HttpInterceptor {
  private activeRequests = 0;

  constructor(private loadingService: LoadingService) {}

  intercept(req: HttpRequest<any>, next: HttpHandler): Observable<HttpEvent<any>> {
    if (this.activeRequests === 0) {
      this.loadingService.show();
    }
    this.activeRequests++;

    return next.handle(req).pipe(
      finalize(() => {
        this.activeRequests--;
        if (this.activeRequests === 0) {
          this.loadingService.hide();
        }
      })
    );
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { BehaviorSubject } from 'rxjs';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class LoadingService {
  private loadingSubject = new BehaviorSubject<boolean>(false);
  loading$ = this.loadingSubject.asObservable();

  show() {
    this.loadingSubject.next(true);
  }

  hide() {
    this.loadingSubject.next(false);
  }
}

// async-user.service.ts
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { BehaviorSubject, Observable, of } from 'rxjs';
import { delay, tap } from 'rxjs/operators';

export interface User {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class AsyncUserService {
  private usersSubject = new BehaviorSubject<User[]>([]);
  users$ = this.usersSubject.asObservable();

  private loadingSubject = new BehaviorSubject<boolean>(false);
  loading$ = this.loadingSubject.asObservable();

  constructor() {
    this.loadUsers();
  }

  loadUsers(): void {
    this.loadingSubject.next(true);

    // 模拟API调用
    of([
      { id: 1, name: '张三', email: 'zhangsan@example.com', role: 'admin' },
      { id: 2, name: '李四', email: 'lisi@example.com', role: 'user' }
    ]).pipe(
      delay(1000),
      tap(users => {
        this.usersSubject.next(users);
        this.loadingSubject.next(false);
      })
    ).subscribe();
  }

  addUser(user: User): Observable<User> {
    return of(user).pipe(
      delay(500),
      tap(newUser => {
        const currentUsers = this.usersSubject.value;
        this.usersSubject.next([...currentUsers, newUser]);
      })
    );
  }

  updateUser(id: number, updates: Partial<User>): Observable<User> {
    return of({ id, ...updates } as User).pipe(
      delay(300),
      tap(updatedUser => {
        const currentUsers = this.usersSubject.value;
        const updatedUsers = currentUsers.map(user =>
          user.id === id ? { ...user, ...updates } : user
        );
        this.usersSubject.next(updatedUsers);
      })
    );
  }
}

// highlight.directive.ts
import { Directive, ElementRef, Input, OnInit, OnDestroy, Renderer2 } from '@angular/core';

@Directive({
  selector: '[appHighlight]'
})
export class HighlightDirective implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Input() appHighlight = 'yellow';
  @Input() appHighlightText = 'black';

  private originalStyles: any = {};

  constructor(
    private el: ElementRef,
    private renderer: Renderer2
  ) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    console.log('指令初始化:', this.el.nativeElement);

    // 保存原始样式
    const element = this.el.nativeElement;
    this.originalStyles = {
      backgroundColor: element.style.backgroundColor,
      color: element.style.color
    };

    // 应用高亮样式
    this.renderer.setStyle(element, 'background-color', this.appHighlight);
    this.renderer.setStyle(element, 'color', this.appHighlightText);
    this.renderer.setStyle(element, 'padding', '5px');
    this.renderer.setStyle(element, 'border-radius', '3px');
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    console.log('指令销毁:', this.el.nativeElement);

    // 恢复原始样式
    const element = this.el.nativeElement;
    Object.keys(this.originalStyles).forEach(style => {
      this.renderer.setStyle(element, style, this.originalStyles[style]);
    });
  }
}

import { PreloadingStrategy, Route } from '@angular/router';

  preload(route: Route, load: () => Observable<any>): Observable<any> {

// ❌ 错误示例：未处理异步验证的加载状态
@Component()
export class UserFormComponent {
  userForm: FormGroup;

  constructor(private fb: FormBuilder) {
    this.userForm = this.fb.group({
      username: ['', {
        validators: [Validators.required],
        asyncValidators: [this.uniqueUsernameValidator],
        updateOn: 'blur'
      }]
    });
  }

  private uniqueUsernameValidator(control: AbstractControl): Promise<ValidationErrors | null> {
    return this.httpService.checkUsername(control.value).toPromise().then(isTaken => {
      return isTaken ? { uniqueUsername: true } : null;
    });
    // ❌ 未处理加载状态和错误情况
  }
}

// ✅ 正确示例：处理异步验证状态
@Component()
export class UserFormComponent implements OnInit {
  userForm: FormGroup;
  usernameStatus = '';

  constructor(private fb: FormBuilder, private httpService: HttpService) {
    this.userForm = this.fb.group({
      username: ['', {
        validators: [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(3)],
        asyncValidators: [this.uniqueUsernameValidator.bind(this)],
        updateOn: 'blur'
      }]
    });
  }

  ngOnInit() {
    const usernameControl = this.userForm.get('username');

    usernameControl?.statusChanges.subscribe(status => {
      this.usernameStatus = status;
    });

    usernameControl?.valueChanges.subscribe(value => {
      if (value && value.length >= 3) {
        // 清除之前的验证错误
        usernameControl.setErrors(null);
      }
    });
  }

  private uniqueUsernameValidator(control: AbstractControl): Promise<ValidationErrors | null> {
    if (!control.value) {
      return Promise.resolve(null);
    }

    return this.httpService.checkUsername(control.value).pipe(
      map(isTaken => isTaken ? { uniqueUsername: true } : null),
      catchError(() => of({ uniqueUsername: null })) // 处理网络错误
    ).toPromise();
  }
}

}

// 自定义操作符用于调试
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { tap, map } from 'rxjs/operators';

export function debug<T>(name: string, logFn: (value: T) => void = console.log) {
  return (source: Observable<T>) =>
    source.pipe(
      tap({
        next: (value) => {
          logFn(value);
          console.log(`${name} - Next:`, value);
        },
        error: (error) => console.log(`${name} - Error:`, error),
        complete: () => console.log(`${name} - Complete`)
      })
    );
}

// 使用调试操作符
@Component()
export class UserListComponent implements OnInit {
  users$: Observable<any[]>;

  constructor(private userService: UserService) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.users$ = this.userService.getUsers().pipe(
      debug('users-load', users => console.log('用户数据:', users)),
      map(users => users.filter(user => user.active)),
      debug('filtered-users', users => console.log('过滤后用户:', users))
    );
  }
}

  public messages$ = this.messageSubject.asObservable();

  sendMessage(message: any) {
    // 通过postMessage进行跨应用通信
    window.parent?.postMessage({
      type: 'MICRO_FRONTEND_MESSAGE',
      data: message
    }, '*');

      }
    });

// WebSocket实时数据服务
@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class RealtimeDataService {
  private socket: WebSocket;
  private dataSubject = new Subject<any>();
  public data$ = this.dataSubject.asObservable();

  constructor() {
    this.connect();
  }

  private connect() {
    this.socket = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:8080/realtime');

    this.socket.onopen = () => {
      console.log('WebSocket连接已建立');
    };

    this.socket.onmessage = (event) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
      this.dataSubject.next(data);
    };

    this.socket.onclose = () => {
      console.log('WebSocket连接已关闭，尝试重连...');
      setTimeout(() => this.connect(), 5000);
    };

    this.socket.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('WebSocket错误:', error);
    };
  }

  sendMessage(message: any) {
    if (this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(message));
    }
  }

  disconnect() {
    if (this.socket) {
      this.socket.close();
    }
  }
}

// 实时数据组件
@Component({
  selector: 'app-realtime-dashboard',
  template: `
    <div class="dashboard">
      <h2>实时数据监控</h2>
      <div class="metrics">
        <div class="metric" *ngFor="let metric of metrics">
          <h3>{{ metric.name }}</h3>
          <p class="value">{{ metric.value }}</p>
          <p class="timestamp">{{ metric.timestamp | date:'medium' }}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `
})
export class RealtimeDashboardComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  metrics: any[] = [];
  private destroy$ = new Subject<void>();

  constructor(private realtimeDataService: RealtimeDataService) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.realtimeDataService.data$.pipe(
      takeUntil(this.destroy$)
    ).subscribe(data => {
      this.updateMetrics(data);
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
    this.realtimeDataService.disconnect();
  }

  private updateMetrics(data: any) {
    // 更新指标数据
    this.metrics = data.metrics;
  }
}

  • 测试工具：Jasmine、Karma、Cypress

通过以上详细的内容，我们已经全面覆盖了Angular框架的核心概念、基础语法、高级用法、易错陷阱、调试技巧和实际应用场景。这个文档为Angular开发者提供了从入门到精通的完整指南。

docs.title: 概述
docs.text: Electron是由GitHub开发的一个跨平台桌面应用开发框架，使用Web技术（HTML、CSS、JavaScript）构建原生桌面应用。它结合了Chromium渲染引擎和Node.js运行时，允许开发者使用前端技术栈开发跨平台桌面应用。

docs.title: 1. 跨平台支持
docs.text:
Electron支持Windows、macOS和Linux三大主流操作系统，一套代码可以打包到多个平台。

// main.js - 主进程
const { app, BrowserWindow, Menu } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');

function createWindow() {
  // 创建浏览器窗口
  const mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1200,
    height: 800,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true, // 在渲染进程中启用Node.js
      contextIsolation: false // 禁用上下文隔离
    },
    icon: path.join(__dirname, 'assets/icon.png') // 应用图标
  });

  // 加载应用
  mainWindow.loadFile('index.html');

  // 打开开发者工具
  mainWindow.webContents.openDevTools();

  // 当窗口被关闭，这个事件会被触发
  mainWindow.on('closed', () => {
    mainWindow = null;
  });
}

// Electron会在初始化后并准备创建浏览器窗口的时候，调用这个函数
app.whenReady().then(createWindow);

// 当全部窗口关闭时退出
app.on('window-all-closed', () => {
  // 在macOS上，应用和菜单栏通常会保持活跃状态，直到用户使用Cmd + Q明确退出
  if (process.platform !== 'darwin') {
    app.quit();
  }
});

app.on('activate', () => {
  // 在macOS上，当单击dock图标并且没有其他窗口打开时，通常会重新创建窗口
  if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) {
    createWindow();
  }
});

docs.title: 2. 主进程和渲染进程
docs.text:
Electron架构基于两个核心进程：主进程和渲染进程。

// main.js - 主进程
const { app, BrowserWindow } = require('electron');

// 创建主进程窗口
function createMainWindow() {
  const mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1000,
    height: 600,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: false, // 渲染进程中禁用Node.js
      contextIsolation: true,  // 启用上下文隔离
      preload: path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js') // 预加载脚本
    }
  });

  mainWindow.loadFile('main.html');

  // 主进程与渲染进程通信
  mainWindow.webContents.on('did-finish-load', () => {
    mainWindow.webContents.send('main-process-message', '主进程消息');
  });
}

// IPC通信处理
const { ipcMain } = require('electron');

ipcMain.handle('get-app-version', () => {
  return app.getVersion();
});

ipcMain.on('window-control', (event, action) => {
  switch (action) {
    case 'minimize':
      mainWindow.minimize();
      break;
    case 'maximize':
      mainWindow.maximize();
      break;
    case 'close':
      mainWindow.close();
      break;
  }
});

// preload.js - 预加载脚本
const { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require('electron');

// 在渲染进程中暴露安全的API
contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('electronAPI', {
  // 应用信息
  getAppVersion: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('get-app-version'),

  // 窗口控制
  minimizeWindow: () => ipcRenderer.send('window-control', 'minimize'),
  maximizeWindow: () => ipcRenderer.send('window-control', 'maximize'),
  closeWindow: () => ipcRenderer.send('window-control', 'close'),

  // 文件操作
  selectFile: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('dialog:openFile'),
  saveFile: (content) => ipcRenderer.invoke('dialog:saveFile', content),

  // 通知
  showNotification: (title, body) => {
    new Notification(title, { body }).show();
  }
});

<!-- renderer.html - 渲染进程页面 -->
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Electron应用</title>
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      padding: 20px;
    }
    .window-controls {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    button {
      padding: 10px 20px;
      font-size: 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <h1>我的Electron应用</h1>

  <div class="window-controls">
    <button onclick="minimizeWindow()">最小化</button>
    <button onclick="maximizeWindow()">最大化</button>
    <button onclick="closeWindow()">关闭</button>
  </div>

  <div id="app-info">
    <p>应用版本: <span id="version">加载中...</span></p>
  </div>

  <div class="file-operations">
    <button onclick="selectFile()">选择文件</button>
    <button onclick="saveFile()">保存文件</button>
  </div>

  <script src="renderer.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

// renderer.js - 渲染进程脚本
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
  // 获取应用版本
  try {
    const version = await window.electronAPI.getAppVersion();
    document.getElementById('version').textContent = version;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('获取版本失败:', error);
  }
});

// 窗口控制函数
function minimizeWindow() {
  window.electronAPI.minimizeWindow();
}

function maximizeWindow() {
  window.electronAPI.maximizeWindow();
}

function closeWindow() {
  window.electronAPI.closeWindow();
}

// 文件操作
async function selectFile() {
  try {
    const result = await window.electronAPI.selectFile();
    console.log('选择的文件:', result);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('选择文件失败:', error);
  }
}

async function saveFile() {
  const content = '这是要保存的内容';
  try {
    const result = await window.electronAPI.saveFile(content);
    console.log('保存结果:', result);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('保存文件失败:', error);
  }
}

docs.title: 1. 窗口管理
docs.text:
// main.js - 窗口管理详解
const { app, BrowserWindow, Menu, dialog, shell } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');

// 创建主窗口
function createMainWindow() {
  const mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1200,
    height: 800,
    minWidth: 800,
    minHeight: 600,
    show: false, // 先不显示，等加载完成后再显示
    center: true, // 窗口居中
    resizable: true, // 允许调整大小
    closable: true, // 允许关闭
    minimizable: true, // 允许最小化
    maximizable: true, // 允许最大化
    fullscreenable: true, // 允许全屏
    skipTaskbar: false, // 在任务栏显示
    kiosk: false, // 不使用 kiosk 模式
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: false,
      contextIsolation: true,
      preload: path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js'),
      webSecurity: true, // 启用web安全
      allowRunningInsecureContent: false, // 不允许运行不安全内容
      experimentalFeatures: false // 禁用实验性功能
    }
  });

  // 窗口事件处理
  mainWindow.once('ready-to-show', () => {
    mainWindow.show();
  });

  // 处理页面跳转
  mainWindow.webContents.on('will-navigate', (event, url) => {
    // 阻止外部链接
    if (url !== mainWindow.loadFile('index.html').toString()) {
      event.preventDefault();
      shell.openExternal(url);
    }
  });

  // 处理新窗口创建
  mainWindow.webContents.setWindowOpenHandler(({ url }) => {
    // 只允许特定URL在新窗口中打开
    if (url.startsWith('https://trusted-domain.com')) {
      return { action: 'allow' };
    }
    return { action: 'deny' };
  });

  return mainWindow;
}

// 创建子窗口
function createChildWindow(parentWindow, url) {
  const childWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 600,
    height: 400,
    parent: parentWindow,
    modal: true, // 模态窗口
    show: false,
    resizable: false,
    minimizable: false,
    maximizable: false,
    closable: true
  });

  childWindow.loadURL(url);

  childWindow.once('ready-to-show', () => {
    childWindow.show();
  });

  return childWindow;
}

docs.text:
// main.js - 菜单系统
const { Menu, MenuItem, shell } = require('electron');

// 创建应用菜单
function createAppMenu() {
  const template = [
    {
      label: '文件',
      submenu: [
        {
          label: '新建',
          accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+N',
          click: (item, window) => {
            // 处理新建文件
            createNewFile();
          }
        },
        {
          label: '打开',
          accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+O',
          click: (item, window) => {
            // 处理打开文件
            openFile();
          }
        },
        {
          label: '保存',
          accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+S',
          click: (item, window) => {
            // 处理保存文件
            saveFile();
          }
        },
        { type: 'separator' },
        {
          label: '退出',
          accelerator: process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'Cmd+Q' : 'Ctrl+Q',
          click: () => {
            app.quit();
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      label: '编辑',
      submenu: [
        { label: '撤销', accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+Z', role: 'undo' },
        { label: '重做', accelerator: 'Shift+CmdOrCtrl+Z', role: 'redo' },
        { type: 'separator' },
        { label: '剪切', accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+X', role: 'cut' },
        { label: '复制', accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+C', role: 'copy' },
        { label: '粘贴', accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+V', role: 'paste' },
        { label: '全选', accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+A', role: 'selectall' }
      ]
    },
    {
      label: '视图',
      submenu: [
        {
          label: '重新加载',
          accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+R',
          click: (item, focusedWindow) => {
            if (focusedWindow) {
              focusedWindow.reload();
            }
          }
        },
        {
          label: '强制重新加载',
          accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+Shift+R',
          click: (item, focusedWindow) => {
            if (focusedWindow) {
              focusedWindow.webContents.reloadIgnoringCache();
            }
          }
        },
        {
          label: '开发者工具',
          accelerator: 'F12',
          click: (item, focusedWindow) => {
            if (focusedWindow) {
              focusedWindow.webContents.toggleDevTools();
            }
          }
        },
        { type: 'separator' },
        {
          label: '实际大小',
          accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+0',
          click: (item, focusedWindow) => {
            if (focusedWindow) {
              focusedWindow.webContents.setZoomLevel(0);
            }
          }
        },
        {
          label: '放大',
          accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+Plus',
          click: (item, focusedWindow) => {
            if (focusedWindow) {
              const currentZoom = focusedWindow.webContents.getZoomLevel();
              focusedWindow.webContents.setZoomLevel(currentZoom + 0.5);
            }
          }
        },
        {
          label: '缩小',
          accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+-',
          click: (item, focusedWindow) => {
            if (focusedWindow) {
              const currentZoom = focusedWindow.webContents.getZoomLevel();
              focusedWindow.webContents.setZoomLevel(currentZoom - 0.5);
            }
          }
        },
        { type: 'separator' },
        {
          label: '全屏',
          accelerator: 'F11',
          click: (item, focusedWindow) => {
            if (focusedWindow) {
              focusedWindow.setFullScreen(!focusedWindow.isFullScreen());
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      label: '窗口',
      submenu: [
        {
          label: '最小化',
          accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+M',
          role: 'minimize'
        },
        {
          label: '关闭',
          accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+W',
          role: 'close'
        },
        { type: 'separator' },
        {
          label: '始终在最前面',
          type: 'checkbox',
          click: (item, focusedWindow) => {
            if (focusedWindow) {
              focusedWindow.setAlwaysOnTop(item.checked);
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      label: '帮助',
      submenu: [
        {
          label: '关于',
          click: () => {
            dialog.showMessageBox(mainWindow, {
              type: 'info',
              title: '关于',
              message: '我的Electron应用',
              detail: '版本 1.0.0\n由 Electron 构建'
            });
          }
        },
        {
          label: '访问官网',
          click: () => {
            shell.openExternal('https://electronjs.org');
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ];

  // macOS 特定菜单调整
  if (process.platform === 'darwin') {
    template.unshift({
      label: app.getName(),
      submenu: [
        {
          label: '关于 ' + app.getName(),
          role: 'about'
        },
        { type: 'separator' },
        {
          label: '服务',
          role: 'services',
          submenu: []
        },
        { type: 'separator' },
        {
          label: '隐藏 ' + app.getName(),
          accelerator: 'Command+H',
          role: 'hide'
        },
        {
          label: '隐藏其他',
          accelerator: 'Command+Shift+H',
          role: 'hideothers'
        },
        {
          label: '显示全部',
          accelerator: 'Command+Shift+A',
          role: 'unhide'
        },
        { type: 'separator' },
        {
          label: '退出',
          accelerator: 'Command+Q',
          click: () => {
            app.quit();
          }
        }
      ]
    });
  }

  const menu = Menu.buildFromTemplate(template);
  Menu.setApplicationMenu(menu);
}

// 创建右键菜单
function createContextMenu() {
  const contextMenu = new Menu();

  contextMenu.append(new MenuItem({
    label: '复制',
    accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+C',
    role: 'copy'
  }));

  contextMenu.append(new MenuItem({
    label: '粘贴',
    accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+V',
    role: 'paste'
  }));

  contextMenu.append(new MenuItem({
    type: 'separator'
  }));

  contextMenu.append(new MenuItem({
    label: '全选',
    accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+A',
    role: 'selectall'
  }));

  contextMenu.append(new MenuItem({
    label: '打开开发者工具',
    click: (item, focusedWindow) => {
      if (focusedWindow) {
        focusedWindow.webContents.toggleDevTools();
      }
    }
  }));

  // 在渲染进程中应用右键菜单
  webContents.on('context-menu', (event, params) => {
    contextMenu.popup(focusedWindow, params.x, params.y);
  });
}

docs.title: 3. 对话框系统
docs.text:
// main.js - 对话框系统
const { dialog, BrowserWindow } = require('electron');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

// 文件选择对话框
function showOpenDialog() {
  dialog.showOpenDialog(mainWindow, {
    properties: ['openFile', 'multiSelections'],
    filters: [
      { name: '文本文件', extensions: ['txt'] },
      { name: 'JavaScript文件', extensions: ['js'] },
      { name: '所有文件', extensions: ['*'] }
    ]
  }).then(result => {
    if (!result.canceled) {
      const filePaths = result.filePaths;
      filePaths.forEach(filePath => {
        const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
        console.log('文件内容:', content);
      });
    }
  }).catch(err => {
    console.error('打开文件对话框错误:', err);
  });
}

// 文件保存对话框
function showSaveDialog() {
  dialog.showSaveDialog(mainWindow, {
    title: '保存文件',
    defaultPath: path.join(__dirname, 'untitled.txt'),
    filters: [
      { name: '文本文件', extensions: ['txt'] },
      { name: 'JavaScript文件', extensions: ['js'] },
      { name: '所有文件', extensions: ['*'] }
    ]
  }).then(result => {
    if (!result.canceled) {
      const filePath = result.filePath;
      const content = '要保存的内容';
      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content, 'utf8');
      console.log('文件已保存:', filePath);
    }
  }).catch(err => {
    console.error('保存文件对话框错误:', err);
  });
}

// 消息对话框
function showMessageBox() {
  dialog.showMessageBox(mainWindow, {
    type: 'question',
    buttons: ['是', '否', '取消'],
    defaultId: 0,
    cancelId: 2,
    title: '确认操作',
    message: '您确定要执行此操作吗？',
    detail: '此操作不可撤销'
  }).then(result => {
    switch (result.response) {
      case 0:
        console.log('用户选择了"是"');
        break;
      case 1:
        console.log('用户选择了"否"');
        break;
      case 2:
        console.log('用户选择了"取消"');
        break;
    }
  }).catch(err => {
    console.error('消息对话框错误:', err);
  });
}

// 错误对话框
function showErrorBox() {
  dialog.showErrorBox('错误标题', '错误内容描述');
}

// 通知对话框
function showNotificationBox() {
  dialog.showNotificationBox(mainWindow, {
    type: 'info',
    title: '通知',
    message: '操作已完成',
    detail: '任务已成功执行'
  });
}

// 自定义对话框
function showCustomDialog() {
  const modalWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 400,
    height: 300,
    parent: mainWindow,
    modal: true,
    show: false,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: false,
      contextIsolation: true
    }
  });

  modalWindow.loadFile('custom-dialog.html');

  modalWindow.once('ready-to-show', () => {
    modalWindow.show();
  });

  // 监听自定义对话框事件
  ipcMain.on('dialog-submit', (event, data) => {
    console.log('自定义对话框提交:', data);
    modalWindow.close();
  });

  ipcMain.on('dialog-cancel', () => {
    console.log('自定义对话框取消');
    modalWindow.close();
  });
}

// main.js - 系统集成
const { app, BrowserWindow, shell, powerMonitor, globalShortcut } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');

// 系统托盘
const { Tray, nativeImage } = require('electron');

let tray = null;

function createTray() {
  const iconPath = path.join(__dirname, 'assets', 'tray-icon.png');
  const trayIcon = nativeImage.createFromPath(iconPath);

  tray = new Tray(trayIcon);
  const contextMenu = Menu.buildFromTemplate([
    {
      label: '显示应用',
      click: () => {
        mainWindow.show();
      }
    },
    {
      label: '隐藏应用',

        mainWindow.hide();
      }
    },
    { type: 'separator' },
    {
      label: '关于',
      click: () => {
        dialog.showMessageBox(mainWindow, {
          type: 'info',
          title: '关于',
          message: '我的Electron应用',
          detail: '版本 1.0.0'
        });
      }
    },
    {
      label: '退出',
      click: () => {
        app.quit();
      }
    }
  ]);

  tray.setContextMenu(contextMenu);
  tray.setToolTip('我的Electron应用');

// 通知系统
function showNotification(title, body) {
  const notification = new Notification({
    title: title,
    body: body,
    icon: path.join(__dirname, 'assets', 'notification-icon.png')
  });

  notification.on('click', () => {
    mainWindow.show();
  });

  notification.show();
}

// 系统快捷键
function registerGlobalShortcuts() {
  // 注册全局快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+A
  globalShortcut.register('CommandOrControl+Shift+A', () => {
    if (mainWindow.isVisible()) {
      mainWindow.hide();
    } else {
      mainWindow.show();
      mainWindow.focus();
    }
  });

  // 注册全局快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+N
  globalShortcut.register('CommandOrControl+Shift+N', () => {
    createNewWindow();
  });
}

// 电源监控
function setupPowerMonitor() {
  powerMonitor.on('suspend', () => {
    console.log('系统挂起');
    // 保存未保存的数据
    saveUnsavedData();
  });

  powerMonitor.on('resume', () => {
    console.log('系统恢复');
    // 重新加载数据
    reloadData();
  });

  powerMonitor.on('lock-screen', () => {
    console.log('屏幕锁定');
    // 锁定应用
    lockApplication();
  });

  powerMonitor.on('unlock-screen', () => {
    console.log('屏幕解锁');
    // 解锁应用
    unlockApplication();
  });
}

// 应用自启动
function setupAutoLaunch() {
  const isMac = process.platform === 'darwin';
  const isWindows = process.platform === 'win32';

  if (isMac) {
    // macOS 自启动设置
    app.setLoginItemSettings({
      openAtLogin: true,
      openAsHidden: false
    });
  } else if (isWindows) {
    // Windows 自启动设置
    app.setAppUserModelId('com.myapp.electron');
  }
}

// 文件关联
function setupFileAssociation() {
  if (process.platform === 'win32') {
    // Windows 文件关联
    app.setAsDefaultProtocolClient('myapp');
  } else if (process.platform === 'darwin') {
    // macOS 文件关联
    app.setAsDefaultProtocolClient('myapp');
  }
}

// 处理文件打开事件
app.on('open-file', (event, path) => {
  event.preventDefault();

  // 确保主窗口已创建
  if (!mainWindow) {
    createMainWindow();
  }

  mainWindow.webContents.send('open-file', path);
});

// 处理协议启动
app.setAsDefaultProtocolClient('myapp');

app.on('second-instance', (event, argv, workingDirectory) => {
  // 当运行第二个实例时，聚焦到主窗口
  if (mainWindow) {
    if (mainWindow.isMinimized()) mainWindow.restore();
    mainWindow.focus();
  }
});

const { ipcMain, BrowserWindow } = require('electron');

// 请求-响应模式
ipcMain.handle('get-app-info', async (event, request) => {

  };

  return appInfo;
});

// 流式数据传输
ipcMain.on('stream-data', (event, chunk) => {
  console.log('收到数据块:', chunk);

  // 处理流数据
  processStreamData(chunk);
});

function processStreamData(chunk) {
  // 数据处理逻辑

// preload.js - 预加载脚本IPC
const { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require('electron');

// 暴露安全的IPC API到渲染进程
contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('electronAPI', {
  // 同步消息

    return ipcRenderer.sendSync('synchronous-message', message);
  },

  // 异步消息

  },

// main.js - 高级IPC模式
const { ipcMain, BrowserWindow } = require('electron');

// 频道模式IPC
class IPCChannel {
  constructor(channelName) {
    this.channelName = channelName;
    this.handlers = new Map();
  }

  on(channel, handler) {
    if (!this.handlers.has(channel)) {
      this.handlers.set(channel, []);
    }
    this.handlers.get(channel).push(handler);
  }

  emit(channel, data) {
    const channelHandlers = this.handlers.get(channel);
    if (channelHandlers) {
      channelHandlers.forEach(handler => handler(data));
    }
  }
}

// 创建IPC频道管理器
const ipcManager = new IPCChannel('app-manager');

// 注册频道处理器
ipcManager.on('window-control', (data) => {
  switch (data.action) {
    case 'minimize':
      mainWindow.minimize();
      break;
    case 'maximize':
      mainWindow.maximize();
      break;
    case 'close':
      mainWindow.close();
      break;
  }
});

ipcManager.on('file-operation', (data) => {
  switch (data.operation) {
    case 'open':
      openFile(data.filePath);
      break;
    case 'save':
      saveFile(data.filePath, data.content);
      break;
  }
});

// 批量IPC处理
ipcMain.handle('batch-operations', async (event, operations) => {
  const results = [];

  for (const operation of operations) {
    try {
      const result = await executeOperation(operation);
      results.push({ success: true, data: result, operation });
    } catch (error) {
      results.push({ success: false, error: error.message, operation });
    }
  }

  return results;
});

async function executeOperation(operation) {
  // 执行具体操作
  return { message: `操作 ${operation.type} 已完成` };
}

// IPC事件队列
class IPCEventQueue {
  constructor() {
    this.queue = [];
    this.processing = false;
  }

  enqueue(event) {
    this.queue.push(event);
    this.processQueue();
  }

  async processQueue() {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const event = this.queue.shift();
      await this.processEvent(event);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }

  async processEvent(event) {
    // 处理事件
    console.log('处理IPC事件:', event);
  }
}

const eventQueue = new IPCEventQueue();

ipcMain.on('queued-event', (event, data) => {
  eventQueue.enqueue({ type: 'queued-event', data });
});

// main.js - 文件系统操作
const { dialog, BrowserWindow } = require('electron');
const fs = require('fs').promises;
const path = require('path');

// 文件选择和读取
async function selectAndReadFile() {
  try {
    const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog(mainWindow, {
      properties: ['openFile'],
      filters: [
        { name: '文本文件', extensions: ['txt', 'md'] },
        { name: 'JSON文件', extensions: ['json'] },
        { name: '所有文件', extensions: ['*'] }
      ]
    });

    if (!result.canceled) {
      const filePath = result.filePaths[0];
      const content = await fs.readFile(filePath, 'utf8');

      // 发送文件内容到渲染进程
      mainWindow.webContents.send('file-content', {
        path: filePath,
        content: content
      });

      return { success: true, content };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('读取文件失败:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

// 文件保存
async function saveFile(filePath, content) {
  try {
    await fs.writeFile(filePath, content, 'utf8');

    // 通知渲染进程保存成功
    mainWindow.webContents.send('file-saved', {
      path: filePath,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    });

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('保存文件失败:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

// 文件信息获取
async function getFileInfo(filePath) {
  try {
    const stats = await fs.stat(filePath);
    const fileName = path.basename(filePath);
    const fileDir = path.dirname(filePath);

    return {
      success: true,
      info: {
        path: filePath,
        name: fileName,
        directory: fileDir,
        size: stats.size,
        isFile: stats.isFile(),
        isDirectory: stats.isDirectory(),
        created: stats.birthtime,
        modified: stats.mtime,
        accessed: stats.atime
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

// 目录操作
async function listDirectory(dirPath) {
  try {
    const files = await fs.readdir(dirPath, { withFileTypes: true });

    const fileList = await Promise.all(
      files.map(async (file) => {
        const fullPath = path.join(dirPath, file.name);
        const stats = await fs.stat(fullPath);

        return {
          name: file.name,
          path: fullPath,
          type: file.isDirectory() ? 'directory' : 'file',
          size: stats.size,
          modified: stats.mtime
        };
      })
    );

    return { success: true, files: fileList };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

// 创建目录
async function createDirectory(dirPath) {
  try {
    await fs.mkdir(dirPath, { recursive: true });
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

// 删除文件或目录
async function deletePath(targetPath) {
  try {
    const stats = await fs.stat(targetPath);

    if (stats.isDirectory()) {
      await fs.rmdir(targetPath, { recursive: true });
    } else {
      await fs.unlink(targetPath);
    }

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

// 文件监控
class FileWatcher {
  constructor() {
    this.watchers = new Map();
  }

  watchFile(filePath, callback) {
    if (this.watchers.has(filePath)) {
      this.watchers.get(filePath).close();
    }

    const watcher = fs.watch(filePath, (eventType, filename) => {
      callback({
        path: filePath,
        event: eventType,
        filename: filename,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    });

    this.watchers.set(filePath, watcher);
  }

  unwatchFile(filePath) {
    const watcher = this.watchers.get(filePath);
    if (watcher) {
      watcher.close();
      this.watchers.delete(filePath);
    }
  }

  unwatchAll() {
    this.watchers.forEach(watcher => watcher.close());
    this.watchers.clear();
  }
}

const fileWatcher = new FileWatcher();

// IPC处理文件操作
ipcMain.handle('file:select', async () => {
  return await selectAndReadFile();
});

ipcMain.handle('file:save', async (event, { path, content }) => {
  return await saveFile(path, content);
});

ipcMain.handle('file:info', async (event, filePath) => {
  return await getFileInfo(filePath);
});

ipcMain.handle('dir:list', async (event, dirPath) => {
  return await listDirectory(dirPath);
});

ipcMain.handle('dir:create', async (event, dirPath) => {
  return await createDirectory(dirPath);
});

ipcMain.handle('path:delete', async (event, targetPath) => {
  return await deletePath(targetPath);
});

ipcMain.handle('file:watch', async (event, filePath) => {
  fileWatcher.watchFile(filePath, (change) => {
    event.sender.send('file-changed', change);
  });
  return { success: true };
});

ipcMain.handle('file:unwatch', async (event, filePath) => {
  fileWatcher.unwatchFile(filePath);
  return { success: true };
});

// main.js - 配置文件管理
const { app } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs').promises;

class ConfigManager {
  constructor() {
    this.configPath = path.join(app.getPath('userData'), 'config.json');
    this.defaultConfig = {
      window: {
        width: 1200,
        height: 800,
        x: 100,
        y: 100,
        maximized: false,
        minimized: false
      },
      app: {
        autoLaunch: false,
        checkUpdates: true,
        theme: 'light'
      },
      network: {
        timeout: 30000,
        retries: 3,
        userAgent: 'ElectronApp/1.0.0'
      }
    };
  }

  async loadConfig() {
    try {
      const configData = await fs.readFile(this.configPath, 'utf8');
      const config = JSON.parse(configData);

      // 合并默认配置
      return this.mergeConfig(this.defaultConfig, config);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code === 'ENOENT') {
        // 配置文件不存在，使用默认配置
        await this.saveConfig(this.defaultConfig);
        return this.defaultConfig;
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async saveConfig(config) {
    try {
      const configDir = path.dirname(this.configPath);
      await fs.mkdir(configDir, { recursive: true });
      await fs.writeFile(this.configPath, JSON.stringify(config, null, 2), 'utf8');
      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
  }

  mergeConfig(defaultConfig, userConfig) {
    const merged = { ...defaultConfig };

    function deepMerge(target, source) {
      Object.keys(source).forEach(key => {
        if (source[key] && typeof source[key] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(source[key])) {
          if (!target[key]) target[key] = {};
          deepMerge(target[key], source[key]);
        } else {
          target[key] = source[key];
        }
      });
    }

    deepMerge(merged, userConfig);
    return merged;
  }

  async getConfig() {
    return await this.loadConfig();
  }

  async updateConfig(updates) {
    try {
      const currentConfig = await this.loadConfig();
      const newConfig = this.mergeConfig(currentConfig, updates);
      await this.saveConfig(newConfig);
      return { success: true, config: newConfig };
    } catch (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
  }

  async resetConfig() {
    try {
      await this.saveConfig(this.defaultConfig);
      return { success: true, config: this.defaultConfig };
    } catch (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
  }
}

const configManager = new ConfigManager();

// IPC处理配置操作
ipcMain.handle('config:get', async () => {
  return await configManager.getConfig();
});

ipcMain.handle('config:update', async (event, updates) => {
  return await configManager.updateConfig(updates);
});

ipcMain.handle('config:reset', async () => {
  return await configManager.resetConfig();
});

// main.js - HTTP请求处理
const { BrowserWindow } = require('electron');
const https = require('https');
const http = require('http');
const { URL } = require('url');

class HTTPClient {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.defaultOptions = {
      timeout: options.timeout || 30000,
      headers: options.headers || {},
      followRedirects: options.followRedirects !== false
    };
  }

  async request(url, options = {}) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const urlObj = new URL(url);
      const client = urlObj.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;

      const requestOptions = {
        hostname: urlObj.hostname,
        port: urlObj.port || (urlObj.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),
        path: urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search,
        method: options.method || 'GET',
        headers: { ...this.defaultOptions.headers, ...options.headers }
      };

      const req = client.request(requestOptions, (res) => {
        let data = '';

        res.on('data', (chunk) => {
          data += chunk;
        });

        res.on('end', () => {
          resolve({
            statusCode: res.statusCode,
            headers: res.headers,
            data: data,
            url: url
          });
        });
      });

      req.on('error', (error) => {
        reject(error);
      });

      req.setTimeout(this.defaultOptions.timeout, () => {
        req.destroy();
        reject(new Error('Request timeout'));
      });

      if (options.data) {
        req.write(options.data);
      }

      req.end();
    });
  }

  async get(url, options = {}) {
    return await this.request(url, { ...options, method: 'GET' });
  }

  async post(url, data, options = {}) {
    const postData = typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data);
    return await this.request(url, {
      ...options,
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(postData)
      },
      data: postData
    });
  }

  async put(url, data, options = {}) {
    const putData = typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data);
    return await this.request(url, {
      ...options,
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(putData)
      },
      data: putData
    });
  }

  async delete(url, options = {}) {
    return await this.request(url, { ...options, method: 'DELETE' });
  }
}

const httpClient = new HTTPClient({
  timeout: 30000,
  headers: {
    'User-Agent': 'ElectronApp/1.0.0'
  }
});

// API请求处理
ipcMain.handle('http:get', async (event, url) => {
  try {
    const response = await httpClient.get(url);
    return { success: true, data: response };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
});

ipcMain.handle('http:post', async (event, { url, data, options }) => {
  try {
    const response = await httpClient.post(url, data, options);
    return { success: true, data: response };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
});

ipcMain.handle('http:put', async (event, { url, data, options }) => {
  try {
    const response = await httpClient.put(url, data, options);
    return { success: true, data: response };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
});

ipcMain.handle('http:delete', async (event, { url, options }) => {
  try {
    const response = await httpClient.delete(url, options);
    return { success: true, data: response };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
});

// main.js - WebSocket处理
const { BrowserWindow } = require('electron');
const WebSocket = require('ws');

class WebSocketManager {
  constructor() {
    this.connections = new Map();
    this.reconnectAttempts = new Map();
    this.maxReconnectAttempts = 5;
  }

  connect(url, options = {}) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        const ws = new WebSocket(url, options);

        ws.on('open', () => {
          console.log('WebSocket连接已建立:', url);
          this.connections.set(url, ws);
          this.reconnectAttempts.set(url, 0);

          // 通知渲染进程连接成功
          BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().forEach(window => {
            window.webContents.send('websocket:connected', { url });
          });

          resolve(ws);
        });

        ws.on('message', (data) => {
          // 转发消息到渲染进程
          BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().forEach(window => {
            window.webContents.send('websocket:message', {
              url,
              data: JSON.parse(data)
            });
          });
        });

        ws.on('close', (code, reason) => {
          console.log('WebSocket连接关闭:', url, code, reason);
          this.connections.delete(url);

          // 自动重连
          if (this.reconnectAttempts.get(url) < this.maxReconnectAttempts) {
            this.scheduleReconnect(url, options);
          }

          BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().forEach(window => {
            window.webContents.send('websocket:disconnected', {
              url,
              code,
              reason: reason.toString()
            });
          });
        });

        ws.on('error', (error) => {
          console.error('WebSocket错误:', url, error);

          BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().forEach(window => {
            window.webContents.send('websocket:error', {
              url,
              error: error.message
            });
          });
        });

      } catch (error) {
        reject(error);
      }
    });
  }

  send(url, data) {
    const ws = this.connections.get(url);
    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      ws.send(typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data));
      return { success: true };
    }
    return { success: false, error: 'WebSocket未连接' };
  }

  disconnect(url) {
    const ws = this.connections.get(url);
    if (ws) {
      ws.close();
      this.connections.delete(url);
      return { success: true };
    }
    return { success: false, error: 'WebSocket连接不存在' };
  }

  scheduleReconnect(url, options) {
    const attempts = this.reconnectAttempts.get(url) || 0;
    const delay = Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(2, attempts), 30000); // 指数退避

    setTimeout(() => {
      if (this.reconnectAttempts.get(url) < this.maxReconnectAttempts) {
        this.reconnectAttempts.set(url, attempts + 1);
        console.log(`尝试重连 WebSocket (${attempts + 1}/${this.maxReconnectAttempts}):`, url);

        this.connect(url, options).catch(error => {
          console.error('WebSocket重连失败:', error);
        });
      }
    }, delay);
  }

  getConnectionStatus(url) {
    const ws = this.connections.get(url);
    if (!ws) return { connected: false };

    return {
      connected: ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN,
      readyState: ws.readyState,
      url: url,
      attempts: this.reconnectAttempts.get(url) || 0
    };
  }
}

const wsManager = new WebSocketManager();

// IPC处理WebSocket操作
ipcMain.handle('websocket:connect', async (event, { url, options }) => {
  try {
    const ws = await wsManager.connect(url, options);
    return { success: true, url: url };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
});

ipcMain.handle('websocket:send', async (event, { url, data }) => {
  return wsManager.send(url, data);
});

ipcMain.handle('websocket:disconnect', async (event, url) => {
  return wsManager.disconnect(url);
});

ipcMain.handle('websocket:status', async (event, url) => {
  return wsManager.getConnectionStatus(url);
});

    }
    return null;
  }
}

docs.text:
// ❌ 错误示例：简单的错误处理
function makeHTTPRequest(url) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    require('https').get(url, (res) => {
      let data = '';
      res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
      res.on('end', () => resolve(data));
    }).on('error', reject); // ❌ 错误信息不详细
  });
}

// ✅ 正确示例：完善的错误处理
function makeHTTPRequest(url) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = require('https').get(url, (res) => {
      // 检查响应状态
      if (res.statusCode >= 400) {
        reject(new Error(`HTTP错误: ${res.statusCode} - ${res.statusMessage}`));
        return;
      }

      let data = '';
      res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
      res.on('end', () => {
        // 检查内容类型
        const contentType = res.headers['content-type'];
        if (contentType && contentType.includes('application/json')) {
          try {
            resolve(JSON.parse(data));
          } catch (parseError) {
            reject(new Error('JSON解析失败: ' + parseError.message));
          }
        } else {
          resolve(data);
        }
      });
    });

    req.on('error', (error) => {
      if (error.code === 'ENOTFOUND') {
        reject(new Error('域名解析失败: ' + url));
      } else if (error.code === 'ECONNREFUSED') {
        reject(new Error('连接被拒绝: ' + url));
      } else if (error.code === 'ETIMEDOUT') {
        reject(new Error('请求超时: ' + url));
      } else {
        reject(new Error('网络错误: ' + error.message));
      }
    });

    req.setTimeout(30000, () => {
      req.destroy();
      reject(new Error('请求超时'));
    });
  });
}

// main.js - 网络请求调试
class DebugHTTPClient {
  constructor() {
    this.requests = new Map();
  }

  async request(url, options = {}) {
    const requestId = Date.now() + Math.random();
    const startTime = Date.now();

    console.log(`[HTTP] 开始请求: ${requestId}`, {
      url,
      method: options.method || 'GET',
      headers: options.headers
    });

    this.requests.set(requestId, {
      url,
      startTime,
      options
    });

    try {
      const result = await this.makeRequest(url, options);
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

      console.log(`[HTTP] 请求完成: ${requestId}`, {
        url,
        duration: `${duration}ms`,
        statusCode: result.statusCode,
        dataSize: result.data ? result.data.length : 0
      });

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

      console.error(`[HTTP] 请求失败: ${requestId}`, {
        url,
        duration: `${duration}ms`,
        error: error.message
      });

      throw error;
    }
  }

  async makeRequest(url, options) {
    // 实际的HTTP请求实现
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const urlObj = new URL(url);
      const client = urlObj.protocol === 'https:' ? require('https') : require('http');

      const req = client.request({
        hostname: urlObj.hostname,
        port: urlObj.port || (urlObj.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),
        path: urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search,
        method: options.method || 'GET',
        headers: options.headers
      }, (res) => {
        let data = '';
        res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
        res.on('end', () => {
          resolve({
            statusCode: res.statusCode,
            headers: res.headers,
            data: data
          });
        });
      });

      req.on('error', reject);
      req.setTimeout(30000, () => {
        req.destroy();
        reject(new Error('Request timeout'));
      });

      req.end();
    });
  }

  getRequestHistory() {
    return Array.from(this.requests.entries()).map(([id, request]) => ({
      id,
      url: request.url,
      duration: Date.now() - request.startTime,
      status: request.completed ? 'completed' : 'pending'
    }));
  }
}

// main.js - 内存泄漏检测
class MemoryLeakDetector {
  constructor() {
    this.baselineMemory = process.memoryUsage();
    this.measurements = [];
  }

  measureMemory() {
    const usage = process.memoryUsage();
    const measurement = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      rss: usage.rss,
      heapTotal: usage.heapTotal,
      heapUsed: usage.heapUsed,
      external: usage.external
    };

    this.measurements.push(measurement);

    // 保持最近100次测量
    if (this.measurements.length > 100) {
      this.measurements.shift();
    }

    return measurement;
  }

  getMemoryTrend() {
    if (this.measurements.length < 10) {
      return 'insufficient-data';
    }

    const recent = this.measurements.slice(-10);
    const first = recent[0];
    const last = recent[recent.length - 1];

    const heapGrowth = last.heapUsed - first.heapUsed;
    const rssGrowth = last.rss - first.rss;

    if (heapGrowth > 10 * 1024 * 1024) { // 10MB增长
      return 'memory-leak-detected';
    }

    return 'normal';
  }

  generateReport() {
    const current = this.measurements[this.measurements.length - 1];
    const baseline = this.baselineMemory;

    return {
      baseline: {
        heapUsed: baseline.heapUsed,
        rss: baseline.rss
      },
      current: {
        heapUsed: current.heapUsed,
        rss: current.rss
      },
      growth: {
        heapUsed: current.heapUsed - baseline.heapUsed,
        rss: current.rss - baseline.rss
      },
      trend: this.getMemoryTrend(),
      measurements: this.measurements.length
    };
  }
}

const memoryDetector = new MemoryLeakDetector();

// 定期内存检查
setInterval(() => {
  const measurement = memoryDetector.measureMemory();
  const trend = memoryDetector.getMemoryTrend();

  if (trend === 'memory-leak-detected') {
    console.warn('[Memory] 检测到内存泄漏:', memoryDetector.generateReport());
  }
}, 30000); // 每30秒检查一次

// main.js - IPC错误排查工具
class IPCDebugger {
  constructor() {
    this.messageHistory = [];
    this.errorCount = new Map();
  }

  logMessage(direction, channel, data, sender) {
    const message = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      direction, // 'in' or 'out'
      channel,
      data: this.sanitizeData(data),
      sender: sender ? sender.id : 'unknown',
      windowId: sender ? sender.id : 'unknown'
    };

    this.messageHistory.push(message);

    // 保持最近1000条消息
    if (this.messageHistory.length > 1000) {
      this.messageHistory.shift();
    }

    console.log(`[IPC-${direction}] ${channel}:`, message.data);
  }

  logError(channel, error, context) {
    const errorInfo = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      channel,
      error: error.message,
      stack: error.stack,
      context: context
    };

    const count = this.errorCount.get(channel) || 0;
    this.errorCount.set(channel, count + 1);

    console.error(`[IPC-ERROR] ${channel}:`, errorInfo);

    // 如果某个频道错误过多，发出警告
    if (count > 10) {
      console.warn(`[IPC] 频道 ${channel} 错误过多 (${count}次)`);
    }
  }

  sanitizeData(data) {
    // 移除敏感信息
    if (typeof data === 'object' && data !== null) {
      const sanitized = { ...data };
      if (sanitized.password) {
        sanitized.password = '***';
      }
      if (sanitized.token) {
        sanitized.token = '***';
      }
      return sanitized;
    }
    return data;
  }

  getMessageHistory(filter = {}) {
    return this.messageHistory.filter(message => {
      if (filter.channel && message.channel !== filter.channel) {
        return false;
      }
      if (filter.direction && message.direction !== filter.direction) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }

  getErrorStats() {
    return Object.fromEntries(this.errorCount);
  }
}

const ipcDebugger = new IPCDebugger();

// IPC消息拦截
const originalIpcMainOn = ipcMain.on.bind(ipcMain);
ipcMain.on = function(channel, listener) {
  const wrappedListener = (event, ...args) => {
    ipcDebugger.logMessage('in', channel, args, event.sender);

    try {
      const result = listener(event, ...args);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      ipcDebugger.logError(channel, error, { type: 'ipc-main-on' });
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return originalIpcMainOn(channel, wrappedListener);
};

  }

// main.js - 多窗口协作应用
class MultiWindowApp {
  constructor() {
    this.windows = new Map();
    this.windowCounter = 0;
    this.collaborationManager = new CollaborationManager();
  }

  async createWorkspace() {
    const workspaceId = `workspace-${++this.windowCounter}`;

    // 创建主工作窗口
    const mainWindow = await this.createWindow({
      id: workspaceId,
      width: 1200,
      height: 800,
      title: `工作区 ${workspaceId}`,
      webPreferences: {
        preload: path.join(__dirname, 'workspace-preload.js')
      }
    });

    // 创建辅助窗口
    const sidebarWindow = await this.createWindow({
      id: `${workspaceId}-sidebar`,
      width: 400,
      height: 800,
      title: '侧边栏',
      parent: mainWindow,
      modal: false,
      webPreferences: {
        preload: path.join(__dirname, 'sidebar-preload.js')
      }
    });

    // 设置窗口间通信
    this.setupWindowCommunication(mainWindow, sidebarWindow);

    return { mainWindow, sidebarWindow };
  }

  async createWindow(options) {
    const window = new BrowserWindow({
      width: options.width || 800,
      height: options.height || 600,
      title: options.title || 'Electron应用',
      parent: options.parent || null,
      modal: options.modal || false,
      show: false,
      webPreferences: {
        nodeIntegration: false,
        contextIsolation: true,
        preload: options.webPreferences?.preload || path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js')
      }
    });

    // 窗口事件处理
    window.once('ready-to-show', () => {
      window.show();
      window.focus();
    });

    window.on('closed', () => {
      this.windows.delete(options.id);
      this.collaborationManager.removeWindow(options.id);
    });

    // 加载内容
    await window.loadFile(options.htmlFile || 'index.html');

    // 注册窗口
    this.windows.set(options.id, window);
    this.collaborationManager.addWindow(options.id, window);

    return window;
  }

  setupWindowCommunication(mainWindow, sidebarWindow) {
    // 主窗口到侧边栏的通信
    mainWindow.webContents.on('did-finish-load', () => {
      mainWindow.webContents.send('window-ready', {
        windowId: 'main',
        collaborationId: this.generateCollaborationId()
      });
    });

    // 侧边栏到主窗口的通信
    sidebarWindow.webContents.on('did-finish-load', () => {
      sidebarWindow.webContents.send('window-ready', {
        windowId: 'sidebar',
        collaborationId: this.generateCollaborationId()
      });
    });

    // IPC处理窗口间消息
    ipcMain.handle('collaboration:send', async (event, { targetWindowId, message }) => {
      const targetWindow = this.windows.get(targetWindowId);
      if (targetWindow && !targetWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        targetWindow.webContents.send('collaboration:message', {
          fromWindowId: event.sender.id,
          message: message,
          timestamp: Date.now()
        });
        return { success: true };
      }
      return { success: false, error: '目标窗口不存在' };
    });

    // 广播消息到所有窗口
    ipcMain.handle('collaboration:broadcast', async (event, message) => {
      const senderWindowId = event.sender.id;
      const results = [];

      for (const [windowId, window] of this.windows) {
        if (windowId !== senderWindowId && !window.isDestroyed()) {
          window.webContents.send('collaboration:broadcast', {
            fromWindowId: senderWindowId,
            message: message,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          });
          results.push({ windowId, success: true });
        }
      }

      return { success: true, results };
    });
  }

  generateCollaborationId() {
    return `collab-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
  }
}

// 协作管理器
class CollaborationManager {
  constructor() {
    this.windows = new Map();
    this.sharedData = new Map();
    this.eventHandlers = new Map();
  }

  addWindow(windowId, window) {
    this.windows.set(windowId, window);

    // 设置窗口间事件监听
    window.webContents.on('collaboration:message', (event, data) => {
      this.handleCollaborationMessage(windowId, data);
    });
  }

  removeWindow(windowId) {
    this.windows.delete(windowId);
    this.sharedData.delete(windowId);
  }

  handleCollaborationMessage(fromWindowId, data) {
    console.log(`收到来自 ${fromWindowId} 的协作消息:`, data);

    // 处理协作逻辑
    const { message, timestamp } = data;

    // 更新共享数据
    if (message.type === 'data-update') {
      this.updateSharedData(message.data);
    }

    // 转发消息到其他窗口
    this.broadcastMessage(fromWindowId, message);
  }

  updateSharedData(data) {
    Object.keys(data).forEach(key => {
      this.sharedData.set(key, data[key]);
    });
  }

  broadcastMessage(fromWindowId, message) {
    for (const [windowId, window] of this.windows) {
      if (windowId !== fromWindowId && !window.isDestroyed()) {
        window.webContents.send('collaboration:update', {
          fromWindowId,
          message,
          timestamp: Date.now()
        });
      }
    }
  }
}

// main.js - 实时数据监控应用
class RealtimeMonitoringApp {
  constructor() {
    this.dataSources = new Map();
    this.monitoringWindows = new Map();
    this.alertManager = new AlertManager();
  }

  async initializeMonitoring() {
    // 创建监控仪表板
    const dashboardWindow = await this.createMonitoringWindow({
      title: '实时监控仪表板',
      width: 1400,
      height: 900,
      htmlFile: 'monitoring-dashboard.html'
    });

    // 创建数据源连接
    await this.setupDataSources();

    // 设置实时数据处理
    this.setupRealtimeDataProcessing();

    // 设置告警系统
    this.setupAlertSystem();
  }

  async createMonitoringWindow(options) {
    const window = new BrowserWindow({
      width: options.width || 1200,
      height: options.height || 800,
      title: options.title || '监控应用',
      webPreferences: {
        nodeIntegration: false,
        contextIsolation: true,
        preload: path.join(__dirname, 'monitoring-preload.js')
      },
      show: false
    });

    await window.loadFile(options.htmlFile || 'monitoring.html');

    window.once('ready-to-show', () => {
      window.show();
    });

    this.monitoringWindows.set('dashboard', window);
    return window;
  }

  async setupDataSources() {
    // WebSocket数据源
    const wsDataSource = new WebSocketDataSource('ws://localhost:8080/metrics');
    wsDataSource.on('data', (data) => {
      this.processRealtimeData('websocket', data);
    });

    // HTTP轮询数据源
    const httpDataSource = new HTTPDataSource('http://localhost:8080/api/metrics');
    httpDataSource.on('data', (data) => {
      this.processRealtimeData('http', data);
    });

    // 文件监控数据源
    const fileDataSource = new FileDataSource('/var/log/app.log');
    fileDataSource.on('data', (data) => {
      this.processRealtimeData('file', data);
    });

    this.dataSources.set('websocket', wsDataSource);
    this.dataSources.set('http', httpDataSource);
    this.dataSources.set('file', fileDataSource);
  }

  setupRealtimeDataProcessing() {
    // 数据聚合器
    const dataAggregator = new DataAggregator();

    // 数据过滤器
    const dataFilter = new DataFilter();

    // 数据处理器
    const dataProcessor = new DataProcessor();

    // 处理来自不同数据源的数据
    this.onRealtimeData((source, data) => {
      try {
        // 数据验证
        if (!dataProcessor.validateData(data)) {
          console.warn('无效数据格式:', data);
          return;
        }

        // 数据过滤
        const filteredData = dataFilter.filter(data);

        // 数据聚合
        const aggregatedData = dataAggregator.aggregate(source, filteredData);

        // 发送到监控窗口
        this.broadcastToWindows('realtime-data', {
          source,
          data: aggregatedData,
          timestamp: Date.now()
        });

        // 检查告警条件
        this.alertManager.checkAlerts(aggregatedData);

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('实时数据处理错误:', error);
      }
    });
  }

  setupAlertSystem() {
    this.alertManager.on('alert', (alert) => {
      // 发送告警通知
      this.sendAlertNotification(alert);

      // 显示告警窗口
      this.showAlertWindow(alert);
    });

    // 配置告警规则
    this.alertManager.addRule({
      name: 'high-cpu-usage',
      condition: (data) => data.cpuUsage > 80,
      severity: 'warning',
      message: 'CPU使用率过高'
    });

    this.alertManager.addRule({
      name: 'critical-error',
      condition: (data) => data.errorRate > 0.1,
      severity: 'critical',
      message: '错误率过高'
    });
  }

  broadcastToWindows(event, data) {
    for (const [windowId, window] of this.monitoringWindows) {
      if (!window.isDestroyed()) {
        window.webContents.send(event, data);
      }
    }
  }

  sendAlertNotification(alert) {
    const notification = new Notification({
      title: `告警: ${alert.severity}`,
      body: alert.message,
      icon: path.join(__dirname, 'assets', 'alert-icon.png')
    });

    notification.on('click', () => {
      const dashboardWindow = this.monitoringWindows.get('dashboard');
      if (dashboardWindow) {
        dashboardWindow.show();
        dashboardWindow.focus();
      }
    });

    notification.show();
  }

  showAlertWindow(alert) {
    const alertWindow = new BrowserWindow({
      width: 500,
      height: 300,
      title: '告警通知',
      modal: true,
      show: false,
      webPreferences: {
        nodeIntegration: false,
        contextIsolation: true
      }
    });

    alertWindow.loadFile('alert-window.html');

    alertWindow.once('ready-to-show', () => {
      alertWindow.show();

      // 3秒后自动关闭
      setTimeout(() => {
        alertWindow.close();
      }, 3000);
    });
  }
}

// 数据源基类
class DataSource extends EventEmitter {
  constructor(url) {
    super();
    this.url = url;
    this.connected = false;
  }

  connect() {
    throw new Error('子类必须实现connect方法');
  }

  disconnect() {
    throw new Error('子类必须实现disconnect方法');
  }
}

// WebSocket数据源
class WebSocketDataSource extends DataSource {
  constructor(url) {
    super(url);
    this.websocket = null;
  }

  connect() {
    try {
      this.websocket = new WebSocket(this.url);

      this.websocket.on('open', () => {
        console.log('WebSocket数据源已连接:', this.url);
        this.connected = true;
        this.emit('connected');
      });

      this.websocket.on('message', (data) => {
        try {
          const parsedData = JSON.parse(data);
          this.emit('data', parsedData);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('WebSocket数据解析错误:', error);
        }
      });

      this.websocket.on('close', () => {
        console.log('WebSocket数据源连接关闭:', this.url);
        this.connected = false;
        this.emit('disconnected');

        // 自动重连
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.connect();
        }, 5000);
      });

      this.websocket.on('error', (error) => {
        console.error('WebSocket数据源错误:', error);
        this.emit('error', error);
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('WebSocket连接失败:', error);
      this.emit('error', error);
    }
  }

  disconnect() {
    if (this.websocket) {
      this.websocket.close();
      this.websocket = null;
    }
  }
}

// HTTP数据源
class HTTPDataSource extends DataSource {
  constructor(url) {
    super(url);
    this.pollingInterval = null;
  }

  connect() {
    this.startPolling();
  }

  startPolling() {
    this.pollingInterval = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const response = await this.makeHTTPRequest(this.url);
        if (response.statusCode === 200) {
          const data = JSON.parse(response.data);
          this.emit('data', data);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('HTTP轮询错误:', error);
      }
    }, 5000); // 每5秒轮询一次
  }

  disconnect() {
    if (this.pollingInterval) {
      clearInterval(this.pollingInterval);
      this.pollingInterval = null;
    }
  }

  async makeHTTPRequest(url) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const urlObj = new URL(url);
      const client = urlObj.protocol === 'https:' ? require('https') : require('http');

      const req = client.get(url, (res) => {
        let data = '';
        res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
        res.on('end', () => {
          resolve({
            statusCode: res.statusCode,
            data: data
          });
        });
      });

      req.on('error', reject);
      req.setTimeout(30000, () => {
        req.destroy();
        reject(new Error('Request timeout'));
      });

      req.end();
    });
  }
}

// 告警管理器
class AlertManager extends EventEmitter {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.rules = new Map();
    this.alertHistory = [];
  }

  addRule(rule) {
    this.rules.set(rule.name, rule);
  }

  checkAlerts(data) {
    for (const [ruleName, rule] of this.rules) {
      try {
        if (rule.condition(data)) {
          const alert = {
            id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
            ruleName,
            severity: rule.severity,
            message: rule.message,
            data: data,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
          };

          this.handleAlert(alert);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(`告警规则检查错误 (${ruleName}):`, error);
      }
    }
  }

  handleAlert(alert) {
    // 添加到历史记录
    this.alertHistory.push(alert);

    // 保持最近100条告警记录
    if (this.alertHistory.length > 100) {
      this.alertHistory.shift();
    }

    // 发出告警事件
    this.emit('alert', alert);

    console.warn(`告警触发: ${alert.ruleName} - ${alert.message}`, alert);
  }
}

docs.title: 概述
docs.text: React是由Facebook开发并维护的一个用于构建用户界面的JavaScript库。它采用组件化架构，支持声明式编程，让开发者能够更轻松地创建交互式用户界面。

docs.title: 1. 组件化架构
docs.text:
• 可复用组件：将UI拆分为独立的、可复用的组件
  • 组件组合：通过组件嵌套和组合构建复杂的用户界面
  • 组件隔离：每个组件拥有自己的状态和逻辑

docs.title: 2. 声明式编程
docs.text:
• 描述UI外观：开发者描述组件在不同状态下的外观
  • React自动渲染：React根据状态变化自动更新DOM
  • 减少样板代码：无需手动操作DOM更新

docs.title: 3. 虚拟DOM
docs.text:
• 内存中的DOM表示：React在内存中维护虚拟DOM树
  • 高效更新：只更新实际变化的DOM部分
  • 性能优化：减少不必要的DOM操作

docs.title: 4. 单向数据流
docs.text:
• 数据向下传递：父组件通过props向子组件传递数据
  • 状态管理：组件内部使用state管理本地状态
  • 可预测性：数据流动方向清晰，易于调试

docs.title: 核心库
docs.text:

class Counter extends React.Component {

      count: 0

  }

    this.setState(prevState => ({
      count: prevState.count + 1
    }));
  };

      count: prevState.count - 1

  }
}

docs.title: 2. useEffect Hook
docs.text:
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

// 基本用法
function DataFetcher() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 组件挂载后执行
    fetchData();
  }, []); // 空依赖数组，只在挂载时执行

  const fetchData = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/data');
      const result = await response.json();
      setData(result);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching data:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>;
  return <div>Data: {JSON.stringify(data)}</div>;
}

// 依赖项变化时执行
function UserProfile({ userId }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userId) {
      fetchUser(userId);
    }
  }, [userId]); // userId变化时重新执行

  const fetchUser = async (id) => {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/users/${id}`);
    const userData = await response.json();
    setUser(userData);
  };

  return user ? <div>{user.name}</div> : <div>Loading...</div>;
}

// 清理函数
function Timer() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setCount(prevCount => prevCount + 1);
    }, 1000);

    // 清理函数
    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, []); // 只在挂载时设置定时器

  return <div>Timer: {count}</div>;
}

// 条件执行
function ConditionalEffect({ shouldFetch }) {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (shouldFetch) {
      fetchData();
    }
  }, [shouldFetch]);

  const fetchData = async () => {
    const response = await fetch('/api/data');
    const result = await response.json();
    setData(result);
  };

  return <div>Data: {data ? JSON.stringify(data) : 'No data'}</div>;
}

// 创建Context

docs.title: 4. useReducer Hook
docs.text:
import { useReducer } from 'react';

// Reducer函数
function todoReducer(state, action) {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'ADD_TODO':
      return {
        ...state,
        todos: [...state.todos, {
          id: Date.now(),
          text: action.text,
          completed: false
        }]
      };
    case 'TOGGLE_TODO':
      return {
        ...state,
        todos: state.todos.map(todo =>
          todo.id === action.id
            ? { ...todo, completed: !todo.completed }
            : todo
        )
      };
    case 'DELETE_TODO':
      return {
        ...state,
        todos: state.todos.filter(todo => todo.id !== action.id)
      };
    case 'SET_FILTER':
      return {
        ...state,
        filter: action.filter
      };
    default:
      return state;
  }
}

// 使用useReducer
function TodoApp() {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(todoReducer, {
    todos: [],
    filter: 'all'
  });

  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');

  const handleSubmit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (inputText.trim()) {
      dispatch({ type: 'ADD_TODO', text: inputText });
      setInputText('');
    }
  };

  const filteredTodos = state.todos.filter(todo => {
    if (state.filter === 'active') return !todo.completed;
    if (state.filter === 'completed') return todo.completed;
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div>
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <input
          value={inputText}
          onChange={(e) => setInputText(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Add a todo"
        />
        <button type="submit">Add</button>
      </form>

      <div>
        <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'SET_FILTER', filter: 'all' })}>
          All
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'SET_FILTER', filter: 'active' })}>
          Active
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'SET_FILTER', filter: 'completed' })}>
          Completed
        </button>
      </div>

      <ul>
        {filteredTodos.map(todo => (
          <li key={todo.id}>
            <span
              style={{
                textDecoration: todo.completed ? 'line-through' : 'none'
              }}
              onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'TOGGLE_TODO', id: todo.id })}
            >
              {todo.text}
            </span>
            <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'DELETE_TODO', id: todo.id })}>
              Delete
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

function ChildComponent({ count, onIncrement }) {
  console.log('Child component rendered');

    </div>

// useMemo
function ExpensiveCalculation({ data, filter }) {
  // 使用useMemo缓存计算结果
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    console.log('Expensive calculation performed');
    return data.filter(item =>
      filter ? item.category === filter : true
    );
  }, [data, filter]);

  const sortedData = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredData.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  }, [filteredData]);

  const totalPrice = useMemo(() => {
    return sortedData.reduce((total, item) => total + item.price, 0);
  }, [sortedData]);

  return (
    <div>
      <h2>Total Price: ${totalPrice}</h2>
      <ul>
        {sortedData.map(item => (
          <li key={item.id}>
            {item.name} - ${item.price}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

// 自定义Hook: useLocalStorage
function useLocalStorage(key, initialValue) {
  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initialValue;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error reading from localStorage:', error);
      return initialValue;
    }
  });

  const setValue = (value) => {
    try {
      setStoredValue(value);
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error writing to localStorage:', error);
    }
  };

  return [storedValue, setValue];
}

// 使用自定义Hook
function UserPreferences() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useLocalStorage('theme', 'light');
  const [language, setLanguage] = useLocalStorage('language', 'en');

  return (
    <div>
      <select value={theme} onChange={(e) => setTheme(e.target.value)}>
        <option value="light">Light</option>
        <option value="dark">Dark</option>
      </select>

      <select value={language} onChange={(e) => setLanguage(e.target.value)}>
        <option value="en">English</option>
        <option value="zh">Chinese</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  );
}

// 自定义Hook: useApi
function useApi(url, options = {}) {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, options);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      const result = await response.json();
      setData(result);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [url, options]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, [fetchData]);

  return { data, loading, error, refetch: fetchData };
}

// 使用自定义Hook
function UserList() {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useApi('/api/users');

  if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>;
  if (error) return <div>Error: {error}</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <button onClick={refetch}>Refresh</button>
      <ul>
        {data?.map(user => (
          <li key={user.id}>{user.name}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

// 自定义Hook: useDebounce
function useDebounce(value, delay) {
  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState(value);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedValue(value);
    }, delay);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(handler);
    };
  }, [value, delay]);

  return debouncedValue;
}

// 使用自定义Hook
function SearchBox() {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const debouncedSearchTerm = useDebounce(searchTerm, 500);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (debouncedSearchTerm) {
      // 执行搜索逻辑
      console.log('Searching for:', debouncedSearchTerm);
    }
  }, [debouncedSearchTerm]);

  return (
    <input
      value={searchTerm}
      onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
      placeholder="Search..."
    />
  );
}
