import React from 'react';

class LifecycleComponent extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    console.log('Constructor called');

    this.state = {
      count: 0,
      data: null
    };
  }

  // 组件挂载后执行
  componentDidMount() {
    console.log('Component did mount');

    // 获取初始数据
    this.fetchData();

    // 设置定时器
    this.intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      this.setState(prevState => ({
        count: prevState.count + 1
      }));
    }, 1000);
  }

  // 组件更新前执行
  componentDidUpdate(prevProps, prevState) {
    console.log('Component did update');

    // 检查特定状态变化
    if (prevState.count !== this.state.count) {
      console.log('Count changed from', prevState.count, 'to', this.state.count);
    }
  }

  // 组件卸载前执行
  componentWillUnmount() {
    console.log('Component will unmount');

    // 清理资源
    clearInterval(this.intervalId);

    // 取消网络请求
    if (this.abortController) {
      this.abortController.abort();
    }
  }

  // 错误边界
  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    console.error('Component caught error:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  // 获取初始数据
  async fetchData() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/data');
      const data = await response.json();
      this.setState({ data });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching data:', error);
    }
  }

  // 处理状态变化
  handleIncrement = () => {
    this.setState(prevState => ({
      count: prevState.count + 1
    }));
  };

  // 渲染方法
  render() {
    console.log('Render called');

    return (
      <div>
        <h1>Lifecycle Component</h1>
        <p>Count: {this.state.count}</p>
        <button onClick={this.handleIncrement}>
          Increment
        </button>
        {this.state.data && (
          <div>
            <h2>Data:</h2>
            <pre>{JSON.stringify(this.state.data, null, 2)}</pre>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }
}

import React from 'react';

class DetailedLifecycle extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    console.log('1. Constructor');

    this.state = {
      initialized: false
    };
  }

  // 静态方法，用于设置初始state
  static getDerivedStateFromProps(nextProps, prevState) {
    console.log('2. getDerivedStateFromProps');
    console.log('Next props:', nextProps);
    console.log('Prev state:', prevState);

    // 根据props返回新的state
    if (nextProps.userId !== prevState.userId) {
      return {
        userId: nextProps.userId,
        loading: true
      };
    }

    return null;
  }

  // 判断组件是否应该重新渲染
  shouldComponentUpdate(nextProps, nextState) {
    console.log('3. shouldComponentUpdate');
    console.log('Next props:', nextProps);
    console.log('Next state:', nextState);

    // 只在特定条件时重新渲染
    return nextState.count !== this.state.count;
  }

  // 渲染前获取快照
  getSnapshotBeforeUpdate(prevProps, prevState) {
    console.log('4. getSnapshotBeforeUpdate');
    console.log('Prev props:', prevProps);
    console.log('Prev state:', prevState);

    // 返回快照值，在componentDidUpdate中可用
    return {
      scrollHeight: this.listRef.scrollHeight,
      scrollTop: this.listRef.scrollTop
    };
  }

  // 组件挂载后执行
  componentDidMount() {
    console.log('5. componentDidMount');

    // 初始化数据
    this.initializeData();

    // 设置事件监听器
    window.addEventListener('resize', this.handleResize);
  }

  // 组件更新后执行
  componentDidUpdate(prevProps, prevState, snapshot) {
    console.log('6. componentDidUpdate');
    console.log('Prev props:', prevProps);
    console.log('Prev state:', prevState);
    console.log('Snapshot:', snapshot);

    // 处理快照
    if (snapshot) {
      this.listRef.scrollTop = snapshot.scrollTop;
    }

    // 根据props变化执行操作
    if (prevProps.userId !== this.props.userId) {
      this.fetchUserData(this.props.userId);
    }
  }

  // 组件卸载前执行
  componentWillUnmount() {
    console.log('7. componentWillUnmount');

    // 清理资源
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.handleResize);
    clearInterval(this.intervalId);
  }

  // 错误边界
  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    console.log('Error boundary - getDerivedStateFromError');
    return {
      hasError: true,
      error: error.message
    };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    console.log('Error boundary - componentDidCatch');
    console.error('Error:', error);
    console.error('Error info:', errorInfo);

    // 发送错误报告到服务器
    this.reportError(error, errorInfo);
  }

  // 初始化数据
  initializeData() {
    console.log('Initializing data...');
    this.setState({ initialized: true });
  }

  // 获取用户数据
  async fetchUserData(userId) {
    console.log('Fetching user data for:', userId);
    // 实现数据获取逻辑
  }

  // 报告错误
  reportError(error, errorInfo) {
    console.log('Reporting error to server...');
    // 实现错误报告逻辑
  }

  // 处理窗口大小变化
  handleResize = () => {
    console.log('Window resized');
  };

  render() {
    console.log('Render method called');

    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return <div>Something went wrong: {this.state.error}</div>;
    }

    return (
      <div>
        <h1>Detailed Lifecycle Component</h1>
        <p>Initialized: {this.state.initialized.toString()}</p>
        <div ref={el => this.listRef = el}>
          {/* 列表内容 */}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

// 模拟componentDidMount
function MountEffect() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Component mounted');

    // 初始化数据
    fetchData();

    // 设置定时器
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      console.log('Timer tick');
    }, 1000);

    // 清理函数
    return () => {
      console.log('Component unmounting');
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, []); // 空依赖数组，只在挂载时执行

  const fetchData = async () => {
    // 实现数据获取逻辑
    setData({ message: 'Data loaded' });
  };

  return <div>Data: {data?.message}</div>;
}

// 模拟componentDidUpdate
function UpdateEffect() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [prevCount, setPrevCount] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Count updated from', prevCount, 'to', count);

    // 更新previous count
    setPrevCount(count);
  }, [count]); // count变化时执行

  return (
    <div>
      <p>Current count: {count}</p>
      <p>Previous count: {prevCount}</p>
      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>
        Increment
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// 模拟componentWillReceiveProps
function ReceivePropsEffect({ userId, name }) {
  const [userData, setUserData] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userId) {
      console.log('UserId changed, fetching data for:', userId);
      fetchUserData(userId);
    }
  }, [userId]); // userId变化时执行

  const fetchUserData = async (id) => {
    // 实现数据获取逻辑
    setUserData({ id, name });
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <p>User ID: {userId}</p>
      <p>Name: {name}</p>
      {userData && <p>User Data: {JSON.stringify(userData)}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

// 模拟getSnapshotBeforeUpdate
function SnapshotEffect() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const listRef = useRef(null);
  const [scrollPosition, setScrollPosition] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 模拟getSnapshotBeforeUpdate
    const snapshot = {
      scrollHeight: listRef.current?.scrollHeight || 0,
      scrollTop: listRef.current?.scrollTop || 0
    };

    // 模拟componentDidUpdate中的快照处理
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (listRef.current && snapshot.scrollTop !== 0) {
        listRef.current.scrollTop = snapshot.scrollTop;
      }
    }, 0);
  }, [items]);

  const addItem = () => {
    const newItem = {
      id: Date.now(),
      text: `Item ${items.length + 1}`
    };
    setItems(prevItems => [...prevItems, newItem]);
  };

  const handleScroll = () => {
    if (listRef.current) {
      setScrollPosition(listRef.current.scrollTop);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <button onClick={addItem}>Add Item</button>
      <div
        ref={listRef}
        style={{ height: '200px', overflow: 'auto' }}
        onScroll={handleScroll}
      >
        {items.map(item => (
          <div key={item.id}>{item.text}</div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p>Scroll position: {scrollPosition}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

// 权限检查Hook
function useAuth() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 检查用户登录状态
    checkAuthStatus().then(userData => {
      setUser(userData);
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  return { user, loading, isAuthenticated: !!user };
}

// 受保护的路由组件
function ProtectedRoute({ children }) {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  if (loading) {
    return <div>Loading...</div>;
  }

  if (!user) {
    // 重定向到登录页面，保存当前路径
    return <Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location }} replace />;
  }

  return children;
}

// 角色权限检查
function RoleBasedRoute({ children, requiredRole }) {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  if (!user) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  if (!user.roles.includes(requiredRole)) {
    return <div>Access Denied</div>;
  }

  return children;
}

// 应用路由配置
function App() {
  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
        <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
        <Route path="/dashboard" element={
          <ProtectedRoute>
            <Dashboard />
          </ProtectedRoute>
        } />
        <Route path="/admin" element={
          <ProtectedRoute>
            <RoleBasedRoute requiredRole="admin">
              <AdminPanel />
            </RoleBasedRoute>
          </ProtectedRoute>
        } />
        <Route path="/profile" element={
          <ProtectedRoute>
            <UserProfile />
          </ProtectedRoute>
        } />
      </Routes>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}

import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

// 路由历史记录管理
function useRouteHistory() {
  const location = useLocation();

  const getRouteHistory = () => {
    const history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('routeHistory') || '[]');
    return history;
  };

  const addToHistory = (route) => {
    const history = getRouteHistory();
    const updatedHistory = [
      ...history,
      {
        path: route.pathname,
        state: route.state,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      }
    ].slice(-50); // 保持最近50条记录

    localStorage.setItem('routeHistory', JSON.stringify(updatedHistory));
  };

  const clearHistory = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('routeHistory');
  };

  return { getRouteHistory, addToHistory, clearHistory };
}

// 路由状态持久化
function RouteStateManager() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const { addToHistory } = useRouteHistory();

  useEffect(() => {
    // 记录路由变化
    addToHistory(location);

    // 保存滚动位置
    const scrollPosition = window.scrollY;
    sessionStorage.setItem(`scroll-${location.pathname}`, scrollPosition.toString());
  }, [location, addToHistory]);

  // 恢复滚动位置
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedPosition = sessionStorage.getItem(`scroll-${location.pathname}`);
    if (savedPosition) {
      window.scrollTo(0, parseInt(savedPosition, 10));
    }
  }, [location]);

  return null;
}

// 路由性能监控
function RoutePerformanceMonitor() {
  const location = useLocation();

  useEffect(() => {
    const startTime = performance.now();

    return () => {
      const endTime = performance.now();
      const routeLoadTime = endTime - startTime;

      console.log(`Route ${location.pathname} loaded in ${routeLoadTime}ms`);

      // 发送性能数据到分析服务
      if (routeLoadTime > 1000) {
        // 慢路由警告
        console.warn(`Slow route detected: ${location.pathname}`);
      }
    };
  }, [location]);

  return null;
}

import { createContext, useContext, useReducer } from 'react';

// 创建Context
const AppContext = createContext();

// Reducer函数
function appReducer(state, action) {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'SET_USER':
      return { ...state, user: action.payload };
    case 'SET_THEME':
      return { ...state, theme: action.payload };
    case 'ADD_NOTIFICATION':
      return {
        ...state,
        notifications: [...state.notifications, action.payload]
      };
    case 'REMOVE_NOTIFICATION':
      return {
        ...state,
        notifications: state.notifications.filter(
          (notification) => notification.id !== action.payload
        )
      };
    default:
      return state;
  }
}

// Context Provider
function AppProvider({ children }) {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(appReducer, {
    user: null,
    theme: 'light',
    notifications: []
  });

  const contextValue = {
    state,
    dispatch,
    // 便捷方法
    setUser: (user) => dispatch({ type: 'SET_USER', payload: user }),
    setTheme: (theme) => dispatch({ type: 'SET_THEME', payload: theme }),
    addNotification: (notification) =>
      dispatch({ type: 'ADD_NOTIFICATION', payload: notification }),
    removeNotification: (id) =>
      dispatch({ type: 'REMOVE_NOTIFICATION', payload: id })
  };

  return (
    <AppContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
    </AppContext.Provider>
  );
}

// 使用Context
function UserProfile() {
  const { state, setUser } = useContext(AppContext);

  const handleUpdateProfile = (userData) => {
    setUser(userData);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>User Profile</h1>
      {state.user ? (
        <div>
          <p>Name: {state.user.name}</p>
          <p>Email: {state.user.email}</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p>No user logged in</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// 嵌套Context
const UserContext = createContext();
const ThemeContext = createContext();

function CombinedProvider({ children }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('light');

  return (
    <UserContext.Provider value={{ user, setUser }}>
      <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>
        {children}
      </ThemeContext.Provider>
    </UserContext.Provider>
  );
}

function UserComponent() {
  const { user } = useContext(UserContext);
  const { theme } = useContext(ThemeContext);

  return (
    <div className={theme}>
      <h1>Welcome {user?.name || 'Guest'}</h1>
    </div>
  );
}

import { createStore, useSelector, useDispatch } from 'react-redux';

// Action creators
export const setUser = (user) => ({
  type: 'SET_USER',
  payload: user
});

export const setTheme = (theme) => ({
  type: 'SET_THEME',
  payload: theme
});

export const addNotification = (notification) => ({
  type: 'ADD_NOTIFICATION',
  payload: notification
});

// Reducer
const initialState = {
  user: null,
  theme: 'light',
  notifications: []
};

function appReducer(state = initialState, action) {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'SET_USER':
      return { ...state, user: action.payload };
    case 'SET_THEME':
      return { ...state, theme: action.payload };
    case 'ADD_NOTIFICATION':
      return {
        ...state,
        notifications: [...state.notifications, action.payload]
      };
    case 'REMOVE_NOTIFICATION':
      return {
        ...state,
        notifications: state.notifications.filter(
          (notification) => notification.id !== action.payload
        )
      };
    default:
      return state;
  }
}

// Store
const store = createStore(appReducer);

// React组件中使用Redux
function UserProfile() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const user = useSelector((state) => state.user);

  const handleUpdateProfile = (userData) => {
    dispatch(setUser(userData));
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>User Profile</h1>
      {user ? (
        <div>
          <p>Name: {user.name}</p>
          <p>Email: {user.email}</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p>No user logged in</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// Redux Toolkit简化版本
import { createSlice, configureStore } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';

const userSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'user',
  initialState: {
    currentUser: null,
    isLoading: false,
    error: null
  },
  reducers: {
    setUser: (state, action) => {
      state.currentUser = action.payload;
    },
    setLoading: (state, action) => {
      state.isLoading = action.payload;
    },
    setError: (state, action) => {
      state.error = action.payload;
    }
  }
});

const store = configureStore({
  reducer: {
    user: userSlice.reducer
  }
});

// 使用Redux Toolkit
function UserProfile() {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { currentUser, isLoading, error } = useSelector((state) => state.user);

  const handleLogin = async (credentials) => {
    dispatch(userSlice.actions.setLoading(true));
    try {
      const user = await loginUser(credentials);
      dispatch(userSlice.actions.setUser(user));
    } catch (err) {
      dispatch(userSlice.actions.setError(err.message));
    } finally {
      dispatch(userSlice.actions.setLoading(false));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {isLoading ? (
        <div>Loading...</div>
      ) : error ? (
        <div>Error: {error}</div>
      ) : (
        <div>
          {currentUser ? (
            <p>Welcome, {currentUser.name}</p>
          ) : (
            <p>Please log in</p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { makeObservable, observable, action, computed } from 'mobx';
import { observer } from 'mobx-react-lite';

// Store类
class UserStore {
  constructor() {
    makeObservable(this, {
      currentUser: observable,
      isLoading: observable,
      error: observable,
      login: action,
      logout: action,
      isLoggedIn: computed
    });

    this.currentUser = null;
    this.isLoading = false;
    this.error = null;
  }

  async login(credentials) {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.error = null;

    try {
      const user = await api.login(credentials);
      this.currentUser = user;
    } catch (error) {
      this.error = error.message;
    } finally {
      this.isLoading = false;
    }
  }

  logout() {
    this.currentUser = null;
    this.error = null;
  }

  get isLoggedIn() {
    return this.currentUser !== null;
  }
}

// 创建全局store实例
const userStore = new UserStore();

// React组件中使用MobX
const UserProfile = observer(() => {
  const { currentUser, isLoading, error, login, logout } = userStore;

  const handleLogin = async (credentials) => {
    await login(credentials);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {isLoading ? (
        <div>Loading...</div>
      ) : error ? (
        <div>Error: {error}</div>
      ) : (
        <div>
          {currentUser ? (
            <div>
              <p>Welcome, {currentUser.name}</p>
              <button onClick={logout}>Logout</button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div>
              <p>Please log in</p>
              <button onClick={() => handleLogin({ username: 'admin', password: '123' })}>
                Login
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

// 嵌套Store
class AppStore {
  constructor() {
    makeObservable(this, {
      userStore: observable,
      themeStore: observable,
      notificationStore: observable
    });

    this.userStore = new UserStore();
    this.themeStore = new ThemeStore();
    this.notificationStore = new NotificationStore();
  }
}

const appStore = new AppStore();

// Provider组件
const AppProvider = ({ children }) => {
  return (
    <StoreContext.Provider value={appStore}>
      {children}
    </StoreContext.Provider>
  );
};

import { useState, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';

// 状态提升最佳实践
function ParentComponent() {
  const [parentData, setParentData] = useState(null);

  // 状态提升到最近的公共父组件
  const handleChildAction = useCallback((data) => {
    setParentData(data);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div>
      <ChildComponent onAction={handleChildAction} />
      <AnotherChildComponent data={parentData} />
    </div>
  );
}

// 状态本地化最佳实践
function LocalStateComponent() {
  const [localData, setLocalData] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  // 只在需要时使用全局状态
  const globalData = useSelector((state) => state.globalData);

  return (
    <div>
      <p>Local data: {localData}</p>
      <p>Global data: {globalData}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

// 状态不可变性
function ImmutableStateComponent() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState({
    name: 'John',
    preferences: {
      theme: 'light',
      language: 'en'
    }
  });

  const updateTheme = (newTheme) => {
    // 使用展开运算符保持不可变性
    setUser(prevUser => ({
      ...prevUser,
      preferences: {
        ...prevUser.preferences,
        theme: newTheme
      }
    }));
  };

  const updateName = (newName) => {
    setUser(prevUser => ({
      ...prevUser,
      name: newName
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <p>Name: {user.name}</p>
      <p>Theme: {user.preferences.theme}</p>
      <button onClick={() => updateTheme('dark')}>
        Switch to Dark Theme
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// 状态派生和计算
function DerivedStateComponent({ users, filter }) {
  // 使用useMemo计算派生状态
  const filteredUsers = useMemo(() => {
    return users.filter(user =>
      filter ? user.category === filter : true
    );
  }, [users, filter]);

  const activeUsersCount = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredUsers.filter(user => user.isActive).length;
  }, [filteredUsers]);

  // 使用useCallback缓存事件处理函数
  const handleUserAction = useCallback((userId, action) => {
    console.log(`User ${userId} action: ${action}`);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div>
      <p>Total users: {filteredUsers.length}</p>
      <p>Active users: {activeUsersCount}</p>
      <ul>
        {filteredUsers.map(user => (
          <li key={user.id}>
            {user.name}
            <button onClick={() => handleUserAction(user.id, 'activate')}>
              Activate
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

docs.title: 1. 状态更新陷阱
docs.text:
// 错误示例：直接修改状态对象
function BadCounter() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState({ name: 'John', age: 25 });

  const updateAge = () => {
    user.age = 26; // 错误：直接修改状态
    setUser(user); // React不会检测到变化
  };

  return <button onClick={updateAge}>Update Age</button>;
}

// 正确示例：使用展开运算符保持不可变性
function GoodCounter() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState({ name: 'John', age: 25 });

  const updateAge = () => {
    setUser(prevUser => ({
      ...prevUser,
      age: 26
    }));
  };

  return <button onClick={updateAge}>Update Age</button>;
}

// 错误示例：异步状态更新问题
function BadAsyncCounter() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  const incrementTwice = () => {
    setCount(count + 1); // 异步，可能不是期望的值
    setCount(count + 1); // 两个setCount使用相同的初始值
  };

  return <button onClick={incrementTwice}>Increment Twice</button>;
}

// 正确示例：使用函数式更新
function GoodAsyncCounter() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  const incrementTwice = () => {
    setCount(prevCount => prevCount + 1);
    setCount(prevCount => prevCount + 1); // 使用更新后的值
  };

  return <button onClick={incrementTwice}>Increment Twice</button>;
}

// 错误示例：事件处理函数中的this问题
class BadEventHandler extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { message: 'Hello' };
  }

  handleClick() {
    console.log(this.state.message); // this为undefined
  }

  render() {
    return <button onClick={this.handleClick}>Click me</button>;
  }
}

// 正确示例1：使用箭头函数
class GoodEventHandler1 extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { message: 'Hello' };
  }

  handleClick = () => {
    console.log(this.state.message); // this正确绑定
  };

  render() {
    return <button onClick={this.handleClick}>Click me</button>;
  }
}

// 正确示例2：在render中使用箭头函数
class GoodEventHandler2 extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { message: 'Hello' };
  }

  handleClick() {
    console.log(this.state.message);
  }

  render() {
    return <button onClick={() => this.handleClick()}>Click me</button>;
  }
}

// 错误示例：传递参数时的问题
function BadParameterHandler({ items }) {
  const handleDelete = (item) => {
    console.log('Delete item:', item);
  };

  return (
    <ul>
      {items.map(item => (
        <li key={item.id}>
          {item.name}
          <button onClick={handleDelete(item)}>Delete</button>
          {/* 错误：函数立即执行，而不是点击时执行 */}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

// 正确示例：使用箭头函数包装
function GoodParameterHandler({ items }) {
  const handleDelete = (item) => {
    console.log('Delete item:', item);
  };

  return (
    <ul>
      {items.map(item => (
        <li key={item.id}>
          {item.name}
          <button onClick={() => handleDelete(item)}>Delete</button>
          {/* 正确：点击时执行 */}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

function BadListRenderer({ items }) {

      {items.map((item, index) => (

function GoodListRenderer({ items }) {
  return (
    <ul>
      {items.map(item => (
        <li key={item.id}>{item.name}</li>
        {/* 正确：使用item.id作为key */}
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

// 错误示例：在map中直接使用索引
function BadIndexRenderer({ items }) {
  return (
    <ul>
      {items.map((item, index) => (
        <li key={item.id}>
          {index}: {item.name}
          {/* 可能的问题：如果items重新排序，索引会改变 */}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

// 正确示例：使用稳定的key和显示索引
function GoodIndexRenderer({ items }) {
  return (
    <ul>
      {items.map((item, index) => (
        <li key={item.id} data-index={index}>
          {index + 1}: {item.name}
          {/* 正确：显示索引从1开始，key使用稳定ID */}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

// 错误示例：使用相等运算符而不是严格相等
function BadConditionalRenderer({ user }) {
  return (
    <div>
      {user == null ? (
        <div>Loading...</div>
      ) : user.name ? (
        <div>Welcome, {user.name}</div>
      ) : (
        <div>Anonymous User</div>
      )}

function GoodConditionalRenderer({ user }) {
  return (
    <div>
      {user === null || user === undefined ? (
        <div>Loading...</div>
      ) : user.name ? (
        <div>Welcome, {user.name}</div>
      ) : (
        <div>Anonymous User</div>
      )}
      {/* 正确：明确检查null和undefined */}
    </div>
  );
}

// 错误示例：短路逻辑的陷阱
function BadShortCircuitRenderer({ items, showItems }) {
  return (
    <div>
      {showItems && items.map(item => <div key={item.id}>{item.name}</div>)}
      {/* 错误：如果items为空数组，&&会返回[]，导致渲染问题 */}
    </div>
  );
}

// 正确示例：明确检查数组长度
function GoodShortCircuitRenderer({ items, showItems }) {
  return (
    <div>
      {showItems && items.length > 0 && (
        items.map(item => <div key={item.id}>{item.name}</div>)
      )}
      {/* 正确：明确检查数组长度 */}
    </div>
  );
}

docs.title: 5. useEffect依赖项陷阱
docs.text:
// 错误示例：缺少依赖项
function BadEffectDependencies({ userId }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchUser(userId).then(setUser);
    // 错误：缺少userId依赖项，userId变化时不会重新执行
  }, []); // 空依赖数组

  return user ? <div>{user.name}</div> : <div>Loading...</div>;
}

// 正确示例：正确设置依赖项
function GoodEffectDependencies({ userId }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchUser(userId).then(setUser);
  }, [userId]); // 正确：包含userId依赖项

  return user ? <div>{user.name}</div> : <div>Loading...</div>;
}

// 错误示例：依赖项中包含对象或函数
function BadObjectDependencies() {
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    category: 'all',
    sortBy: 'name'
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchProducts(filters).then(setProducts);
  }, [filters]); // 错误：每次filters对象变化都会重新执行

  return <div>Products: {products.length}</div>;
}

// 正确示例：使用useMemo缓存依赖项
function GoodObjectDependencies() {
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    category: 'all',
    sortBy: 'name'
  });

  const stableFilters = useMemo(() => ({
    category: filters.category,
    sortBy: filters.sortBy
  }), [filters.category, filters.sortBy]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchProducts(stableFilters).then(setProducts);
  }, [stableFilters]); // 正确：只有实际值变化时才会重新执行

  return <div>Products: {products.length}</div>;
}

docs.text:
// 错误示例：父组件直接修改子组件状态
function BadParentChildCommunication() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const childRef = React.createRef();

  const handleIncrement = () => {
    setCount(count + 1);
    childRef.current.resetCounter(); // 错误：直接操作子组件
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <ChildComponent ref={childRef} />
      <button onClick={handleIncrement}>Increment</button>
    </div>
  );
}

// 正确示例：通过props和回调函数通信
function GoodParentChildCommunication() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  const handleChildReset = () => {
    setCount(0);
  };

  const handleIncrement = () => {
    setCount(count + 1);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <ChildComponent count={count} onReset={handleChildReset} />
      <button onClick={handleIncrement}>Increment</button>
    </div>
  );
}

// 错误示例：Context过度使用
function BadContextOveruse() {
  const UserContext = createContext();

  function App() {
    const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
    const [theme, setTheme] = useState('light');
    const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState([]);
    const [filters, setFilters] = useState({});
    const [sorting, setSorting] = useState({});

    return (
      <UserContext.Provider value={{
        user, setUser,
        theme, setTheme,
        notifications, setNotifications,
        filters, setFilters,
        sorting, setSorting
      }}>
        {/* 错误：所有状态都放在一个Context中 */}
        <AppContent />
      </UserContext.Provider>
    );
  }
}

// 正确示例：分离不同类型的Context
function GoodContextSeparation() {
  const UserContext = createContext();
  const ThemeContext = createContext();
  const NotificationContext = createContext();

  function App() {
    const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
    const [theme, setTheme] = useState('light');
    const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState([]);

    return (
      <UserContext.Provider value={{ user, setUser }}>
        <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>
          <NotificationContext.Provider value={{ notifications, setNotifications }}>
            <AppContent />
          </NotificationContext.Provider>

  }, [filteredItems]); // 正确：依赖项是计算结果

  return (

// 错误示例：错误边界组件过于宽泛
class BadErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    console.log('Error caught:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return <div>Something went wrong</div>; // 错误：过于宽泛的错误处理
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

// 正确示例：特定错误类型的处理
class GoodErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = {
      hasError: false,
      errorType: null,
      errorMessage: null
    };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return {
      hasError: true,
      errorType: error.name,
      errorMessage: error.message
    };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    console.log('Error caught:', error, errorInfo);

    // 区分不同类型的错误
    if (error.name === 'NetworkError') {
      // 处理网络错误
      this.handleNetworkError(error);
    } else if (error.name === 'ValidationError') {
      // 处理验证错误
      this.handleValidationError(error);
    } else {
      // 处理其他错误
      this.handleGenericError(error);
    }
  }

  handleNetworkError(error) {
    console.log('Handling network error:', error);
  }

  handleValidationError(error) {
    console.log('Handling validation error:', error);
  }

  handleGenericError(error) {
    console.log('Handling generic error:', error);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div>
          <h2>Error occurred</h2>
          <p>Error type: {this.state.errorType}</p>
          <p>Error message: {this.state.errorMessage}</p>
          <button onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false })}>
            Try again
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

// 错误边界组件用于调试
class DebugErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = {
      hasError: false,
      error: null,
      errorInfo: null
    };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    console.error('React Error Boundary caught an error:', error, errorInfo);

    this.setState({
      error,
      errorInfo
    });

    // 发送错误到日志服务
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
      logErrorToService(error, errorInfo);
    }
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div style={{ padding: '20px', backgroundColor: '#ffe6e6' }}>
          <h2>Something went wrong.</h2>
          <details style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>
            <summary>Error Details</summary>
            {this.state.error && this.state.error.toString()}
            <br />
            {this.state.errorInfo.componentStack}
          </details>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

const debugFetch = (url, options = {}) => {
  console.log('Fetch request:', { url, options });

  const startTime = performance.now();

  return fetch(url, options)
    .then(response => {
      const endTime = performance.now();
      const duration = endTime - startTime;

      console.log('Fetch response:', {
        url,
        status: response.status,
        duration: `${duration.toFixed(2)}ms`
      });

      return response;
    })
    .catch(error => {
      const endTime = performance.now();
      const duration = endTime - startTime;

      console.error('Fetch error:', {
        url,
        error: error.message,
        duration: `${duration.toFixed(2)}ms`
      });

      throw error;
    });
};

// WebSocket调试
class DebugWebSocket {
  constructor(url) {
    this.url = url;
    this.ws = new WebSocket(url);
    this.setupDebugging();
  }

  setupDebugging() {
    this.ws.onopen = () => {
      console.log('WebSocket connected:', this.url);
    };

    this.ws.onmessage = (event) => {
      console.log('WebSocket message received:', event.data);
    };

    this.ws.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('WebSocket error:', error);
    };

    this.ws.onclose = (event) => {
      console.log('WebSocket closed:', {
        code: event.code,
        reason: event.reason,
        wasClean: event.wasClean
      });
    };
  }

  send(data) {
    console.log('WebSocket sending:', data);
    this.ws.send(data);
  }

  close() {
    console.log('WebSocket closing:', this.url);
    this.ws.close();
  }
}

  // 只负责用户资料展示，不处理其他逻辑

    fetchUser(userId).then(setUser).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [userId]);

  if (loading) return <LoadingSpinner />;
  if (!user) return <ErrorMessage message="User not found" />;

  return (
    <div>
      <UserAvatar user={user} />
      <UserInfo user={user} />
      <UserActions user={user} />
    </div>
  );
}

// 组件组合优于继承
function Button({ children, variant, ...props }) {
  return (
    <button className={`btn btn-${variant}`} {...props}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function IconButton({ icon, children, ...props }) {
  return (
    <Button {...props}>
      <Icon name={icon} />
      {children}
    </Button>
  );
}

docs.title: 4. 错误处理最佳实践
docs.text:
// 错误边界
class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    // 记录错误到监控系统
    logErrorToService(error, errorInfo);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return <ErrorFallback />;
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

// 异步错误处理
async function fetchDataWithErrorHandling() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/data');
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
    }
    return await response.json();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Fetch error:', error);
    throw new AppError('Failed to fetch data', error);
  }
}

docs.text:
// 输入验证和清理
import DOMPurify from 'dompurify';

function SafeInput({ value, onChange }) {
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState(value);

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const sanitizedValue = DOMPurify.sanitize(e.target.value);
    setInputValue(sanitizedValue);
    onChange(sanitizedValue);
  };

  return (
    <input
      value={inputValue}
      onChange={handleChange}
      maxLength={100}
    />
  );
}

// XSS防护
function SafeDisplay({ content }) {
  return (
    <div
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: DOMPurify.sanitize(content)
      }}
    />
  );
}

// CSRF防护
function useCSRFToken() {
  const [token, setToken] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/csrf-token')
      .then(response => response.json())
      .then(data => setToken(data.token));
  }, []);

  return token;
}

docs.text: Vue.js是一套用于构建用户界面的渐进式JavaScript框架。由尤雨溪创建，Vue.js专注于视图层，具有简单灵活的API和优秀的性能。

docs.title: 1. 响应式数据绑定
docs.text:
// Vue 3 响应式系统
import { createApp, ref, reactive } from 'vue';

const app = createApp({
  setup() {
    // 基础响应式数据
    const count = ref(0);
    const message = ref('Hello Vue!');

    // 对象响应式数据
    const user = reactive({
      name: 'John',
      age: 25
    });

    // 计算属性
    const doubleCount = computed(() => count.value * 2);

    return {
      count,
      message,
      user,
      doubleCount
    };
  },
  template: `
    <div>
      <p>{{ message }}</p>
      <p>Count: {{ count }}</p>
      <p>Double Count: {{ doubleCount }}</p>
      <p>User: {{ user.name }}, Age: {{ user.age }}</p>
      <button @click="count++">Increment</button>
    </div>
  `
});

    msg: String
  },
  template: `
    <div class="hello-world">
      <h1>{{ msg }}</h1>
    </div>
  `
};

// 组合式API组件
const Counter = {
  setup(props, { emit }) {
    const count = ref(0);

    const increment = () => {
      count.value++;
      emit('update', count.value);
    };

    return {
      count,
      increment
    };
  },
  emits: ['update'],
  template: `
    <div>
      <p>Count: {{ count }}</p>
      <button @click="increment">Increment</button>
    </div>
  `
};

// 组件注册和使用
const app = createApp({
  components: {
    HelloWorld,
    Counter
  },
  template: `
    <div>
      <HelloWorld msg="Welcome to Vue" />
      <Counter @update="handleUpdate" />
    </div>
  `,
  methods: {
    handleUpdate(value) {
      console.log('Count updated:', value);
    }
  }
});

// Vue 3 Composition API
import { createApp, ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue';

createApp({
  setup() {
    const message = ref('Hello Vue 3!');
    const reversedMessage = computed(() =>
      message.value.split('').reverse().join('')
    );

    onMounted(() => {
      console.log('Vue 3 app mounted');
    });

    const reverseMessage = () => {
      message.value = reversedMessage.value;
    };

    return {
      message,
      reversedMessage,
      reverseMessage
    };
  },
  template: `
    <div>
      <p>{{ message }}</p>
      <p>Reversed: {{ reversedMessage }}</p>
      <button @click="reverseMessage">Reverse</button>
    </div>
  `
}).mount('#app');

// v-show vs v-if 对比
const ShowVsIf = {
  data() {
    return {
      shouldShow: false,
      shouldRender: false
    };
  },
  methods: {
    toggleShow() {
      this.shouldShow = !this.shouldShow;
    },
    toggleRender() {
      this.shouldRender = !this.shouldRender;
    }
  },
  template: `
    <div>
      <h3>v-show vs v-if</h3>

      <!-- v-show: 切换display属性，保留DOM -->
      <div v-show="shouldShow" style="background: lightblue;">
        This is shown with v-show
      </div>
      <button @click="toggleShow">Toggle v-show</button>

      <!-- v-if: 条件渲染，销毁/重建DOM -->
      <div v-if="shouldRender" style="background: lightgreen;">
        This is rendered with v-if
      </div>
      <button @click="toggleRender">Toggle v-if</button>

      <!-- 性能考虑 -->
      <div v-if="isExpensiveOperation()">
        <!-- 复杂计算，只在条件满足时执行 -->
        {{ expensiveComputation() }}
      </div>

      <div v-show="isExpensiveOperation()">
        <!-- 简单显示，始终执行计算 -->
        {{ expensiveComputation() }}
      </div>
    </div>
  `,
  methods: {
    isExpensiveOperation() {
      console.log('Expensive operation called');
      return true;
    },
    expensiveComputation() {
      console.log('Expensive computation executed');
      return 'Computed result';
    }
  }
};

// 计算属性
const ComputedProperties = {
  data() {
    return {
      firstName: 'John',
      lastName: 'Doe',
      items: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
      users: [
        { name: 'Alice', age: 25 },
        { name: 'Bob', age: 30 },
        { name: 'Charlie', age: 35 }
      ]
    };
  },
  computed: {
    // 基础计算属性
    fullName() {
      return `${this.firstName} ${this.lastName}`;
    },

    // 带setter的计算属性
    fullNameWithSetter: {
      get() {
        return `${this.firstName} ${this.lastName}`;
      },
      set(newValue) {
        const names = newValue.split(' ');
        this.firstName = names[0];
        this.lastName = names[1] || '';
      }
    },

    // 数组计算属性
    sumItems() {
      return this.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item, 0);
    },

    // 对象数组计算属性
    averageAge() {
      if (this.users.length === 0) return 0;
      const totalAge = this.users.reduce((sum, user) => sum + user.age, 0);
      return totalAge / this.users.length;
    },

    // 过滤计算属性
    adultUsers() {
      return this.users.filter(user => user.age >= 18);
    }
  },
  template: `
    <div>
      <h3>Computed Properties</h3>

      <input v-model="firstName" placeholder="First name" />
      <input v-model="lastName" placeholder="Last name" />
      <p>Full Name: {{ fullName }}</p>

      <input v-model="fullNameWithSetter" placeholder="Full name with setter" />
      <p>First: {{ firstName }}, Last: {{ lastName }}</p>

      <p>Sum of items: {{ sumItems }}</p>
      <p>Average age: {{ averageAge }}</p>
      <p>Adult users: {{ adultUsers.length }}</p>
    </div>
  `
};

// watch 侦听器
const WatchProperties = {
  data() {
    return {
      message: '',
      user: {
        name: '',
        email: ''
      },
      searchQuery: '',
      filteredItems: []
    };
  },
  watch: {
    // 基础侦听器
    message(newValue, oldValue) {
      console.log('Message changed:', oldValue, '->', newValue);
    },

    // 深度侦听器
    user: {
      handler(newValue, oldValue) {
        console.log('User object changed:', oldValue, '->', newValue);
      },
      deep: true
    },

    // 立即执行侦听器
    searchQuery: {
      immediate: true,
      handler(newValue) {
        this.filterItems();
      }
    }
  },
  methods: {
    filterItems() {
      // 模拟搜索过滤
      this.filteredItems = this.items.filter(item =>
        item.toLowerCase().includes(this.searchQuery.toLowerCase())
      );
    }
  },
  template: `
    <div>
      <h3>Watch Properties</h3>

      <input v-model="message" placeholder="Type something..." />
      <p>Message: {{ message }}</p>

        @child-message="handleChildMessage"
        @multiple-messages="handleMultipleMessages"
      />

  `,

    handleChildMessage(message) {
      this.parentMessage = message;
    },
    handleMultipleMessages(messages) {
      this.childMessages = messages;
    }
  },
  components: {

      data() {
        return {
          messageToSend: '',
          internalMessages: []
        };
      },
      emits: ['child-message', 'multiple-messages'],
      template: `

            v-model="messageToSend"
            placeholder="Send message to parent"
          />

            Send Multiple Messages
          </button>

          this.$emit('multiple-messages', messages);
        }
      }
    }
  }

// components/CounterComposition.vue
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue';

export default {
  name: 'CounterComposition',
  setup() {
    // 响应式数据
    const count = ref(0);
    const message = ref('点击按钮增加计数');

    // 计算属性
    const isPositive = computed(() => count.value > 0);
    const isNegative = computed(() => count.value < 0);
    const displayCount = computed(() => count.value);

    // 方法
    const increment = () => {
      count.value++;
      updateMessage();
    };

    const decrement = () => {
      count.value--;
      updateMessage();
    };

    const reset = () => {
      count.value = 0;
      updateMessage();
    };

    const updateMessage = () => {
      if (count.value > 0) {
        message.value = `当前计数: ${count.value}`;
      } else if (count.value < 0) {
        message.value = `计数为负: ${count.value}`;
      } else {
        message.value = '点击按钮增加计数';
      }
    };

    // 生命周期钩子
    onMounted(() => {
      console.log('CounterComposition component mounted');
    });

    return {
      count,
      message,
      isPositive,
      isNegative,
      displayCount,
      increment,
      decrement,
      reset
    };
  },
  template: `
    <div class="counter">
      <h2>Composition API 计数器</h2>
      <p>{{ message }}</p>
      <div class="counter-status">
        <span v-if="isPositive" class="positive">正数</span>
        <span v-else-if="isNegative" class="negative">负数</span>
        <span v-else class="zero">零</span>
      </div>
      <div class="counter-controls">
        <button @click="decrement">-</button>
        <span class="count-display">{{ displayCount }}</span>
        <button @click="increment">+</button>
      </div>
      <button @click="reset" class="reset-btn">重置</button>
    </div>
  `
};

// components/TodoList.vue
export default {
  name: 'TodoList',
  data() {
    return {
      todos: [],
      newTodo: '',
      filter: 'all' // all, active, completed
    };
  },
  computed: {
    filteredTodos() {
      switch (this.filter) {
        case 'active':
          return this.todos.filter(todo => !todo.completed);
        case 'completed':
          return this.todos.filter(todo => todo.completed);
        default:
          return this.todos;
      }
    },
    activeTodosCount() {
      return this.todos.filter(todo => !todo.completed).length;
    },
    completedTodosCount() {
      return this.todos.filter(todo => todo.completed).length;
    },
    hasTodos() {
      return this.todos.length > 0;
    }
  },
  methods: {
    addTodo() {
      if (this.newTodo.trim()) {
        const todo = {
          id: Date.now(),
          text: this.newTodo.trim(),
          completed: false,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        this.todos.push(todo);
        this.newTodo = '';
      }
    },
    toggleTodo(todo) {
      todo.completed = !todo.completed;
    },
    removeTodo(todo) {
      const index = this.todos.indexOf(todo);
      if (index > -1) {
        this.todos.splice(index, 1);
      }
    },
    clearCompleted() {
      this.todos = this.todos.filter(todo => !todo.completed);
    },
    setFilter(newFilter) {
      this.filter = newFilter;
    }
  },
  template: `
    <div class="todo-list">
      <h2>待办事项</h2>

      <!-- 添加新待办事项 -->
      <div class="todo-input">
        <input
          v-model="newTodo"
          @keyup.enter="addTodo"
          placeholder="添加新的待办事项..."
        />
        <button @click="addTodo">添加</button>
      </div>

      <!-- 过滤器 -->
      <div class="todo-filters" v-if="hasTodos">
        <button
          @click="setFilter('all')"
          :class="{ active: filter === 'all' }"
        >
          全部 ({{ todos.length }})
        </button>
        <button
          @click="setFilter('active')"
          :class="{ active: filter === 'active' }"
        >
          进行中 ({{ activeTodosCount }})
        </button>
        <button
          @click="setFilter('completed')"
          :class="{ active: filter === 'completed' }"
        >
          已完成 ({{ completedTodosCount }})
        </button>
      </div>

      <!-- 待办事项列表 -->
      <ul class="todo-items" v-if="hasTodos">
        <li
          v-for="todo in filteredTodos"
          :key="todo.id"
          :class="{ completed: todo.completed }"
        >
          <label>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              v-model="todo.completed"
              @change="toggleTodo(todo)"
            />
            <span class="todo-text">{{ todo.text }}</span>
          </label>
          <button
            @click="removeTodo(todo)"
            class="remove-btn"
          >
            删除
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>

      <!-- 空状态 -->
      <div v-else class="empty-state">
        <p>还没有待办事项，添加一个吧！</p>
      </div>

      <!-- 底部操作 -->
      <div class="todo-footer" v-if="hasTodos">
        <span>总计: {{ todos.length }} 项</span>
        <button
          @click="clearCompleted"
          v-if="completedTodosCount > 0"
        >
          清除已完成 ({{ completedTodosCount }})
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `
};

// components/UserList.vue
export default {
  name: 'UserList',
  data() {
    return {
      users: [
        {
          id: 1,
          name: '张三',
          email: 'zhangsan@example.com',
          age: 25,
          department: '技术部',
          isActive: true
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          name: '李四',
          email: 'lisi@example.com',
          age: 30,
          department: '市场部',
          isActive: false
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          name: '王五',
          email: 'wangwu@example.com',
          age: 28,
          department: '人事部',
          isActive: true
        }
      ],
      searchQuery: '',
      sortBy: 'name',
      sortOrder: 'asc',
      selectedUser: null
    };
  },
  computed: {
    filteredUsers() {
      let filtered = this.users;

      // 搜索过滤
      if (this.searchQuery) {
        const query = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        filtered = filtered.filter(user =>
          user.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          user.email.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          user.department.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        );
      }

      // 排序
      return filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        let aValue = a[this.sortBy];
        let bValue = b[this.sortBy];

        if (typeof aValue === 'string') {
          aValue = aValue.toLowerCase();
          bValue = bValue.toLowerCase();
        }

        if (this.sortOrder === 'asc') {
          return aValue > bValue ? 1 : -1;
        } else {
          return aValue < bValue ? 1 : -1;
        }
      });
    },
    activeUsersCount() {
      return this.users.filter(user => user.isActive).length;
    },
    departments() {
      return [...new Set(this.users.map(user => user.department))];
    }
  },
  methods: {
    toggleUserStatus(user) {
      user.isActive = !user.isActive;
    },
    removeUser(user) {
      const index = this.users.indexOf(user);
      if (index > -1) {
        this.users.splice(index, 1);
      }
    },
    selectUser(user) {
      this.selectedUser = { ...user }; // 深拷贝
    },
    updateUser() {
      if (this.selectedUser) {
        const index = this.users.findIndex(user => user.id === this.selectedUser.id);
        if (index > -1) {
          this.$set(this.users, index, { ...this.selectedUser });
        }
        this.selectedUser = null;
      }
    },
    setSortBy(field) {
      if (this.sortBy === field) {
        this.sortOrder = this.sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
      } else {
        this.sortBy = field;
        this.sortOrder = 'asc';
      }
    }
  },
  template: `
    <div class="user-list">
      <h2>用户管理</h2>

      <!-- 搜索和排序 -->
      <div class="user-controls">
        <input
          v-model="searchQuery"
          placeholder="搜索用户..."
          class="search-input"
        />
        <select v-model="sortBy" @change="setSortBy(sortBy)">
          <option value="name">按姓名排序</option>
          <option value="age">按年龄排序</option>
          <option value="department">按部门排序</option>
        </select>
        <button @click="sortOrder = sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'">
          {{ sortOrder === 'asc' ? '升序' : '降序' }}
        </button>
      </div>

      <!-- 统计信息 -->
      <div class="user-stats">
        <span>总用户数: {{ users.length }}</span>
        <span>活跃用户: {{ activeUsersCount }}</span>
        <span>部门数: {{ departments.length }}</span>
      </div>

      <!-- 用户列表 -->
      <table class="user-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th @click="setSortBy('name')">姓名</th>
            <th @click="setSortBy('email')">邮箱</th>
            <th @click="setSortBy('age')">年龄</th>
            <th @click="setSortBy('department')">部门</th>
            <th>状态</th>
            <th>操作</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr v-for="user in filteredUsers" :key="user.id">
            <td>{{ user.name }}</td>
            <td>{{ user.email }}</td>
            <td>{{ user.age }}</td>
            <td>{{ user.department }}</td>
            <td>
              <span
                :class="['status-badge', user.isActive ? 'active' : 'inactive']"
              >
                {{ user.isActive ? '活跃' : '非活跃' }}
              </span>
            </td>
            <td>
              <button @click="selectUser(user)">编辑</button>
              <button @click="toggleUserStatus(user)">
                {{ user.isActive ? '停用' : '启用' }}
              </button>
              <button @click="removeUser(user)">删除</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <!-- 用户编辑模态框 -->
      <div v-if="selectedUser" class="modal-overlay">
        <div class="modal">
          <h3>编辑用户</h3>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label>姓名:</label>
            <input v-model="selectedUser.name" />
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label>邮箱:</label>
            <input v-model="selectedUser.email" type="email" />
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label>年龄:</label>
            <input v-model="selectedUser.age" type="number" />
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label>部门:</label>
            <select v-model="selectedUser.department">
              <option value="技术部">技术部</option>
              <option value="市场部">市场部</option>
              <option value="人事部">人事部</option>
              <option value="财务部">财务部</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                v-model="selectedUser.isActive"
              />

            </label>
          </div>
          <div class="modal-actions">
            <button @click="updateUser">保存</button>
            <button @click="selectedUser = null">取消</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

// components/ChatApp.vue
export default {
  name: 'ChatApp',
  data() {
    return {
      messages: [],
      newMessage: '',
      username: '',
      isConnected: false,
      typingUsers: []
    };
  },
  computed: {
    formattedMessages() {
      return this.messages.map(msg => ({
        ...msg,
        timestamp: new Date(msg.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString(),
        isOwn: msg.username === this.username
      }));
    },
    isTyping() {
      return this.typingUsers.length > 0;
    }
  },
  methods: {
    connect() {
      if (this.username.trim()) {
        this.isConnected = true;
        this.addSystemMessage(`${this.username} 加入聊天室`);
      }
    },
    disconnect() {
      if (this.isConnected) {
        this.addSystemMessage(`${this.username} 离开聊天室`);
        this.isConnected = false;
        this.username = '';
      }
    },
    sendMessage() {
      if (this.newMessage.trim() && this.isConnected) {
        const message = {
          id: Date.now(),
          username: this.username,
          text: this.newMessage.trim(),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          type: 'user'
        };
        this.messages.push(message);
        this.newMessage = '';

        // 模拟其他用户正在输入
        this.simulateTyping();
      }
    },
    addSystemMessage(text) {
      const message = {
        id: Date.now(),
        username: '系统',
        text: text,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        type: 'system'
      };
      this.messages.push(message);
    },
    simulateTyping() {
      // 模拟其他用户正在输入
      const typingUser = `用户${Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 1}`;
      this.typingUsers.push(typingUser);

      setTimeout(() => {
        this.typingUsers = this.typingUsers.filter(user => user !== typingUser);
      }, 2000);
    }
  },
  template: `
    <div class="chat-app">
      <h2>实时聊天室</h2>

      <!-- 连接界面 -->
      <div v-if="!isConnected" class="connection-form">
        <input
          v-model="username"
          placeholder="输入用户名..."
          @keyup.enter="connect"
        />
        <button @click="connect">加入聊天室</button>
      </div>

      <!-- 聊天界面 -->
      <div v-else class="chat-interface">
        <!-- 消息列表 -->
        <div class="messages-container">
          <div
            v-for="message in formattedMessages"
            :key="message.id"
            :class="['message', message.type, { own: message.isOwn }]"
          >
            <div class="message-header">
              <span class="username">{{ message.username }}</span>
              <span class="timestamp">{{ message.timestamp }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="message-text">{{ message.text }}</div>
          </div>

          <!-- 正在输入指示器 -->
          <div v-if="isTyping" class="typing-indicator">
            <span>{{ typingUsers.join(', ') }} 正在输入...</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 输入区域 -->
        <div class="input-area">
          <input
            v-model="newMessage"
            @keyup.enter="sendMessage"
            placeholder="输入消息..."
            class="message-input"
          />
          <button @click="sendMessage">发送</button>
          <button @click="disconnect" class="disconnect-btn">离开</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `
};

export default {
  name: 'DataVisualization',
  data() {
    return {
      chartData: [
        { label: '一月', value: 120 },
        { label: '二月', value: 150 },
        { label: '三月', value: 180 },
        { label: '四月', value: 200 },
        { label: '五月', value: 170 },
        { label: '六月', value: 220 }
      ],
      chartType: 'bar', // bar, line, pie
      showDataTable: false,
      maxValue: 0
    };
  },
  computed: {
    processedData() {
      return this.chartData.map(item => ({
        ...item,
        percentage: this.maxValue > 0 ? (item.value / this.maxValue) * 100 : 0
      }));
    },
    totalValue() {
      return this.chartData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.value, 0);
    },
    averageValue() {
      return this.chartData.length > 0 ? this.totalValue / this.chartData.length : 0;
    }
  },
  methods: {
    addDataPoint() {
      const months = ['七月', '八月', '九月', '十月', '十一月', '十二月'];
      const newPoint = {
        label: months[Math.floor(Math.random() * months.length)],
        value: Math.floor(Math.random() * 250) + 50
      };
      this.chartData.push(newPoint);
    },
    removeDataPoint(index) {
      this.chartData.splice(index, 1);
    },
    updateChartType(type) {
      this.chartType = type;
    },
    toggleDataTable() {
      this.showDataTable = !this.showDataTable;
    }
  },
  mounted() {
    this.maxValue = Math.max(...this.chartData.map(item => item.value));
  },
  template: `
    <div class="data-visualization">
      <h2>数据可视化</h2>

      <!-- 图表类型选择 -->
      <div class="chart-controls">
        <button
          @click="updateChartType('bar')"
          :class="{ active: chartType === 'bar' }"
        >
          柱状图
        </button>
        <button
          @click="updateChartType('line')"
          :class="{ active: chartType === 'line' }"
        >
          折线图
        </button>
        <button
          @click="updateChartType('pie')"
          :class="{ active: chartType === 'pie' }"
        >
          饼图
        </button>
        <button @click="addDataPoint">添加数据</button>
        <button @click="toggleDataTable">
          {{ showDataTable ? '隐藏' : '显示' }}数据表
        </button>
      </div>

      <!-- 统计信息 -->
      <div class="chart-stats">
        <span>数据点: {{ chartData.length }}</span>
        <span>总值: {{ totalValue }}</span>
        <span>平均值: {{ averageValue.toFixed(1) }}</span>
        <span>最大值: {{ maxValue }}</span>
      </div>

      <!-- 图表显示区域 -->
      <div class="chart-display">
        <!-- 柱状图 -->
        <div v-if="chartType === 'bar'" class="bar-chart">
          <div
            v-for="(item, index) in processedData"
            :key="index"
            class="bar-item"
          >
            <div class="bar-container">
              <div
                class="bar"
                :style="{ height: item.percentage + '%' }"
              ></div>
            </div>
            <div class="bar-label">{{ item.label }}</div>
            <div class="bar-value">{{ item.value }}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 折线图 -->
        <div v-else-if="chartType === 'line'" class="line-chart">
          <svg width="400" height="200" class="line-svg">
            <polyline
              :points="getLinePoints()"
              fill="none"
              stroke="#3498db"
              stroke-width="2"
            />
            <circle
              v-for="(item, index) in processedData"
              :key="index"
              :cx="getPointX(index)"
              :cy="getPointY(item.value)"
              r="4"
              fill="#3498db"
            />
          </svg>
        </div>

        <!-- 饼图 -->
        <div v-else-if="chartType === 'pie'" class="pie-chart">
          <svg width="200" height="200" class="pie-svg">
            <g v-for="(item, index) in processedData" :key="index">
              <path
                :d="getPieSlicePath(index)"
                :fill="getSliceColor(index)"
                stroke="white"
                stroke-width="2"
              />
            </g>
          </svg>
          <div class="pie-legend">
            <div
              v-for="(item, index) in processedData"
              :key="index"
              class="legend-item"
            >
              <span
                class="legend-color"
                :style="{ backgroundColor: getSliceColor(index) }"
              ></span>
              <span>{{ item.label }}: {{ item.value }}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- 数据表格 -->
      <div v-if="showDataTable" class="data-table">
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>标签</th>
              <th>数值</th>
              <th>百分比</th>
              <th>操作</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr v-for="(item, index) in processedData" :key="index">
              <td>{{ item.label }}</td>
              <td>{{ item.value }}</td>
              <td>{{ item.percentage.toFixed(1) }}%</td>
              <td>
                <button @click="removeDataPoint(index)">删除</button>
              </td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  `,
  methods: {
    getLinePoints() {
      const width = 400;
      const height = 200;
      const maxValue = Math.max(...this.chartData.map(item => item.value));

      return this.chartData.map((item, index) => {
        const x = (index / (this.chartData.length - 1)) * width;
        const y = height - (item.value / maxValue) * height;
        return `${x},${y}`;
      }).join(' ');
    },
    getPointX(index) {
      const width = 400;
      return (index / (this.chartData.length - 1)) * width;
    },
    getPointY(value) {
      const height = 200;
      const maxValue = Math.max(...this.chartData.map(item => item.value));
      return height - (value / maxValue) * height;
    },
    getPieSlicePath(index) {
      // 简化的饼图路径计算
      const centerX = 100;
      const centerY = 100;
      const radius = 80;
      const startAngle = (index / this.chartData.length) * 2 * Math.PI;
      const endAngle = ((index + 1) / this.chartData.length) * 2 * Math.PI;

      const x1 = centerX + radius * Math.cos(startAngle);
      const y1 = centerY + radius * Math.sin(startAngle);
      const x2 = centerX + radius * Math.cos(endAngle);
      const y2 = centerY + radius * Math.sin(endAngle);

      const largeArcFlag = endAngle - startAngle > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;

      return `M ${centerX} ${centerY} L ${x1} ${y1} A ${radius} ${radius} 0 ${largeArcFlag} 1 ${x2} ${y2} Z`;
    },
    getSliceColor(index) {
      const colors = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c', '#2ecc71', '#f39c12', '#9b59b6', '#1abc9c'];
      return colors[index % colors.length];
    }
  }
};

// composables/useWebSocket.js
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue';

export function useWebSocket(url, options = {}) {
  const ws = ref(null);
  const isConnected = ref(false);
  const messages = ref([]);
  const error = ref(null);

  const connect = () => {
    try {
      ws.value = new WebSocket(url);

      ws.value.onopen = () => {
        isConnected.value = true;
        console.log('WebSocket connected');
      };

      ws.value.onmessage = (event) => {
        const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
        messages.value.push({
          ...data,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        });
      };

      ws.value.onclose = () => {
        isConnected.value = false;
        console.log('WebSocket disconnected');
      };

      ws.value.onerror = (event) => {
        error.value = event;
        console.error('WebSocket error:', event);
      };
    } catch (err) {
      error.value = err;
    }
  };

  const disconnect = () => {
    if (ws.value) {
      ws.value.close();
    }
  };

  const sendMessage = (message) => {
    if (ws.value && isConnected.value) {
      ws.value.send(JSON.stringify(message));
    }
  };

  onMounted(() => {
    connect();
  });

  onUnmounted(() => {
    disconnect();
  });

  return {
    ws: ws.value,
    isConnected,
    messages,
    error,
    connect,
    disconnect,
    sendMessage
  };
}

// components/RealTimeDashboard.vue
<template>
  <div class="real-time-dashboard">
    <div class="connection-status">
      <span :class="['status-indicator', isConnected ? 'connected' : 'disconnected']">
        {{ isConnected ? '已连接' : '未连接' }}
      </span>
    </div>

    <div class="metrics-grid">
      <div
        v-for="metric in realTimeMetrics"
        :key="metric.id"
        class="metric-card"
      >
        <h3>{{ metric.name }}</h3>
        <div class="metric-value">{{ metric.value }}</div>
        <div class="metric-change" :class="metric.change >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative'">
          {{ metric.change >= 0 ? '+' : '' }}{{ metric.change }}%
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="chart-container">
      <RealTimeChart :data="chartData" />
    </div>

    <div class="activity-feed">
      <h3>实时活动</h3>
      <div class="activity-list">
        <div
          v-for="activity in recentActivities"
          :key="activity.id"
          class="activity-item"
        >
          <span class="activity-time">{{ formatTime(activity.timestamp) }}</span>
          <span class="activity-message">{{ activity.message }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { useWebSocket } from '../composables/useWebSocket';

export default {
  name: 'RealTimeDashboard',
  setup() {
    const { isConnected, messages } = useWebSocket('ws://localhost:8080/dashboard');

    const realTimeMetrics = ref([
      { id: 1, name: 'CPU使用率', value: '45%', change: 2.5 },
      { id: 2, name: '内存使用率', value: '62%', change: -1.2 },
      { id: 3, name: '网络流量', value: '1.2GB/s', change: 5.8 },
      { id: 4, name: '活跃用户', value: '1,234', change: 12.3 }
    ]);

    const chartData = ref([]);
    const recentActivities = ref([]);

    // 处理WebSocket消息
    const processMessage = (message) => {
      switch (message.type) {
        case 'metric_update':
          updateMetric(message.data);
          break;
        case 'chart_data':
          updateChartData(message.data);
          break;
        case 'activity':
          addActivity(message.data);
          break;
      }
    };

    const updateMetric = (data) => {
      const metric = realTimeMetrics.value.find(m => m.id === data.id);
      if (metric) {
        metric.value = data.value;
        metric.change = data.change;
      }
    };

    const updateChartData = (data) => {
      chartData.value.push({
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        value: data.value
      });

      // 保持最近100个数据点
      if (chartData.value.length > 100) {
        chartData.value.shift();
      }
    };

    const addActivity = (data) => {
      recentActivities.value.unshift({
        id: Date.now(),
        message: data.message,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      });

      // 保持最近20个活动
      if (recentActivities.value.length > 20) {
        recentActivities.value.pop();
      }
    };

    const formatTime = (timestamp) => {
      return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString();
    };

    // 监听消息变化
    onMounted(() => {
      // 模拟实时数据更新
      setInterval(() => {
        realTimeMetrics.value.forEach(metric => {
          const change = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
          metric.change = change;
          metric.value = `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 100)}%`;
        });
      }, 5000);
    });

    return {
      isConnected,
      realTimeMetrics,
      chartData,
      recentActivities,
      formatTime
    };
  }
};
</script>

      <div
        v-for="product in products"
        :key="product.id"
        class="product-card"
      >
        <h3>{{ product.name }}</h3>
        <p>{{ product.description }}</p>
        <span class="price">¥{{ product.price }}</span>
      </div>
    </div>

<script>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';

export default {
  name: 'ProductsMicroApp',
  setup() {
    const products = ref([]);

    onMounted(async () => {
      try {
        // 与主应用通信
        window.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);

        // 初始化产品数据
        products.value = [
          { id: 1, name: '产品A', description: '产品A描述', price: 99 },
          { id: 2, name: '产品B', description: '产品B描述', price: 199 },
          { id: 3, name: '产品C', description: '产品C描述', price: 299 }
        ];

        // 通知主应用已加载
        window.parent.postMessage({
          type: 'MICRO_APP_LOADED',
          appName: 'products'
        }, '*');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to initialize products app:', error);
      }
    });

    const handleMessage = (event) => {
      const { type, data } = event.data;

      switch (type) {
        case 'UPDATE_PRODUCT':
          updateProduct(data);
          break;
        case 'GET_PRODUCTS':
          sendProducts();
          break;
      }
    };

    const updateProduct = (updatedProduct) => {
      const index = products.value.findIndex(p => p.id === updatedProduct.id);
      if (index > -1) {
        products.value[index] = { ...products.value[index], ...updatedProduct };
      }
    };

    const sendProducts = () => {
      window.parent.postMessage({
        type: 'PRODUCTS_DATA',
        data: products.value
      }, '*');
    };

    return {
      products
    };
  }
};
</script>

  });
  const pagination = ref({
    page: 1,
    pageSize: 50,
    total: 0
  });

  const columns = computed(() => {
    if (data.value.length === 0) return [];
    return Object.keys(data.value[0]).map(key => ({
      key,
      label: key.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + key.slice(1),
      sortable: true,
      filterable: true
    }));
  });

  const paginatedData = computed(() => {
    const start = (pagination.value.page - 1) * pagination.value.pageSize;
    const end = start + pagination.value.pageSize;
    return filteredData.value.slice(start, end);
  });

  const totalPages = computed(() => {
    return Math.ceil(filteredData.value.length / pagination.value.pageSize);
  });

  const sortData = (column) => {
    if (sortConfig.value.column === column) {
      sortConfig.value.direction = sortConfig.value.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    } else {
      sortConfig.value.column = column;
      sortConfig.value.direction = 'asc';
    }

    filteredData.value.sort((a, b) => {
      const aVal = a[column];
      const bVal = b[column];

      if (typeof aVal === 'number' && typeof bVal === 'number') {
        return sortConfig.value.direction === 'asc' ? aVal - bVal : bVal - aVal;
      }

      const comparison = aVal > bVal ? 1 : -1;
      return sortConfig.value.direction === 'asc' ? comparison : -comparison;
    });
  };

  const filterData = (filters) => {
    filteredData.value = data.value.filter(item => {
      return Object.entries(filters).every(([key, value]) => {
        if (!value) return true;
        return item[key].toString().toLowerCase().includes(value.toLowerCase());
      });
    });
  };

  const setPage = (page) => {
    pagination.value.page = Math.max(1, Math.min(page, totalPages.value));
  };

  const setPageSize = (pageSize) => {
    pagination.value.pageSize = pageSize;
    pagination.value.page = 1;
  };

  watch(data, () => {
    filteredData.value = [...data.value];
    pagination.value.total = data.value.length;
  }, { immediate: true });

  return {
    data,
    filteredData,
    paginatedData,
    columns,
    pagination,
    sortConfig,
    totalPages,
    sortData,
    filterData,
    setPage,
    setPageSize
  };
}

// components/DataTable.vue
<template>
  <div class="data-table">
    <!-- 过滤器 -->
    <div class="table-filters">
      <input
        v-for="column in columns"
        :key="column.key"
        v-model="filters[column.key]"
        :placeholder="`过滤 ${column.label}...`"
        @input="handleFilter"
      />
    </div>

    <!-- 表格头部 -->
    <div class="table-header">
      <div
        v-for="column in columns"
        :key="column.key"
        class="table-column-header"
        :class="{ sortable: column.sortable }"
        @click="column.sortable ? handleSort(column.key) : null"
      >
        <span>{{ column.label }}</span>
        <span
          v-if="sortConfig.column === column.key"
          class="sort-indicator"
        >
          {{ sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓' }}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 表格主体 -->
    <div class="table-body">
      <div
        v-for="(row, rowIndex) in paginatedData"
        :key="rowIndex"
        class="table-row"
      >
        <div
          v-for="column in columns"
          :key="column.key"
          class="table-cell"
        >
          {{ row[column.key] }}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 分页控件 -->
    <div class="table-pagination">
      <button
        @click="setPage(pagination.page - 1)"
        :disabled="pagination.page <= 1"
      >
        上一页
      </button>

      <span>第 {{ pagination.page }} 页，共 {{ totalPages }} 页</span>

      <button
        @click="setPage(pagination.page + 1)"
        :disabled="pagination.page >= totalPages"
      >
        下一页
      </button>

      <select v-model="pagination.pageSize" @change="handlePageSizeChange">
        <option :value="25">25</option>
        <option :value="50">50</option>
        <option :value="100">100</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { useDataTable } from '../composables/useDataTable';

export default {
  name: 'DataTable',
  props: {
    initialData: {
      type: Array,
      default: () => []
    }
  },
  setup(props) {
    const {
      filteredData,
      paginatedData,
      columns,
      pagination,
      sortConfig,
      totalPages,
      sortData,
      filterData,
      setPage,
      setPageSize
    } = useDataTable(props.initialData);

    const filters = ref({});

    const handleSort = (column) => {
      sortData(column);
    };

    const handleFilter = () => {
      filterData(filters.value);
    };

    const handlePageSizeChange = (event) => {
      setPageSize(parseInt(event.target.value));
    };

    return {
      filteredData,
      paginatedData,
      columns,
      pagination,
      sortConfig,
      totalPages,
      filters,
      handleSort,
      handleFilter,
      handlePageSizeChange,
      setPage,
      setPageSize
    };
  }
};
</script>

docs.title: 直接修改数组/对象
docs.text:
// ❌ 错误示例 - 不触发响应式更新
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      items: ['Apple', 'Banana', 'Orange']
    };
  },
  methods: {
    addItemWrong() {
      this.items.push('New Item'); // 不触发更新
    },
    updateUserWrong() {
      this.user.name = 'New Name'; // 不触发更新
    }
  }
};

// ✅ 正确示例 - 触发响应式更新
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      items: ['Apple', 'Banana', 'Orange'],
      user: {
        name: 'John',
        age: 25
      }
    };
  },
  methods: {
    addItemCorrect() {
      // Vue 2: 使用$set或替换整个数组
      this.$set(this.items, this.items.length, 'New Item');
      // 或
      this.items = [...this.items, 'New Item'];
    },
    updateUserCorrect() {
      // Vue 2: 使用$set
      this.$set(this.user, 'name', 'New Name');
      // 或替换整个对象
      this.user = { ...this.user, name: 'New Name' };
    }
  }
};

// ✅ Vue 3 正确示例
import { ref, reactive } from 'vue';

export default {
  setup() {
    const items = ref(['Apple', 'Banana', 'Orange']);
    const user = reactive({
      name: 'John',
      age: 25
    });

    const addItemCorrect = () => {
      items.value.push('New Item'); // 正确触发更新
    };

    const updateUserCorrect = () => {
      user.name = 'New Name'; // 正确触发更新
    };

    return {
      items,
      user,
      addItemCorrect,
      updateUserCorrect
    };
  }
};

docs.title: 异步数据更新陷阱
docs.text:
// ❌ 错误示例 - 异步更新不触发响应式
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      userList: []
    };
  },
  methods: {
    async fetchUsersWrong() {
      const response = await fetch('/api/users');
      const users = await response.json();
      this.userList = users; // 可能不触发更新

      // 或者更糟的情况
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.userList = users; // 绝对不触发更新
      }, 1000);
    }
  }
};

// ✅ 正确示例 - 确保异步更新触发响应式
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      userList: []
    };
  },
  methods: {
    async fetchUsersCorrect() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/users');
        const users = await response.json();

        // 确保在正确的上下文中更新
        this.$nextTick(() => {
          this.userList = users;
        });

        // 或者使用async/await的正确方式
        await this.$nextTick();
        this.userList = users;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch users:', error);
      }
    }
  }
};

// ✅ Vue 3 正确示例
import { ref } from 'vue';

export default {
  setup() {
    const userList = ref([]);

    const fetchUsersCorrect = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/users');
        const users = await response.json();
        userList.value = users; // 正确触发更新
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch users:', error);
      }
    };

    return {
      userList,
      fetchUsersCorrect
    };
  }
};
