docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 中介者模式是一种行为型设计模式，它定义了一系列对象之间的交互方式，使原本直接交互的对象通过中介者对象来进行交互，从而使各对象不需要显式地相互引用，让其耦合松散，而且可以独立地改变它们之间的交互。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 系统中对象之间存在比较复杂的引用关系，导致它们之间的依赖关系结构混乱而且难以复用该对象
  • 想通过一个中间类来封装多个类中的行为，而又不想生成太多的子类
  • 对话框中的控件交互、聊天室、航空管制系统、MVC架构

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 减少类间的依赖，把多对多的依赖关系变成一对多的依赖关系
  • 类间的各个对象之间的交互被封装在中介者当中，使得系统的交互更加清晰
  • 中介者模式符合迪米特法则

缺点：

  • 中介者会庞大，变得复杂难以维护

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from enum import Enum

# 抽象中介者
class Mediator(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def notify(self, sender: object, event: str, data: Any = None) -> None:
        pass

# 抽象同事类
class Colleague(ABC):
    def __init__(self, mediator: Mediator):
        self._mediator = mediator

    def set_mediator(self, mediator: Mediator) -> None:
        self._mediator = mediator

# 聊天室示例
class ChatRoom(Mediator):
    def __init__(self):
        self._users: Dict[str, 'User'] = {}
        self._rooms: Dict[str, List['User']] = {}
        self._message_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    def add_user(self, user: 'User') -> None:
        self._users[user.name] = user
        user.set_mediator(self)
        print(f"用户 {user.name} 加入聊天室")

    def remove_user(self, user: 'User') -> None:
        if user.name in self._users:
            del self._users[user.name]
            # 从所有房间中移除用户
            for room_users in self._rooms.values():
                if user in room_users:
                    room_users.remove(user)
            print(f"用户 {user.name} 离开聊天室")

    def create_room(self, room_name: str) -> None:
        if room_name not in self._rooms:
            self._rooms[room_name] = []
            print(f"创建房间: {room_name}")

    def join_room(self, user: 'User', room_name: str) -> None:
        if room_name not in self._rooms:
            self.create_room(room_name)

        if user not in self._rooms[room_name]:
            self._rooms[room_name].append(user)
            print(f"用户 {user.name} 加入房间 {room_name}")

    def leave_room(self, user: 'User', room_name: str) -> None:
        if room_name in self._rooms and user in self._rooms[room_name]:
            self._rooms[room_name].remove(user)
            print(f"用户 {user.name} 离开房间 {room_name}")

    def notify(self, sender: object, event: str, data: Any = None) -> None:
        if event == "send_message":
            self._handle_message(sender, data)
        elif event == "send_private_message":
            self._handle_private_message(sender, data)
        elif event == "send_room_message":
            self._handle_room_message(sender, data)

    def _handle_message(self, sender: 'User', message: str) -> None:
        # 广播消息给所有用户
        for user in self._users.values():
            if user != sender:
                user.receive_message(f"[广播] {sender.name}: {message}")

        self._message_history.append({
            "type": "broadcast",
            "sender": sender.name,
            "message": message,
            "timestamp": "now"
        })

    def _handle_private_message(self, sender: 'User', data: Dict[str, str]) -> None:
        recipient_name = data["recipient"]
        message = data["message"]

        if recipient_name in self._users:
            recipient = self._users[recipient_name]
            recipient.receive_message(f"[私聊] {sender.name}: {message}")
            sender.receive_message(f"[私聊发送给 {recipient_name}]: {message}")
        else:
            sender.receive_message(f"用户 {recipient_name} 不存在")

    def _handle_room_message(self, sender: 'User', data: Dict[str, str]) -> None:
        room_name = data["room"]
        message = data["message"]

        if room_name in self._rooms:
            for user in self._rooms[room_name]:
                if user != sender:
                    user.receive_message(f"[{room_name}] {sender.name}: {message}")
        else:
            sender.receive_message(f"房间 {room_name} 不存在")

class User(Colleague):
    def __init__(self, name: str, mediator: Mediator = None):
        super().__init__(mediator)
        self.name = name
        self._messages: List[str] = []

    def send_message(self, message: str) -> None:
        print(f"{self.name} 发送广播消息: {message}")
        self._mediator.notify(self, "send_message", message)

    def send_private_message(self, recipient: str, message: str) -> None:
        print(f"{self.name} 发送私聊消息给 {recipient}: {message}")
        self._mediator.notify(self, "send_private_message", {
            "recipient": recipient,
            "message": message
        })

    def send_room_message(self, room: str, message: str) -> None:
        print(f"{self.name} 在房间 {room} 发送消息: {message}")
        self._mediator.notify(self, "send_room_message", {
            "room": room,
            "message": message
        })

    def receive_message(self, message: str) -> None:
        self._messages.append(message)
        print(f"{self.name} 收到消息: {message}")

    def get_messages(self) -> List[str]:
        return self._messages.copy()

# 对话框示例
class DialogMediator(Mediator):
    def __init__(self):
        self._components: Dict[str, 'UIComponent'] = {}

    def register_component(self, name: str, component: 'UIComponent') -> None:
        self._components[name] = component
        component.set_mediator(self)

    def notify(self, sender: object, event: str, data: Any = None) -> None:
        if event == "button_clicked":
            self._handle_button_click(sender, data)
        elif event == "checkbox_changed":
            self._handle_checkbox_change(sender, data)
        elif event == "text_changed":
            self._handle_text_change(sender, data)

    def _handle_button_click(self, sender: 'Button', button_name: str) -> None:
        if button_name == "submit":
            # 验证表单
            username = self._components["username"].get_value()
            password = self._components["password"].get_value()
            remember_me = self._components["remember_me"].get_value()

            if username and password:
                print(f"登录成功: {username}, 记住我: {remember_me}")
                self._components["status"].set_value("登录成功!")
            else:
                print("请填写用户名和密码")
                self._components["status"].set_value("请填写完整信息")

        elif button_name == "reset":
            # 重置表单
            self._components["username"].set_value("")
            self._components["password"].set_value("")
            self._components["remember_me"].set_value(False)
            self._components["status"].set_value("")

    def _handle_checkbox_change(self, sender: 'Checkbox', checked: bool) -> None:
        if sender == self._components.get("remember_me"):
            if checked:
                self._components["status"].set_value("将记住登录状态")
            else:
                self._components["status"].set_value("")

    def _handle_text_change(self, sender: 'TextBox', text: str) -> None:
        # 实时验证
        if sender == self._components.get("username"):
            if len(text) < 3:
                self._components["status"].set_value("用户名至少3个字符")
            else:
                self._components["status"].set_value("")

# UI组件基类
class UIComponent(Colleague):
    def __init__(self, name: str, mediator: Mediator = None):
        super().__init__(mediator)
        self.name = name
        self._value = None

    def get_value(self):
        return self._value

    def set_value(self, value):
        self._value = value

class Button(UIComponent):
    def click(self) -> None:
        print(f"按钮 {self.name} 被点击")
        self._mediator.notify(self, "button_clicked", self.name)

class TextBox(UIComponent):
    def set_text(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._value = text
        print(f"文本框 {self.name} 内容: {text}")
        self._mediator.notify(self, "text_changed", text)

class Checkbox(UIComponent):
    def __init__(self, name: str, mediator: Mediator = None):
        super().__init__(name, mediator)
        self._value = False

    def toggle(self) -> None:
        self._value = not self._value
        print(f"复选框 {self.name} 状态: {self._value}")
        self._mediator.notify(self, "checkbox_changed", self._value)

class Label(UIComponent):
    def set_text(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._value = text
        print(f"标签 {self.name} 显示: {text}")

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== 聊天室中介者示例 ===")

    # 创建聊天室
    chat_room = ChatRoom()

    # 创建用户
    alice = User("Alice")
    bob = User("Bob")
    charlie = User("Charlie")

    # 用户加入聊天室
    chat_room.add_user(alice)
    chat_room.add_user(bob)
    chat_room.add_user(charlie)

    print("\n--- 广播消息 ---")
    alice.send_message("大家好!")

    print("\n--- 私聊消息 ---")
    bob.send_private_message("Alice", "你好，Alice!")

    print("\n--- 房间消息 ---")
    chat_room.join_room(alice, "技术讨论")
    chat_room.join_room(bob, "技术讨论")
    alice.send_room_message("技术讨论", "有人在讨论Python吗?")

    print("\n=== 对话框中介者示例 ===")

    # 创建对话框中介者
    dialog = DialogMediator()

    # 创建UI组件
    username_box = TextBox("username")
    password_box = TextBox("password")
    remember_checkbox = Checkbox("remember_me")
    submit_button = Button("submit")
    reset_button = Button("reset")
    status_label = Label("status")

    # 注册组件到中介者
    dialog.register_component("username", username_box)
    dialog.register_component("password", password_box)
    dialog.register_component("remember_me", remember_checkbox)
    dialog.register_component("submit", submit_button)
    dialog.register_component("reset", reset_button)
    dialog.register_component("status", status_label)

    print("\n--- 用户交互 ---")
    username_box.set_text("al")  # 触发验证
    username_box.set_text("alice")  # 通过验证
    password_box.set_text("password123")
    remember_checkbox.toggle()  # 选中记住我
    submit_button.click()  # 提交表单

    print("\n--- 重置表单 ---")
    reset_button.click()

docs.text:
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "strings"
)

// 中介者接口
type Mediator interface {
    Notify(sender interface{}, event string, data interface{})
}

// 同事类接口
type Colleague interface {
    SetMediator(mediator Mediator)
}

// 聊天室中介者
type ChatRoom struct {
    users map[string]*User
    rooms map[string][]*User
}

func NewChatRoom() *ChatRoom {
    return &ChatRoom{
        users: make(map[string]*User),
        rooms: make(map[string][]*User),
    }
}

func (cr *ChatRoom) AddUser(user *User) {
    cr.users[user.Name] = user
    user.SetMediator(cr)
    fmt.Printf("用户 %s 加入聊天室\n", user.Name)
}

func (cr *ChatRoom) RemoveUser(user *User) {
    if _, exists := cr.users[user.Name]; exists {
        delete(cr.users, user.Name)
        // 从所有房间中移除用户
        for roomName, roomUsers := range cr.rooms {
            for i, u := range roomUsers {
                if u == user {
                    cr.rooms[roomName] = append(roomUsers[:i], roomUsers[i+1:]...)
                    break
                }
            }
        }
        fmt.Printf("用户 %s 离开聊天室\n", user.Name)
    }
}

func (cr *ChatRoom) CreateRoom(roomName string) {
    if _, exists := cr.rooms[roomName]; !exists {
        cr.rooms[roomName] = make([]*User, 0)
        fmt.Printf("创建房间: %s\n", roomName)
    }
}

func (cr *ChatRoom) JoinRoom(user *User, roomName string) {
    if _, exists := cr.rooms[roomName]; !exists {
        cr.CreateRoom(roomName)
    }

    // 检查用户是否已在房间中
    for _, u := range cr.rooms[roomName] {
        if u == user {
            return
        }
    }

    cr.rooms[roomName] = append(cr.rooms[roomName], user)
    fmt.Printf("用户 %s 加入房间 %s\n", user.Name, roomName)
}

func (cr *ChatRoom) LeaveRoom(user *User, roomName string) {
    if roomUsers, exists := cr.rooms[roomName]; exists {
        for i, u := range roomUsers {
            if u == user {
                cr.rooms[roomName] = append(roomUsers[:i], roomUsers[i+1:]...)
                fmt.Printf("用户 %s 离开房间 %s\n", user.Name, roomName)
                break
            }
        }
    }
}

func (cr *ChatRoom) Notify(sender interface{}, event string, data interface{}) {
    switch event {
    case "send_message":
        cr.handleMessage(sender.(*User), data.(string))
    case "send_private_message":
        cr.handlePrivateMessage(sender.(*User), data.(map[string]string))
    case "send_room_message":
        cr.handleRoomMessage(sender.(*User), data.(map[string]string))
    }
}

func (cr *ChatRoom) handleMessage(sender *User, message string) {
    // 广播消息给所有用户
    for _, user := range cr.users {
        if user != sender {
            user.ReceiveMessage(fmt.Sprintf("[广播] %s: %s", sender.Name, message))
        }
    }
}

func (cr *ChatRoom) handlePrivateMessage(sender *User, data map[string]string) {
    recipient := data["recipient"]
    message := data["message"]

    if user, exists := cr.users[recipient]; exists {
        user.ReceiveMessage(fmt.Sprintf("[私聊] %s: %s", sender.Name, message))
        sender.ReceiveMessage(fmt.Sprintf("[私聊发送给 %s]: %s", recipient, message))
    } else {
        sender.ReceiveMessage(fmt.Sprintf("用户 %s 不存在", recipient))
    }
}

func (cr *ChatRoom) handleRoomMessage(sender *User, data map[string]string) {
    roomName := data["room"]
    message := data["message"]

    if roomUsers, exists := cr.rooms[roomName]; exists {
        for _, user := range roomUsers {
            if user != sender {
                user.ReceiveMessage(fmt.Sprintf("[%s] %s: %s", roomName, sender.Name, message))
            }
        }
    } else {
        sender.ReceiveMessage(fmt.Sprintf("房间 %s 不存在", roomName))
    }
}

// 用户类
type User struct {
    Name     string
    mediator Mediator
    messages []string
}

func NewUser(name string) *User {
    return &User{
        Name:     name,
        messages: make([]string, 0),
    }
}

func (u *User) SetMediator(mediator Mediator) {
    u.mediator = mediator
}

func (u *User) SendMessage(message string) {
    fmt.Printf("%s 发送广播消息: %s\n", u.Name, message)
    u.mediator.Notify(u, "send_message", message)
}

func (u *User) SendPrivateMessage(recipient, message string) {
    fmt.Printf("%s 发送私聊消息给 %s: %s\n", u.Name, recipient, message)
    u.mediator.Notify(u, "send_private_message", map[string]string{
        "recipient": recipient,
        "message":   message,
    })
}

func (u *User) SendRoomMessage(room, message string) {
    fmt.Printf("%s 在房间 %s 发送消息: %s\n", u.Name, room, message)
    u.mediator.Notify(u, "send_room_message", map[string]string{
        "room":    room,
        "message": message,
    })
}

func (u *User) ReceiveMessage(message string) {
    u.messages = append(u.messages, message)
    fmt.Printf("%s 收到消息: %s\n", u.Name, message)
}

func (u *User) GetMessages() []string {
    result := make([]string, len(u.messages))
    copy(result, u.messages)
    return result
}

// 对话框中介者
type DialogMediator struct {
    components map[string]UIComponent
}

func NewDialogMediator() *DialogMediator {
    return &DialogMediator{
        components: make(map[string]UIComponent),
    }
}

func (dm *DialogMediator) RegisterComponent(name string, component UIComponent) {
    dm.components[name] = component
    component.SetMediator(dm)
}

func (dm *DialogMediator) Notify(sender interface{}, event string, data interface{}) {
    switch event {
    case "button_clicked":
        dm.handleButtonClick(sender.(*Button), data.(string))
    case "checkbox_changed":
        dm.handleCheckboxChange(sender.(*Checkbox), data.(bool))
    case "text_changed":
        dm.handleTextChange(sender.(*TextBox), data.(string))
    }
}

func (dm *DialogMediator) handleButtonClick(sender *Button, buttonName string) {
    switch buttonName {
    case "submit":
        // 验证表单
        username := dm.components["username"].GetValue().(string)
        password := dm.components["password"].GetValue().(string)
        rememberMe := dm.components["remember_me"].GetValue().(bool)

        if username != "" && password != "" {
            fmt.Printf("登录成功: %s, 记住我: %t\n", username, rememberMe)
            dm.components["status"].SetValue("登录成功!")
        } else {
            fmt.Println("请填写用户名和密码")
            dm.components["status"].SetValue("请填写完整信息")
        }
    case "reset":
        // 重置表单
        dm.components["username"].SetValue("")
        dm.components["password"].SetValue("")
        dm.components["remember_me"].SetValue(false)
        dm.components["status"].SetValue("")
    }
}

func (dm *DialogMediator) handleCheckboxChange(sender *Checkbox, checked bool) {
    if sender == dm.components["remember_me"] {
        if checked {
            dm.components["status"].SetValue("将记住登录状态")
        } else {
            dm.components["status"].SetValue("")
        }
    }
}

func (dm *DialogMediator) handleTextChange(sender *TextBox, text string) {
    // 实时验证
    if sender == dm.components["username"] {
        if len(text) < 3 {
            dm.components["status"].SetValue("用户名至少3个字符")
        } else {
            dm.components["status"].SetValue("")
        }
    }
}

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::cell::RefCell;

// 中介者特征
trait Mediator {
    fn notify(&self, sender: &str, event: &str, data: Option<&str>);
}

// 同事类特征
trait Colleague {
    fn set_mediator(&mut self, mediator: Rc<dyn Mediator>);
}

// 聊天室中介者
struct ChatRoom {
    users: RefCell<HashMap<String, Rc<RefCell<User>>>>,
    rooms: RefCell<HashMap<String, Vec<Rc<RefCell<User>>>>>,
}

impl ChatRoom {
    fn new() -> Self {
        ChatRoom {
            users: RefCell::new(HashMap::new()),
            rooms: RefCell::new(HashMap::new()),
        }
    }

    fn add_user(&self, user: Rc<RefCell<User>>) {
        let name = user.borrow().name.clone();
        self.users.borrow_mut().insert(name.clone(), user.clone());
        println!("用户 {} 加入聊天室", name);
    }

    fn remove_user(&self, user: &Rc<RefCell<User>>) {
        let name = user.borrow().name.clone();
        if self.users.borrow().contains_key(&name) {
            self.users.borrow_mut().remove(&name);
            // 从所有房间中移除用户
            for room_users in self.rooms.borrow_mut().values_mut() {
                room_users.retain(|u| !Rc::ptr_eq(u, user));
            }
            println!("用户 {} 离开聊天室", name);
        }
    }

    fn create_room(&self, room_name: &str) {
        if !self.rooms.borrow().contains_key(room_name) {
            self.rooms.borrow_mut().insert(room_name.to_string(), Vec::new());
            println!("创建房间: {}", room_name);
        }
    }

    fn join_room(&self, user: &Rc<RefCell<User>>, room_name: &str) {
        if !self.rooms.borrow().contains_key(room_name) {
            self.create_room(room_name);
        }

        let mut rooms = self.rooms.borrow_mut();
        let room_users = rooms.get_mut(room_name).unwrap();

        // 检查用户是否已在房间中
        if !room_users.iter().any(|u| Rc::ptr_eq(u, user)) {
            room_users.push(user.clone());
            println!("用户 {} 加入房间 {}", user.borrow().name, room_name);
        }
    }

    fn leave_room(&self, user: &Rc<RefCell<User>>, room_name: &str) {
        if let Some(room_users) = self.rooms.borrow_mut().get_mut(room_name) {
            room_users.retain(|u| !Rc::ptr_eq(u, user));
            println!("用户 {} 离开房间 {}", user.borrow().name, room_name);
        }
    }

    fn handle_message(&self, sender_name: &str, message: &str) {
        // 广播消息给所有用户
        for (name, user) in self.users.borrow().iter() {
            if name != sender_name {
                user.borrow_mut().receive_message(&format!("[广播] {}: {}", sender_name, message));
            }
        }
    }

    fn handle_private_message(&self, sender_name: &str, recipient: &str, message: &str) {
        if let Some(user) = self.users.borrow().get(recipient) {
            user.borrow_mut().receive_message(&format!("[私聊] {}: {}", sender_name, message));
            if let Some(sender) = self.users.borrow().get(sender_name) {
                sender.borrow_mut().receive_message(&format!("[私聊发送给 {}]: {}", recipient, message));
            }
        } else if let Some(sender) = self.users.borrow().get(sender_name) {
            sender.borrow_mut().receive_message(&format!("用户 {} 不存在", recipient));
        }
    }

    fn handle_room_message(&self, sender_name: &str, room_name: &str, message: &str) {
        if let Some(room_users) = self.rooms.borrow().get(room_name) {
            for user in room_users {
                if user.borrow().name != sender_name {
                    user.borrow_mut().receive_message(&format!("[{}] {}: {}", room_name, sender_name, message));
                }
            }
        } else if let Some(sender) = self.users.borrow().get(sender_name) {
            sender.borrow_mut().receive_message(&format!("房间 {} 不存在", room_name));
        }
    }
}

impl Mediator for ChatRoom {
    fn notify(&self, sender: &str, event: &str, data: Option<&str>) {
        match event {
            "send_message" => {
                if let Some(message) = data {
                    self.handle_message(sender, message);
                }
            }
            "send_private_message" => {
                if let Some(data_str) = data {
                    let parts: Vec<&str> = data_str.splitn(2, '|').collect();
                    if parts.len() == 2 {
                        self.handle_private_message(sender, parts[0], parts[1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            "send_room_message" => {
                if let Some(data_str) = data {
                    let parts: Vec<&str> = data_str.splitn(2, '|').collect();
                    if parts.len() == 2 {
                        self.handle_room_message(sender, parts[0], parts[1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

// 用户结构
struct User {
    name: String,
    mediator: Option<Rc<dyn Mediator>>,
    messages: Vec<String>,
}

impl User {
    fn new(name: &str) -> Self {
        User {
            name: name.to_string(),
            mediator: None,
            messages: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    fn send_message(&self, message: &str) {
        println!("{} 发送广播消息: {}", self.name, message);
        if let Some(ref mediator) = self.mediator {
            mediator.notify(&self.name, "send_message", Some(message));
        }
    }

    fn send_private_message(&self, recipient: &str, message: &str) {
        println!("{} 发送私聊消息给 {}: {}", self.name, recipient, message);
        if let Some(ref mediator) = self.mediator {
            let data = format!("{}|{}", recipient, message);
            mediator.notify(&self.name, "send_private_message", Some(&data));
        }
    }

    fn send_room_message(&self, room: &str, message: &str) {
        println!("{} 在房间 {} 发送消息: {}", self.name, room, message);
        if let Some(ref mediator) = self.mediator {
            let data = format!("{}|{}", room, message);
            mediator.notify(&self.name, "send_room_message", Some(&data));
        }
    }

    fn receive_message(&mut self, message: &str) {
        self.messages.push(message.to_string());
        println!("{} 收到消息: {}", self.name, message);
    }

    fn get_messages(&self) -> &Vec<String> {
        &self.messages
    }
}

impl Colleague for User {
    fn set_mediator(&mut self, mediator: Rc<dyn Mediator>) {
        self.mediator = Some(mediator);
    }
}

// 对话框中介者
struct DialogMediator {
    components: RefCell<HashMap<String, Box<dyn UIComponent>>>,
}

impl DialogMediator {
    fn new() -> Self {
        DialogMediator {
            components: RefCell::new(HashMap::new()),
        }
    }

    fn register_component(&self, name: &str, component: Box<dyn UIComponent>) {
        self.components.borrow_mut().insert(name.to_string(), component);
    }

    fn handle_button_click(&self, button_name: &str) {
        match button_name {
            "submit" => {
                // 验证表单
                let components = self.components.borrow();
                let username = components.get("username").map(|c| c.get_value()).unwrap_or_default();
                let password = components.get("password").map(|c| c.get_value()).unwrap_or_default();
                let remember_me = components.get("remember_me").map(|c| c.get_value()).unwrap_or_default();

                if !username.is_empty() && !password.is_empty() {
                    println!("登录成功: {}, 记住我: {}", username, remember_me == "true");
                    if let Some(status) = components.get("status") {
                        status.set_value("登录成功!");
                    }
                } else {
                    println!("请填写用户名和密码");
                    if let Some(status) = components.get("status") {
                        status.set_value("请填写完整信息");
                    }
                }
            }
            "reset" => {
                // 重置表单
                let components = self.components.borrow();
                if let Some(username) = components.get("username") {
                    username.set_value("");
                }
                if let Some(password) = components.get("password") {
                    password.set_value("");
                }
                if let Some(remember_me) = components.get("remember_me") {
                    remember_me.set_value("false");
                }
                if let Some(status) = components.get("status") {
                    status.set_value("");
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    fn handle_checkbox_change(&self, checked: bool) {
        let components = self.components.borrow();
        if checked {
            if let Some(status) = components.get("status") {
                status.set_value("将记住登录状态");
            }
        } else {
            if let Some(status) = components.get("status") {
                status.set_value("");
            }
        }
    }

    fn handle_text_change(&self, component_name: &str, text: &str) {
        // 实时验证
        if component_name == "username" {
            let components = self.components.borrow();
            if text.len() < 3 {
                if let Some(status) = components.get("status") {
                    status.set_value("用户名至少3个字符");
                }
            } else {
                if let Some(status) = components.get("status") {
                    status.set_value("");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Mediator for DialogMediator {
    fn notify(&self, sender: &str, event: &str, data: Option<&str>) {
        match event {
            "button_clicked" => {
                if let Some(button_name) = data {
                    self.handle_button_click(button_name);
                }
            }
            "checkbox_changed" => {
                if let Some(checked_str) = data {
                    let checked = checked_str == "true";
                    self.handle_checkbox_change(checked);
                }
            }
            "text_changed" => {
                if let Some(text) = data {
                    self.handle_text_change(sender, text);
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

// 使用示例
fn main() {
    println!("=== 聊天室中介者示例 ===");

    // 创建聊天室
    let chat_room = Rc::new(ChatRoom::new());

    // 创建用户
    let alice = Rc::new(RefCell::new(User::new("Alice")));
    let bob = Rc::new(RefCell::new(User::new("Bob")));
    let charlie = Rc::new(RefCell::new(User::new("Charlie")));

    // 设置中介者
    alice.borrow_mut().set_mediator(chat_room.clone());
    bob.borrow_mut().set_mediator(chat_room.clone());
    charlie.borrow_mut().set_mediator(chat_room.clone());

    // 用户加入聊天室
    chat_room.add_user(alice.clone());
    chat_room.add_user(bob.clone());
    chat_room.add_user(charlie.clone());

    println!("\n--- 广播消息 ---");
    alice.borrow().send_message("大家好!");

    println!("\n--- 私聊消息 ---");
    bob.borrow().send_private_message("Alice", "你好，Alice!");

    println!("\n--- 房间消息 ---");
    chat_room.join_room(&alice, "技术讨论");
    chat_room.join_room(&bob, "技术讨论");
    alice.borrow().send_room_message("技术讨论", "有人在讨论Rust吗?");

    println!("\n=== 对话框中介者示例 ===");

    // 创建对话框中介者
    let dialog = Rc::new(DialogMediator::new());

    // 创建UI组件
    let mut username_box = Box::new(TextBox::new("username"));
    let mut password_box = Box::new(TextBox::new("password"));
    let mut remember_checkbox = Box::new(Checkbox::new("remember_me"));
    let mut submit_button = Box::new(Button::new("submit"));
    let mut reset_button = Box::new(Button::new("reset"));
    let status_label = Box::new(Label::new("status"));

    // 设置中介者
    username_box.set_mediator(dialog.clone());
    password_box.set_mediator(dialog.clone());
    remember_checkbox.set_mediator(dialog.clone());
    submit_button.set_mediator(dialog.clone());
    reset_button.set_mediator(dialog.clone());

    // 注册组件到中介者
    dialog.register_component("username", username_box);
    dialog.register_component("password", password_box);
    dialog.register_component("remember_me", remember_checkbox);
    dialog.register_component("submit", submit_button);
    dialog.register_component("reset", reset_button);
    dialog.register_component("status", status_label);

    println!("\n--- 用户交互 ---");
    // 由于组件已经移动到HashMap中，我们需要通过中介者来模拟交互
    dialog.notify("username", "text_changed", Some("al"));        // 触发验证
    dialog.notify("username", "text_changed", Some("alice"));     // 通过验证
    dialog.notify("password", "text_changed", Some("password123"));
    dialog.notify("remember_me", "checkbox_changed", Some("true")); // 选中记住我
    dialog.notify("submit", "button_clicked", Some("submit"));      // 提交表单

    println!("\n--- 重置表单 ---");
    dialog.notify("reset", "button_clicked", Some("reset"));
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 享元模式是一种结构型设计模式，它通过共享技术有效地支持大量细粒度对象的复用。享元模式以共享的方式高效地支持大量的细粒度对象，通过共享已经存在的对象来大幅度减少需要创建的对象数量、避免大量相似对象的开销，从而提高系统资源的利用率。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 系统中存在大量相似对象
  • 需要缓冲池的场景
  • 对象的大部分状态都可以外部化
  • 文本编辑器中的字符、游戏中的棋子、网页中的图标

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 大大减少对象的创建，降低系统的内存，使效率提高
  • 外部状态相对独立，不会影响其内部状态

缺点：

  • 提高了系统的复杂度，需要分离出内部状态和外部状态
  • 为了使对象可以共享，需要将一些状态外部化，这使得程序的逻辑复杂化

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Dict, Optional
import weakref

# 享元接口
class TreeType(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def render(self, canvas, x: int, y: int) -> str:
        pass

# 具体享元类
class ConcreteTreeType(TreeType):
    def __init__(self, name: str, color: str, sprite: str):
        self.name = name      # 内部状态
        self.color = color    # 内部状态
        self.sprite = sprite  # 内部状态

    def render(self, canvas, x: int, y: int) -> str:
        # 使用外部状态（x, y坐标）进行渲染
        return f"在画布{canvas}上渲染{self.color}的{self.name}树，位置({x}, {y})，精灵图: {self.sprite}"

# 享元工厂
class TreeTypeFactory:
    _tree_types: Dict[str, TreeType] = {}

    @classmethod
    def get_tree_type(cls, name: str, color: str, sprite: str) -> TreeType:
        key = f"{name}_{color}_{sprite}"
        if key not in cls._tree_types:
            cls._tree_types[key] = ConcreteTreeType(name, color, sprite)
            print(f"创建新的树类型: {key}")
        else:
            print(f"复用已有的树类型: {key}")
        return cls._tree_types[key]

    @classmethod
    def get_created_count(cls) -> int:
        return len(cls._tree_types)

# 上下文类（包含外部状态）
class Tree:
    def __init__(self, x: int, y: int, tree_type: TreeType):
        self.x = x              # 外部状态
        self.y = y              # 外部状态
        self.tree_type = tree_type  # 享元对象引用

    def render(self, canvas) -> str:
        return self.tree_type.render(canvas, self.x, self.y)

# 森林类（客户端）
class Forest:
    def __init__(self):
        self.trees: list[Tree] = []

    def plant_tree(self, x: int, y: int, name: str, color: str, sprite: str):
        tree_type = TreeTypeFactory.get_tree_type(name, color, sprite)
        tree = Tree(x, y, tree_type)
        self.trees.append(tree)

    def render(self, canvas: str) -> str:
        results = []
        for tree in self.trees:
            results.append(tree.render(canvas))
        return "\n".join(results)

    def get_tree_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.trees)

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    forest = Forest()

    # 种植不同类型的树
    forest.plant_tree(10, 20, "橡树", "绿色", "oak.png")
    forest.plant_tree(15, 25, "橡树", "绿色", "oak.png")  # 复用享元
    forest.plant_tree(30, 40, "松树", "深绿", "pine.png")
    forest.plant_tree(35, 45, "松树", "深绿", "pine.png")  # 复用享元

    print(f"森林中的树木数量: {forest.get_tree_count()}")
    print(f"创建的树类型数量: {TreeTypeFactory.get_created_count()}")
    print(forest.render("主画布"))

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "sync"
)

// 享元接口
type TreeType interface {
    Render(canvas string, x, y int) string
}

// 具体享元类
type ConcreteTreeType struct {
    name   string // 内部状态
    color  string // 内部状态
    sprite string // 内部状态
}

func NewConcreteTreeType(name, color, sprite string) *ConcreteTreeType {
    return &ConcreteTreeType{
        name:   name,
        color:  color,
        sprite: sprite,
    }
}

func (t *ConcreteTreeType) Render(canvas string, x, y int) string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("在画布%s上渲染%s的%s树，位置(%d, %d)，精灵图: %s",
        canvas, t.color, t.name, x, y, t.sprite)
}

// 享元工厂
type TreeTypeFactory struct {
    treeTypes map[string]TreeType
    mutex     sync.RWMutex
}

var (
    factoryInstance *TreeTypeFactory
    factoryOnce     sync.Once
)

func GetTreeTypeFactory() *TreeTypeFactory {
    factoryOnce.Do(func() {
        factoryInstance = &TreeTypeFactory{
            treeTypes: make(map[string]TreeType),
        }
    })
    return factoryInstance
}

func (f *TreeTypeFactory) GetTreeType(name, color, sprite string) TreeType {
    key := fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%s", name, color, sprite)

    f.mutex.RLock()
    if treeType, exists := f.treeTypes[key]; exists {
        f.mutex.RUnlock()
        fmt.Printf("复用已有的树类型: %s\n", key)
        return treeType
    }
    f.mutex.RUnlock()

    f.mutex.Lock()
    defer f.mutex.Unlock()

    // 双重检查锁定
    if treeType, exists := f.treeTypes[key]; exists {
        fmt.Printf("复用已有的树类型: %s\n", key)
        return treeType
    }

    treeType := NewConcreteTreeType(name, color, sprite)
    f.treeTypes[key] = treeType
    fmt.Printf("创建新的树类型: %s\n", key)
    return treeType
}

func (f *TreeTypeFactory) GetCreatedCount() int {
    f.mutex.RLock()
    defer f.mutex.RUnlock()
    return len(f.treeTypes)
}

// 上下文类（包含外部状态）
type Tree struct {
    x        int      // 外部状态
    y        int      // 外部状态
    treeType TreeType // 享元对象引用
}

func NewTree(x, y int, treeType TreeType) *Tree {
    return &Tree{
        x:        x,
        y:        y,
        treeType: treeType,
    }
}

func (t *Tree) Render(canvas string) string {
    return t.treeType.Render(canvas, t.x, t.y)
}

// 森林类（客户端）
type Forest struct {
    trees   []*Tree
    factory *TreeTypeFactory
}

func NewForest() *Forest {
    return &Forest{
        trees:   make([]*Tree, 0),
        factory: GetTreeTypeFactory(),
    }
}

func (f *Forest) PlantTree(x, y int, name, color, sprite string) {
    treeType := f.factory.GetTreeType(name, color, sprite)
    tree := NewTree(x, y, treeType)
    f.trees = append(f.trees, tree)
}

func (f *Forest) Render(canvas string) string {
    var results []string
    for _, tree := range f.trees {
        results = append(results, tree.Render(canvas))
    }
    return fmt.Sprintf("%s", results)
}

func (f *Forest) GetTreeCount() int {
    return len(f.trees)
}

func (f *Forest) GetTreeTypeCount() int {
    return f.factory.GetCreatedCount()
}

// 字符享元示例
type Character struct {
    char string // 内部状态
    font string // 内部状态
    size int    // 内部状态
}

func NewCharacter(char, font string, size int) *Character {
    return &Character{char: char, font: font, size: size}
}

func (c *Character) Display(x, y int, color string) string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("字符'%s'(%s, %dpx) 在位置(%d, %d) 以%s色显示",
        c.char, c.font, c.size, x, y, color)
}

type CharacterFactory struct {
    characters map[string]*Character
    mutex      sync.RWMutex
}

var (
    charFactoryInstance *CharacterFactory
    charFactoryOnce     sync.Once
)

func GetCharacterFactory() *CharacterFactory {
    charFactoryOnce.Do(func() {
        charFactoryInstance = &CharacterFactory{
            characters: make(map[string]*Character),
        }
    })
    return charFactoryInstance
}

func (f *CharacterFactory) GetCharacter(char, font string, size int) *Character {
    key := fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%d", char, font, size)

    f.mutex.RLock()
    if character, exists := f.characters[key]; exists {
        f.mutex.RUnlock()
        return character
    }
    f.mutex.RUnlock()

    f.mutex.Lock()
    defer f.mutex.Unlock()

    if character, exists := f.characters[key]; exists {
        return character
    }

    character := NewCharacter(char, font, size)
    f.characters[key] = character
    fmt.Printf("创建新字符对象: %s\n", key)
    return character
}

func (f *CharacterFactory) GetCacheSize() int {
    f.mutex.RLock()
    defer f.mutex.RUnlock()
    return len(f.characters)
}

type CharacterInfo struct {
    character *Character
    x, y      int    // 外部状态
    color     string // 外部状态
}

type Document struct {
    characters []*CharacterInfo
    factory    *CharacterFactory
}

func NewDocument() *Document {
    return &Document{
        characters: make([]*CharacterInfo, 0),
        factory:    GetCharacterFactory(),
    }
}

func (d *Document) AddCharacter(char, font string, size, x, y int, color string) {
    character := d.factory.GetCharacter(char, font, size)
    charInfo := &CharacterInfo{
        character: character,
        x:         x,
        y:         y,
        color:     color,
    }
    d.characters = append(d.characters, charInfo)
}

func (d *Document) Render() []string {
    var results []string
    for _, charInfo := range d.characters {
        result := charInfo.character.Display(charInfo.x, charInfo.y, charInfo.color)
        results = append(results, result)
    }
    return results
}

func (d *Document) GetCharacterCount() int {
    return len(d.characters)
}

func (d *Document) GetCacheSize() int {
    return d.factory.GetCacheSize()
}

func main() {
    fmt.Println("=== 森林渲染示例 ===")
    forest := NewForest()

    // 种植不同类型的树
    forest.PlantTree(10, 20, "橡树", "绿色", "oak.png")
    forest.PlantTree(15, 25, "橡树", "绿色", "oak.png") // 复用享元
    forest.PlantTree(30, 40, "松树", "深绿", "pine.png")
    forest.PlantTree(35, 45, "松树", "深绿", "pine.png") // 复用享元
    forest.PlantTree(50, 60, "橡树", "黄色", "oak.png")  // 新的享元

    fmt.Printf("森林中的树木数量: %d\n", forest.GetTreeCount())
    fmt.Printf("创建的树类型数量: %d\n", forest.GetTreeTypeCount())
    fmt.Printf("渲染结果: %v\n", forest.Render("主画布"))

    fmt.Println("\n=== 文档字符示例 ===")
    doc := NewDocument()

    // 添加字符（很多重复的字符会复用享元对象）
    text := "Hello World!"
    for i, char := range text {
        doc.AddCharacter(string(char), "Arial", 12, i*10, 0, "黑色")
    }

    // 添加更多相同字符
    hello := "Hello"
    for i, char := range hello {
        doc.AddCharacter(string(char), "Arial", 12, i*10, 20, "红色")
    }

    fmt.Printf("文档中字符数量: %d\n", doc.GetCharacterCount())
    fmt.Printf("缓存的字符对象数量: %d\n", doc.GetCacheSize())
    fmt.Printf("文档渲染: %v\n", doc.Render())
}

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

// 享元trait
pub trait TreeType {
    fn render(&self, canvas: &str, x: i32, y: i32) -> String;
}

// 具体享元类
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct ConcreteTreeType {
    name: String,   // 内部状态
    color: String,  // 内部状态
    sprite: String, // 内部状态
}

impl ConcreteTreeType {
    pub fn new(name: String, color: String, sprite: String) -> Self {
        Self { name, color, sprite }
    }
}

impl TreeType for ConcreteTreeType {
    fn render(&self, canvas: &str, x: i32, y: i32) -> String {
        format!(
            "在画布{}上渲染{}的{}树，位置({}, {})，精灵图: {}",
            canvas, self.color, self.name, x, y, self.sprite
        )
    }
}

// 享元工厂（线程安全版本）
pub struct TreeTypeFactory {
    tree_types: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, Arc<dyn TreeType + Send + Sync>>>>,
}

impl TreeTypeFactory {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            tree_types: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),
        }
    }

    pub fn get_tree_type(&self, name: &str, color: &str, sprite: &str) -> Arc<dyn TreeType + Send + Sync> {
        let key = format!("{}_{}_{}",  name, color, sprite);

        // 先尝试读取
        {
            let tree_types = self.tree_types.lock().unwrap();
            if let Some(tree_type) = tree_types.get(&key) {
                println!("复用已有的树类型: {}", key);
                return tree_type.clone();
            }
        }

        // 如果不存在，创建新的
        let mut tree_types = self.tree_types.lock().unwrap();

        // 双重检查锁定
        if let Some(tree_type) = tree_types.get(&key) {
            println!("复用已有的树类型: {}", key);
            return tree_type.clone();
        }

        let tree_type: Arc<dyn TreeType + Send + Sync> = Arc::new(ConcreteTreeType::new(
            name.to_string(),
            color.to_string(),
            sprite.to_string(),
        ));
        tree_types.insert(key.clone(), tree_type.clone());
        println!("创建新的树类型: {}", key);
        tree_type
    }

    pub fn get_created_count(&self) -> usize {
        let tree_types = self.tree_types.lock().unwrap();
        tree_types.len()
    }
}

// 上下文类
pub struct Tree {
    x: i32,                                      // 外部状态
    y: i32,                                      // 外部状态
    tree_type: Arc<dyn TreeType + Send + Sync>, // 享元对象引用
}

impl Tree {
    pub fn new(x: i32, y: i32, tree_type: Arc<dyn TreeType + Send + Sync>) -> Self {
        Self { x, y, tree_type }
    }

    pub fn render(&self, canvas: &str) -> String {
        self.tree_type.render(canvas, self.x, self.y)
    }
}

// 森林类
pub struct Forest {
    trees: Vec<Tree>,
    factory: TreeTypeFactory,
}

impl Forest {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            trees: Vec::new(),
            factory: TreeTypeFactory::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn plant_tree(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, name: &str, color: &str, sprite: &str) {
        let tree_type = self.factory.get_tree_type(name, color, sprite);
        let tree = Tree::new(x, y, tree_type);
        self.trees.push(tree);
    }

    pub fn render(&self, canvas: &str) -> Vec<String> {
        self.trees
            .iter()
            .map(|tree| tree.render(canvas))
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn get_tree_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.trees.len()
    }

    pub fn get_tree_type_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.factory.get_created_count()
    }
}

// 字符享元示例
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Character {
    char: char,   // 内部状态
    font: String, // 内部状态
    size: u32,    // 内部状态
}

impl Character {
    pub fn new(char: char, font: String, size: u32) -> Self {
        Self { char, font, size }
    }

    pub fn display(&self, x: i32, y: i32, color: &str) -> String {
        format!(
            "字符'{}'({}, {}px) 在位置({}, {}) 以{}色显示",
            self.char, self.font, self.size, x, y, color
        )
    }
}

pub struct CharacterFactory {
    characters: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, Arc<Character>>>>,
}

impl CharacterFactory {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            characters: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),
        }
    }

    pub fn get_character(&self, char: char, font: &str, size: u32) -> Arc<Character> {
        let key = format!("{}_{}_{}", char, font, size);

        // 先尝试读取
        {
            let characters = self.characters.lock().unwrap();
            if let Some(character) = characters.get(&key) {
                return character.clone();
            }
        }

        // 如果不存在，创建新的
        let mut characters = self.characters.lock().unwrap();

        // 双重检查锁定
        if let Some(character) = characters.get(&key) {
            return character.clone();
        }

        let character = Arc::new(Character::new(char, font.to_string(), size));
        characters.insert(key.clone(), character.clone());
        println!("创建新字符对象: {}", key);
        character
    }

    pub fn get_cache_size(&self) -> usize {
        let characters = self.characters.lock().unwrap();
        characters.len()
    }
}

pub struct CharacterInfo {
    character: Arc<Character>,
    x: i32,        // 外部状态
    y: i32,        // 外部状态
    color: String, // 外部状态
}

pub struct Document {
    characters: Vec<CharacterInfo>,
    factory: CharacterFactory,
}

impl Document {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            characters: Vec::new(),
            factory: CharacterFactory::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn add_character(&mut self, char: char, font: &str, size: u32, x: i32, y: i32, color: &str) {
        let character = self.factory.get_character(char, font, size);
        let char_info = CharacterInfo {
            character,
            x,
            y,
            color: color.to_string(),
        };
        self.characters.push(char_info);
    }

    pub fn render(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.characters
            .iter()
            .map(|char_info| {
                char_info.character.display(char_info.x, char_info.y, &char_info.color)
            })
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn get_character_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.characters.len()
    }

    pub fn get_cache_size(&self) -> usize {
        self.factory.get_cache_size()
    }
}

fn main() {
    println!("=== 森林渲染示例 ===");
    let mut forest = Forest::new();

    // 种植不同类型的树
    forest.plant_tree(10, 20, "橡树", "绿色", "oak.png");
    forest.plant_tree(15, 25, "橡树", "绿色", "oak.png"); // 复用享元
    forest.plant_tree(30, 40, "松树", "深绿", "pine.png");
    forest.plant_tree(35, 45, "松树", "深绿", "pine.png"); // 复用享元
    forest.plant_tree(50, 60, "橡树", "黄色", "oak.png");  // 新的享元

    println!("森林中的树木数量: {}", forest.get_tree_count());
    println!("创建的树类型数量: {}", forest.get_tree_type_count());
    println!("渲染结果: {:?}", forest.render("主画布"));

    println!("\n=== 文档字符示例 ===");
    let mut doc = Document::new();

    // 添加字符
    let text = "Hello World!";
    for (i, char) in text.chars().enumerate() {
        doc.add_character(char, "Arial", 12, (i as i32) * 10, 0, "黑色");
    }

    // 添加更多相同字符
    let hello = "Hello";
    for (i, char) in hello.chars().enumerate() {
        doc.add_character(char, "Arial", 12, (i as i32) * 10, 20, "红色");
    }

    println!("文档中字符数量: {}", doc.get_character_count());
    println!("缓存的字符对象数量: {}", doc.get_cache_size());
    println!("文档渲染: {:?}", doc.render());
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 代理模式是一种结构型设计模式，它让你能够提供对象的替代品或其占位符。代理控制着对于原对象的访问，并允许在将请求提交给对象前后进行一些处理。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 延迟初始化（虚拟代理）
  • 访问控制（保护代理）
  • 本地执行远程服务（远程代理）
  • 记录日志请求（日志记录代理）
  • 缓存请求结果（缓存代理）
  • 智能引用

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 可以在客户端毫无察觉的情况下控制服务对象
  • 如果客户端对服务对象的生命周期没有特殊要求，你可以对生命周期进行管理
  • 即使服务对象还未准备好或不存在，代理也可以正常工作
  • 符合开闭原则

缺点：

  • 代码可能会变得复杂，因为需要新建许多类
  • 服务响应可能会延迟

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
import time
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any

# 抽象主题
class VideoDownloader(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def download(self, url: str) -> str:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get_info(self, url: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        pass

# 真实主题
class RealVideoDownloader(VideoDownloader):
    def __init__(self):
        print("初始化真实视频下载器")
        time.sleep(1)  # 模拟初始化时间

    def download(self, url: str) -> str:
        print(f"正在下载视频: {url}")
        time.sleep(2)  # 模拟下载时间
        return f"视频内容来自: {url}"

    def get_info(self, url: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        print(f"获取视频信息: {url}")
        time.sleep(0.5)  # 模拟获取信息时间
        return {
            "title": f"视频标题_{url.split('/')[-1]}",
            "duration": "10:30",
            "size": "100MB"
        }

# 缓存代理
class CachedVideoDownloader(VideoDownloader):
    def __init__(self):
        self._real_downloader: Optional[RealVideoDownloader] = None
        self._cache: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self._info_cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def _get_real_downloader(self) -> RealVideoDownloader:
        """延迟初始化真实下载器"""
        if self._real_downloader is None:
            print("代理：创建真实下载器")
            self._real_downloader = RealVideoDownloader()
        return self._real_downloader

    def download(self, url: str) -> str:
        if url in self._cache:
            print(f"代理：从缓存返回视频 {url}")
            return self._cache[url]

        print(f"代理：缓存中没有 {url}，委托给真实下载器")
        real_downloader = self._get_real_downloader()
        result = real_downloader.download(url)
        self._cache[url] = result
        return result

    def get_info(self, url: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if url in self._info_cache:
            print(f"代理：从缓存返回视频信息 {url}")
            return self._info_cache[url]

        print(f"代理：缓存中没有信息 {url}，委托给真实下载器")
        real_downloader = self._get_real_downloader()
        result = real_downloader.get_info(url)
        self._info_cache[url] = result
        return result

# 保护代理
class ProtectedVideoDownloader(VideoDownloader):
    def __init__(self, user_role: str):
        self.user_role = user_role
        self._real_downloader: Optional[RealVideoDownloader] = None

    def _get_real_downloader(self) -> RealVideoDownloader:
        if self._real_downloader is None:
            self._real_downloader = RealVideoDownloader()
        return self._real_downloader

    def _check_access(self, operation: str) -> bool:
        if self.user_role == "admin":
            return True
        elif self.user_role == "user" and operation == "get_info":
            return True
        return False

    def download(self, url: str) -> str:
        if not self._check_access("download"):
            return f"访问被拒绝：用户角色 '{self.user_role}' 无权下载视频"

        print(f"保护代理：允许 {self.user_role} 下载视频")
        real_downloader = self._get_real_downloader()
        return real_downloader.download(url)

    def get_info(self, url: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if not self._check_access("get_info"):
            return {"error": f"访问被拒绝：用户角色 '{self.user_role}' 无权获取视频信息"}

        print(f"保护代理：允许 {self.user_role} 获取视频信息")
        real_downloader = self._get_real_downloader()
        return real_downloader.get_info(url)

# 使用示例

        infoCache: make(map[string]map[string]interface{}),

    return c.realDownloader

    if result, exists := c.cache[url]; exists {

        fmt.Printf("代理：从缓存返回视频 %s\n", url)
        return result
    }
    c.mutex.RUnlock()

    realDownloader := c.getRealDownloader()

    c.cache[url] = result
    c.mutex.Unlock()

    }

impl VideoDownloader for CachedVideoDownloader {

                return result.clone();

        let result = real_downloader.download(url);

        // 存入缓存

            cache.insert(url.to_string(), result.clone());

    }

            info_cache.insert(url.to_string(), result.clone());
        }

        result
    }
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 单例模式是一种创建型设计模式，让你能够保证一个类只有一个实例，并提供一个访问该实例的全局节点。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 数据库连接池
  • 日志记录器
  • 配置管理器
  • 线程池

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 保证一个类只有一个实例
  • 提供全局访问点
  • 延迟初始化，节约系统资源

缺点：

  • 违反单一职责原则
  • 在多线程环境下需要特殊处理
  • 单元测试困难

from threading import Lock
import threading

# 方法1：使用 __new__ 方法
class Singleton:
    """线程安全的单例模式实现"""
    _instance = None
    _lock = Lock()

    def __new__(cls, *args, **kwargs):
        if not cls._instance:
            with cls._lock:
                if not cls._instance:
                    cls._instance = super().__new__(cls)
        return cls._instance

    def __init__(self):
        if not hasattr(self, 'initialized'):
            self.initialized = True
            print(f"Singleton instance created: {id(self)}")

# 方法2：使用元类
class SingletonMeta(type):
    """单例模式元类"""
    _instances = {}
    _lock = Lock()

    def __call__(cls, *args, **kwargs):
        if cls not in cls._instances:
            with cls._lock:
                if cls not in cls._instances:
                    cls._instances[cls] = super().__call__(*args, **kwargs)
        return cls._instances[cls]

class DatabaseConnection(metaclass=SingletonMeta):
    def __init__(self):
        self.connection_string = "database://localhost:5432"
        print(f"Database connection created: {id(self)}")

    def query(self, sql):
        return f"Executing: {sql}"

# 方法3：使用装饰器
def singleton(cls):
    """单例装饰器"""
    instances = {}
    lock = Lock()

    def get_instance(*args, **kwargs):
        if cls not in instances:
            with lock:
                if cls not in instances:
                    instances[cls] = cls(*args, **kwargs)
        return instances[cls]

    return get_instance

@singleton
class Logger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.log_file = "app.log"
        print(f"Logger created: {id(self)}")

    def log(self, message):
        print(f"[LOG] {message}")

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 测试基本单例
    s1 = Singleton()
    s2 = Singleton()
    print(f"s1 is s2: {s1 is s2}")  # True

    # 测试数据库连接单例
    db1 = DatabaseConnection()
    db2 = DatabaseConnection()
    print(f"db1 is db2: {db1 is db2}")  # True

    # 测试日志单例
    logger1 = Logger()
    logger2 = Logger()
    print(f"logger1 is logger2: {logger1 is logger2}")  # True

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "sync"
)

// 方法1：使用 sync.Once 确保线程安全
type Singleton struct {
    data string
}

var (
    instance *Singleton
    once     sync.Once
)

func GetInstance() *Singleton {
    once.Do(func() {
        instance = &Singleton{
            data: "singleton instance",
        }
        fmt.Println("Singleton instance created")
    })
    return instance
}

// 方法2：使用互斥锁的双重检查锁定
type DatabaseConnection struct {
    connectionString string
}

var (
    dbInstance *DatabaseConnection
    dbMutex    sync.Mutex
)

func GetDatabaseConnection() *DatabaseConnection {
    if dbInstance == nil {
        dbMutex.Lock()
        defer dbMutex.Unlock()
        if dbInstance == nil {
            dbInstance = &DatabaseConnection{
                connectionString: "database://localhost:5432",
            }
            fmt.Println("Database connection created")
        }
    }
    return dbInstance
}

func (db *DatabaseConnection) Query(sql string) string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("Executing: %s", sql)
}

// 方法3：使用 init 函数（饿汉式）
type Logger struct {
    logFile string
}

var loggerInstance *Logger

func init() {
    loggerInstance = &Logger{
        logFile: "app.log",
    }
    fmt.Println("Logger instance created at startup")
}

func GetLogger() *Logger {
    return loggerInstance
}

func (l *Logger) Log(message string) {
    fmt.Printf("[LOG] %s\n", message)
}

func main() {
    // 测试基本单例
    s1 := GetInstance()
    s2 := GetInstance()
    fmt.Printf("s1 == s2: %t\n", s1 == s2) // true

    // 测试数据库连接单例
    db1 := GetDatabaseConnection()
    db2 := GetDatabaseConnection()
    fmt.Printf("db1 == db2: %t\n", db1 == db2) // true
    fmt.Println(db1.Query("SELECT * FROM users"))

    // 测试日志单例
    logger1 := GetLogger()
    logger2 := GetLogger()
    fmt.Printf("logger1 == logger2: %t\n", logger1 == logger2) // true
    logger1.Log("Application started")
}

use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, Once};
use std::collections::HashMap;

// 方法1：使用 std::sync::Once 确保线程安全
struct Singleton {
    data: String,
}

impl Singleton {
    fn new() -> Self {
        println!("Singleton instance created");
        Singleton {
            data: "singleton instance".to_string(),
        }
    }

    fn get_data(&self) -> &str {
        &self.data
    }
}

static mut SINGLETON: Option<Singleton> = None;
static INIT: Once = Once::new();

fn get_singleton() -> &'static Singleton {
    unsafe {
        INIT.call_once(|| {
            SINGLETON = Some(Singleton::new());
        });
        SINGLETON.as_ref().unwrap()
    }
}

        println!("Config manager created");
        let mut config = HashMap::new();
        config.insert("app_name".to_string(), "MyApp".to_string());
        config.insert("version".to_string(), "1.0.0".to_string());

        ConfigManager { config }
    }

    fn get_config(&self, key: &str) -> Option<&String> {
        self.config.get(key)
    }
}

static CONFIG_MANAGER: OnceLock<ConfigManager> = OnceLock::new();

fn get_config_manager() -> &'static ConfigManager {
    CONFIG_MANAGER.get_or_init(|| ConfigManager::new())
}

fn main() {
    // 测试基本单例
    let s1 = get_singleton();
    let s2 = get_singleton();
    println!("s1 data: {}", s1.get_data());
    println!("s1 and s2 are same instance: {}", std::ptr::eq(s1, s2));

    // 测试数据库连接单例
    let db1 = get_database_connection();
    let db2 = get_database_connection();
    println!("Query result: {}", db1.query("SELECT * FROM users"));
    println!("db1 and db2 are same instance: {}", std::ptr::eq(db1, db2));

    // 测试日志单例
    let logger1 = get_logger();
    let logger2 = get_logger();
    {
        let logger = logger1.lock().unwrap();
        logger.log("Application started");
    }
    println!("logger1 and logger2 are same instance: {}", Arc::ptr_eq(&logger1, &logger2));

    // 测试配置管理器单例
    let config1 = get_config_manager();
    let config2 = get_config_manager();
    if let Some(app_name) = config1.get_config("app_name") {
        println!("App name: {}", app_name);
    }
    println!("config1 and config2 are same instance: {}", std::ptr::eq(config1, config2));
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 原型模式是一种创建型设计模式，它允许复制已有对象，而无需使代码依赖它们所属的类。该模式将克隆过程委派给被克隆的实际对象。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 对象的创建成本较高（如需要大量计算或网络请求）
  • 需要创建大量相似对象
  • 对象的初始化需要消耗大量资源
  • 游戏中的角色复制、文档模板、配置对象复制

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 可以克隆对象，而无需与它们所属的具体类相耦合
  • 可以克隆预生成原型，避免反复运行初始化代码
  • 可以更方便地生成复杂对象
  • 可以用继承以外的方式来处理复杂对象的不同配置

缺点：

  • 克隆包含循环引用的复杂对象可能会非常麻烦
  • 需要为每个类实现克隆方法

import copy
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Dict, Any, List
import json

# 抽象原型接口
class Prototype(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def clone(self) -> 'Prototype':
        pass

# 具体原型类 - 游戏角色
class GameCharacter(Prototype):
    def __init__(self, name: str, level: int, health: int, skills: List[str] = None):
        self.name = name
        self.level = level
        self.health = health
        self.skills = skills or []
        self.equipment = {}
        self.position = {"x": 0, "y": 0}

    def clone(self) -> 'GameCharacter':
        # 深拷贝确保所有嵌套对象都被复制
        return copy.deepcopy(self)

    def shallow_clone(self) -> 'GameCharacter':
        # 浅拷贝，共享引用类型的数据
        return copy.copy(self)

    def add_skill(self, skill: str):
        self.skills.append(skill)

    def set_equipment(self, slot: str, item: str):
        self.equipment[slot] = item

    def set_position(self, x: int, y: int):
        self.position["x"] = x
        self.position["y"] = y

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return (f"角色: {self.name}, 等级: {self.level}, 生命值: {self.health}, "
                f"技能: {self.skills}, 装备: {self.equipment}, 位置: {self.position}")

# 文档原型类
class Document(Prototype):
    def __init__(self, title: str, content: str, metadata: Dict[str, Any] = None):
        self.title = title
        self.content = content
        self.metadata = metadata or {}
        self.created_at = "2024-01-01"
        self.version = 1

    def clone(self) -> 'Document':
        cloned = Document(self.title, self.content, copy.deepcopy(self.metadata))
        cloned.created_at = self.created_at
        cloned.version = self.version
        return cloned

    def update_content(self, new_content: str):
        self.content = new_content
        self.version += 1

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"文档: {self.title} (v{self.version}) - {self.content[:50]}..."

# 原型管理器
class PrototypeManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self._prototypes: Dict[str, Prototype] = {}

    def register_prototype(self, name: str, prototype: Prototype):
        self._prototypes[name] = prototype

    def unregister_prototype(self, name: str):
        if name in self._prototypes:
            del self._prototypes[name]

    def create_instance(self, name: str) -> Prototype:
        if name not in self._prototypes:
            raise ValueError(f"原型 '{name}' 不存在")
        return self._prototypes[name].clone()

    def list_prototypes(self) -> List[str]:
        return list(self._prototypes.keys())

# 配置原型类（支持序列化）
class Configuration(Prototype):
    def __init__(self, name: str, settings: Dict[str, Any] = None):
        self.name = name
        self.settings = settings or {}
        self.environment = "development"

    def clone(self) -> 'Configuration':
        # 使用JSON序列化进行深拷贝（适用于可序列化的对象）
        data = {
            'name': self.name,
            'settings': self.settings,
            'environment': self.environment
        }
        json_str = json.dumps(data)
        cloned_data = json.loads(json_str)

        cloned = Configuration(cloned_data['name'], cloned_data['settings'])
        cloned.environment = cloned_data['environment']
        return cloned

    def update_setting(self, key: str, value: Any):
        self.settings[key] = value

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"配置: {self.name} ({self.environment}) - {self.settings}"

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 创建原型管理器
    manager = PrototypeManager()

    # 创建游戏角色原型
    warrior_prototype = GameCharacter("战士模板", 1, 100, ["剑击", "盾牌格挡"])
    warrior_prototype.set_equipment("武器", "铁剑")
    warrior_prototype.set_equipment("防具", "皮甲")

    mage_prototype = GameCharacter("法师模板", 1, 80, ["火球术", "治疗术"])
    mage_prototype.set_equipment("武器", "法杖")
    mage_prototype.set_equipment("防具", "法袍")

    # 注册原型
    manager.register_prototype("warrior", warrior_prototype)
    manager.register_prototype("mage", mage_prototype)

    print("=== 游戏角色克隆示例 ===")
    # 创建角色实例
    player1 = manager.create_instance("warrior")
    player1.name = "亚瑟"
    player1.level = 5
    player1.set_position(10, 20)

    player2 = manager.create_instance("warrior")
    player2.name = "兰斯洛特"
    player2.level = 3
    player2.add_skill("旋风斩")
    player2.set_position(15, 25)

    print(f"玩家1: {player1}")
    print(f"玩家2: {player2}")
    print(f"原型: {warrior_prototype}")
    print()

    # 文档克隆示例
    print("=== 文档克隆示例 ===")
    template_doc = Document("报告模板", "这是一个报告模板...", {"作者": "系统", "类型": "模板"})

    doc1 = template_doc.clone()
    doc1.title = "月度销售报告"
    doc1.update_content("2024年1月销售数据...")
    doc1.metadata["作者"] = "张三"

    doc2 = template_doc.clone()
    doc2.title = "季度财务报告"
    doc2.update_content("2024年Q1财务数据...")
    doc2.metadata["作者"] = "李四"

    print(f"模板: {template_doc}")
    print(f"文档1: {doc1}")
    print(f"文档2: {doc2}")
    print()

    # 配置克隆示例
    print("=== 配置克隆示例 ===")
    base_config = Configuration("基础配置", {
        "database": {"host": "localhost", "port": 5432},
        "cache": {"enabled": True, "ttl": 3600}
    })

    dev_config = base_config.clone()
    dev_config.name = "开发环境配置"
    dev_config.environment = "development"
    dev_config.update_setting("debug", True)

    prod_config = base_config.clone()
    prod_config.name = "生产环境配置"
    prod_config.environment = "production"
    prod_config.settings["database"]["host"] = "prod-db.example.com"
    prod_config.update_setting("debug", False)

    print(f"基础配置: {base_config}")
    print(f"开发配置: {dev_config}")
    print(f"生产配置: {prod_config}")

package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "strings"
)

// 抽象原型接口
type Prototype interface {
    Clone() Prototype
}

// 具体原型类 - 游戏角色
type GameCharacter struct {
    Name      string            `json:"name"`
    Level     int               `json:"level"`
    Health    int               `json:"health"`
    Skills    []string          `json:"skills"`
    Equipment map[string]string `json:"equipment"`
    Position  map[string]int    `json:"position"`
}

func NewGameCharacter(name string, level, health int, skills []string) *GameCharacter {
    return &GameCharacter{
        Name:      name,
        Level:     level,
        Health:    health,
        Skills:    append([]string{}, skills...), // 复制切片
        Equipment: make(map[string]string),
        Position:  map[string]int{"x": 0, "y": 0},
    }
}

func (gc *GameCharacter) Clone() Prototype {
    // 深拷贝
    cloned := &GameCharacter{
        Name:      gc.Name,
        Level:     gc.Level,
        Health:    gc.Health,
        Skills:    make([]string, len(gc.Skills)),
        Equipment: make(map[string]string),
        Position:  make(map[string]int),
    }

    // 复制切片
    copy(cloned.Skills, gc.Skills)

    // 复制map
    for k, v := range gc.Equipment {
        cloned.Equipment[k] = v
    }
    for k, v := range gc.Position {
        cloned.Position[k] = v
    }

    return cloned
}

func (gc *GameCharacter) AddSkill(skill string) {
    gc.Skills = append(gc.Skills, skill)
}

func (gc *GameCharacter) SetEquipment(slot, item string) {
    gc.Equipment[slot] = item
}

func (gc *GameCharacter) SetPosition(x, y int) {
    gc.Position["x"] = x
    gc.Position["y"] = y
}

func (gc *GameCharacter) String() string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("角色: %s, 等级: %d, 生命值: %d, 技能: %v, 装备: %v, 位置: %v",
        gc.Name, gc.Level, gc.Health, gc.Skills, gc.Equipment, gc.Position)
}

// 文档原型类
type Document struct {
    Title     string                 `json:"title"`
    Content   string                 `json:"content"`
    Metadata  map[string]interface{} `json:"metadata"`
    CreatedAt string                 `json:"created_at"`
    Version   int                    `json:"version"`
}

func NewDocument(title, content string, metadata map[string]interface{}) *Document {
    if metadata == nil {
        metadata = make(map[string]interface{})
    }
    return &Document{
        Title:     title,
        Content:   content,
        Metadata:  metadata,
        CreatedAt: "2024-01-01",
        Version:   1,
    }
}

func (d *Document) Clone() Prototype {
    cloned := &Document{
        Title:     d.Title,
        Content:   d.Content,
        Metadata:  make(map[string]interface{}),
        CreatedAt: d.CreatedAt,
        Version:   d.Version,
    }

    // 深拷贝metadata
    for k, v := range d.Metadata {
        cloned.Metadata[k] = v
    }

    return cloned
}

func (d *Document) UpdateContent(newContent string) {
    d.Content = newContent
    d.Version++
}

func (d *Document) String() string {
    contentPreview := d.Content
    if len(contentPreview) > 50 {
        contentPreview = contentPreview[:50] + "..."
    }
    return fmt.Sprintf("文档: %s (v%d) - %s", d.Title, d.Version, contentPreview)
}

// 原型管理器
type PrototypeManager struct {
    prototypes map[string]Prototype
}

func NewPrototypeManager() *PrototypeManager {
    return &PrototypeManager{
        prototypes: make(map[string]Prototype),
    }
}

func (pm *PrototypeManager) RegisterPrototype(name string, prototype Prototype) {
    pm.prototypes[name] = prototype
}

func (pm *PrototypeManager) UnregisterPrototype(name string) {
    delete(pm.prototypes, name)
}

func (pm *PrototypeManager) CreateInstance(name string) (Prototype, error) {
    prototype, exists := pm.prototypes[name]
    if !exists {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("原型 '%s' 不存在", name)
    }
    return prototype.Clone(), nil
}

func (pm *PrototypeManager) ListPrototypes() []string {
    var names []string
    for name := range pm.prototypes {
        names = append(names, name)
    }
    return names
}

// 配置原型类（支持序列化）
type Configuration struct {
    Name        string                 `json:"name"`
    Settings    map[string]interface{} `json:"settings"`
    Environment string                 `json:"environment"`
}

func NewConfiguration(name string, settings map[string]interface{}) *Configuration {
    if settings == nil {
        settings = make(map[string]interface{})
    }
    return &Configuration{
        Name:        name,
        Settings:    settings,
        Environment: "development",
    }
}

func (c *Configuration) Clone() Prototype {
    // 使用JSON序列化进行深拷贝
    jsonData, err := json.Marshal(c)
    if err != nil {
        // 如果序列化失败，使用手动拷贝
        return c.manualClone()
    }

    var cloned Configuration
    err = json.Unmarshal(jsonData, &cloned)
    if err != nil {
        // 如果反序列化失败，使用手动拷贝
        return c.manualClone()
    }

    return &cloned
}

func (c *Configuration) manualClone() *Configuration {
    cloned := &Configuration{
        Name:        c.Name,
        Settings:    make(map[string]interface{}),
        Environment: c.Environment,
    }

    for k, v := range c.Settings {
        cloned.Settings[k] = v
    }

    return cloned
}

func (c *Configuration) UpdateSetting(key string, value interface{}) {
    c.Settings[key] = value
}

func (c *Configuration) String() string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("配置: %s (%s) - %v", c.Name, c.Environment, c.Settings)
}

func main() {
    // 创建原型管理器
    manager := NewPrototypeManager()

    // 创建游戏角色原型
    warriorPrototype := NewGameCharacter("战士模板", 1, 100, []string{"剑击", "盾牌格挡"})
    warriorPrototype.SetEquipment("武器", "铁剑")
    warriorPrototype.SetEquipment("防具", "皮甲")

    magePrototype := NewGameCharacter("法师模板", 1, 80, []string{"火球术", "治疗术"})
    magePrototype.SetEquipment("武器", "法杖")
    magePrototype.SetEquipment("防具", "法袍")

    // 注册原型
    manager.RegisterPrototype("warrior", warriorPrototype)
    manager.RegisterPrototype("mage", magePrototype)

    fmt.Println("=== 游戏角色克隆示例 ===")
    // 创建角色实例
    player1, _ := manager.CreateInstance("warrior")
    if gc1, ok := player1.(*GameCharacter); ok {
        gc1.Name = "亚瑟"
        gc1.Level = 5
        gc1.SetPosition(10, 20)
        fmt.Printf("玩家1: %s\n", gc1)
    }

    player2, _ := manager.CreateInstance("warrior")
    if gc2, ok := player2.(*GameCharacter); ok {
        gc2.Name = "兰斯洛特"
        gc2.Level = 3
        gc2.AddSkill("旋风斩")
        gc2.SetPosition(15, 25)
        fmt.Printf("玩家2: %s\n", gc2)
    }

    fmt.Printf("原型: %s\n", warriorPrototype)
    fmt.Println()

    // 文档克隆示例
    fmt.Println("=== 文档克隆示例 ===")
    templateDoc := NewDocument("报告模板", "这是一个报告模板...", map[string]interface{}{
        "作者": "系统",
        "类型": "模板",
    })

    doc1 := templateDoc.Clone().(*Document)
    doc1.Title = "月度销售报告"
    doc1.UpdateContent("2024年1月销售数据...")
    doc1.Metadata["作者"] = "张三"

    doc2 := templateDoc.Clone().(*Document)
    doc2.Title = "季度财务报告"
    doc2.UpdateContent("2024年Q1财务数据...")
    doc2.Metadata["作者"] = "李四"

    fmt.Printf("模板: %s\n", templateDoc)
    fmt.Printf("文档1: %s\n", doc1)
    fmt.Printf("文档2: %s\n", doc2)
    fmt.Println()

    // 配置克隆示例
    fmt.Println("=== 配置克隆示例 ===")
    baseConfig := NewConfiguration("基础配置", map[string]interface{}{
        "database": map[string]interface{}{
            "host": "localhost",
            "port": 5432,
        },
        "cache": map[string]interface{}{
            "enabled": true,
            "ttl":     3600,
        },
    })

    devConfig := baseConfig.Clone().(*Configuration)
    devConfig.Name = "开发环境配置"
    devConfig.Environment = "development"
    devConfig.UpdateSetting("debug", true)

    prodConfig := baseConfig.Clone().(*Configuration)
    prodConfig.Name = "生产环境配置"
    prodConfig.Environment = "production"
    if db, ok := prodConfig.Settings["database"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
        db["host"] = "prod-db.example.com"
    }
    prodConfig.UpdateSetting("debug", false)

    fmt.Printf("基础配置: %s\n", baseConfig)
    fmt.Printf("开发配置: %s\n", devConfig)
    fmt.Printf("生产配置: %s\n", prodConfig)
}

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

// 抽象原型trait
pub trait Prototype: Clone {
    fn clone_prototype(&self) -> Box<dyn Prototype>;
}

// 具体原型类 - 游戏角色
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GameCharacter {
    pub name: String,
    pub level: i32,
    pub health: i32,
    pub skills: Vec<String>,
    pub equipment: HashMap<String, String>,
    pub position: HashMap<String, i32>,
}

impl GameCharacter {
    pub fn new(name: String, level: i32, health: i32, skills: Vec<String>) -> Self {
        let mut position = HashMap::new();
        position.insert("x".to_string(), 0);
        position.insert("y".to_string(), 0);

        Self {
            name,
            level,
            health,
            skills,
            equipment: HashMap::new(),
            position,
        }
    }

    pub fn add_skill(&mut self, skill: &str) {
        self.skills.push(skill.to_string());
    }

    pub fn set_equipment(&mut self, slot: &str, item: &str) {
        self.equipment.insert(slot.to_string(), item.to_string());
    }

    pub fn set_position(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32) {
        self.position.insert("x".to_string(), x);
        self.position.insert("y".to_string(), y);
    }
}

impl Prototype for GameCharacter {
    fn clone_prototype(&self) -> Box<dyn Prototype> {
        Box::new(self.clone())
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for GameCharacter {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "角色: {}, 等级: {}, 生命值: {}, 技能: {:?}, 装备: {:?}, 位置: {:?}",
            self.name, self.level, self.health, self.skills, self.equipment, self.position)
    }
}

// 文档原型类
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Document {
    pub title: String,
    pub content: String,
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, String>,
    pub created_at: String,
    pub version: i32,
}

impl Document {
    pub fn new(title: String, content: String, metadata: HashMap<String, String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            title,
            content,
            metadata,
            created_at: "2024-01-01".to_string(),
            version: 1,
        }
    }

    pub fn update_content(&mut self, new_content: &str) {
        self.content = new_content.to_string();
        self.version += 1;
    }
}

impl Prototype for Document {
    fn clone_prototype(&self) -> Box<dyn Prototype> {
        Box::new(self.clone())
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for Document {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        let content_preview = if self.content.len() > 50 {
            format!("{}...", &self.content[..50])
        } else {
            self.content.clone()
        };
        write!(f, "文档: {} (v{}) - {}", self.title, self.version, content_preview)
    }
}

// 原型管理器
pub struct PrototypeManager {
    prototypes: HashMap<String, Box<dyn Prototype>>,
}

impl PrototypeManager {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            prototypes: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn register_prototype(&mut self, name: &str, prototype: Box<dyn Prototype>) {
        self.prototypes.insert(name.to_string(), prototype);
    }

    pub fn unregister_prototype(&mut self, name: &str) {
        self.prototypes.remove(name);
    }

    pub fn create_instance(&self, name: &str) -> Result<Box<dyn Prototype>, String> {
        match self.prototypes.get(name) {
            Some(prototype) => Ok(prototype.clone_prototype()),
            None => Err(format!("原型 '{}' 不存在", name)),
        }
    }

    pub fn list_prototypes(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.prototypes.keys().cloned().collect()
    }
}

// 配置原型类（支持序列化）
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Configuration {
    pub name: String,
    pub settings: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
    pub environment: String,
}

impl Configuration {
    pub fn new(name: String, settings: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>) -> Self {
        Self {
            name,
            settings,
            environment: "development".to_string(),
        }
    }

    pub fn update_setting(&mut self, key: &str, value: serde_json::Value) {
        self.settings.insert(key.to_string(), value);
    }

    // 使用JSON序列化进行深拷贝
    pub fn json_clone(&self) -> Result<Self, serde_json::Error> {
        let json_str = serde_json::to_string(self)?;
        serde_json::from_str(&json_str)
    }
}

impl Prototype for Configuration {
    fn clone_prototype(&self) -> Box<dyn Prototype> {
        // 尝试使用JSON序列化进行深拷贝，失败则使用标准克隆
        match self.json_clone() {
            Ok(cloned) => Box::new(cloned),
            Err(_) => Box::new(self.clone()),
        }
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for Configuration {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "配置: {} ({}) - {:?}", self.name, self.environment, self.settings)
    }
}

fn main() {
    // 创建原型管理器
    let mut manager = PrototypeManager::new();

    // 创建游戏角色原型
    let mut warrior_prototype = GameCharacter::new(
        "战士模板".to_string(),
        1,
        100,
        vec!["剑击".to_string(), "盾牌格挡".to_string()]
    );
    warrior_prototype.set_equipment("武器", "铁剑");
    warrior_prototype.set_equipment("防具", "皮甲");

    let mut mage_prototype = GameCharacter::new(
        "法师模板".to_string(),
        1,

    );
    mage_prototype.set_equipment("武器", "法杖");
    mage_prototype.set_equipment("防具", "法袍");

    // 注册原型
    manager.register_prototype("warrior", Box::new(warrior_prototype.clone()));
    manager.register_prototype("mage", Box::new(mage_prototype.clone()));

    println!("=== 游戏角色克隆示例 ===");
    // 创建角色实例
    if let Ok(player1_proto) = manager.create_instance("warrior") {
        // 由于Rust的类型系统限制，这里需要重新创建具体类型的实例
        let mut player1 = warrior_prototype.clone();
        player1.name = "亚瑟".to_string();
        player1.level = 5;
        player1.set_position(10, 20);
        println!("玩家1: {}", player1);
    }

    if let Ok(player2_proto) = manager.create_instance("warrior") {
        let mut player2 = warrior_prototype.clone();
        player2.name = "兰斯洛特".to_string();
        player2.level = 3;
        player2.add_skill("旋风斩");
        player2.set_position(15, 25);
        println!("玩家2: {}", player2);
    }

    println!("原型: {}", warrior_prototype);
    println!();

    // 文档克隆示例
    println!("=== 文档克隆示例 ===");
    let mut metadata = HashMap::new();
    metadata.insert("作者".to_string(), "系统".to_string());
    metadata.insert("类型".to_string(), "模板".to_string());

    let template_doc = Document::new(
        "报告模板".to_string(),

    );

    let mut doc1 = template_doc.clone();

    doc1.update_content("2024年1月销售数据...");

    // 配置克隆示例
    println!("=== 配置克隆示例 ===");
    let mut base_settings = HashMap::new();
    base_settings.insert("database".to_string(), serde_json::json!({

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 命令模式是一种行为型设计模式，它将请求封装成对象，从而使你可用不同的请求对客户进行参数化；对请求排队或记录请求日志，以及支持可撤销的操作。命令模式把发出命令的责任和执行命令的责任分割开，委派给不同的对象。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 需要将请求调用者和请求接收者解耦
  • 需要在不同的时间指定、排列和执行请求
  • 需要支持撤销操作
  • 需要支持日志记录、事务等功能
  • GUI按钮和菜单项、宏录制、队列请求、日志和撤销操作

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 降低了系统耦合度
  • 新的命令可以很容易添加到系统中去
  • 可以比较容易地设计一个命令队列和宏命令
  • 可以方便地实现对请求的撤销和重做

缺点：

  • 使用命令模式可能会导致某些系统有过多的具体命令类
