from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Any
import copy
from enum import Enum

# 命令接口
class Command(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def execute(self) -> Any:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def undo(self) -> Any:
        pass

# 接收者 - 文本编辑器
class TextEditor:
    def __init__(self):
        self.content = ""
        self.cursor_position = 0

    def insert_text(self, text: str, position: int = None) -> None:
        if position is None:
            position = self.cursor_position
        self.content = self.content[:position] + text + self.content[position:]
        self.cursor_position = position + len(text)
        print(f"插入文本 '{text}' 在位置 {position}")

    def delete_text(self, start: int, length: int) -> str:
        deleted_text = self.content[start:start + length]
        self.content = self.content[:start] + self.content[start + length:]
        self.cursor_position = start
        print(f"删除文本 '{deleted_text}' 从位置 {start}")
        return deleted_text

    def replace_text(self, start: int, length: int, new_text: str) -> str:
        old_text = self.content[start:start + length]
        self.content = self.content[:start] + new_text + self.content[start + length:]
        self.cursor_position = start + len(new_text)
        print(f"替换文本 '{old_text}' 为 '{new_text}' 在位置 {start}")
        return old_text

    def get_content(self) -> str:
        return self.content

    def set_cursor_position(self, position: int) -> None:
        self.cursor_position = max(0, min(position, len(self.content)))

# 具体命令 - 插入文本命令
class InsertTextCommand(Command):
    def __init__(self, editor: TextEditor, text: str, position: int = None):
        self.editor = editor
        self.text = text
        self.position = position if position is not None else editor.cursor_position
        self.executed = False

    def execute(self) -> None:
        self.editor.insert_text(self.text, self.position)
        self.executed = True

    def undo(self) -> None:
        if self.executed:
            self.editor.delete_text(self.position, len(self.text))
            self.executed = False

# 具体命令 - 删除文本命令
class DeleteTextCommand(Command):
    def __init__(self, editor: TextEditor, start: int, length: int):
        self.editor = editor
        self.start = start
        self.length = length
        self.deleted_text = ""
        self.executed = False

    def execute(self) -> None:
        self.deleted_text = self.editor.delete_text(self.start, self.length)
        self.executed = True

    def undo(self) -> None:
        if self.executed:
            self.editor.insert_text(self.deleted_text, self.start)
            self.executed = False

# 具体命令 - 替换文本命令
class ReplaceTextCommand(Command):
    def __init__(self, editor: TextEditor, start: int, length: int, new_text: str):
        self.editor = editor
        self.start = start
        self.length = length
        self.new_text = new_text
        self.old_text = ""
        self.executed = False

    def execute(self) -> None:
        self.old_text = self.editor.replace_text(self.start, self.length, self.new_text)
        self.executed = True

    def undo(self) -> None:
        if self.executed:
            self.editor.replace_text(self.start, len(self.new_text), self.old_text)
            self.executed = False

# 宏命令 - 组合多个命令
class MacroCommand(Command):
    def __init__(self, commands: List[Command]):
        self.commands = commands
        self.executed = False

    def execute(self) -> None:
        for command in self.commands:
            command.execute()
        self.executed = True

    def undo(self) -> None:
        if self.executed:
            # 逆序撤销
            for command in reversed(self.commands):
                command.undo()
            self.executed = False

# 调用者 - 编辑器控制器
class EditorController:
    def __init__(self, editor: TextEditor):
        self.editor = editor
        self.history: List[Command] = []
        self.current_position = -1

    def execute_command(self, command: Command) -> None:
        # 执行命令前，清除当前位置之后的历史
        self.history = self.history[:self.current_position + 1]

        command.execute()
        self.history.append(command)
        self.current_position += 1

        print(f"执行命令，历史记录数量: {len(self.history)}")

    def undo(self) -> bool:
        if self.current_position >= 0:
            command = self.history[self.current_position]
            command.undo()
            self.current_position -= 1
            print(f"撤销命令，当前位置: {self.current_position}")
            return True
        print("没有可撤销的命令")
        return False

    def redo(self) -> bool:
        if self.current_position < len(self.history) - 1:
            self.current_position += 1
            command = self.history[self.current_position]
            command.execute()
            print(f"重做命令，当前位置: {self.current_position}")
            return True
        print("没有可重做的命令")
        return False

    def get_content(self) -> str:
        return self.editor.get_content()

# 远程控制示例
class Light:
    def __init__(self, location: str):
        self.location = location
        self.is_on = False

    def turn_on(self) -> None:
        self.is_on = True
        print(f"{self.location} 灯已打开")

    def turn_off(self) -> None:
        self.is_on = False
        print(f"{self.location} 灯已关闭")

class Fan:
    def __init__(self, location: str):
        self.location = location
        self.speed = 0  # 0=关闭, 1=低速, 2=中速, 3=高速

    def turn_on(self, speed: int = 1) -> None:
        self.speed = speed
        print(f"{self.location} 风扇已开启，速度: {speed}")

    def turn_off(self) -> None:
        self.speed = 0
        print(f"{self.location} 风扇已关闭")

# 设备控制命令
class LightOnCommand(Command):
    def __init__(self, light: Light):
        self.light = light
        self.previous_state = False

    def execute(self) -> None:
        self.previous_state = self.light.is_on
        self.light.turn_on()

    def undo(self) -> None:
        if not self.previous_state:
            self.light.turn_off()

class LightOffCommand(Command):
    def __init__(self, light: Light):
        self.light = light
        self.previous_state = False

    def execute(self) -> None:
        self.previous_state = self.light.is_on
        self.light.turn_off()

    def undo(self) -> None:
        if self.previous_state:
            self.light.turn_on()

class FanCommand(Command):
    def __init__(self, fan: Fan, speed: int):
        self.fan = fan
        self.speed = speed
        self.previous_speed = 0

    def execute(self) -> None:
        self.previous_speed = self.fan.speed
        if self.speed == 0:
            self.fan.turn_off()
        else:
            self.fan.turn_on(self.speed)

    def undo(self) -> None:
        if self.previous_speed == 0:
            self.fan.turn_off()
        else:
            self.fan.turn_on(self.previous_speed)

# 空命令（空对象模式）
class NoCommand(Command):
    def execute(self) -> None:
        pass

    def undo(self) -> None:
        pass

# 远程控制器
class RemoteControl:
    def __init__(self):
        self.on_commands: List[Command] = [NoCommand()] * 7
        self.off_commands: List[Command] = [NoCommand()] * 7
        self.undo_command: Command = NoCommand()

    def set_command(self, slot: int, on_command: Command, off_command: Command) -> None:
        self.on_commands[slot] = on_command
        self.off_commands[slot] = off_command

    def on_button_pressed(self, slot: int) -> None:
        self.on_commands[slot].execute()
        self.undo_command = self.on_commands[slot]

    def off_button_pressed(self, slot: int) -> None:
        self.off_commands[slot].execute()
        self.undo_command = self.off_commands[slot]

    def undo_button_pressed(self) -> None:
        self.undo_command.undo()

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== 文本编辑器命令模式示例 ===")

    # 创建文本编辑器和控制器
    editor = TextEditor()
    controller = EditorController(editor)

    # 执行一系列编辑命令
    controller.execute_command(InsertTextCommand(editor, "Hello"))
    print(f"内容: '{controller.get_content()}'")

    controller.execute_command(InsertTextCommand(editor, " World"))
    print(f"内容: '{controller.get_content()}'")

    controller.execute_command(ReplaceTextCommand(editor, 0, 5, "Hi"))
    print(f"内容: '{controller.get_content()}'")

    # 撤销操作
    controller.undo()
    print(f"撤销后内容: '{controller.get_content()}'")

    controller.undo()
    print(f"撤销后内容: '{controller.get_content()}'")

    # 重做操作
    controller.redo()
    print(f"重做后内容: '{controller.get_content()}'")

    print("\n=== 宏命令示例 ===")

    # 创建宏命令
    macro_commands = [
        DeleteTextCommand(editor, 0, len(editor.get_content())),  # 清空
        InsertTextCommand(editor, "Python"),
        InsertTextCommand(editor, " is"),
        InsertTextCommand(editor, " awesome!")
    ]
    macro = MacroCommand(macro_commands)

    controller.execute_command(macro)
    print(f"宏命令执行后: '{controller.get_content()}'")

    controller.undo()
    print(f"宏命令撤销后: '{controller.get_content()}'")

    print("\n=== 远程控制器示例 ===")

    # 创建设备
    living_room_light = Light("客厅")
    kitchen_light = Light("厨房")
    bedroom_fan = Fan("卧室")

    # 创建命令
    living_room_light_on = LightOnCommand(living_room_light)
    living_room_light_off = LightOffCommand(living_room_light)
    kitchen_light_on = LightOnCommand(kitchen_light)
    kitchen_light_off = LightOffCommand(kitchen_light)
    bedroom_fan_high = FanCommand(bedroom_fan, 3)
    bedroom_fan_off = FanCommand(bedroom_fan, 0)

    # 创建远程控制器
    remote = RemoteControl()
    remote.set_command(0, living_room_light_on, living_room_light_off)
    remote.set_command(1, kitchen_light_on, kitchen_light_off)
    remote.set_command(2, bedroom_fan_high, bedroom_fan_off)

    # 使用远程控制器
    print("按下客厅灯开关:")
    remote.on_button_pressed(0)

    print("按下厨房灯开关:")
    remote.on_button_pressed(1)

    print("按下卧室风扇开关:")
    remote.on_button_pressed(2)

    print("按下撤销按钮:")
    remote.undo_button_pressed()

    print("按下客厅灯关闭:")
    remote.off_button_pressed(0)

    print("按下撤销按钮:")
    remote.undo_button_pressed()

package main

import (
    "fmt"
)

// Command 命令接口
type Command interface {
    Execute() error
    Undo() error
}

// TextEditor 文本编辑器（接收者）
type TextEditor struct {
    content        string
    cursorPosition int
}

func NewTextEditor() *TextEditor {
    return &TextEditor{
        content:        "",
        cursorPosition: 0,
    }
}

func (te *TextEditor) InsertText(text string, position int) {
    if position < 0 {
        position = te.cursorPosition
    }
    te.content = te.content[:position] + text + te.content[position:]
    te.cursorPosition = position + len(text)
    fmt.Printf("插入文本 '%s' 在位置 %d\n", text, position)
}

func (te *TextEditor) DeleteText(start, length int) string {
    if start < 0 || start >= len(te.content) {
        return ""
    }
    end := start + length
    if end > len(te.content) {
        end = len(te.content)
    }

    deletedText := te.content[start:end]
    te.content = te.content[:start] + te.content[end:]
    te.cursorPosition = start
    fmt.Printf("删除文本 '%s' 从位置 %d\n", deletedText, start)
    return deletedText
}

func (te *TextEditor) GetContent() string {
    return te.content
}

// InsertTextCommand 插入文本命令
type InsertTextCommand struct {
    editor   *TextEditor
    text     string
    position int
    executed bool
}

func NewInsertTextCommand(editor *TextEditor, text string, position int) *InsertTextCommand {
    if position < 0 {
        position = editor.cursorPosition
    }
    return &InsertTextCommand{
        editor:   editor,
        text:     text,
        position: position,
        executed: false,
    }
}

func (cmd *InsertTextCommand) Execute() error {
    cmd.editor.InsertText(cmd.text, cmd.position)
    cmd.executed = true
    return nil
}

func (cmd *InsertTextCommand) Undo() error {
    if cmd.executed {
        cmd.editor.DeleteText(cmd.position, len(cmd.text))
        cmd.executed = false
    }
    return nil
}

// EditorController 编辑器控制器（调用者）
type EditorController struct {
    editor          *TextEditor
    history         []Command
    currentPosition int
}

func NewEditorController(editor *TextEditor) *EditorController {
    return &EditorController{
        editor:          editor,
        history:         make([]Command, 0),
        currentPosition: -1,
    }
}

func (ec *EditorController) ExecuteCommand(command Command) error {
    ec.history = ec.history[:ec.currentPosition+1]

    if err := command.Execute(); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    ec.history = append(ec.history, command)
    ec.currentPosition++

    fmt.Printf("执行命令，历史记录数量: %d\n", len(ec.history))
    return nil
}

func (ec *EditorController) Undo() bool {
    if ec.currentPosition >= 0 {
        command := ec.history[ec.currentPosition]
        command.Undo()
        ec.currentPosition--
        fmt.Printf("撤销命令，当前位置: %d\n", ec.currentPosition)
        return true
    }
    fmt.Println("没有可撤销的命令")
    return false
}

func (ec *EditorController) GetContent() string {
    return ec.editor.GetContent()
}

func main() {
    fmt.Println("=== 文本编辑器命令模式示例 ===")

    editor := NewTextEditor()
    controller := NewEditorController(editor)

    controller.ExecuteCommand(NewInsertTextCommand(editor, "Hello", -1))
    fmt.Printf("内容: '%s'\n", controller.GetContent())

    controller.ExecuteCommand(NewInsertTextCommand(editor, " World", -1))
    fmt.Printf("内容: '%s'\n", controller.GetContent())

    controller.Undo()
    fmt.Printf("撤销后内容: '%s'\n", controller.GetContent())
}

// 命令trait
pub trait Command {
    fn execute(&mut self) -> Result<(), String>;
    fn undo(&mut self) -> Result<(), String>;
}

// 文本编辑器（接收者）
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct TextEditor {
    content: String,
    cursor_position: usize,
}

impl TextEditor {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        TextEditor {
            content: String::new(),
            cursor_position: 0,
        }
    }

    pub fn insert_text(&mut self, text: &str, position: Option<usize>) {
        let pos = position.unwrap_or(self.cursor_position);
        let pos = pos.min(self.content.len());

        self.content.insert_str(pos, text);
        self.cursor_position = pos + text.len();
        println!("插入文本 '{}' 在位置 {}", text, pos);
    }

    pub fn delete_text(&mut self, start: usize, length: usize) -> String {
        if start >= self.content.len() {
            return String::new();
        }

        let end = (start + length).min(self.content.len());
        let deleted_text: String = self.content.chars().skip(start).take(end - start).collect();

        let before: String = self.content.chars().take(start).collect();
        let after: String = self.content.chars().skip(end).collect();
        self.content = before + &after;

        self.cursor_position = start;
        println!("删除文本 '{}' 从位置 {}", deleted_text, start);
        deleted_text
    }

    pub fn get_content(&self) -> &str {
        &self.content
    }
}

// 插入文本命令
pub struct InsertTextCommand {
    editor: TextEditor,
    text: String,
    position: usize,
    executed: bool,
}

impl InsertTextCommand {
    pub fn new(editor: TextEditor, text: String, position: Option<usize>) -> Self {
        let pos = position.unwrap_or(editor.cursor_position);
        InsertTextCommand {
            editor,
            text,
            position: pos,
            executed: false,
        }
    }
}

impl Command for InsertTextCommand {
    fn execute(&mut self) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.editor.insert_text(&self.text, Some(self.position));
        self.executed = true;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn undo(&mut self) -> Result<(), String> {
        if self.executed {
            self.editor.delete_text(self.position, self.text.len());
            self.executed = false;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

// 编辑器控制器（调用者）
pub struct EditorController {
    editor: TextEditor,
    history: Vec<Box<dyn Command>>,
    current_position: i32,
}

impl EditorController {
    pub fn new(editor: TextEditor) -> Self {
        EditorController {
            editor,
            history: Vec::new(),
            current_position: -1,
        }
    }

    pub fn execute_command(&mut self, mut command: Box<dyn Command>) -> Result<(), String> {
        self.history.truncate((self.current_position + 1) as usize);

        command.execute()?;
        self.history.push(command);
        self.current_position += 1;

        println!("执行命令，历史记录数量: {}", self.history.len());
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn undo(&mut self) -> bool {
        if self.current_position >= 0 {
            let index = self.current_position as usize;
            self.history[index].undo().ok();
            self.current_position -= 1;
            println!("撤销命令，当前位置: {}", self.current_position);
            true
        } else {
            println!("没有可撤销的命令");
            false
        }
    }

    pub fn get_content(&self) -> &str {
        self.editor.get_content()
    }
}

fn main() {
    println!("=== 文本编辑器命令模式示例 ===");

    let editor = TextEditor::new();
    let mut controller = EditorController::new(editor.clone());

    controller.execute_command(Box::new(InsertTextCommand::new(editor.clone(), "Hello".to_string(), None))).ok();
    println!("内容: '{}'", controller.get_content());

    controller.execute_command(Box::new(InsertTextCommand::new(editor.clone(), " World".to_string(), None))).ok();
    println!("内容: '{}'", controller.get_content());

    controller.undo();
    println!("撤销后内容: '{}'", controller.get_content());
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 备忘录模式是一种行为型设计模式，它在不破坏封装性的前提下，捕获一个对象的内部状态，并在该对象之外保存这个状态，以便以后当需要时能将该对象恢复到原先保存的状态。备忘录模式又叫快照模式。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 需要保存/恢复数据的相关状态场景
  • 提供一个可回滚的操作
  • 需要监控的副本场景中，但又不希望提供它的全部访问权限
  • 文本编辑器的撤销功能、游戏存档、数据库事务回滚、浏览器历史记录

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 给用户提供了一种可以恢复状态的机制，可以使用户能够比较方便地回到某个历史的状态
  • 实现了信息的封装，使得用户不需要关心状态的保存细节

缺点：

  • 消耗资源，如果类的成员变量过多，势必会占用比较大的资源
  • 而且每一次保存都会消耗一定的内存

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Any, Dict, Optional
import copy
import json
from datetime import datetime

# 备忘录接口
class Memento(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def get_state(self) -> Any:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get_name(self) -> str:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get_date(self) -> str:
        pass

# 具体备忘录
class ConcreteMemento(Memento):
    def __init__(self, state: Any, name: str = ""):
        self._state = copy.deepcopy(state)
        self._name = name if name else f"Backup_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
        self._date = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

    def get_state(self) -> Any:
        return copy.deepcopy(self._state)

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return self._name

    def get_date(self) -> str:
        return self._date

# 发起人 - 文本编辑器
class TextEditor:
    def __init__(self):
        self._content = ""
        self._cursor_position = 0
        self._font_size = 12
        self._font_family = "Arial"
        self._is_bold = False
        self._is_italic = False

    def write(self, text: str) -> None:
        """在光标位置插入文本"""
        self._content = (self._content[:self._cursor_position] +
                        text +
                        self._content[self._cursor_position:])
        self._cursor_position += len(text)
        print(f"写入文本: '{text}'")

    def delete(self, length: int) -> None:
        """从光标位置删除指定长度的文本"""
        start = max(0, self._cursor_position - length)
        deleted_text = self._content[start:self._cursor_position]
        self._content = self._content[:start] + self._content[self._cursor_position:]
        self._cursor_position = start
        print(f"删除文本: '{deleted_text}'")

    def set_cursor_position(self, position: int) -> None:
        """设置光标位置"""
        self._cursor_position = max(0, min(position, len(self._content)))

    def set_font_size(self, size: int) -> None:
        """设置字体大小"""
        self._font_size = size
        print(f"字体大小设置为: {size}")

    def set_font_family(self, family: str) -> None:
        """设置字体"""
        self._font_family = family
        print(f"字体设置为: {family}")

    def toggle_bold(self) -> None:
        """切换粗体"""
        self._is_bold = not self._is_bold
        print(f"粗体: {'开启' if self._is_bold else '关闭'}")

    def toggle_italic(self) -> None:
        """切换斜体"""
        self._is_italic = not self._is_italic
        print(f"斜体: {'开启' if self._is_italic else '关闭'}")

    def get_content(self) -> str:
        return self._content

    def get_state_info(self) -> str:
        """获取当前状态信息"""
        return (f"内容: '{self._content}' | "
                f"光标: {self._cursor_position} | "
                f"字体: {self._font_family} {self._font_size}pt | "
                f"样式: {'粗体' if self._is_bold else ''}{'斜体' if self._is_italic else ''}")

    def save(self, name: str = "") -> Memento:
        """保存当前状态到备忘录"""
        state = {
            'content': self._content,
            'cursor_position': self._cursor_position,
            'font_size': self._font_size,
            'font_family': self._font_family,
            'is_bold': self._is_bold,
            'is_italic': self._is_italic
        }
        print(f"保存状态: {name if name else '自动保存'}")
        return ConcreteMemento(state, name)

    def restore(self, memento: Memento) -> None:
        """从备忘录恢复状态"""
        state = memento.get_state()
        self._content = state['content']
        self._cursor_position = state['cursor_position']
        self._font_size = state['font_size']
        self._font_family = state['font_family']
        self._is_bold = state['is_bold']
        self._is_italic = state['is_italic']
        print(f"恢复状态: {memento.get_name()} ({memento.get_date()})")

# 管理者 - 历史记录管理器
class HistoryManager:
    def __init__(self, max_history: int = 10):
        self._mementos: List[Memento] = []
        self._max_history = max_history
        self._current_index = -1

    def backup(self, memento: Memento) -> None:
        """保存备忘录"""
        # 如果当前不在历史记录的末尾，删除后面的记录
        if self._current_index < len(self._mementos) - 1:
            self._mementos = self._mementos[:self._current_index + 1]

        self._mementos.append(memento)
        self._current_index += 1

        # 限制历史记录数量
        if len(self._mementos) > self._max_history:
            self._mementos.pop(0)
            self._current_index -= 1

        print(f"历史记录数量: {len(self._mementos)}")

    def undo(self) -> Optional[Memento]:
        """撤销到上一个状态"""
        if self._current_index > 0:
            self._current_index -= 1
            return self._mementos[self._current_index]
        return None

    def redo(self) -> Optional[Memento]:
        """重做到下一个状态"""
        if self._current_index < len(self._mementos) - 1:
            self._current_index += 1
            return self._mementos[self._current_index]
        return None

    def get_history(self) -> List[str]:
        """获取历史记录列表"""
        history = []
        for i, memento in enumerate(self._mementos):
            marker = " -> " if i == self._current_index else "    "
            history.append(f"{marker}{memento.get_name()} ({memento.get_date()})")
        return history

    def can_undo(self) -> bool:
        return self._current_index > 0

    def can_redo(self) -> bool:
        return self._current_index < len(self._mementos) - 1

# 游戏存档示例
class GameState:
    def __init__(self):
        self.level = 1
        self.score = 0
        self.health = 100
        self.position = {"x": 0, "y": 0}
        self.inventory = []
        self.achievements = set()

    def play_level(self, level_score: int, health_change: int, new_items: List[str] = None) -> None:
        """玩一关"""
        self.score += level_score
        self.health += health_change
        self.health = max(0, min(100, self.health))  # 限制在0-100之间

        if new_items:
            self.inventory.extend(new_items)

        if self.score >= self.level * 1000:
            self.level += 1
            self.achievements.add(f"Level {self.level - 1} Complete")

        print(f"关卡进度 - 等级: {self.level}, 分数: {self.score}, 生命: {self.health}")

    def move_to(self, x: int, y: int) -> None:
        """移动到指定位置"""
        self.position = {"x": x, "y": y}
        print(f"移动到位置: ({x}, {y})")

    def get_status(self) -> str:
        return (f"等级: {self.level} | 分数: {self.score} | 生命: {self.health} | "
                f"位置: ({self.position['x']}, {self.position['y']}) | "
                f"物品: {len(self.inventory)} | 成就: {len(self.achievements)}")

    def save_game(self, save_name: str = "") -> Memento:
        """保存游戏"""
        state = {
            'level': self.level,
            'score': self.score,
            'health': self.health,
            'position': self.position.copy(),
            'inventory': self.inventory.copy(),
            'achievements': self.achievements.copy()
        }
        name = save_name if save_name else f"Save_Level_{self.level}"
        print(f"游戏已保存: {name}")
        return ConcreteMemento(state, name)

    def load_game(self, memento: Memento) -> None:
        """加载游戏"""
        state = memento.get_state()
        self.level = state['level']
        self.score = state['score']
        self.health = state['health']
        self.position = state['position']
        self.inventory = state['inventory']
        self.achievements = state['achievements']
        print(f"游戏已加载: {memento.get_name()} ({memento.get_date()})")

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== 文本编辑器备忘录示例 ===")

    # 创建文本编辑器和历史管理器
    editor = TextEditor()
    history = HistoryManager(max_history=5)

    # 初始保存
    history.backup(editor.save("初始状态"))

    # 编辑文档
    editor.write("Hello")
    history.backup(editor.save("写入Hello"))
    print(f"当前状态: {editor.get_state_info()}")

    editor.write(" World")
    history.backup(editor.save("写入World"))
    print(f"当前状态: {editor.get_state_info()}")

    editor.set_font_size(16)
    editor.toggle_bold()
    history.backup(editor.save("格式调整"))
    print(f"当前状态: {editor.get_state_info()}")

    editor.write("!")
    history.backup(editor.save("添加感叹号"))
    print(f"当前状态: {editor.get_state_info()}")

    print("\n--- 撤销操作 ---")
    if history.can_undo():
        memento = history.undo()
        editor.restore(memento)
        print(f"撤销后状态: {editor.get_state_info()}")

    if history.can_undo():
        memento = history.undo()
        editor.restore(memento)
        print(f"撤销后状态: {editor.get_state_info()}")

    print("\n--- 重做操作 ---")
    if history.can_redo():
        memento = history.redo()
        editor.restore(memento)
        print(f"重做后状态: {editor.get_state_info()}")

    print("\n--- 历史记录 ---")
    for record in history.get_history():
        print(record)

    print("\n=== 游戏存档示例 ===")

    # 创建游戏状态
    game = GameState()
    save_manager = HistoryManager(max_history=3)

    # 初始存档
    save_manager.backup(game.save_game("游戏开始"))
    print(f"初始状态: {game.get_status()}")

    # 玩第一关
    game.play_level(500, -10, ["剑", "盾牌"])
    game.move_to(10, 5)
    save_manager.backup(game.save_game("第一关完成"))
    print(f"第一关后: {game.get_status()}")

    # 玩第二关
    game.play_level(800, -20, ["药水", "魔法书"])
    game.move_to(25, 15)
    save_manager.backup(game.save_game("第二关完成"))
    print(f"第二关后: {game.get_status()}")

    # 玩第三关（失败）
    game.play_level(200, -80)  # 生命值大幅下降
    print(f"第三关失败: {game.get_status()}")

    # 加载第二关存档
    print("\n--- 加载存档 ---")
    if save_manager.can_undo():
        memento = save_manager.undo()
        game.load_game(memento)
        print(f"加载后状态: {game.get_status()}")

    print("\n--- 存档历史 ---")
    for record in save_manager.get_history():
        print(record)

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "time"
)

// 备忘录接口
type Memento interface {
    GetState() map[string]interface{}
    GetName() string
    GetDate() string
}

// 具体备忘录
type ConcreteMemento struct {
    state map[string]interface{}
    name  string
    date  string
}

func NewConcreteMemento(state map[string]interface{}, name string) *ConcreteMemento {
    if name == "" {
        name = fmt.Sprintf("Backup_%s", time.Now().Format("20060102_150405"))
    }

    // 深拷贝状态
    stateCopy := make(map[string]interface{})
    for k, v := range state {
        stateCopy[k] = v
    }

    return &ConcreteMemento{
        state: stateCopy,
        name:  name,
        date:  time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"),
    }
}

func (cm *ConcreteMemento) GetState() map[string]interface{} {
    // 返回状态的深拷贝
    stateCopy := make(map[string]interface{})
    for k, v := range cm.state {
        stateCopy[k] = v
    }
    return stateCopy
}

func (cm *ConcreteMemento) GetName() string {
    return cm.name
}

func (cm *ConcreteMemento) GetDate() string {
    return cm.date
}

// 发起人 - 文本编辑器
type TextEditor struct {
    content        string
    cursorPosition int
    fontSize       int
    fontFamily     string
    isBold         bool
    isItalic       bool
}

func NewTextEditor() *TextEditor {
    return &TextEditor{
        content:        "",
        cursorPosition: 0,
        fontSize:       12,
        fontFamily:     "Arial",
        isBold:         false,
        isItalic:       false,
    }
}

func (te *TextEditor) Write(text string) {
    // 在光标位置插入文本
    te.content = te.content[:te.cursorPosition] + text + te.content[te.cursorPosition:]
    te.cursorPosition += len(text)
    fmt.Printf("写入文本: '%s'\n", text)
}

func (te *TextEditor) Delete(length int) {
    // 从光标位置删除指定长度的文本
    start := te.cursorPosition - length
    if start < 0 {
        start = 0
    }
    deletedText := te.content[start:te.cursorPosition]
    te.content = te.content[:start] + te.content[te.cursorPosition:]
    te.cursorPosition = start
    fmt.Printf("删除文本: '%s'\n", deletedText)
}

func (te *TextEditor) SetCursorPosition(position int) {
    if position < 0 {
        position = 0
    }
    if position > len(te.content) {
        position = len(te.content)
    }
    te.cursorPosition = position
}

func (te *TextEditor) SetFontSize(size int) {
    te.fontSize = size
    fmt.Printf("字体大小设置为: %d\n", size)
}

func (te *TextEditor) SetFontFamily(family string) {
    te.fontFamily = family
    fmt.Printf("字体设置为: %s\n", family)
}

func (te *TextEditor) ToggleBold() {
    te.isBold = !te.isBold
    status := "关闭"
    if te.isBold {
        status = "开启"
    }
    fmt.Printf("粗体: %s\n", status)
}

func (te *TextEditor) ToggleItalic() {
    te.isItalic = !te.isItalic
    status := "关闭"
    if te.isItalic {
        status = "开启"
    }
    fmt.Printf("斜体: %s\n", status)
}

func (te *TextEditor) GetContent() string {
    return te.content
}

func (te *TextEditor) GetStateInfo() string {
    style := ""
    if te.isBold {
        style += "粗体"
    }
    if te.isItalic {
        style += "斜体"
    }
    return fmt.Sprintf("内容: '%s' | 光标: %d | 字体: %s %dpt | 样式: %s",
        te.content, te.cursorPosition, te.fontFamily, te.fontSize, style)
}

func (te *TextEditor) Save(name string) Memento {
    state := map[string]interface{}{
        "content":         te.content,
        "cursor_position": te.cursorPosition,
        "font_size":       te.fontSize,
        "font_family":     te.fontFamily,
        "is_bold":         te.isBold,
        "is_italic":       te.isItalic,
    }

    saveName := name
    if saveName == "" {
        saveName = "自动保存"
    }
    fmt.Printf("保存状态: %s\n", saveName)
    return NewConcreteMemento(state, name)
}

func (te *TextEditor) Restore(memento Memento) {
    state := memento.GetState()
    te.content = state["content"].(string)
    te.cursorPosition = state["cursor_position"].(int)
    te.fontSize = state["font_size"].(int)
    te.fontFamily = state["font_family"].(string)
    te.isBold = state["is_bold"].(bool)
    te.isItalic = state["is_italic"].(bool)
    fmt.Printf("恢复状态: %s (%s)\n", memento.GetName(), memento.GetDate())
}

// 管理者 - 历史记录管理器
type HistoryManager struct {
    mementos     []Memento
    maxHistory   int
    currentIndex int
}

func NewHistoryManager(maxHistory int) *HistoryManager {
    return &HistoryManager{
        mementos:     make([]Memento, 0),
        maxHistory:   maxHistory,
        currentIndex: -1,
    }
}

func (hm *HistoryManager) Backup(memento Memento) {
    // 如果当前不在历史记录的末尾，删除后面的记录
    if hm.currentIndex < len(hm.mementos)-1 {
        hm.mementos = hm.mementos[:hm.currentIndex+1]
    }

    hm.mementos = append(hm.mementos, memento)
    hm.currentIndex++

    // 限制历史记录数量
    if len(hm.mementos) > hm.maxHistory {
        hm.mementos = hm.mementos[1:]
        hm.currentIndex--
    }

    fmt.Printf("历史记录数量: %d\n", len(hm.mementos))
}

func (hm *HistoryManager) Undo() Memento {
    if hm.currentIndex > 0 {
        hm.currentIndex--
        return hm.mementos[hm.currentIndex]
    }
    return nil
}

func (hm *HistoryManager) Redo() Memento {
    if hm.currentIndex < len(hm.mementos)-1 {
        hm.currentIndex++
        return hm.mementos[hm.currentIndex]
    }
    return nil
}

func (hm *HistoryManager) GetHistory() []string {
    history := make([]string, 0)
    for i, memento := range hm.mementos {
        marker := "    "
        if i == hm.currentIndex {
            marker = " -> "
        }
        history = append(history, fmt.Sprintf("%s%s (%s)", marker, memento.GetName(), memento.GetDate()))
    }
    return history
}

func (hm *HistoryManager) CanUndo() bool {
    return hm.currentIndex > 0
}

func (hm *HistoryManager) CanRedo() bool {
    return hm.currentIndex < len(hm.mementos)-1
}

// 游戏存档示例
type GameState struct {
    level        int
    score        int
    health       int
    position     map[string]int
    inventory    []string
    achievements map[string]bool
}

func NewGameState() *GameState {
    return &GameState{
        level:        1,
        score:        0,
        health:       100,
        position:     map[string]int{"x": 0, "y": 0},
        inventory:    make([]string, 0),
        achievements: make(map[string]bool),
    }
}

func (gs *GameState) PlayLevel(levelScore, healthChange int, newItems []string) {
    gs.score += levelScore
    gs.health += healthChange

    // 限制生命值在0-100之间
    if gs.health < 0 {
        gs.health = 0
    }
    if gs.health > 100 {
        gs.health = 100
    }

    if newItems != nil {
        gs.inventory = append(gs.inventory, newItems...)
    }

    if gs.score >= gs.level*1000 {
        gs.level++
        gs.achievements[fmt.Sprintf("Level %d Complete", gs.level-1)] = true
    }

    fmt.Printf("关卡进度 - 等级: %d, 分数: %d, 生命: %d\n", gs.level, gs.score, gs.health)
}

func (gs *GameState) MoveTo(x, y int) {
    gs.position["x"] = x
    gs.position["y"] = y
    fmt.Printf("移动到位置: (%d, %d)\n", x, y)
}

func (gs *GameState) GetStatus() string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("等级: %d | 分数: %d | 生命: %d | 位置: (%d, %d) | 物品: %d | 成就: %d",
        gs.level, gs.score, gs.health, gs.position["x"], gs.position["y"],
        len(gs.inventory), len(gs.achievements))
}

func (gs *GameState) SaveGame(saveName string) Memento {
    // 深拷贝位置
    positionCopy := make(map[string]int)
    for k, v := range gs.position {
        positionCopy[k] = v
    }

    // 深拷贝物品清单
    inventoryCopy := make([]string, len(gs.inventory))
    copy(inventoryCopy, gs.inventory)

    // 深拷贝成就
    achievementsCopy := make(map[string]bool)
    for k, v := range gs.achievements {
        achievementsCopy[k] = v
    }

    state := map[string]interface{}{
        "level":        gs.level,
        "score":        gs.score,
        "health":       gs.health,
        "position":     positionCopy,
        "inventory":    inventoryCopy,
        "achievements": achievementsCopy,
    }

    name := saveName
    if name == "" {
        name = fmt.Sprintf("Save_Level_%d", gs.level)
    }
    fmt.Printf("游戏已保存: %s\n", name)
    return NewConcreteMemento(state, name)
}

func (gs *GameState) LoadGame(memento Memento) {
    state := memento.GetState()
    gs.level = state["level"].(int)
    gs.score = state["score"].(int)
    gs.health = state["health"].(int)
    gs.position = state["position"].(map[string]int)
    gs.inventory = state["inventory"].([]string)
    gs.achievements = state["achievements"].(map[string]bool)
    fmt.Printf("游戏已加载: %s (%s)\n", memento.GetName(), memento.GetDate())
}

// 使用示例
func main() {
    fmt.Println("=== 文本编辑器备忘录示例 ===")

    // 创建文本编辑器和历史管理器
    editor := NewTextEditor()
    history := NewHistoryManager(5)

    // 初始保存
    history.Backup(editor.Save("初始状态"))

    // 编辑文档
    editor.Write("Hello")
    history.Backup(editor.Save("写入Hello"))
    fmt.Printf("当前状态: %s\n", editor.GetStateInfo())

    editor.Write(" World")
    history.Backup(editor.Save("写入World"))
    fmt.Printf("当前状态: %s\n", editor.GetStateInfo())

    editor.SetFontSize(16)
    editor.ToggleBold()
    history.Backup(editor.Save("格式调整"))
    fmt.Printf("当前状态: %s\n", editor.GetStateInfo())

    editor.Write("!")
    history.Backup(editor.Save("添加感叹号"))
    fmt.Printf("当前状态: %s\n", editor.GetStateInfo())

    fmt.Println("\n--- 撤销操作 ---")
    if history.CanUndo() {
        memento := history.Undo()
        editor.Restore(memento)
        fmt.Printf("撤销后状态: %s\n", editor.GetStateInfo())
    }

    if history.CanUndo() {
        memento := history.Undo()
        editor.Restore(memento)
        fmt.Printf("撤销后状态: %s\n", editor.GetStateInfo())
    }

    fmt.Println("\n--- 重做操作 ---")
    if history.CanRedo() {
        memento := history.Redo()
        editor.Restore(memento)
        fmt.Printf("重做后状态: %s\n", editor.GetStateInfo())
    }

    fmt.Println("\n--- 历史记录 ---")
    for _, record := range history.GetHistory() {
        fmt.Println(record)
    }

    fmt.Println("\n=== 游戏存档示例 ===")

    // 创建游戏状态
    game := NewGameState()
    saveManager := NewHistoryManager(3)

    // 初始存档
    saveManager.Backup(game.SaveGame("游戏开始"))
    fmt.Printf("初始状态: %s\n", game.GetStatus())

    // 玩第一关
    game.PlayLevel(500, -10, []string{"剑", "盾牌"})
    game.MoveTo(10, 5)
    saveManager.Backup(game.SaveGame("第一关完成"))
    fmt.Printf("第一关后: %s\n", game.GetStatus())

    // 玩第二关
    game.PlayLevel(800, -20, []string{"药水", "魔法书"})
    game.MoveTo(25, 15)
    saveManager.Backup(game.SaveGame("第二关完成"))
    fmt.Printf("第二关后: %s\n", game.GetStatus())

    // 玩第三关（失败）
    game.PlayLevel(200, -80, nil) // 生命值大幅下降
    fmt.Printf("第三关失败: %s\n", game.GetStatus())

    // 加载第二关存档
    fmt.Println("\n--- 加载存档 ---")
    if saveManager.CanUndo() {
        memento := saveManager.Undo()
        game.LoadGame(memento)
        fmt.Printf("加载后状态: %s\n", game.GetStatus())
    }

    fmt.Println("\n--- 存档历史 ---")
    for _, record := range saveManager.GetHistory() {

    }
}

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
use chrono::{DateTime, Local};

// 备忘录特征
trait Memento {
    fn get_state(&self) -> HashMap<String, String>;
    fn get_name(&self) -> &str;
    fn get_date(&self) -> &str;
}

// 具体备忘录
#[derive(Clone)]
struct ConcreteMemento {
    state: HashMap<String, String>,
    name: String,
    date: String,
}

impl ConcreteMemento {
    fn new(state: HashMap<String, String>, name: String) -> Self {
        let name = if name.is_empty() {
            let now = Local::now();
            format!("Backup_{}", now.format("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"))
        } else {
            name
        };

        let date = Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").to_string();

        ConcreteMemento {
            state: state.clone(),
            name,
            date,
        }
    }
}

impl Memento for ConcreteMemento {
    fn get_state(&self) -> HashMap<String, String> {
        self.state.clone()
    }

    fn get_name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.name
    }

    fn get_date(&self) -> &str {
        &self.date
    }
}

// 发起人 - 文本编辑器
struct TextEditor {
    content: String,
    cursor_position: usize,
    font_size: u32,
    font_family: String,
    is_bold: bool,
    is_italic: bool,
}

impl TextEditor {
    fn new() -> Self {
        TextEditor {
            content: String::new(),
            cursor_position: 0,
            font_size: 12,
            font_family: "Arial".to_string(),
            is_bold: false,
            is_italic: false,
        }
    }

    fn write(&mut self, text: &str) {
        // 在光标位置插入文本
        self.content.insert_str(self.cursor_position, text);
        self.cursor_position += text.len();
        println!("写入文本: '{}'", text);
    }

    fn delete(&mut self, length: usize) {
        // 从光标位置删除指定长度的文本
        let start = if self.cursor_position >= length {
            self.cursor_position - length
        } else {
            0
        };

        let deleted_text = self.content[start..self.cursor_position].to_string();
        self.content.drain(start..self.cursor_position);
        self.cursor_position = start;
        println!("删除文本: '{}'", deleted_text);
    }

    fn set_cursor_position(&mut self, position: usize) {
        self.cursor_position = position.min(self.content.len());
    }

    fn set_font_size(&mut self, size: u32) {
        self.font_size = size;
        println!("字体大小设置为: {}", size);
    }

    fn set_font_family(&mut self, family: &str) {
        self.font_family = family.to_string();
        println!("字体设置为: {}", family);
    }

    fn toggle_bold(&mut self) {
        self.is_bold = !self.is_bold;
        let status = if self.is_bold { "开启" } else { "关闭" };
        println!("粗体: {}", status);
    }

    fn toggle_italic(&mut self) {
        self.is_italic = !self.is_italic;
        let status = if self.is_italic { "开启" } else { "关闭" };
        println!("斜体: {}", status);
    }

    fn get_content(&self) -> &str {
        &self.content
    }

    fn get_state_info(&self) -> String {
        let mut style = String::new();
        if self.is_bold {
            style.push_str("粗体");
        }
        if self.is_italic {
            style.push_str("斜体");
        }

        format!("内容: '{}' | 光标: {} | 字体: {} {}pt | 样式: {}",
            self.content, self.cursor_position, self.font_family, self.font_size, style)
    }

    fn save(&self, name: &str) -> Box<dyn Memento> {
        let mut state = HashMap::new();
        state.insert("content".to_string(), self.content.clone());
        state.insert("cursor_position".to_string(), self.cursor_position.to_string());
        state.insert("font_size".to_string(), self.font_size.to_string());
        state.insert("font_family".to_string(), self.font_family.clone());
        state.insert("is_bold".to_string(), self.is_bold.to_string());
        state.insert("is_italic".to_string(), self.is_italic.to_string());

        let save_name = if name.is_empty() { "自动保存" } else { name };
        println!("保存状态: {}", save_name);
        Box::new(ConcreteMemento::new(state, name.to_string()))
    }

    fn restore(&mut self, memento: &dyn Memento) {
        let state = memento.get_state();
        self.content = state.get("content").unwrap_or(&String::new()).clone();
        self.cursor_position = state.get("cursor_position")
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        self.font_size = state.get("font_size")
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(12);
        self.font_family = state.get("font_family").unwrap_or(&"Arial".to_string()).clone();
        self.is_bold = state.get("is_bold")
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(false);
        self.is_italic = state.get("is_italic")
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(false);

        println!("恢复状态: {} ({})", memento.get_name(), memento.get_date());
    }
}

// 管理者 - 历史记录管理器
struct HistoryManager {
    mementos: Vec<Box<dyn Memento>>,
    max_history: usize,
    current_index: isize,
}

impl HistoryManager {
    fn new(max_history: usize) -> Self {
        HistoryManager {
            mementos: Vec::new(),
            max_history,
            current_index: -1,
        }
    }

    fn backup(&mut self, memento: Box<dyn Memento>) {
        // 如果当前不在历史记录的末尾，删除后面的记录
        if self.current_index < self.mementos.len() as isize - 1 {
            self.mementos.truncate((self.current_index + 1) as usize);
        }

        self.mementos.push(memento);
        self.current_index += 1;

        // 限制历史记录数量
        if self.mementos.len() > self.max_history {
            self.mementos.remove(0);
            self.current_index -= 1;
        }

        println!("历史记录数量: {}", self.mementos.len());
    }

    fn undo(&mut self) -> Option<&dyn Memento> {
        if self.current_index > 0 {
            self.current_index -= 1;
            Some(self.mementos[self.current_index as usize].as_ref())
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    fn redo(&mut self) -> Option<&dyn Memento> {
        if self.current_index < self.mementos.len() as isize - 1 {
            self.current_index += 1;
            Some(self.mementos[self.current_index as usize].as_ref())
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    fn get_history(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut history = Vec::new();
        for (i, memento) in self.mementos.iter().enumerate() {
            let marker = if i == self.current_index as usize { " -> " } else { "    " };
            history.push(format!("{}{} ({})", marker, memento.get_name(), memento.get_date()));
        }
        history
    }

    fn can_undo(&self) -> bool {
        self.current_index > 0
    }

    fn can_redo(&self) -> bool {
        self.current_index < self.mementos.len() as isize - 1
    }
}

// 游戏存档示例
struct GameState {
    level: u32,
    score: u32,
    health: u32,
    position: (i32, i32),
    inventory: Vec<String>,
    achievements: HashMap<String, bool>,
}

impl GameState {
    fn new() -> Self {
        GameState {
            level: 1,
            score: 0,
            health: 100,
            position: (0, 0),
            inventory: Vec::new(),
            achievements: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    fn play_level(&mut self, level_score: u32, health_change: i32, new_items: Option<Vec<String>>) {
        self.score += level_score;

        // 更新生命值，限制在0-100之间
        if health_change < 0 {
            self.health = self.health.saturating_sub((-health_change) as u32);
        } else {
            self.health = (self.health + health_change as u32).min(100);
        }

        if let Some(items) = new_items {
            self.inventory.extend(items);
        }

        if self.score >= self.level * 1000 {
            self.level += 1;
            self.achievements.insert(format!("Level {} Complete", self.level - 1), true);
        }

        println!("关卡进度 - 等级: {}, 分数: {}, 生命: {}", self.level, self.score, self.health);
    }

    fn move_to(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32) {
        self.position = (x, y);
        println!("移动到位置: ({}, {})", x, y);
    }

    fn get_status(&self) -> String {
        format!("等级: {} | 分数: {} | 生命: {} | 位置: ({}, {}) | 物品: {} | 成就: {}",
            self.level, self.score, self.health, self.position.0, self.position.1,
            self.inventory.len(), self.achievements.len())
    }

    fn save_game(&self, save_name: &str) -> Box<dyn Memento> {
        let mut state = HashMap::new();
        state.insert("level".to_string(), self.level.to_string());
        state.insert("score".to_string(), self.score.to_string());
        state.insert("health".to_string(), self.health.to_string());
        state.insert("position_x".to_string(), self.position.0.to_string());
        state.insert("position_y".to_string(), self.position.1.to_string());
        state.insert("inventory".to_string(), self.inventory.join(","));

        let achievements_str = self.achievements.keys()
            .cloned()
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(",");
        state.insert("achievements".to_string(), achievements_str);

        let name = if save_name.is_empty() {
            format!("Save_Level_{}", self.level)
        } else {
            save_name.to_string()
        };

        println!("游戏已保存: {}", name);
        Box::new(ConcreteMemento::new(state, name))
    }

    fn load_game(&mut self, memento: &dyn Memento) {
        let state = memento.get_state();

        self.level = state.get("level")
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(1);
        self.score = state.get("score")
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        self.health = state.get("health")
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(100);

        let x = state.get("position_x")
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        let y = state.get("position_y")
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        self.position = (x, y);

        self.inventory = state.get("inventory")
            .map(|s| if s.is_empty() {
                Vec::new()
            } else {
                s.split(',').map(|item| item.to_string()).collect()
            })
            .unwrap_or_default();

        self.achievements = state.get("achievements")
            .map(|s| if s.is_empty() {
                HashMap::new()
            } else {
                s.split(',').map(|achievement| (achievement.to_string(), true)).collect()
            })
            .unwrap_or_default();

        println!("游戏已加载: {} ({})", memento.get_name(), memento.get_date());
    }
}

// 使用示例
fn main() {
    println!("=== 文本编辑器备忘录示例 ===");

    // 创建文本编辑器和历史管理器
    let mut editor = TextEditor::new();

    // 初始存档

    // 玩第一关
    game.play_level(500, -10, Some(vec!["剑".to_string(), "盾牌".to_string()]));
    game.move_to(10, 5);
    save_manager.backup(game.save_game("第一关完成"));
    println!("第一关后: {}", game.get_status());

    // 玩第二关
    game.play_level(800, -20, Some(vec!["药水".to_string(), "魔法书".to_string()]));
    game.move_to(25, 15);
    save_manager.backup(game.save_game("第二关完成"));
    println!("第二关后: {}", game.get_status());

    // 玩第三关（失败）
    game.play_level(200, -80, None); // 生命值大幅下降
    println!("第三关失败: {}", game.get_status());

    // 加载第二关存档
    println!("\n--- 加载存档 ---");
    if save_manager.can_undo() {
        if let Some(memento) = save_manager.undo() {
            game.load_game(memento);
            println!("加载后状态: {}", game.get_status());
        }
    }

    println!("\n--- 存档历史 ---");
    for record in save_manager.get_history() {
        println!("{}", record);
    }
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 外观模式是一种结构型设计模式，它能为程序库、框架或其他复杂类集合提供一个简单的接口。外观类为包含许多活动部件的复杂子系统提供一个简单的接口。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 需要为一个复杂子系统提供一个简单接口
  • 客户程序与多个子系统之间存在很大依赖性
  • 需要构建一个层次结构的子系统
  • 家庭影院系统、计算机启动过程、API网关

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 减少系统相互依赖
  • 提高灵活性和安全性
  • 简化客户端调用

缺点：

  • 不符合开闭原则，如果要改东西很麻烦，继承重写都不合适

        print(f"📽️ 投影模式设置为: {mode}")

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 工厂方法模式是一种创建型设计模式，它提供了一种创建对象的接口，但由子类决定要实例化的类是哪一个。工厂方法让类把实例化推迟到子类。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 需要根据不同条件创建不同类型的对象
  • 不知道具体需要创建哪种类型的对象
  • 希望用户能够扩展库或框架的内部组件
  • UI组件库、数据库驱动程序、日志系统

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 避免创建者和具体产品之间的紧密耦合
  • 符合单一职责原则，将产品创建代码移入一个位置
  • 符合开闭原则，无需更改现有代码就可以在程序中引入新的产品类型

缺点：

  • 代码可能会变得复杂，因为需要引入许多新的子类
  • 需要创建对应的工厂层次结构

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from enum import Enum
from typing import Dict, Type

# 产品接口
class Transport(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def deliver(self) -> str:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get_info(self) -> str:
        pass

# 具体产品类
class Truck(Transport):
    def deliver(self) -> str:
        return "在陆地上用卡车运输"

    def get_info(self) -> str:
        return "卡车: 适合陆地运输，载重量大"

class Ship(Transport):
    def deliver(self) -> str:
        return "在海上用船舶运输"

    def get_info(self) -> str:
        return "船舶: 适合海上运输，载量巨大"

class Airplane(Transport):
    def deliver(self) -> str:
        return "在空中用飞机运输"

    def get_info(self) -> str:
        return "飞机: 适合空中运输，速度最快"

# 抽象工厂类
class TransportFactory(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def create_transport(self) -> Transport:
        pass

    def plan_delivery(self) -> str:
        # 使用工厂方法创建产品
        transport = self.create_transport()
        result = f"运输方式: {transport.get_info()}\n"
        result += f"执行运输: {transport.deliver()}"
        return result

# 具体工厂类
class TruckFactory(TransportFactory):
    def create_transport(self) -> Transport:
        return Truck()

class ShipFactory(TransportFactory):
    def create_transport(self) -> Transport:
        return Ship()

class AirplaneFactory(TransportFactory):
    def create_transport(self) -> Transport:
        return Airplane()

# 工厂注册表模式
class TransportType(Enum):
    TRUCK = "truck"
    SHIP = "ship"
    AIRPLANE = "airplane"

class TransportFactoryRegistry:
    _factories: Dict[TransportType, Type[TransportFactory]] = {
        TransportType.TRUCK: TruckFactory,
        TransportType.SHIP: ShipFactory,
        TransportType.AIRPLANE: AirplaneFactory,
    }

    @classmethod
    def get_factory(cls, transport_type: TransportType) -> TransportFactory:
        factory_class = cls._factories.get(transport_type)
        if not factory_class:
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的运输类型: {transport_type}")
        return factory_class()

    @classmethod
    def register_factory(cls, transport_type: TransportType, factory_class: Type[TransportFactory]):
        cls._factories[transport_type] = factory_class

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 直接使用工厂
    print("直接使用工厂:")
    truck_factory = TruckFactory()
    print(truck_factory.plan_delivery())
    print()

    ship_factory = ShipFactory()
    print(ship_factory.plan_delivery())
    print()

    # 使用工厂注册表
    print("使用工厂注册表:")
    for transport_type in TransportType:
        factory = TransportFactoryRegistry.get_factory(transport_type)
        print(f"{transport_type.value.upper()}:")
        print(factory.plan_delivery())
        print()

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "strings"
)

// 产品接口
type Transport interface {
    Deliver() string
    GetInfo() string
}

// 具体产品类
type Truck struct{}

func (t *Truck) Deliver() string {
    return "在陆地上用卡车运输"
}

func (t *Truck) GetInfo() string {
    return "卡车: 适合陆地运输，载重量大"
}

type Ship struct{}

func (s *Ship) Deliver() string {
    return "在海上用船舶运输"
}

func (s *Ship) GetInfo() string {
    return "船舶: 适合海上运输，载量巨大"
}

type Airplane struct{}

func (a *Airplane) Deliver() string {
    return "在空中用飞机运输"
}

func (a *Airplane) GetInfo() string {
    return "飞机: 适合空中运输，速度最快"
}

// 抽象工厂接口
type TransportFactory interface {
    CreateTransport() Transport
    PlanDelivery() string
}

// 基础工厂结构体（提供通用方法）
type BaseFactory struct{}

func (bf *BaseFactory) PlanDelivery(factory TransportFactory) string {
    transport := factory.CreateTransport()
    var result strings.Builder
    result.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("运输方式: %s\n", transport.GetInfo()))
    result.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("执行运输: %s", transport.Deliver()))
    return result.String()
}

// 具体工厂类
type TruckFactory struct {
    BaseFactory
}

func (tf *TruckFactory) CreateTransport() Transport {
    return &Truck{}
}

func (tf *TruckFactory) PlanDelivery() string {
    return tf.BaseFactory.PlanDelivery(tf)
}

type ShipFactory struct {
    BaseFactory
}

func (sf *ShipFactory) CreateTransport() Transport {
    return &Ship{}
}

func (sf *ShipFactory) PlanDelivery() string {
    return sf.BaseFactory.PlanDelivery(sf)
}

type AirplaneFactory struct {
    BaseFactory
}

func (af *AirplaneFactory) CreateTransport() Transport {
    return &Airplane{}
}

func (af *AirplaneFactory) PlanDelivery() string {
    return af.BaseFactory.PlanDelivery(af)
}

// 工厂注册表
type TransportType string

const (
    TruckType    TransportType = "truck"
    ShipType     TransportType = "ship"
    AirplaneType TransportType = "airplane"
)

type FactoryRegistry struct {
    factories map[TransportType]func() TransportFactory
}

func NewFactoryRegistry() *FactoryRegistry {
    return &FactoryRegistry{
        factories: map[TransportType]func() TransportFactory{
            TruckType:    func() TransportFactory { return &TruckFactory{} },
            ShipType:     func() TransportFactory { return &ShipFactory{} },
            AirplaneType: func() TransportFactory { return &AirplaneFactory{} },
        },
    }
}

func (fr *FactoryRegistry) GetFactory(transportType TransportType) (TransportFactory, error) {
    factoryFunc, exists := fr.factories[transportType]
    if !exists {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("不支持的运输类型: %s", transportType)
    }
    return factoryFunc(), nil
}

func (fr *FactoryRegistry) RegisterFactory(transportType TransportType, factoryFunc func() TransportFactory) {
    fr.factories[transportType] = factoryFunc
}

func main() {
    // 直接使用工厂
    fmt.Println("直接使用工厂:")
    truckFactory := &TruckFactory{}
    fmt.Println(truckFactory.PlanDelivery())
    fmt.Println()

    shipFactory := &ShipFactory{}
    fmt.Println(shipFactory.PlanDelivery())
    fmt.Println()

    // 使用工厂注册表
    fmt.Println("使用工厂注册表:")
    registry := NewFactoryRegistry()

    transportTypes := []TransportType{TruckType, ShipType, AirplaneType}
    for _, transportType := range transportTypes {
        factory, err := registry.GetFactory(transportType)
        if err != nil {
            fmt.Printf("错误: %v\n", err)
            continue
        }
        fmt.Printf("%s:\n", strings.ToUpper(string(transportType)))
        fmt.Println(factory.PlanDelivery())
        fmt.Println()
    }
}

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fmt;

// 产品特征
trait Transport {
    fn deliver(&self) -> String;
    fn get_info(&self) -> String;
}

// 具体产品类
struct Truck;

impl Transport for Truck {
    fn deliver(&self) -> String {
        "在陆地上用卡车运输".to_string()
    }

    fn get_info(&self) -> String {
        "卡车: 适合陆地运输，载重量大".to_string()
    }
}

struct Ship;

impl Transport for Ship {
    fn deliver(&self) -> String {
        "在海上用船舶运输".to_string()
    }

    fn get_info(&self) -> String {
        "船舶: 适合海上运输，载量巨大".to_string()
    }
}

struct Airplane;

impl Transport for Airplane {
    fn deliver(&self) -> String {
        "在空中用飞机运输".to_string()
    }

    fn get_info(&self) -> String {
        "飞机: 适合空中运输，速度最快".to_string()
    }
}

// 抽象工厂特征
trait TransportFactory {
    fn create_transport(&self) -> Box<dyn Transport>;

    fn plan_delivery(&self) -> String {
        let transport = self.create_transport();
        format!(
            "运输方式: {}\n执行运输: {}",
            transport.get_info(),
            transport.deliver()
        )
    }
}

// 具体工厂类
struct TruckFactory;

impl TransportFactory for TruckFactory {
    fn create_transport(&self) -> Box<dyn Transport> {
        Box::new(Truck)
    }
}

struct ShipFactory;

impl TransportFactory for ShipFactory {
    fn create_transport(&self) -> Box<dyn Transport> {
        Box::new(Ship)
    }
}

struct AirplaneFactory;

impl TransportFactory for AirplaneFactory {
    fn create_transport(&self) -> Box<dyn Transport> {
        Box::new(Airplane)
    }
}

// 运输类型枚举
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Hash, Eq, PartialEq)]
enum TransportType {
    Truck,
    Ship,
    Airplane,
}

impl fmt::Display for TransportType {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            TransportType::Truck => write!(f, "truck"),
            TransportType::Ship => write!(f, "ship"),
            TransportType::Airplane => write!(f, "airplane"),
        }
    }
}

// 工厂注册表
struct FactoryRegistry {
    factories: HashMap<TransportType, Box<dyn Fn() -> Box<dyn TransportFactory>>>,
}

impl FactoryRegistry {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let mut factories: HashMap<TransportType, Box<dyn Fn() -> Box<dyn TransportFactory>>> = HashMap::new();

        factories.insert(
            TransportType::Truck,
            Box::new(|| Box::new(TruckFactory))
        );
        factories.insert(
            TransportType::Ship,
            Box::new(|| Box::new(ShipFactory))
        );
        factories.insert(
            TransportType::Airplane,
            Box::new(|| Box::new(AirplaneFactory))
        );

        FactoryRegistry { factories }
    }

    fn get_factory(&self, transport_type: &TransportType) -> Result<Box<dyn TransportFactory>, String> {
        match self.factories.get(transport_type) {
            Some(factory_func) => Ok(factory_func()),
            None => Err(format!("不支持的运输类型: {}", transport_type)),
        }
    }

    fn register_factory<F>(&mut self, transport_type: TransportType, factory_func: F)
    where
        F: Fn() -> Box<dyn TransportFactory> + 'static,
    {
        self.factories.insert(transport_type, Box::new(factory_func));
    }
}

// 简化的工厂函数方法
fn create_transport_factory(transport_type: &TransportType) -> Box<dyn TransportFactory> {
    match transport_type {
        TransportType::Truck => Box::new(TruckFactory),
        TransportType::Ship => Box::new(ShipFactory),
        TransportType::Airplane => Box::new(AirplaneFactory),
    }
}

fn main() {
    // 直接使用工厂
    println!("直接使用工厂:");
    let truck_factory = TruckFactory;
    println!("{}", truck_factory.plan_delivery());
    println!();

    let ship_factory = ShipFactory;
    println!("{}", ship_factory.plan_delivery());
    println!();

    // 使用工厂注册表
    println!("使用工厂注册表:");
    let registry = FactoryRegistry::new();

    let transport_types = vec![TransportType::Truck, TransportType::Ship, TransportType::Airplane];
    for transport_type in transport_types {
        match registry.get_factory(&transport_type) {
            Ok(factory) => {
                println!("{}:", transport_type.to_string().to_uppercase());
                println!("{}", factory.plan_delivery());
                println!();
            }
            Err(e) => println!("错误: {}", e),
        }
    }

    // 使用简化的工厂函数
    println!("使用简化的工厂函数:");
    for transport_type in [TransportType::Truck, TransportType::Ship, TransportType::Airplane] {
        let factory = create_transport_factory(&transport_type);
        println!("{}:", transport_type.to_string().to_uppercase());
        println!("{}", factory.plan_delivery());
        println!();
    }
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 建造者模式是一种创建型设计模式，它允许你分步骤创建复杂对象。该模式允许你使用相同的创建代码生成不同类型和形式的对象。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 需要创建的对象有复杂的内部结构
  • 需要创建的对象的属性相互依赖，需要指定其生成顺序
  • 对象的创建过程独立于创建该对象的类
  • SQL查询构建器、HTTP请求构建器、配置对象构建

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 可以分步创建对象，暂缓创建步骤或递归运行创建步骤
  • 生成不同形式的产品时，可以复用相同的制造代码
  • 符合单一职责原则，可以将复杂构造代码从产品的业务逻辑中分离出来

缺点：

  • 由于该模式需要新增多个类，因此代码整体复杂程度会有所增加

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Optional, List
from enum import Enum

# 产品类
class Computer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.cpu: Optional[str] = None
        self.memory: Optional[str] = None
        self.storage: Optional[str] = None
        self.graphics_card: Optional[str] = None
        self.motherboard: Optional[str] = None
        self.power_supply: Optional[str] = None
        self.case: Optional[str] = None
        self.accessories: List[str] = []

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        specs = []
        specs.append(f"CPU: {self.cpu}")
        specs.append(f"内存: {self.memory}")
        specs.append(f"存储: {self.storage}")
        specs.append(f"显卡: {self.graphics_card}")
        specs.append(f"主板: {self.motherboard}")
        specs.append(f"电源: {self.power_supply}")
        specs.append(f"机箱: {self.case}")
        if self.accessories:
            specs.append(f"配件: {', '.join(self.accessories)}")
        return "电脑配置:\n" + "\n".join(specs)

# 抽象建造者
class ComputerBuilder(ABC):
    def __init__(self):
        self.reset()

    def reset(self):
        self._computer = Computer()

    @abstractmethod
    def build_cpu(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def build_memory(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def build_storage(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def build_graphics_card(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def build_motherboard(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def build_power_supply(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def build_case(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        pass

    def add_accessory(self, accessory: str) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.accessories.append(accessory)
        return self

    def get_result(self) -> Computer:
        result = self._computer
        self.reset()
        return result

# 具体建造者 - 游戏电脑
class GamingComputerBuilder(ComputerBuilder):
    def build_cpu(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.cpu = "Intel i9-13900K"
        return self

    def build_memory(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.memory = "32GB DDR5-5600"
        return self

    def build_storage(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.storage = "2TB NVMe SSD"
        return self

    def build_graphics_card(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.graphics_card = "NVIDIA RTX 4080"
        return self

    def build_motherboard(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.motherboard = "ASUS ROG Z790"
        return self

    def build_power_supply(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.power_supply = "850W 80+ Gold"
        return self

    def build_case(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.case = "RGB游戏机箱"
        return self

# 具体建造者 - 办公电脑
class OfficeComputerBuilder(ComputerBuilder):
    def build_cpu(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.cpu = "Intel i5-13400"
        return self

    def build_memory(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.memory = "16GB DDR4-3200"
        return self

    def build_storage(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.storage = "512GB SSD"
        return self

    def build_graphics_card(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.graphics_card = "集成显卡"
        return self

    def build_motherboard(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.motherboard = "华硕 B760M"
        return self

    def build_power_supply(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.power_supply = "450W 80+ Bronze"
        return self

    def build_case(self) -> 'ComputerBuilder':
        self._computer.case = "简约办公机箱"
        return self

# 指挥者
class ComputerDirector:
    def __init__(self, builder: ComputerBuilder):
        self._builder = builder

    def set_builder(self, builder: ComputerBuilder):
        self._builder = builder

    def build_basic_computer(self) -> Computer:
        return (self._builder
                .build_cpu()
                .build_memory()
                .build_storage()
                .build_motherboard()
                .build_power_supply()
                .build_case()
                .get_result())

    def build_full_computer(self) -> Computer:
        return (self._builder
                .build_cpu()
                .build_memory()
                .build_storage()
                .build_graphics_card()
                .build_motherboard()
                .build_power_supply()
                .build_case()
                .add_accessory("机械键盘")
                .add_accessory("游戏鼠标")
                .get_result())

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 使用指挥者构建
    gaming_builder = GamingComputerBuilder()
    director = ComputerDirector(gaming_builder)

    gaming_computer = director.build_full_computer()
    print("游戏电脑:")
    print(gaming_computer)
    print()

    # 直接使用建造者（链式调用）
    office_builder = OfficeComputerBuilder()
    office_computer = (office_builder
                      .build_cpu()
                      .build_memory()
                      .build_storage()
                      .build_graphics_card()
                      .build_motherboard()
                      .build_power_supply()
                      .build_case()
                      .add_accessory("无线键鼠套装")
                      .get_result())

    print("办公电脑:")
    print(office_computer)

impl fmt::Display for Computer {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        let mut specs = Vec::new();

        if let Some(ref cpu) = self.cpu {
            specs.push(format!("CPU: {}", cpu));
        }
        if let Some(ref memory) = self.memory {
            specs.push(format!("内存: {}", memory));

        if let Some(ref storage) = self.storage {

        }
        if let Some(ref graphics_card) = self.graphics_card {

        }
        if let Some(ref motherboard) = self.motherboard {
            specs.push(format!("主板: {}", motherboard));
        }
        if let Some(ref power_supply) = self.power_supply {
            specs.push(format!("电源: {}", power_supply));
        }
        if let Some(ref case) = self.case {
            specs.push(format!("机箱: {}", case));
        }
        if !self.accessories.is_empty() {
            specs.push(format!("配件: {}", self.accessories.join(", ")));

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 抽象工厂模式是一种创建型设计模式，它提供了一个接口，用于创建一系列相关或相互依赖的对象，而无需指定它们具体的类。抽象工厂模式也被称为Kit模式。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 系统需要独立于其产品的创建、组合和表示
  • 系统需要由多个产品系列中的一个来配置
  • 需要强调一系列相关产品对象的设计以便进行联合使用
  • 跨平台UI组件库、数据库访问层、游戏中的不同主题

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 分离了具体的类
  • 使得易于交换产品系列
  • 有利于产品的一致性
  • 符合开闭原则

缺点：

  • 难以支持新种类的产品
  • 增加了系统的抽象性和理解难度

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from enum import Enum

# 抽象产品A - 按钮
class Button(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def render(self) -> str:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def click(self) -> str:
        pass

# 抽象产品B - 复选框
class Checkbox(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def render(self) -> str:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def check(self) -> str:
        pass

# Windows风格的具体产品
class WindowsButton(Button):
    def render(self) -> str:
        return "渲染Windows风格按钮"

    def click(self) -> str:
        return "Windows按钮被点击"

class WindowsCheckbox(Checkbox):
    def render(self) -> str:
        return "渲染Windows风格复选框"

    def check(self) -> str:
        return "Windows复选框被选中"

# macOS风格的具体产品
class MacButton(Button):
    def render(self) -> str:
        return "渲染macOS风格按钮"

    def click(self) -> str:
        return "macOS按钮被点击"

class MacCheckbox(Checkbox):
    def render(self) -> str:
        return "渲染macOS风格复选框"

    def check(self) -> str:
        return "macOS复选框被选中"

# Linux风格的具体产品
class LinuxButton(Button):
    def render(self) -> str:
        return "渲染Linux风格按钮"

    def click(self) -> str:
        return "Linux按钮被点击"

class LinuxCheckbox(Checkbox):
    def render(self) -> str:
        return "渲染Linux风格复选框"

    def check(self) -> str:
        return "Linux复选框被选中"

# 抽象工厂
class GUIFactory(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def create_button(self) -> Button:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def create_checkbox(self) -> Checkbox:
        pass

# 具体工厂
class WindowsFactory(GUIFactory):
    def create_button(self) -> Button:
        return WindowsButton()

    def create_checkbox(self) -> Checkbox:
        return WindowsCheckbox()

class MacFactory(GUIFactory):
    def create_button(self) -> Button:
        return MacButton()

    def create_checkbox(self) -> Checkbox:
        return MacCheckbox()

class LinuxFactory(GUIFactory):
    def create_button(self) -> Button:
        return LinuxButton()

    def create_checkbox(self) -> Checkbox:
        return LinuxCheckbox()

# 客户端代码
class Application:
    def __init__(self, factory: GUIFactory):
        self.factory = factory
        self.button = factory.create_button()
        self.checkbox = factory.create_checkbox()

    def render_ui(self) -> str:
        result = []
        result.append(self.button.render())
        result.append(self.checkbox.render())
        return "\n".join(result)

    def interact(self) -> str:
        result = []
        result.append(self.button.click())
        result.append(self.checkbox.check())
        return "\n".join(result)

# 工厂选择器
class OSType(Enum):
    WINDOWS = "windows"
    MACOS = "macos"
    LINUX = "linux"

def get_factory(os_type: OSType) -> GUIFactory:
    factories = {
        OSType.WINDOWS: WindowsFactory(),
        OSType.MACOS: MacFactory(),
        OSType.LINUX: LinuxFactory(),
    }
    return factories.get(os_type, WindowsFactory())

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import platform

    # 根据当前系统选择工厂
    system = platform.system().lower()
    if "windows" in system:
        os_type = OSType.WINDOWS
    elif "darwin" in system:
        os_type = OSType.MACOS
    else:
        os_type = OSType.LINUX

    factory = get_factory(os_type)
    app = Application(factory)

    print(f"当前系统: {os_type.value}")
    print("UI渲染:")
    print(app.render_ui())
    print("\n用户交互:")
    print(app.interact())

    default:

    case "darwin":
        return &MacFactory{}
    case "linux":

    default:

    fn create_checkbox(&self) -> Box<dyn Checkbox> {
        Box::new(LinuxCheckbox)
    }
}

// 客户端代码
pub struct Application {
    button: Box<dyn Button>,
    checkbox: Box<dyn Checkbox>,
}

impl Application {
    pub fn new(factory: &dyn GUIFactory) -> Self {
        Self {
            button: factory.create_button(),
            checkbox: factory.create_checkbox(),
        }
    }

    pub fn render_ui(&self) -> String {
        format!("{}\n{}", self.button.render(), self.checkbox.render())
    }

    pub fn interact(&self) -> String {
        format!("{}\n{}", self.button.click(), self.checkbox.check())
    }
}

// 操作系统类型
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum OSType {
    Windows,
    MacOS,
    Linux,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for OSType {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            OSType::Windows => write!(f, "windows"),
            OSType::MacOS => write!(f, "macos"),
            OSType::Linux => write!(f, "linux"),
        }
    }
}

// 工厂选择器
pub fn get_factory(os_type: &OSType) -> Box<dyn GUIFactory> {
    match os_type {
        OSType::Windows => Box::new(WindowsFactory),
        OSType::MacOS => Box::new(MacFactory),
        OSType::Linux => Box::new(LinuxFactory),
    }
}

// 根据运行时系统自动选择工厂
pub fn get_factory_by_runtime() -> (Box<dyn GUIFactory>, OSType) {
    let os_type = if cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
        OSType::Windows
    } else if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
        OSType::MacOS
    } else {
        OSType::Linux
    };

    (get_factory(&os_type), os_type)
}

fn main() {
    // 根据当前系统选择工厂
    let (factory, current_os) = get_factory_by_runtime();
    let app = Application::new(factory.as_ref());

    println!("当前系统: {}", current_os);
    println!("UI渲染:");
    println!("{}", app.render_ui());
    println!("\n用户交互:");
    println!("{}", app.interact());

    println!("\n=== 测试所有平台 ===");

    // 测试所有平台
    let os_types = vec![OSType::Windows, OSType::MacOS, OSType::Linux];
    for os_type in os_types {
        println!("\n--- {} 平台 ---", os_type.to_string().to_uppercase());
        let factory = get_factory(&os_type);
        let app = Application::new(factory.as_ref());

        println!("UI渲染:");
        println!("{}", app.render_ui());
        println!("用户交互:");
        println!("{}", app.interact());
    }
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 桥接模式是一种结构型设计模式，它可以将抽象部分与实现部分分离，使它们都可以独立地变化。桥接模式通过组合的方式建立两个类层次结构之间的联系。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 不希望在抽象和实现之间有一个固定的绑定关系
  • 类的抽象以及它的实现都应该可以通过生成子类的方法加以扩充
  • 对一个抽象的实现部分的修改应对客户不产生影响
  • 跨平台应用、图形渲染系统、数据库驱动程序

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 分离抽象接口及其实现部分
  • 桥接模式提高了系统的可扩充性
  • 实现细节对客户透明
  • 符合开闭原则

缺点：

  • 桥接模式的引入会增加系统的理解与设计难度
  • 桥接模式要求正确识别出系统中两个独立变化的维度
