from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from enum import Enum

# 实现接口 - 渲染器
class Renderer(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def render_circle(self, radius: float) -> str:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def render_square(self, side: float) -> str:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def render_triangle(self, base: float, height: float) -> str:
        pass

# 具体实现 - 矢量渲染器
class VectorRenderer(Renderer):
    def render_circle(self, radius: float) -> str:
        return f"矢量渲染圆形，半径: {radius}"

    def render_square(self, side: float) -> str:
        return f"矢量渲染正方形，边长: {side}"

    def render_triangle(self, base: float, height: float) -> str:
        return f"矢量渲染三角形，底边: {base}, 高: {height}"

# 具体实现 - 光栅渲染器
class RasterRenderer(Renderer):
    def render_circle(self, radius: float) -> str:
        return f"光栅渲染圆形，半径: {radius} 像素"

    def render_square(self, side: float) -> str:
        return f"光栅渲染正方形，边长: {side} 像素"

    def render_triangle(self, base: float, height: float) -> str:
        return f"光栅渲染三角形，底边: {base} 像素, 高: {height} 像素"

# 具体实现 - 3D渲染器
class Renderer3D(Renderer):
    def render_circle(self, radius: float) -> str:
        return f"3D渲染球体，半径: {radius}"

    def render_square(self, side: float) -> str:
        return f"3D渲染立方体，边长: {side}"

    def render_triangle(self, base: float, height: float) -> str:
        return f"3D渲染三角锥，底边: {base}, 高: {height}"

# 抽象类 - 形状
class Shape(ABC):
    def __init__(self, renderer: Renderer):
        self.renderer = renderer

    @abstractmethod
    def draw(self) -> str:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def resize(self, factor: float):
        pass

# 扩展抽象类 - 圆形
class Circle(Shape):
    def __init__(self, renderer: Renderer, radius: float):
        super().__init__(renderer)
        self.radius = radius

    def draw(self) -> str:
        return self.renderer.render_circle(self.radius)

    def resize(self, factor: float):
        self.radius *= factor

# 扩展抽象类 - 正方形
class Square(Shape):
    def __init__(self, renderer: Renderer, side: float):
        super().__init__(renderer)
        self.side = side

    def draw(self) -> str:
        return self.renderer.render_square(self.side)

    def resize(self, factor: float):
        self.side *= factor

# 扩展抽象类 - 三角形
class Triangle(Shape):
    def __init__(self, renderer: Renderer, base: float, height: float):
        super().__init__(renderer)
        self.base = base
        self.height = height

    def draw(self) -> str:
        return self.renderer.render_triangle(self.base, self.height)

    def resize(self, factor: float):
        self.base *= factor
        self.height *= factor

# 渲染器类型枚举
class RendererType(Enum):
    VECTOR = "vector"
    RASTER = "raster"
    RENDERER_3D = "3d"

# 形状工厂
class ShapeFactory:
    @staticmethod
    def create_renderer(renderer_type: RendererType) -> Renderer:
        renderers = {
            RendererType.VECTOR: VectorRenderer(),
            RendererType.RASTER: RasterRenderer(),
            RendererType.RENDERER_3D: Renderer3D(),
        }
        return renderers.get(renderer_type, VectorRenderer())

    @staticmethod
    def create_circle(renderer_type: RendererType, radius: float) -> Circle:
        renderer = ShapeFactory.create_renderer(renderer_type)
        return Circle(renderer, radius)

    @staticmethod
    def create_square(renderer_type: RendererType, side: float) -> Square:
        renderer = ShapeFactory.create_renderer(renderer_type)
        return Square(renderer, side)

    @staticmethod
    def create_triangle(renderer_type: RendererType, base: float, height: float) -> Triangle:
        renderer = ShapeFactory.create_renderer(renderer_type)
        return Triangle(renderer, base, height)

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== 桥接模式示例 ===")

    # 创建不同渲染器的形状
    shapes = [
        ShapeFactory.create_circle(RendererType.VECTOR, 5.0),
        ShapeFactory.create_circle(RendererType.RASTER, 5.0),
        ShapeFactory.create_circle(RendererType.RENDERER_3D, 5.0),

        ShapeFactory.create_square(RendererType.VECTOR, 4.0),
        ShapeFactory.create_square(RendererType.RASTER, 4.0),
        ShapeFactory.create_square(RendererType.RENDERER_3D, 4.0),

        ShapeFactory.create_triangle(RendererType.VECTOR, 6.0, 8.0),
        ShapeFactory.create_triangle(RendererType.RASTER, 6.0, 8.0),
        ShapeFactory.create_triangle(RendererType.RENDERER_3D, 6.0, 8.0),
    ]

    print("1. 绘制所有形状:")
    for i, shape in enumerate(shapes, 1):
        print(f"{i}. {shape.draw()}")

    print("\n2. 调整大小后重新绘制:")
    for i, shape in enumerate(shapes, 1):
        shape.resize(1.5)
        print(f"{i}. {shape.draw()}")

    print("\n3. 动态切换渲染器:")
    # 创建一个圆形，然后切换不同的渲染器
    circle = Circle(VectorRenderer(), 3.0)
    print(f"矢量渲染: {circle.draw()}")

    circle.renderer = RasterRenderer()
    print(f"光栅渲染: {circle.draw()}")

    circle.renderer = Renderer3D()
    print(f"3D渲染: {circle.draw()}")

}

    t.height *= factor
}

    t.renderer = renderer
}

// 渲染器类型

const (
    Vector RendererType = iota
    Raster
    Renderer3DType
)

// 形状工厂
type ShapeFactory struct{}

func (sf *ShapeFactory) CreateRenderer(rendererType RendererType) Renderer {
    switch rendererType {
    case Vector:
        return &VectorRenderer{}
    case Raster:
        return &RasterRenderer{}
    case Renderer3DType:
        return &Renderer3D{}
    default:
        return &VectorRenderer{}
    }
}

func (sf *ShapeFactory) CreateCircle(rendererType RendererType, radius float64) *Circle {
    renderer := sf.CreateRenderer(rendererType)
    return NewCircle(renderer, radius)
}

func (sf *ShapeFactory) CreateSquare(rendererType RendererType, side float64) *Square {
    renderer := sf.CreateRenderer(rendererType)
    return NewSquare(renderer, side)
}

func (sf *ShapeFactory) CreateTriangle(rendererType RendererType, base, height float64) *Triangle {
    renderer := sf.CreateRenderer(rendererType)
    return NewTriangle(renderer, base, height)
}

    fmt.Println("=== 桥接模式示例 ===")

    factory := &ShapeFactory{}

    // 创建不同渲染器的形状
    shapes := []Shape{
        factory.CreateCircle(Vector, 5.0),
        factory.CreateCircle(Raster, 5.0),
        factory.CreateCircle(Renderer3DType, 5.0),

        factory.CreateSquare(Vector, 4.0),
        factory.CreateSquare(Raster, 4.0),
        factory.CreateSquare(Renderer3DType, 4.0),

        factory.CreateTriangle(Vector, 6.0, 8.0),
        factory.CreateTriangle(Raster, 6.0, 8.0),
        factory.CreateTriangle(Renderer3DType, 6.0, 8.0),
    }

    fmt.Println("1. 绘制所有形状:")
    for i, shape := range shapes {
        fmt.Printf("%d. %s\n", i+1, shape.Draw())
    }

    fmt.Println("\n2. 调整大小后重新绘制:")
    for i, shape := range shapes {
        shape.Resize(1.5)
        fmt.Printf("%d. %s\n", i+1, shape.Draw())
    }

    fmt.Println("\n3. 动态切换渲染器:")

    circle := NewCircle(&VectorRenderer{}, 3.0)
    fmt.Printf("矢量渲染: %s\n", circle.Draw())

    circle.SetRenderer(&RasterRenderer{})
    fmt.Printf("光栅渲染: %s\n", circle.Draw())

    circle.SetRenderer(&Renderer3D{})
    fmt.Printf("3D渲染: %s\n", circle.Draw())
}

// 抽象trait - 形状

// 扩展抽象类 - 圆形
pub struct Circle {

}

impl Circle {

        Self { renderer, side }
    }

    pub fn set_renderer(&mut self, renderer: Box<dyn Renderer>) {

    }

impl Shape for Square {

    }

    }
}

// 扩展抽象类 - 三角形
pub struct Triangle {
    renderer: Box<dyn Renderer>,
    base: f64,
    height: f64,
}

impl Triangle {
    pub fn new(renderer: Box<dyn Renderer>, base: f64, height: f64) -> Self {
        Self { renderer, base, height }
    }

    pub fn set_renderer(&mut self, renderer: Box<dyn Renderer>) {

    }

        self.height *= factor;
    }

// 渲染器类型枚举
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub enum RendererType {
    Vector,
    Raster,
    Renderer3D,
}

// 形状工厂
pub struct ShapeFactory;

impl ShapeFactory {
    pub fn create_renderer(renderer_type: RendererType) -> Box<dyn Renderer> {
        match renderer_type {
            RendererType::Vector => Box::new(VectorRenderer),
            RendererType::Raster => Box::new(RasterRenderer),
            RendererType::Renderer3D => Box::new(Renderer3D),
        }
    }

    pub fn create_circle(renderer_type: RendererType, radius: f64) -> Circle {
        let renderer = Self::create_renderer(renderer_type);
        Circle::new(renderer, radius)
    }

    pub fn create_square(renderer_type: RendererType, side: f64) -> Square {
        let renderer = Self::create_renderer(renderer_type);
        Square::new(renderer, side)
    }

    pub fn create_triangle(renderer_type: RendererType, base: f64, height: f64) -> Triangle {
        let renderer = Self::create_renderer(renderer_type);
        Triangle::new(renderer, base, height)
    }
}

fn main() {
    println!("=== 桥接模式示例 ===");

    // 创建不同渲染器的形状
    let mut shapes: Vec<Box<dyn Shape>> = vec![
        Box::new(ShapeFactory::create_circle(RendererType::Vector, 5.0)),
        Box::new(ShapeFactory::create_circle(RendererType::Raster, 5.0)),
        Box::new(ShapeFactory::create_circle(RendererType::Renderer3D, 5.0)),

        Box::new(ShapeFactory::create_square(RendererType::Vector, 4.0)),
        Box::new(ShapeFactory::create_square(RendererType::Raster, 4.0)),
        Box::new(ShapeFactory::create_square(RendererType::Renderer3D, 4.0)),

        Box::new(ShapeFactory::create_triangle(RendererType::Vector, 6.0, 8.0)),
        Box::new(ShapeFactory::create_triangle(RendererType::Raster, 6.0, 8.0)),
        Box::new(ShapeFactory::create_triangle(RendererType::Renderer3D, 6.0, 8.0)),
    ];

    println!("1. 绘制所有形状:");
    for (i, shape) in shapes.iter().enumerate() {
        println!("{}. {}", i + 1, shape.draw());
    }

    println!("\n2. 调整大小后重新绘制:");
    for (i, shape) in shapes.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        shape.resize(1.5);
        println!("{}. {}", i + 1, shape.draw());
    }

    println!("\n3. 动态切换渲染器:");
    // 创建一个圆形，然后切换不同的渲染器
    let mut circle = Circle::new(Box::new(VectorRenderer), 3.0);
    println!("矢量渲染: {}", circle.draw());

    circle.set_renderer(Box::new(RasterRenderer));
    println!("光栅渲染: {}", circle.draw());

    circle.set_renderer(Box::new(Renderer3D));
    println!("3D渲染: {}", circle.draw());
}

docs.text: 模板方法模式是一种行为型设计模式，它在超类中定义了一个算法的框架，允许子类在不改变算法整体结构的情况下重写算法的特定步骤。模板方法模式通过把不变的行为搬移到超类，去除了子类中的重复代码。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 多个类有相同的方法，逻辑相同，细节不同
  • 重要、复杂的算法，可以把核心算法设计为模板方法
  • 重构时，把相同的代码抽取到父类中
  • 数据挖掘算法、Web框架、游戏AI

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 提取了公共代码部分，易于维护
  • 行为由父类控制，子类实现
  • 符合开闭原则

缺点：

  • 每一个不同的实现都需要一个子类来实现，导致类的个数增加
  • 类数目的增加，间接地增加了系统实现的复杂度

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
import time
from typing import List, Optional

# 抽象模板类
class DataProcessor(ABC):
    """数据处理模板方法"""

    def process_data(self, data_source: str) -> dict:
        """模板方法：定义数据处理的整体流程"""
        print("=== 开始数据处理流程 ===")

        # 1. 读取数据
        raw_data = self.read_data(data_source)
        print(f"读取到 {len(raw_data)} 条原始数据")

        # 2. 验证数据
        if not self.validate_data(raw_data):
            raise ValueError("数据验证失败")
        print("数据验证通过")

        # 3. 处理数据
        processed_data = self.transform_data(raw_data)
        print(f"处理后得到 {len(processed_data)} 条数据")

        # 4. 保存数据（可选步骤）
        if self.should_save_data():
            self.save_data(processed_data)
            print("数据已保存")

        # 5. 生成报告
        report = self.generate_report(processed_data)

        print("=== 数据处理流程完成 ===")
        return report

    # 抽象方法：子类必须实现
    @abstractmethod
    def read_data(self, source: str) -> List[dict]:
        """读取数据"""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def transform_data(self, data: List[dict]) -> List[dict]:
        """转换数据"""
        pass

    # 具体方法：提供默认实现
    def validate_data(self, data: List[dict]) -> bool:
        """验证数据（默认实现）"""
        return len(data) > 0

    def generate_report(self, data: List[dict]) -> dict:
        """生成报告（默认实现）"""
        return {
            "total_records": len(data),
            "processing_time": time.time(),
            "status": "success"
        }

    # 钩子方法：子类可以选择性重写
    def should_save_data(self) -> bool:
        """是否保存数据的钩子方法"""
        return True

    def save_data(self, data: List[dict]) -> None:
        """保存数据的钩子方法"""
        print(f"保存了 {len(data)} 条数据到默认存储")

# 具体实现类 - CSV数据处理器
class CSVDataProcessor(DataProcessor):
    def read_data(self, source: str) -> List[dict]:
        """从CSV文件读取数据"""
        print(f"从CSV文件读取数据: {source}")
        # 模拟CSV数据
        return [
            {"id": 1, "name": "Alice", "age": 25, "salary": 50000},
            {"id": 2, "name": "Bob", "age": 30, "salary": 60000},
            {"id": 3, "name": "Charlie", "age": 35, "salary": 70000},
        ]

    def transform_data(self, data: List[dict]) -> List[dict]:
        """转换CSV数据：添加年薪字段"""
        transformed = []
        for record in data:
            new_record = record.copy()
            new_record["annual_salary"] = record["salary"] * 12
            new_record["age_group"] = "young" if record["age"] < 30 else "senior"
            transformed.append(new_record)
        return transformed

    def validate_data(self, data: List[dict]) -> bool:
        """CSV特定的数据验证"""
        if not super().validate_data(data):
            return False

        # 检查必需字段
        required_fields = ["id", "name", "age", "salary"]
        for record in data:
            for field in required_fields:
                if field not in record:
                    return False
        return True

# 具体实现类 - JSON数据处理器
class JSONDataProcessor(DataProcessor):
    def read_data(self, source: str) -> List[dict]:
        """从JSON API读取数据"""
        print(f"从JSON API读取数据: {source}")
        # 模拟JSON API数据
        return [
            {"user_id": "u001", "username": "alice", "profile": {"age": 25, "department": "IT"}},
            {"user_id": "u002", "username": "bob", "profile": {"age": 30, "department": "HR"}},
            {"user_id": "u003", "username": "charlie", "profile": {"age": 35, "department": "Finance"}},
        ]

    def transform_data(self, data: List[dict]) -> List[dict]:
        """转换JSON数据：扁平化结构"""
        transformed = []
        for record in data:
            new_record = {
                "id": record["user_id"],
                "name": record["username"],
                "age": record["profile"]["age"],
                "department": record["profile"]["department"]
            }
            transformed.append(new_record)
        return transformed

    def should_save_data(self) -> bool:
        """JSON处理器选择不保存数据"""
        return False

    def generate_report(self, data: List[dict]) -> dict:
        """生成JSON特定的报告"""
        base_report = super().generate_report(data)

        # 添加部门统计
        departments = {}
        for record in data:
            dept = record.get("department", "Unknown")
            departments[dept] = departments.get(dept, 0) + 1

        base_report["department_stats"] = departments
        return base_report

# 具体实现类 - 数据库数据处理器
class DatabaseDataProcessor(DataProcessor):
    def __init__(self, table_name: str):
        self.table_name = table_name

    def read_data(self, source: str) -> List[dict]:
        """从数据库读取数据"""
        print(f"从数据库表 {self.table_name} 读取数据")
        # 模拟数据库数据
        return [
            {"emp_id": 101, "emp_name": "Alice", "emp_age": 25, "emp_salary": 50000, "dept_id": 1},
            {"emp_id": 102, "emp_name": "Bob", "emp_age": 30, "emp_salary": 60000, "dept_id": 2},
            {"emp_id": 103, "emp_name": "Charlie", "emp_age": 35, "emp_salary": 70000, "dept_id": 1},
        ]

    def transform_data(self, data: List[dict]) -> List[dict]:
        """转换数据库数据：标准化字段名"""
        transformed = []
        for record in data:
            new_record = {
                "id": record["emp_id"],
                "name": record["emp_name"],
                "age": record["emp_age"],
                "salary": record["emp_salary"],
                "department_id": record["dept_id"]
            }
            transformed.append(new_record)
        return transformed

    def save_data(self, data: List[dict]) -> None:
        """保存到数据库"""
        print(f"将 {len(data)} 条数据保存到数据库表 {self.table_name}_processed")

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== CSV数据处理示例 ===")
    csv_processor = CSVDataProcessor()
    csv_report = csv_processor.process_data("employees.csv")
    print(f"CSV处理报告: {csv_report}\n")

    print("=== JSON数据处理示例 ===")
    json_processor = JSONDataProcessor()
    json_report = json_processor.process_data("https://api.example.com/users")
    print(f"JSON处理报告: {json_report}\n")

    print("=== 数据库数据处理示例 ===")
    db_processor = DatabaseDataProcessor("employees")
    db_report = db_processor.process_data("database_connection")
    print(f"数据库处理报告: {db_report}")

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "time"
)

// DataRecord 表示数据记录
type DataRecord map[string]interface{}

// DataProcessor 抽象数据处理器接口
type DataProcessor interface {
    ReadData(source string) []DataRecord
    TransformData(data []DataRecord) []DataRecord
    ValidateData(data []DataRecord) bool
    GenerateReport(data []DataRecord) map[string]interface{}
    ShouldSaveData() bool
    SaveData(data []DataRecord)
}

// BaseDataProcessor 基础数据处理器，实现模板方法
type BaseDataProcessor struct {
    processor DataProcessor
}

// NewBaseDataProcessor 创建基础数据处理器
func NewBaseDataProcessor(processor DataProcessor) *BaseDataProcessor {
    return &BaseDataProcessor{processor: processor}
}

// ProcessData 模板方法：定义数据处理的整体流程
func (b *BaseDataProcessor) ProcessData(dataSource string) map[string]interface{} {
    fmt.Println("=== 开始数据处理流程 ===")

    // 1. 读取数据
    rawData := b.processor.ReadData(dataSource)
    fmt.Printf("读取到 %d 条原始数据\n", len(rawData))

    // 2. 验证数据
    if !b.processor.ValidateData(rawData) {
        panic("数据验证失败")
    }
    fmt.Println("数据验证通过")

    // 3. 处理数据
    processedData := b.processor.TransformData(rawData)
    fmt.Printf("处理后得到 %d 条数据\n", len(processedData))

    // 4. 保存数据（可选步骤）
    if b.processor.ShouldSaveData() {
        b.processor.SaveData(processedData)
        fmt.Println("数据已保存")
    }

    // 5. 生成报告
    report := b.processor.GenerateReport(processedData)

    fmt.Println("=== 数据处理流程完成 ===")
    return report
}

// CSVDataProcessor CSV数据处理器
type CSVDataProcessor struct{}

func NewCSVDataProcessor() *CSVDataProcessor {
    return &CSVDataProcessor{}
}

func (c *CSVDataProcessor) ReadData(source string) []DataRecord {
    fmt.Printf("从CSV文件读取数据: %s\n", source)
    // 模拟CSV数据
    return []DataRecord{
        {"id": 1, "name": "Alice", "age": 25, "salary": 50000},
        {"id": 2, "name": "Bob", "age": 30, "salary": 60000},
        {"id": 3, "name": "Charlie", "age": 35, "salary": 70000},
    }
}

func (c *CSVDataProcessor) TransformData(data []DataRecord) []DataRecord {
    transformed := make([]DataRecord, 0, len(data))
    for _, record := range data {
        newRecord := make(DataRecord)
        for k, v := range record {
            newRecord[k] = v
        }

        if salary, ok := record["salary"].(int); ok {
            newRecord["annual_salary"] = salary * 12
        }

        if age, ok := record["age"].(int); ok {
            if age < 30 {
                newRecord["age_group"] = "young"
            } else {
                newRecord["age_group"] = "senior"
            }
        }

        transformed = append(transformed, newRecord)
    }
    return transformed
}

func (c *CSVDataProcessor) ValidateData(data []DataRecord) bool {
    if len(data) == 0 {
        return false
    }

    requiredFields := []string{"id", "name", "age", "salary"}
    for _, record := range data {
        for _, field := range requiredFields {
            if _, exists := record[field]; !exists {
                return false
            }
        }
    }
    return true
}

func (c *CSVDataProcessor) GenerateReport(data []DataRecord) map[string]interface{} {
    return map[string]interface{}{
        "total_records":   len(data),
        "processing_time": time.Now().Unix(),
        "status":         "success",
    }
}

func (c *CSVDataProcessor) ShouldSaveData() bool {
    return true
}

func (c *CSVDataProcessor) SaveData(data []DataRecord) {
    fmt.Printf("保存了 %d 条数据到默认存储\n", len(data))
}

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

// 数据记录类型
pub type DataRecord = HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>;

// 数据处理器trait
pub trait DataProcessor {
    fn read_data(&self, source: &str) -> Vec<DataRecord>;
    fn transform_data(&self, data: Vec<DataRecord>) -> Vec<DataRecord>;
    fn validate_data(&self, data: &[DataRecord]) -> bool {
        !data.is_empty()
    }
    fn generate_report(&self, data: &[DataRecord]) -> HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> {
        let mut report = HashMap::new();
        report.insert("total_records".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(data.len())));
        report.insert("processing_time".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(
            SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_secs()
        )));
        report.insert("status".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String("success".to_string()));
        report
    }
    fn should_save_data(&self) -> bool {
        true
    }
    fn save_data(&self, data: &[DataRecord]) {
        println!("保存了 {} 条数据到默认存储", data.len());
    }
}

// 基础数据处理器，实现模板方法
pub struct BaseDataProcessor<T: DataProcessor> {
    processor: T,
}

impl<T: DataProcessor> BaseDataProcessor<T> {
    pub fn new(processor: T) -> Self {
        BaseDataProcessor { processor }
    }

    // 模板方法：定义数据处理的整体流程
    pub fn process_data(&self, data_source: &str) -> HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> {
        println!("=== 开始数据处理流程 ===");

        // 1. 读取数据
        let raw_data = self.processor.read_data(data_source);
        println!("读取到 {} 条原始数据", raw_data.len());

        // 2. 验证数据
        if !self.processor.validate_data(&raw_data) {
            panic!("数据验证失败");
        }
        println!("数据验证通过");

        // 3. 处理数据
        let processed_data = self.processor.transform_data(raw_data);
        println!("处理后得到 {} 条数据", processed_data.len());

        // 4. 保存数据（可选步骤）
        if self.processor.should_save_data() {
            self.processor.save_data(&processed_data);
            println!("数据已保存");
        }

        // 5. 生成报告
        let report = self.processor.generate_report(&processed_data);

        println!("=== 数据处理流程完成 ===");
        report
    }
}

// CSV数据处理器
pub struct CSVDataProcessor;

impl CSVDataProcessor {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        CSVDataProcessor
    }
}

impl DataProcessor for CSVDataProcessor {
    fn read_data(&self, source: &str) -> Vec<DataRecord> {
        println!("从CSV文件读取数据: {}", source);
        // 模拟CSV数据
        vec![
            {
                let mut record = HashMap::new();
                record.insert("id".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(1)));
                record.insert("name".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String("Alice".to_string()));
                record.insert("age".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(25)));
                record.insert("salary".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(50000)));
                record
            },
            {
                let mut record = HashMap::new();
                record.insert("id".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(2)));
                record.insert("name".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String("Bob".to_string()));
                record.insert("age".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(30)));
                record.insert("salary".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(60000)));
                record
            },
            {
                let mut record = HashMap::new();
                record.insert("id".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(3)));
                record.insert("name".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String("Charlie".to_string()));
                record.insert("age".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(35)));
                record.insert("salary".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(70000)));
                record
            },
        ]
    }

    fn transform_data(&self, data: Vec<DataRecord>) -> Vec<DataRecord> {
        data.into_iter().map(|mut record| {
            // 添加年薪字段
            if let Some(serde_json::Value::Number(salary)) = record.get("salary") {
                if let Some(salary_val) = salary.as_i64() {
                    record.insert("annual_salary".to_string(),
                        serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(salary_val * 12)));
                }
            }

            // 添加年龄组字段
            if let Some(serde_json::Value::Number(age)) = record.get("age") {
                if let Some(age_val) = age.as_i64() {
                    let age_group = if age_val < 30 { "young" } else { "senior" };
                    record.insert("age_group".to_string(),
                        serde_json::Value::String(age_group.to_string()));
                }
            }

            record
        }).collect()
    }

    fn validate_data(&self, data: &[DataRecord]) -> bool {
        if data.is_empty() {
            return false;
        }

        let required_fields = ["id", "name", "age", "salary"];
        for record in data {
            for field in &required_fields {
                if !record.contains_key(*field) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        true
    }
}

                record
            },
            {
                let mut record = HashMap::new();
                record.insert("user_id".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String("u003".to_string()));
                record.insert("username".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String("charlie".to_string()));

                let mut profile = HashMap::new();
                profile.insert("age".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(35)));
                profile.insert("department".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String("Finance".to_string()));
                record.insert("profile".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(
                    profile.into_iter().collect()
                ));
                record
            },
        ]
    }

    fn transform_data(&self, data: Vec<DataRecord>) -> Vec<DataRecord> {
        data.into_iter().map(|record| {
            let mut new_record = HashMap::new();

            if let Some(user_id) = record.get("user_id") {
                new_record.insert("id".to_string(), user_id.clone());
            }

            if let Some(username) = record.get("username") {
                new_record.insert("name".to_string(), username.clone());
            }

            if let Some(serde_json::Value::Object(profile)) = record.get("profile") {
                if let Some(age) = profile.get("age") {
                    new_record.insert("age".to_string(), age.clone());
                }
                if let Some(department) = profile.get("department") {
                    new_record.insert("department".to_string(), department.clone());
                }
            }

            new_record
        }).collect()
    }

    fn should_save_data(&self) -> bool {
        false
    }

    fn generate_report(&self, data: &[DataRecord]) -> HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> {
        let mut base_report = self.validate_data(data).then(|| {
            let mut report = HashMap::new();
            report.insert("total_records".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(data.len())));
            report.insert("processing_time".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(
                SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_secs()
            )));
            report.insert("status".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String("success".to_string()));
            report
        }).unwrap_or_default();

        // 添加部门统计
        let mut departments: HashMap<String, i32> = HashMap::new();
        for record in data {
            let dept = record.get("department")
                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("Unknown");
            *departments.entry(dept.to_string()).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }

        let dept_stats: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = departments
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(k, v)| (k, serde_json::Value::Number(serde_json::Number::from(v))))
            .collect();

        base_report.insert("department_stats".to_string(),
            serde_json::Value::Object(dept_stats));

        base_report
    }
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 状态模式是一种行为型设计模式，它让你能在一个对象的内部状态变化时改变其行为，使该对象看上去就像是改变了自身所属的类一样。状态模式将与特定状态相关的行为局部化，并且将不同状态的行为分割开来。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 对象的行为依赖于它的状态，并且可以根据它的状态改变而改变它的相关行为
  • 代码中包含大量与对象状态有关的条件语句
  • 状态转换逻辑复杂，且状态数量较多
  • 游戏角色状态、订单状态、TCP连接状态、媒体播放器状态

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 封装了转换规则
  • 枚举可能的状态，在枚举状态之前需要确定状态种类
  • 将所有与某个状态有关的行为放到一个类中，并且可以方便地增加新的状态
  • 允许状态转换逻辑与状态对象合成一体，而不是某一个巨大的条件语句块

缺点：

  • 状态模式的使用必然会增加系统类和对象的个数
  • 状态模式的结构与实现都较为复杂，如果使用不当将导致程序结构和代码的混乱

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any
from enum import Enum
import time

# 抽象状态
class State(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def handle_request(self, context: 'Context') -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get_state_name(self) -> str:
        pass

# 上下文类 - 媒体播放器
class MediaPlayer:
    def __init__(self):
        self._state: Optional[State] = None
        self._current_song = ""
        self._volume = 50
        self._position = 0
        self._playlist = []
        self._current_index = 0

        # 设置初始状态
        self.set_state(StoppedState())

    def set_state(self, state: State) -> None:
        """设置当前状态"""
        if self._state:
            print(f"状态从 {self._state.get_state_name()} 切换到 {state.get_state_name()}")
        else:
            print(f"初始状态: {state.get_state_name()}")

        self._state = state
        self._state.context = self

    def get_state(self) -> State:
        return self._state

    def play(self) -> None:
        """播放"""
        self._state.play()

    def pause(self) -> None:
        """暂停"""
        self._state.pause()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        """停止"""
        self._state.stop()

    def next_song(self) -> None:
        """下一首"""
        self._state.next_song()

    def previous_song(self) -> None:
        """上一首"""
        self._state.previous_song()

    def set_volume(self, volume: int) -> None:
        """设置音量"""
        self._volume = max(0, min(100, volume))
        print(f"音量设置为: {self._volume}")

    def load_playlist(self, playlist: list) -> None:
        """加载播放列表"""
        self._playlist = playlist
        self._current_index = 0
        if playlist:
            self._current_song = playlist[0]
            print(f"播放列表已加载，当前歌曲: {self._current_song}")

    def get_current_song(self) -> str:
        return self._current_song

    def get_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            'state': self._state.get_state_name(),
            'song': self._current_song,
            'volume': self._volume,
            'position': self._position,
            'playlist_size': len(self._playlist),
            'current_index': self._current_index
        }

# 播放器状态基类
class PlayerState(State):
    def __init__(self):
        self.context: Optional[MediaPlayer] = None

    def play(self) -> None:
        print(f"在 {self.get_state_name()} 状态下无法播放")

    def pause(self) -> None:
        print(f"在 {self.get_state_name()} 状态下无法暂停")

    def stop(self) -> None:
        print(f"在 {self.get_state_name()} 状态下无法停止")

    def next_song(self) -> None:
        if self.context and self.context._playlist:
            self.context._current_index = (self.context._current_index + 1) % len(self.context._playlist)
            self.context._current_song = self.context._playlist[self.context._current_index]
            print(f"切换到下一首: {self.context._current_song}")

    def previous_song(self) -> None:
        if self.context and self.context._playlist:
            self.context._current_index = (self.context._current_index - 1) % len(self.context._playlist)
            self.context._current_song = self.context._playlist[self.context._current_index]
            print(f"切换到上一首: {self.context._current_song}")

# 具体状态 - 停止状态
class StoppedState(PlayerState):
    def play(self) -> None:
        if self.context._current_song:
            print(f"开始播放: {self.context._current_song}")
            self.context.set_state(PlayingState())
        else:
            print("没有可播放的歌曲")

    def get_state_name(self) -> str:
        return "已停止"

# 具体状态 - 播放状态
class PlayingState(PlayerState):
    def pause(self) -> None:
        print(f"暂停播放: {self.context._current_song}")
        self.context.set_state(PausedState())

    def stop(self) -> None:
        print(f"停止播放: {self.context._current_song}")
        self.context._position = 0
        self.context.set_state(StoppedState())

    def next_song(self) -> None:
        super().next_song()
        if self.context._current_song:
            print(f"自动播放下一首: {self.context._current_song}")

    def get_state_name(self) -> str:
        return "正在播放"

# 具体状态 - 暂停状态
class PausedState(PlayerState):
    def play(self) -> None:
        print(f"继续播放: {self.context._current_song}")
        self.context.set_state(PlayingState())

    def stop(self) -> None:
        print(f"停止播放: {self.context._current_song}")
        self.context._position = 0
        self.context.set_state(StoppedState())

    def get_state_name(self) -> str:
        return "已暂停"

# 订单状态机示例
class OrderState(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def pay(self, order: 'Order') -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def ship(self, order: 'Order') -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def deliver(self, order: 'Order') -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def cancel(self, order: 'Order') -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get_state_name(self) -> str:
        pass

class Order:
    def __init__(self, order_id: str, amount: float):
        self.order_id = order_id
        self.amount = amount
        self.state: OrderState = PendingState()
        print(f"订单 {order_id} 已创建，金额: ${amount:.2f}")

    def set_state(self, state: OrderState) -> None:
        print(f"订单 {self.order_id} 状态从 {self.state.get_state_name()} 变更为 {state.get_state_name()}")
        self.state = state

    def pay(self) -> None:
        self.state.pay(self)

    def ship(self) -> None:
        self.state.ship(self)

    def deliver(self) -> None:
        self.state.deliver(self)

    def cancel(self) -> None:
        self.state.cancel(self)

    def get_status(self) -> str:
        return f"订单 {self.order_id}: {self.state.get_state_name()}"

# 订单状态实现
class PendingState(OrderState):
    def pay(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print(f"订单 {order.order_id} 支付成功")
        order.set_state(PaidState())

    def ship(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单未支付，无法发货")

    def deliver(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单未支付，无法配送")

    def cancel(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print(f"订单 {order.order_id} 已取消")
        order.set_state(CancelledState())

    def get_state_name(self) -> str:
        return "待支付"

class PaidState(OrderState):
    def pay(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已支付，无需重复支付")

    def ship(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print(f"订单 {order.order_id} 已发货")
        order.set_state(ShippedState())

    def deliver(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单未发货，无法配送")

    def cancel(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print(f"订单 {order.order_id} 已取消，将退款")
        order.set_state(CancelledState())

    def get_state_name(self) -> str:
        return "已支付"

class ShippedState(OrderState):
    def pay(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已支付")

    def ship(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已发货")

    def deliver(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print(f"订单 {order.order_id} 已送达")
        order.set_state(DeliveredState())

    def cancel(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已发货，无法取消")

    def get_state_name(self) -> str:
        return "已发货"

class DeliveredState(OrderState):
    def pay(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已完成")

    def ship(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已完成")

    def deliver(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已送达")

    def cancel(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已完成，无法取消")

    def get_state_name(self) -> str:
        return "已送达"

class CancelledState(OrderState):
    def pay(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已取消，无法支付")

    def ship(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已取消，无法发货")

    def deliver(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已取消，无法配送")

    def cancel(self, order: Order) -> None:
        print("订单已取消")

    def get_state_name(self) -> str:
        return "已取消"

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== 媒体播放器状态模式示例 ===")

    # 创建媒体播放器
    player = MediaPlayer()

    # 加载播放列表
    playlist = ["歌曲1.mp3", "歌曲2.mp3", "歌曲3.mp3"]
    player.load_playlist(playlist)

    print(f"\n当前状态: {player.get_status()}")

    # 测试状态转换
    player.play()      # 停止 -> 播放
    player.pause()     # 播放 -> 暂停
    player.play()      # 暂停 -> 播放
    player.next_song() # 下一首
    player.stop()      # 播放 -> 停止

    print(f"\n最终状态: {player.get_status()}")

    print("\n=== 订单状态模式示例 ===")

    # 创建订单
    order = Order("ORD001", 99.99)

    # 正常流程
    print(f"\n{order.get_status()}")
    order.pay()        # 待支付 -> 已支付
    order.ship()       # 已支付 -> 已发货
    order.deliver()    # 已发货 -> 已送达

    print(f"\n{order.get_status()}")

    # 异常流程
    print("\n--- 异常操作测试 ---")
    order.cancel()     # 已送达状态下取消（应该失败）
    order.pay()        # 已送达状态下支付（应该提示已完成）

    # 创建另一个订单测试取消流程
    print("\n--- 取消流程测试 ---")
    order2 = Order("ORD002", 49.99)
    order2.pay()       # 待支付 -> 已支付
    order2.cancel()    # 已支付 -> 已取消
    order2.ship()      # 已取消状态下发货（应该失败）

package main

import (
    "fmt"
)

// 状态接口
type State interface {
    Play(player *MediaPlayer)
    Pause(player *MediaPlayer)
    Stop(player *MediaPlayer)
    NextSong(player *MediaPlayer)
    PreviousSong(player *MediaPlayer)
    GetStateName() string
}

// 媒体播放器上下文
type MediaPlayer struct {
    state        State
    currentSong  string
    volume       int
    position     int
    playlist     []string
    currentIndex int
}

func NewMediaPlayer() *MediaPlayer {
    player := &MediaPlayer{
        volume:       50,
        position:     0,
        playlist:     make([]string, 0),
        currentIndex: 0,
    }
    player.SetState(&StoppedState{})
    return player
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) SetState(state State) {
    if p.state != nil {
        fmt.Printf("状态从 %s 切换到 %s\n", p.state.GetStateName(), state.GetStateName())
    } else {
        fmt.Printf("初始状态: %s\n", state.GetStateName())
    }
    p.state = state
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) GetState() State {
    return p.state
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) Play() {
    p.state.Play(p)
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) Pause() {
    p.state.Pause(p)
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) Stop() {
    p.state.Stop(p)
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) NextSong() {
    p.state.NextSong(p)
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) PreviousSong() {
    p.state.PreviousSong(p)
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) SetVolume(volume int) {
    if volume < 0 {
        volume = 0
    }
    if volume > 100 {
        volume = 100
    }
    p.volume = volume
    fmt.Printf("音量设置为: %d\n", p.volume)
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) LoadPlaylist(playlist []string) {
    p.playlist = playlist
    p.currentIndex = 0
    if len(playlist) > 0 {
        p.currentSong = playlist[0]
        fmt.Printf("播放列表已加载，当前歌曲: %s\n", p.currentSong)
    }
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) GetCurrentSong() string {
    return p.currentSong
}

func (p *MediaPlayer) GetStatus() map[string]interface{} {
    return map[string]interface{}{
        "state":         p.state.GetStateName(),
        "song":          p.currentSong,
        "volume":        p.volume,
        "position":      p.position,
        "playlist_size": len(p.playlist),
        "current_index": p.currentIndex,
    }
}

// 播放器状态基类
type PlayerState struct{}

func (ps *PlayerState) Play(player *MediaPlayer) {
    fmt.Printf("在当前状态下无法播放\n")
}

func (ps *PlayerState) Pause(player *MediaPlayer) {
    fmt.Printf("在当前状态下无法暂停\n")
}

func (ps *PlayerState) Stop(player *MediaPlayer) {
    fmt.Printf("在当前状态下无法停止\n")
}

func (ps *PlayerState) NextSong(player *MediaPlayer) {
    if len(player.playlist) > 0 {
        player.currentIndex = (player.currentIndex + 1) % len(player.playlist)
        player.currentSong = player.playlist[player.currentIndex]
        fmt.Printf("切换到下一首: %s\n", player.currentSong)
    }
}

func (ps *PlayerState) PreviousSong(player *MediaPlayer) {
    if len(player.playlist) > 0 {
        player.currentIndex = (player.currentIndex - 1 + len(player.playlist)) % len(player.playlist)
        player.currentSong = player.playlist[player.currentIndex]
        fmt.Printf("切换到上一首: %s\n", player.currentSong)
    }
}

// 具体状态 - 停止状态
type StoppedState struct {
    PlayerState
}

func (s *StoppedState) Play(player *MediaPlayer) {
    if player.currentSong != "" {
        fmt.Printf("开始播放: %s\n", player.currentSong)
        player.SetState(&PlayingState{})
    } else {
        fmt.Println("没有可播放的歌曲")

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fmt;

// 状态trait
trait State {
    fn play(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer);
    fn pause(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer);
    fn stop(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer);
    fn next_song(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer);
    fn previous_song(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer);
    fn get_state_name(&self) -> &'static str;
}

// 媒体播放器上下文
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct MediaPlayer {
    state: Box<dyn State>,
    current_song: String,
    volume: u8,
    position: u32,
    playlist: Vec<String>,
    current_index: usize,
}

impl MediaPlayer {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let mut player = MediaPlayer {
            state: Box::new(StoppedState),
            current_song: String::new(),
            volume: 50,
            position: 0,
            playlist: Vec::new(),
            current_index: 0,
        };
        println!("初始状态: {}", player.state.get_state_name());
        player
    }

    pub fn set_state(&mut self, state: Box<dyn State>) {
        println!("状态从 {} 切换到 {}",
                self.state.get_state_name(),
                state.get_state_name());
        self.state = state;
    }

    pub fn play(&mut self) {
        self.state.play(self);
    }

    pub fn pause(&mut self) {
        self.state.pause(self);
    }

    pub fn stop(&mut self) {
        self.state.stop(self);
    }

    pub fn next_song(&mut self) {
        self.state.next_song(self);
    }

    pub fn previous_song(&mut self) {
        self.state.previous_song(self);
    }

    pub fn set_volume(&mut self, volume: u8) {
        self.volume = volume.min(100);
        println!("音量设置为: {}", self.volume);
    }

    pub fn load_playlist(&mut self, playlist: Vec<String>) {
        self.playlist = playlist;
        self.current_index = 0;
        if !self.playlist.is_empty() {
            self.current_song = self.playlist[0].clone();
            println!("播放列表已加载，当前歌曲: {}", self.current_song);
        }
    }

    pub fn get_current_song(&self) -> &str {
        &self.current_song
    }

    pub fn get_status(&self) -> HashMap<String, String> {
        let mut status = HashMap::new();
        status.insert("state".to_string(), self.state.get_state_name().to_string());
        status.insert("song".to_string(), self.current_song.clone());
        status.insert("volume".to_string(), self.volume.to_string());
        status.insert("position".to_string(), self.position.to_string());
        status.insert("playlist_size".to_string(), self.playlist.len().to_string());
        status.insert("current_index".to_string(), self.current_index.to_string());
        status
    }

    // 内部方法，供状态使用
    fn switch_song(&mut self, direction: i32) {
        if !self.playlist.is_empty() {
            let len = self.playlist.len();
            if direction > 0 {
                self.current_index = (self.current_index + 1) % len;
            } else {
                self.current_index = (self.current_index + len - 1) % len;
            }
            self.current_song = self.playlist[self.current_index].clone();
        }
    }
}

// 具体状态 - 停止状态
struct StoppedState;

impl State for StoppedState {
    fn play(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        if !player.current_song.is_empty() {
            println!("开始播放: {}", player.current_song);
            player.set_state(Box::new(PlayingState));
        } else {
            println!("没有可播放的歌曲");
        }
    }

    fn pause(&self, _player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        println!("在 {} 状态下无法暂停", self.get_state_name());
    }

    fn stop(&self, _player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        println!("在 {} 状态下无法停止", self.get_state_name());
    }

    fn next_song(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        player.switch_song(1);
        println!("切换到下一首: {}", player.current_song);
    }

    fn previous_song(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        player.switch_song(-1);
        println!("切换到上一首: {}", player.current_song);
    }

    fn get_state_name(&self) -> &'static str {
        "已停止"
    }
}

// 具体状态 - 播放状态
struct PlayingState;

impl State for PlayingState {
    fn play(&self, _player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        println!("在 {} 状态下无法播放", self.get_state_name());
    }

    fn pause(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        println!("暂停播放: {}", player.current_song);
        player.set_state(Box::new(PausedState));
    }

    fn stop(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        println!("停止播放: {}", player.current_song);
        player.position = 0;
        player.set_state(Box::new(StoppedState));
    }

    fn next_song(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        player.switch_song(1);
        if !player.current_song.is_empty() {
            println!("自动播放下一首: {}", player.current_song);
        }
    }

    fn previous_song(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        player.switch_song(-1);
        if !player.current_song.is_empty() {
            println!("自动播放上一首: {}", player.current_song);
        }
    }

    fn get_state_name(&self) -> &'static str {
        "正在播放"
    }
}

// 具体状态 - 暂停状态
struct PausedState;

impl State for PausedState {
    fn play(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        println!("继续播放: {}", player.current_song);
        player.set_state(Box::new(PlayingState));
    }

    fn pause(&self, _player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        println!("在 {} 状态下无法暂停", self.get_state_name());
    }

    fn stop(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        println!("停止播放: {}", player.current_song);
        player.position = 0;
        player.set_state(Box::new(StoppedState));
    }

    fn next_song(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        player.switch_song(1);
        println!("切换到下一首: {}", player.current_song);
    }

    fn previous_song(&self, player: &mut MediaPlayer) {
        player.switch_song(-1);
        println!("切换到上一首: {}", player.current_song);
    }

    fn get_state_name(&self) -> &'static str {
        "已暂停"
    }
}

// 订单状态trait

#[derive(Debug)]

mod tests {

    #[test]
    fn test_media_player_state_transitions() {
        let mut player = MediaPlayer::new();
        player.load_playlist(vec!["test.mp3".to_string()]);

        assert_eq!(player.state.get_state_name(), "已暂停");

        // 测试暂停 -> 播放
        player.play();
        assert_eq!(player.state.get_state_name(), "正在播放");

        // 测试播放 -> 停止
        player.stop();
        assert_eq!(player.state.get_state_name(), "已停止");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_order_state_transitions() {
        let mut order = Order::new("TEST001".to_string(), 100.0);

        // 测试待支付 -> 已支付
        order.pay();
        assert_eq!(order.state.get_state_name(), "已支付");

        // 测试已支付 -> 已发货
        order.ship();
        assert_eq!(order.state.get_state_name(), "已发货");

        // 测试已发货 -> 已送达
        order.deliver();
        assert_eq!(order.state.get_state_name(), "已送达");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_order_cancellation() {
        let mut order = Order::new("CANCEL001".to_string(), 50.0);

        // 测试待支付状态下取消
        order.cancel();
        assert_eq!(order.state.get_state_name(), "已取消");

        // 测试已取消状态下的操作
        order.pay();    // 应该失败
        order.ship();   // 应该失败
        assert_eq!(order.state.get_state_name(), "已取消");
    }
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 策略模式是一种行为型设计模式，它定义了一系列算法，并将每个算法封装起来，使它们可以互换。策略模式让算法独立于使用它的客户端而变化，使得算法可以在运行时动态地选择和切换。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 需要在运行时选择算法
  • 有多种实现同一功能的方式
  • 需要避免使用条件语句选择算法
  • 支付方式选择、排序算法选择、压缩算法选择、路径规划算法

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 算法可以自由切换
  • 避免使用多重条件判断
  • 扩展性良好，符合开闭原则

缺点：

  • 策略类会增多
  • 所有策略类都需要对外暴露

docs.text:
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from enum import Enum
import time
import random

# 抽象策略接口
class Strategy(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def execute(self, data: Any) -> Any:
        pass

# 排序策略示例
class SortStrategy(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def sort(self, data: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get_name(self) -> str:
        pass

# 具体策略 - 冒泡排序
class BubbleSortStrategy(SortStrategy):
    def sort(self, data: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        arr = data.copy()
        n = len(arr)
        comparisons = 0

        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(0, n - i - 1):
                comparisons += 1
                if arr[j] > arr[j + 1]:
                    arr[j], arr[j + 1] = arr[j + 1], arr[j]

        print(f"冒泡排序完成，比较次数: {comparisons}")
        return arr

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return "冒泡排序"

# 具体策略 - 快速排序
class QuickSortStrategy(SortStrategy):
    def __init__(self):
        self.comparisons = 0

    def sort(self, data: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        arr = data.copy()
        self.comparisons = 0
        self._quick_sort(arr, 0, len(arr) - 1)
        print(f"快速排序完成，比较次数: {self.comparisons}")
        return arr

    def _quick_sort(self, arr: List[int], low: int, high: int) -> None:
        if low < high:
            pi = self._partition(arr, low, high)
            self._quick_sort(arr, low, pi - 1)
            self._quick_sort(arr, pi + 1, high)

    def _partition(self, arr: List[int], low: int, high: int) -> int:
        pivot = arr[high]
        i = low - 1

        for j in range(low, high):
            self.comparisons += 1
            if arr[j] <= pivot:
                i += 1
                arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]

        arr[i + 1], arr[high] = arr[high], arr[i + 1]
        return i + 1

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return "快速排序"

# 具体策略 - 归并排序
class MergeSortStrategy(SortStrategy):
    def __init__(self):
        self.comparisons = 0

    def sort(self, data: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        arr = data.copy()
        self.comparisons = 0
        self._merge_sort(arr, 0, len(arr) - 1)
        print(f"归并排序完成，比较次数: {self.comparisons}")
        return arr

    def _merge_sort(self, arr: List[int], left: int, right: int) -> None:
        if left < right:
            mid = (left + right) // 2
            self._merge_sort(arr, left, mid)
            self._merge_sort(arr, mid + 1, right)
            self._merge(arr, left, mid, right)

    def _merge(self, arr: List[int], left: int, mid: int, right: int) -> None:
        left_arr = arr[left:mid + 1]
        right_arr = arr[mid + 1:right + 1]

        i = j = 0
        k = left

        while i < len(left_arr) and j < len(right_arr):
            self.comparisons += 1
            if left_arr[i] <= right_arr[j]:
                arr[k] = left_arr[i]
                i += 1
            else:
                arr[k] = right_arr[j]
                j += 1
            k += 1

        while i < len(left_arr):
            arr[k] = left_arr[i]
            i += 1
            k += 1

        while j < len(right_arr):
            arr[k] = right_arr[j]
            j += 1
            k += 1

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return "归并排序"

# 上下文类 - 排序器
class Sorter:
    def __init__(self, strategy: SortStrategy):
        self._strategy = strategy

    def set_strategy(self, strategy: SortStrategy) -> None:
        """动态切换策略"""
        self._strategy = strategy
        print(f"切换排序策略为: {strategy.get_name()}")

    def sort(self, data: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        """执行排序"""
        print(f"使用 {self._strategy.get_name()} 进行排序")
        start_time = time.time()
        result = self._strategy.sort(data)
        end_time = time.time()
        print(f"排序耗时: {(end_time - start_time) * 1000:.2f}ms")
        return result

# 支付策略示例
class PaymentStrategy(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def pay(self, amount: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get_name(self) -> str:
        pass

# 具体支付策略 - 信用卡支付
class CreditCardPayment(PaymentStrategy):
    def __init__(self, card_number: str, cvv: str):
        self.card_number = card_number[-4:]  # 只保留后4位
        self.cvv = cvv

    def pay(self, amount: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # 模拟信用卡支付处理
        print(f"正在处理信用卡支付...")
        print(f"卡号后4位: ****{self.card_number}")

        # 模拟支付延迟
        time.sleep(0.1)

        return {
            'success': True,
            'transaction_id': f"CC_{random.randint(100000, 999999)}",
            'method': 'credit_card',
            'amount': amount,
            'fee': amount * 0.03  # 3% 手续费
        }

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return "信用卡支付"

# 具体支付策略 - PayPal支付
class PayPalPayment(PaymentStrategy):
    def __init__(self, email: str):
        self.email = email

    def pay(self, amount: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        print(f"正在处理PayPal支付...")
        print(f"PayPal账户: {self.email}")

        time.sleep(0.05)

        return {
            'success': True,
            'transaction_id': f"PP_{random.randint(100000, 999999)}",
            'method': 'paypal',
            'amount': amount,
            'fee': amount * 0.025  # 2.5% 手续费
        }

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return "PayPal支付"

# 具体支付策略 - 加密货币支付
class CryptoPayment(PaymentStrategy):
    def __init__(self, wallet_address: str, crypto_type: str = "BTC"):
        self.wallet_address = wallet_address
        self.crypto_type = crypto_type

    def pay(self, amount: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        print(f"正在处理{self.crypto_type}支付...")
        print(f"钱包地址: {self.wallet_address[:6]}...{self.wallet_address[-4:]}")

        time.sleep(0.2)  # 区块链确认需要更长时间

        return {
            'success': True,
            'transaction_id': f"CRYPTO_{random.randint(100000, 999999)}",
            'method': 'cryptocurrency',
            'crypto_type': self.crypto_type,
            'amount': amount,
            'fee': 0.001  # 固定手续费
        }

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.crypto_type}支付"

# 支付处理器
class PaymentProcessor:
    def __init__(self):
        self._strategy: Optional[PaymentStrategy] = None
        self._transaction_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    def set_payment_method(self, strategy: PaymentStrategy) -> None:
        """设置支付方式"""
        self._strategy = strategy
        print(f"支付方式设置为: {strategy.get_name()}")

    def process_payment(self, amount: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """处理支付"""
        if not self._strategy:
            raise ValueError("未设置支付方式")

        print(f"\n处理支付金额: ${amount:.2f}")
        result = self._strategy.pay(amount)

        if result['success']:
            self._transaction_history.append({
                **result,
                'timestamp': time.time(),
                'payment_method': self._strategy.get_name()
            })
            print(f"支付成功! 交易ID: {result['transaction_id']}")
            print(f"手续费: ${result['fee']:.2f}")
        else:
            print("支付失败!")

        return result

    def get_transaction_history(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return self._transaction_history.copy()

# 压缩策略示例
class CompressionStrategy(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def compress(self, data: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get_name(self) -> str:
        pass

class ZipCompression(CompressionStrategy):
    def compress(self, data: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # 模拟ZIP压缩
        compressed_size = len(data) * 0.6  # 假设压缩率60%
        return {
            'original_size': len(data),
            'compressed_size': int(compressed_size),
            'compression_ratio': compressed_size / len(data),
            'method': 'ZIP'
        }

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return "ZIP压缩"

class GzipCompression(CompressionStrategy):
    def compress(self, data: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # 模拟GZIP压缩
        compressed_size = len(data) * 0.5  # 假设压缩率50%
        return {
            'original_size': len(data),
            'compressed_size': int(compressed_size),
            'compression_ratio': compressed_size / len(data),
            'method': 'GZIP'
        }

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return "GZIP压缩"

class LzmaCompression(CompressionStrategy):
    def compress(self, data: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # 模拟LZMA压缩
        compressed_size = len(data) * 0.4  # 假设压缩率40%
        return {
            'original_size': len(data),
            'compressed_size': int(compressed_size),
            'compression_ratio': compressed_size / len(data),
            'method': 'LZMA'
        }

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return "LZMA压缩"

# 压缩器
class Compressor:
    def __init__(self, strategy: CompressionStrategy):
        self._strategy = strategy

    def set_strategy(self, strategy: CompressionStrategy) -> None:
        self._strategy = strategy
        print(f"压缩策略设置为: {strategy.get_name()}")

    def compress(self, data: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        print(f"使用 {self._strategy.get_name()} 压缩数据")
        result = self._strategy.compress(data)
        print(f"原始大小: {result['original_size']} bytes")
        print(f"压缩后大小: {result['compressed_size']} bytes")
        print(f"压缩率: {result['compression_ratio']:.2%}")
        return result

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== 排序策略模式示例 ===")

    # 生成测试数据
    test_data = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90, 5, 77, 30]
    print(f"原始数据: {test_data}")

    # 创建排序器，初始使用冒泡排序
    sorter = Sorter(BubbleSortStrategy())

    # 使用不同的排序策略
    strategies = [
        BubbleSortStrategy(),
        QuickSortStrategy(),
        MergeSortStrategy()
    ]

    for strategy in strategies:
        print(f"\n--- {strategy.get_name()} ---")
        sorter.set_strategy(strategy)
        result = sorter.sort(test_data)
        print(f"排序结果: {result}")

    print("\n=== 支付策略模式示例 ===")

    # 创建支付处理器
    processor = PaymentProcessor()

    # 创建不同的支付方式
    credit_card = CreditCardPayment("1234567890123456", "123")
    paypal = PayPalPayment("user@example.com")
    crypto = CryptoPayment("1A1zP1eP5QGefi2DMPTfTL5SLmv7DivfNa", "BTC")

    # 测试不同支付方式
    payment_methods = [credit_card, paypal, crypto]
    amounts = [100.0, 250.0, 50.0]

    for method, amount in zip(payment_methods, amounts):
        processor.set_payment_method(method)
        processor.process_payment(amount)
        print()

    print("=== 交易历史 ===")
    for transaction in processor.get_transaction_history():
        print(f"时间: {time.ctime(transaction['timestamp'])}")
        print(f"方式: {transaction['payment_method']}")
        print(f"金额: ${transaction['amount']:.2f}")
        print(f"手续费: ${transaction['fee']:.2f}")
        print(f"交易ID: {transaction['transaction_id']}")
        print("-" * 30)

    print("\n=== 压缩策略模式示例 ===")

    # 测试数据
    test_text = "这是一个用于测试压缩算法的示例文本。" * 10
    print(f"测试文本长度: {len(test_text)} 字符")

    # 创建压缩器
    compressor = Compressor(ZipCompression())

    # 测试不同压缩策略
    compression_strategies = [
        ZipCompression(),
        GzipCompression(),
        LzmaCompression()
    ]

    results = []
    for strategy in compression_strategies:
        print(f"\n--- {strategy.get_name()} ---")
        compressor.set_strategy(strategy)
        result = compressor.compress(test_text)
        results.append(result)

    print("\n=== 压缩效果对比 ===")
    best_compression = min(results, key=lambda x: x['compression_ratio'])
    print(f"最佳压缩方式: {best_compression['method']}")
    print(f"最佳压缩率: {best_compression['compression_ratio']:.2%}")

docs.text:
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "math/rand"
    "strings"
    "time"
)

// 策略接口
type Strategy interface {
    Execute(data interface{}) interface{}
}

// 排序策略接口
type SortStrategy interface {
    Sort(data []int) []int
    GetName() string
}

// 具体策略 - 冒泡排序
type BubbleSortStrategy struct {
    comparisons int
}

func (b *BubbleSortStrategy) Sort(data []int) []int {
    arr := make([]int, len(data))
    copy(arr, data)
    n := len(arr)
    b.comparisons = 0

    for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
        for j := 0; j < n-i-1; j++ {
            b.comparisons++
            if arr[j] > arr[j+1] {
                arr[j], arr[j+1] = arr[j+1], arr[j]
            }
        }
    }

    fmt.Printf("冒泡排序完成，比较次数: %d\n", b.comparisons)
    return arr
}

func (b *BubbleSortStrategy) GetName() string {
    return "冒泡排序"
}

// 具体策略 - 快速排序
type QuickSortStrategy struct {
    comparisons int
}

func (q *QuickSortStrategy) Sort(data []int) []int {
    arr := make([]int, len(data))
    copy(arr, data)
    q.comparisons = 0
    q.quickSort(arr, 0, len(arr)-1)
    fmt.Printf("快速排序完成，比较次数: %d\n", q.comparisons)
    return arr
}

func (q *QuickSortStrategy) quickSort(arr []int, low, high int) {
    if low < high {
        pi := q.partition(arr, low, high)
        q.quickSort(arr, low, pi-1)
        q.quickSort(arr, pi+1, high)
    }
}

func (q *QuickSortStrategy) partition(arr []int, low, high int) int {
    pivot := arr[high]
    i := low - 1

    for j := low; j < high; j++ {
        q.comparisons++
        if arr[j] <= pivot {
            i++
            arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]
        }
    }

    arr[i+1], arr[high] = arr[high], arr[i+1]
    return i + 1
}

func (q *QuickSortStrategy) GetName() string {
    return "快速排序"
}

// 具体策略 - 归并排序
type MergeSortStrategy struct {
    comparisons int
}

func (m *MergeSortStrategy) Sort(data []int) []int {
    arr := make([]int, len(data))
    copy(arr, data)
    m.comparisons = 0
    m.mergeSort(arr, 0, len(arr)-1)
    fmt.Printf("归并排序完成，比较次数: %d\n", m.comparisons)
    return arr
}

func (m *MergeSortStrategy) mergeSort(arr []int, left, right int) {
    if left < right {
        mid := (left + right) / 2
        m.mergeSort(arr, left, mid)
        m.mergeSort(arr, mid+1, right)
        m.merge(arr, left, mid, right)
    }
}

func (m *MergeSortStrategy) merge(arr []int, left, mid, right int) {
    leftArr := make([]int, mid-left+1)
    rightArr := make([]int, right-mid)

    copy(leftArr, arr[left:mid+1])
    copy(rightArr, arr[mid+1:right+1])

    i, j, k := 0, 0, left

    for i < len(leftArr) && j < len(rightArr) {
        m.comparisons++
        if leftArr[i] <= rightArr[j] {
            arr[k] = leftArr[i]
            i++
        } else {
            arr[k] = rightArr[j]
            j++
        }
        k++
    }

    for i < len(leftArr) {
        arr[k] = leftArr[i]
        i++
        k++
    }

    for j < len(rightArr) {
        arr[k] = rightArr[j]
        j++
        k++
    }
}

func (m *MergeSortStrategy) GetName() string {
    return "归并排序"
}

// 上下文类 - 排序器
type Sorter struct {
    strategy SortStrategy
}

func NewSorter(strategy SortStrategy) *Sorter {
    return &Sorter{strategy: strategy}
}

func (s *Sorter) SetStrategy(strategy SortStrategy) {
    s.strategy = strategy
    fmt.Printf("切换排序策略为: %s\n", strategy.GetName())
}

func (s *Sorter) Sort(data []int) []int {
    fmt.Printf("使用 %s 进行排序\n", s.strategy.GetName())
    start := time.Now()
    result := s.strategy.Sort(data)
    elapsed := time.Since(start)
    fmt.Printf("排序耗时: %.2fms\n", float64(elapsed.Nanoseconds())/1000000)
    return result
}

// 支付策略接口
type PaymentStrategy interface {
    Pay(amount float64) map[string]interface{}
    GetName() string
}

// 具体支付策略 - 信用卡支付
type CreditCardPayment struct {
    cardNumber string
    cvv        string
}

func NewCreditCardPayment(cardNumber, cvv string) *CreditCardPayment {
    return &CreditCardPayment{
        cardNumber: cardNumber[len(cardNumber)-4:], // 只保留后4位
        cvv:        cvv,
    }
}

func (c *CreditCardPayment) Pay(amount float64) map[string]interface{} {
    fmt.Println("正在处理信用卡支付...")
    fmt.Printf("卡号后4位: ****%s\n", c.cardNumber)

    // 模拟支付延迟
    time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)

    return map[string]interface{}{
        "success":        true,
        "transaction_id": fmt.Sprintf("CC_%d", rand.Intn(900000)+100000),
        "method":         "credit_card",
        "amount":         amount,
        "fee":            amount * 0.03, // 3% 手续费
    }
}

func (c *CreditCardPayment) GetName() string {
    return "信用卡支付"
}

// 具体支付策略 - PayPal支付
type PayPalPayment struct {
    email string
}

func NewPayPalPayment(email string) *PayPalPayment {
    return &PayPalPayment{email: email}
}

func (p *PayPalPayment) Pay(amount float64) map[string]interface{} {
    fmt.Println("正在处理PayPal支付...")
    fmt.Printf("PayPal账户: %s\n", p.email)

    time.Sleep(150 * time.Millisecond)

    return map[string]interface{}{
        "success":        true,
        "transaction_id": fmt.Sprintf("PP_%d", rand.Intn(900000)+100000),
        "method":         "paypal",
        "amount":         amount,
        "fee":            amount * 0.025, // 2.5% 手续费
    }
}

func (p *PayPalPayment) GetName() string {
    return "PayPal支付"
}

// 具体支付策略 - 加密货币支付
type CryptoPayment struct {
    walletAddress string
    cryptoType    string
}

func NewCryptoPayment(walletAddress, cryptoType string) *CryptoPayment {
    return &CryptoPayment{
        walletAddress: walletAddress,
        cryptoType:    cryptoType,
    }
}

func (c *CryptoPayment) Pay(amount float64) map[string]interface{} {
    fmt.Printf("正在处理%s支付...\n", c.cryptoType)
    fmt.Printf("钱包地址: %s...%s\n",
        c.walletAddress[:6],
        c.walletAddress[len(c.walletAddress)-4:])

    time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond) // 区块链确认需要更长时间

    return map[string]interface{}{
        "success":        true,
        "transaction_id": fmt.Sprintf("CRYPTO_%d", rand.Intn(900000)+100000),
        "method":         "cryptocurrency",
        "crypto_type":    c.cryptoType,
        "amount":         amount,
        "fee":            0.001, // 固定手续费
    }
}

func (c *CryptoPayment) GetName() string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("%s支付", c.cryptoType)
}

// 支付处理器
type PaymentProcessor struct {
    strategy           PaymentStrategy
    transactionHistory []map[string]interface{}
}

func NewPaymentProcessor() *PaymentProcessor {
    return &PaymentProcessor{
        transactionHistory: make([]map[string]interface{}, 0),
    }
}

func (p *PaymentProcessor) SetPaymentMethod(strategy PaymentStrategy) {
    p.strategy = strategy
    fmt.Printf("支付方式设置为: %s\n", strategy.GetName())
}

func (p *PaymentProcessor) ProcessPayment(amount float64) map[string]interface{} {
    if p.strategy == nil {
        panic("未设置支付方式")
    }

    fmt.Printf("\n处理支付金额: $%.2f\n", amount)
    result := p.strategy.Pay(amount)

    if success, ok := result["success"].(bool); ok && success {
        transaction := make(map[string]interface{})
        for k, v := range result {
            transaction[k] = v
        }
        transaction["timestamp"] = time.Now().Unix()
        transaction["payment_method"] = p.strategy.GetName()

        p.transactionHistory = append(p.transactionHistory, transaction)
        fmt.Printf("支付成功! 交易ID: %s\n", result["transaction_id"])
        fmt.Printf("手续费: $%.2f\n", result["fee"])
    } else {

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use std::thread;
use rand::Rng;

// 策略trait
trait Strategy {
    fn execute(&self, data: &dyn std::any::Any) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any>;
}

// 排序策略trait
trait SortStrategy {
    fn sort(&mut self, data: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32>;
    fn get_name(&self) -> &'static str;
}

// 具体策略 - 冒泡排序
#[derive(Default)]
struct BubbleSortStrategy {
    comparisons: usize,
}

impl SortStrategy for BubbleSortStrategy {
    fn sort(&mut self, data: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32> {
        let mut arr = data.to_vec();
        let n = arr.len();
        self.comparisons = 0;

        for i in 0..n {
            for j in 0..n - i - 1 {
                self.comparisons += 1;
                if arr[j] > arr[j + 1] {
                    arr.swap(j, j + 1);
                }
            }
        }

        println!("冒泡排序完成，比较次数: {}", self.comparisons);
        arr
    }

    fn get_name(&self) -> &'static str {
        "冒泡排序"
    }
}

// 具体策略 - 快速排序
#[derive(Default)]
struct QuickSortStrategy {
    comparisons: usize,
}

impl QuickSortStrategy {
    fn quick_sort(&mut self, arr: &mut [i32], low: isize, high: isize) {
        if low < high {
            let pi = self.partition(arr, low, high);
            self.quick_sort(arr, low, pi - 1);
            self.quick_sort(arr, pi + 1, high);
        }
    }

    fn partition(&mut self, arr: &mut [i32], low: isize, high: isize) -> isize {
        let pivot = arr[high as usize];
        let mut i = low - 1;

        for j in low..high {
            self.comparisons += 1;
            if arr[j as usize] <= pivot {
                i += 1;
                arr.swap(i as usize, j as usize);
            }
        }

        arr.swap((i + 1) as usize, high as usize);
        i + 1
    }
}

impl SortStrategy for QuickSortStrategy {
    fn sort(&mut self, data: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32> {
        let mut arr = data.to_vec();
        self.comparisons = 0;
        let len = arr.len() as isize;
        if len > 1 {
            self.quick_sort(&mut arr, 0, len - 1);
        }
        println!("快速排序完成，比较次数: {}", self.comparisons);
        arr
    }

    fn get_name(&self) -> &'static str {
        "快速排序"
    }
}

// 具体策略 - 归并排序
#[derive(Default)]
struct MergeSortStrategy {
    comparisons: usize,
}

impl MergeSortStrategy {
    fn merge_sort(&mut self, arr: &mut [i32], left: usize, right: usize) {
        if left < right {
            let mid = (left + right) / 2;
            self.merge_sort(arr, left, mid);
            self.merge_sort(arr, mid + 1, right);
            self.merge(arr, left, mid, right);
        }
    }

    fn merge(&mut self, arr: &mut [i32], left: usize, mid: usize, right: usize) {
        let left_arr: Vec<i32> = arr[left..=mid].to_vec();
        let right_arr: Vec<i32> = arr[mid + 1..=right].to_vec();

        let mut i = 0;
        let mut j = 0;
        let mut k = left;

        while i < left_arr.len() && j < right_arr.len() {
            self.comparisons += 1;
            if left_arr[i] <= right_arr[j] {
                arr[k] = left_arr[i];
                i += 1;
            } else {
                arr[k] = right_arr[j];
                j += 1;
            }
            k += 1;
        }

        while i < left_arr.len() {
            arr[k] = left_arr[i];
            i += 1;
            k += 1;
        }

        while j < right_arr.len() {
            arr[k] = right_arr[j];
            j += 1;
            k += 1;
        }
    }
}

impl SortStrategy for MergeSortStrategy {
    fn sort(&mut self, data: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32> {
        let mut arr = data.to_vec();
        self.comparisons = 0;
        let len = arr.len();
        if len > 1 {
            self.merge_sort(&mut arr, 0, len - 1);
        }
        println!("归并排序完成，比较次数: {}", self.comparisons);
        arr
    }

    fn get_name(&self) -> &'static str {
        "归并排序"
    }
}

// 上下文类 - 排序器
struct Sorter {
    strategy: Box<dyn SortStrategy>,
}

impl Sorter {
    fn new(strategy: Box<dyn SortStrategy>) -> Self {
        Self { strategy }
    }

    fn set_strategy(&mut self, strategy: Box<dyn SortStrategy>) {
        println!("切换排序策略为: {}", strategy.get_name());
        self.strategy = strategy;
    }

    fn sort(&mut self, data: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32> {
        println!("使用 {} 进行排序", self.strategy.get_name());
        let start = Instant::now();
        let result = self.strategy.sort(data);
        let elapsed = start.elapsed();
        println!("排序耗时: {:.2}ms", elapsed.as_secs_f64() * 1000.0);
        result
    }
}

            if result.get("success") == Some(&"true".to_string()) {

                             std::time::SystemTime::now()
                                 .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
                                 .unwrap()
                                 .as_secs()

                result.insert("payment_method".to_string(), strategy.get_name().to_string());

                self.transaction_history.push(result.clone());
                println!("支付成功! 交易ID: {}", result.get("transaction_id").unwrap());

            } else {

            Some(result)

        Box::new(LzmaCompression),
    ];

    let mut results = Vec::new();
    for strategy in compression_strategies {
        println!("\n--- {} ---", strategy.get_name());
        compressor.set_strategy(strategy);
        let result = compressor.compress(&test_text);
        results.push(result);
    }

    println!("\n=== 压缩效果对比 ===");
    let mut best_compression = &results[0];
    let mut best_ratio: f64 = best_compression.get("compression_ratio").unwrap().parse().unwrap();

    for result in &results[1..] {
        let ratio: f64 = result.get("compression_ratio").unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        if ratio < best_ratio {
            best_compression = result;
            best_ratio = ratio;
        }
    }

    println!("最佳压缩方式: {}", best_compression.get("method").unwrap());
    println!("最佳压缩率: {:.2}%", best_ratio * 100.0);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_bubble_sort() {
        let mut strategy = BubbleSortStrategy::default();
        let data = vec![3, 1, 4, 1, 5];

    }

    #[test]

    #[test]

    #[test]

        let result = credit_card.pay(100.0);
        assert_eq!(result.get("success"), Some(&"true".to_string()));

    #[test]

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 组合模式是一种结构型设计模式，它可以将对象组合成树形结构来表示"部分-整体"的层次结构。组合模式使得用户对单个对象和组合对象的使用具有一致性。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 需要表示对象的部分-整体层次结构
  • 希望用户忽略组合对象与单个对象的不同，统一地使用组合结构中的所有对象
  • 文件系统、GUI组件树、公司组织架构、菜单系统

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 高层模块调用简单，节点自由增加
  • 符合开闭原则，对扩展开放，对修改关闭
  • 叶节点和树枝节点实现相同的接口，所以它们之间没有差别

缺点：

  • 树叶和树枝的声明都是实现类，而不是接口，违反了依赖倒置原则
  • 设计较复杂，客户端需要花更多时间理清类之间的层次关系
