use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fmt;

// 错误类型定义
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum InterpreterError {
    UndefinedVariable(String),
    InvalidOperand(String),
    DivisionByZero,
    TypeMismatch,
    UnsupportedOperator(String),
}

impl fmt::Display for InterpreterError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            InterpreterError::UndefinedVariable(var) => write!(f, "未定义的变量: {}", var),
            InterpreterError::InvalidOperand(op) => write!(f, "无效的操作数: {}", op),
            InterpreterError::DivisionByZero => write!(f, "除零错误"),
            InterpreterError::TypeMismatch => write!(f, "类型不匹配"),
            InterpreterError::UnsupportedOperator(op) => write!(f, "不支持的操作符: {}", op),
        }
    }
}

// 表达式值类型
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum Value {
    Number(f64),
    Boolean(bool),
}

impl Value {
    pub fn as_number(&self) -> Result<f64, InterpreterError> {
        match self {
            Value::Number(n) => Ok(*n),
            _ => Err(InterpreterError::TypeMismatch),
        }
    }

    pub fn as_boolean(&self) -> Result<bool, InterpreterError> {
        match self {
            Value::Boolean(b) => Ok(*b),
            _ => Err(InterpreterError::TypeMismatch),
        }
    }
}

// 上下文类型
pub type Context = HashMap<String, Value>;

// 抽象表达式trait
pub trait Expression {
    fn interpret(&self, context: &Context) -> Result<Value, InterpreterError>;
}

// 数字表达式
pub struct NumberExpression {
    value: f64,
}

impl NumberExpression {
    pub fn new(value: f64) -> Self {
        NumberExpression { value }
    }
}

impl Expression for NumberExpression {
    fn interpret(&self, _context: &Context) -> Result<Value, InterpreterError> {
        Ok(Value::Number(self.value))
    }
}

// 变量表达式
pub struct VariableExpression {
    name: String,
}

impl VariableExpression {
    pub fn new(name: String) -> Self {
        VariableExpression { name }
    }
}

impl Expression for VariableExpression {
    fn interpret(&self, context: &Context) -> Result<Value, InterpreterError> {
        context.get(&self.name)
            .cloned()
            .ok_or_else(|| InterpreterError::UndefinedVariable(self.name.clone()))
    }
}

// 二元表达式
pub struct BinaryExpression {
    left: Box<dyn Expression>,
    right: Box<dyn Expression>,
    operator: BinaryOperator,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum BinaryOperator {
    Add,
    Subtract,
    Multiply,
    Divide,
}

impl BinaryExpression {
    pub fn new(left: Box<dyn Expression>, right: Box<dyn Expression>, operator: BinaryOperator) -> Self {
        BinaryExpression { left, right, operator }
    }
}

impl Expression for BinaryExpression {
    fn interpret(&self, context: &Context) -> Result<Value, InterpreterError> {
        let left_value = self.left.interpret(context)?.as_number()?;
        let right_value = self.right.interpret(context)?.as_number()?;

        let result = match self.operator {
            BinaryOperator::Add => left_value + right_value,
            BinaryOperator::Subtract => left_value - right_value,
            BinaryOperator::Multiply => left_value * right_value,
            BinaryOperator::Divide => {
                if right_value == 0.0 {
                    return Err(InterpreterError::DivisionByZero);
                }
                left_value / right_value
            }
        };

        Ok(Value::Number(result))
    }
}

// 具体的运算表达式构造函数
pub fn add_expression(left: Box<dyn Expression>, right: Box<dyn Expression>) -> BinaryExpression {
    BinaryExpression::new(left, right, BinaryOperator::Add)
}

pub fn subtract_expression(left: Box<dyn Expression>, right: Box<dyn Expression>) -> BinaryExpression {
    BinaryExpression::new(left, right, BinaryOperator::Subtract)
}

pub fn multiply_expression(left: Box<dyn Expression>, right: Box<dyn Expression>) -> BinaryExpression {
    BinaryExpression::new(left, right, BinaryOperator::Multiply)
}

pub fn divide_expression(left: Box<dyn Expression>, right: Box<dyn Expression>) -> BinaryExpression {
    BinaryExpression::new(left, right, BinaryOperator::Divide)
}

// 数学表达式解析器
pub struct MathExpressionParser;

impl MathExpressionParser {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        MathExpressionParser
    }

    pub fn parse(&self, expression: &str) -> Result<Box<dyn Expression>, InterpreterError> {
        let expression = expression.replace(" ", "");

        // 简单的表达式解析（仅支持二元运算）
        let operators = vec!["+", "-", "*", "/"];

        for op in operators {
            if let Some(pos) = expression.find(op) {
                let left_str = &expression[..pos];
                let right_str = &expression[pos + 1..];

                let left = self.parse_operand(left_str)?;
                let right = self.parse_operand(right_str)?;

                return match op {
                    "+" => Ok(Box::new(add_expression(left, right))),
                    "-" => Ok(Box::new(subtract_expression(left, right))),
                    "*" => Ok(Box::new(multiply_expression(left, right))),
                    "/" => Ok(Box::new(divide_expression(left, right))),
                    _ => Err(InterpreterError::UnsupportedOperator(op.to_string())),
                };
            }
        }

        // 如果没有运算符，直接解析操作数
        self.parse_operand(&expression)
    }

    fn parse_operand(&self, operand: &str) -> Result<Box<dyn Expression>, InterpreterError> {
        let operand = operand.trim();

        // 尝试解析为数字
        if let Ok(number) = operand.parse::<f64>() {
            return Ok(Box::new(NumberExpression::new(number)));
        }

        // 如果不是数字，则作为变量处理
        if operand.chars().all(|c| c.is_alphabetic()) {
            return Ok(Box::new(VariableExpression::new(operand.to_string())));
        }

        Err(InterpreterError::InvalidOperand(operand.to_string()))
    }
}

// 布尔表达式
pub trait BooleanExpression {
    fn interpret_bool(&self, context: &Context) -> Result<bool, InterpreterError>;
}

pub struct TrueExpression;

impl BooleanExpression for TrueExpression {
    fn interpret_bool(&self, _context: &Context) -> Result<bool, InterpreterError> {
        Ok(true)
    }
}

pub struct FalseExpression;

impl BooleanExpression for FalseExpression {
    fn interpret_bool(&self, _context: &Context) -> Result<bool, InterpreterError> {
        Ok(false)
    }
}

pub struct AndExpression {
    left: Box<dyn BooleanExpression>,
    right: Box<dyn BooleanExpression>,
}

impl AndExpression {
    pub fn new(left: Box<dyn BooleanExpression>, right: Box<dyn BooleanExpression>) -> Self {
        AndExpression { left, right }
    }
}

impl BooleanExpression for AndExpression {
    fn interpret_bool(&self, context: &Context) -> Result<bool, InterpreterError> {
        let left_result = self.left.interpret_bool(context)?;
        let right_result = self.right.interpret_bool(context)?;
        Ok(left_result && right_result)
    }
}

pub struct OrExpression {
    left: Box<dyn BooleanExpression>,
    right: Box<dyn BooleanExpression>,
}

impl OrExpression {
    pub fn new(left: Box<dyn BooleanExpression>, right: Box<dyn BooleanExpression>) -> Self {
        OrExpression { left, right }
    }
}

impl BooleanExpression for OrExpression {
    fn interpret_bool(&self, context: &Context) -> Result<bool, InterpreterError> {
        let left_result = self.left.interpret_bool(context)?;
        let right_result = self.right.interpret_bool(context)?;
        Ok(left_result || right_result)
    }
}

pub struct NotExpression {
    expression: Box<dyn BooleanExpression>,
}

impl NotExpression {
    pub fn new(expression: Box<dyn BooleanExpression>) -> Self {
        NotExpression { expression }
    }
}

impl BooleanExpression for NotExpression {
    fn interpret_bool(&self, context: &Context) -> Result<bool, InterpreterError> {
        let result = self.expression.interpret_bool(context)?;
        Ok(!result)
    }
}

fn main() {
    println!("=== 数学表达式解释器示例 ===");

    let parser = MathExpressionParser::new();

    let expressions = vec![
        "10+5",
        "x*2",
        "a+b",
        "100/4",
    ];

    let mut context = Context::new();
    context.insert("x".to_string(), Value::Number(15.0));
    context.insert("a".to_string(), Value::Number(20.0));
    context.insert("b".to_string(), Value::Number(30.0));

    for expr_str in expressions {
        match parser.parse(expr_str) {
            Ok(expression) => {
                match expression.interpret(&context) {
                    Ok(result) => println!("表达式 '{}' = {:?}", expr_str, result),
                    Err(e) => println!("表达式 '{}' 执行错误: {}", expr_str, e),
                }
            }
            Err(e) => println!("表达式 '{}' 解析错误: {}", expr_str, e),
        }
    }

    println!("\n=== 布尔表达式解释器示例 ===");

    // 构建布尔表达式: (True AND False) OR (NOT False)
    let true_expr = Box::new(TrueExpression);
    let false_expr = Box::new(FalseExpression);

    let and_expr = Box::new(AndExpression::new(
        Box::new(TrueExpression),
        Box::new(FalseExpression),
    ));
    let not_expr = Box::new(NotExpression::new(Box::new(FalseExpression)));
    let or_expr = OrExpression::new(and_expr, not_expr);

    match or_expr.interpret_bool(&Context::new()) {
        Ok(result) => println!("(True AND False) OR (NOT False) = {}", result),
        Err(e) => println!("布尔表达式执行错误: {}", e),
    }

    // 更复杂的表达式: NOT (True AND False)
    let complex_expr = NotExpression::new(Box::new(AndExpression::new(
        Box::new(TrueExpression),
        Box::new(FalseExpression),
    )));

    match complex_expr.interpret_bool(&Context::new()) {
        Ok(result) => println!("NOT (True AND False) = {}", result),
        Err(e) => println!("复杂布尔表达式执行错误: {}", e),
    }
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 访问者模式是一种行为型设计模式，它能让你在不改变各元素的类的前提下定义作用于这些元素的新操作。访问者模式将数据结构与数据操作分离，使得操作集合可相对自由地演化。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 对象结构中对象对应的类很少改变，但经常需要在此对象结构上定义新的操作
  • 需要对一个对象结构中的对象进行很多不同的并且不相关的操作
  • 对象结构不能改变但是需要拓展功能
  • 编译器、AST遍历、文件系统操作、报表生成

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 符合单一职责原则
  • 优秀的扩展性
  • 灵活性

缺点：

  • 具体元素对访问者公布细节，违反了迪米特法则
  • 具体元素变更比较困难
  • 违反了依赖倒置原则，依赖了具体类，没有依赖抽象

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Any, Dict
from enum import Enum

# 抽象访问者
class Visitor(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def visit_file(self, file: 'File') -> Any:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def visit_directory(self, directory: 'Directory') -> Any:
        pass

# 抽象元素
class FileSystemElement(ABC):
    def __init__(self, name: str):
        self.name = name

    @abstractmethod
    def accept(self, visitor: Visitor) -> Any:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get_size(self) -> int:
        pass

# 具体元素 - 文件
class File(FileSystemElement):
    def __init__(self, name: str, size: int, file_type: str):
        super().__init__(name)
        self.size = size
        self.file_type = file_type
        self.content = f"Content of {name}"

    def accept(self, visitor: Visitor) -> Any:
        return visitor.visit_file(self)

    def get_size(self) -> int:
        return self.size

    def read_content(self) -> str:
        return self.content

# 具体元素 - 目录
class Directory(FileSystemElement):
    def __init__(self, name: str):
        super().__init__(name)
        self.children: List[FileSystemElement] = []

    def add(self, element: FileSystemElement) -> None:
        self.children.append(element)

    def remove(self, element: FileSystemElement) -> None:
        if element in self.children:
            self.children.remove(element)

    def accept(self, visitor: Visitor) -> Any:
        return visitor.visit_directory(self)

    def get_size(self) -> int:
        total_size = 0
        for child in self.children:
            total_size += child.get_size()
        return total_size

# 具体访问者 - 大小计算器
class SizeCalculatorVisitor(Visitor):
    def __init__(self):
        self.total_size = 0
        self.file_count = 0
        self.directory_count = 0

    def visit_file(self, file: File) -> int:
        self.file_count += 1
        self.total_size += file.get_size()
        print(f"文件: {file.name} ({file.size} bytes)")
        return file.get_size()

    def visit_directory(self, directory: Directory) -> int:
        self.directory_count += 1
        print(f"目录: {directory.name}/")

        dir_size = 0
        for child in directory.children:
            dir_size += child.accept(self)

        return dir_size

    def get_report(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            'total_size': self.total_size,
            'file_count': self.file_count,
            'directory_count': self.directory_count
        }

# 具体访问者 - 搜索访问者
class SearchVisitor(Visitor):
    def __init__(self, search_pattern: str):
        self.search_pattern = search_pattern.lower()
        self.results: List[FileSystemElement] = []

    def visit_file(self, file: File) -> None:
        if self.search_pattern in file.name.lower():
            self.results.append(file)
            print(f"找到文件: {file.name}")

    def visit_directory(self, directory: Directory) -> None:
        if self.search_pattern in directory.name.lower():
            self.results.append(directory)
            print(f"找到目录: {directory.name}/")

        # 继续搜索子元素
        for child in directory.children:
            child.accept(self)

    def get_results(self) -> List[FileSystemElement]:
        return self.results

# 具体访问者 - 备份访问者
class BackupVisitor(Visitor):
    def __init__(self, backup_path: str):
        self.backup_path = backup_path
        self.backed_up_files: List[str] = []

    def visit_file(self, file: File) -> None:
        backup_file_path = f"{self.backup_path}/{file.name}"
        self.backed_up_files.append(backup_file_path)
        print(f"备份文件: {file.name} -> {backup_file_path}")

    def visit_directory(self, directory: Directory) -> None:
        backup_dir_path = f"{self.backup_path}/{directory.name}"
        print(f"创建备份目录: {backup_dir_path}")

        # 备份所有子元素
        for child in directory.children:
            child.accept(self)

    def get_backup_list(self) -> List[str]:
        return self.backed_up_files

# 具体访问者 - 类型统计访问者
class TypeStatisticsVisitor(Visitor):
    def __init__(self):
        self.file_types: Dict[str, int] = {}
        self.file_type_sizes: Dict[str, int] = {}

    def visit_file(self, file: File) -> None:
        file_type = file.file_type

        # 统计文件类型数量
        self.file_types[file_type] = self.file_types.get(file_type, 0) + 1

        # 统计文件类型大小
        self.file_type_sizes[file_type] = self.file_type_sizes.get(file_type, 0) + file.size

    def visit_directory(self, directory: Directory) -> None:
        # 遍历所有子元素
        for child in directory.children:
            child.accept(self)

    def get_statistics(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, int]]:
        return {
            'file_counts': self.file_types,
            'file_sizes': self.file_type_sizes
        }

# 表达式访问者示例
class Expression(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def accept(self, visitor: 'ExpressionVisitor') -> Any:
        pass

class NumberExpression(Expression):
    def __init__(self, value: float):
        self.value = value

    def accept(self, visitor: 'ExpressionVisitor') -> Any:
        return visitor.visit_number(self)

class AddExpression(Expression):
    def __init__(self, left: Expression, right: Expression):
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

    def accept(self, visitor: 'ExpressionVisitor') -> Any:
        return visitor.visit_add(self)

class MultiplyExpression(Expression):
    def __init__(self, left: Expression, right: Expression):
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

    def accept(self, visitor: 'ExpressionVisitor') -> Any:
        return visitor.visit_multiply(self)

# 表达式访问者接口
class ExpressionVisitor(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def visit_number(self, expr: NumberExpression) -> Any:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def visit_add(self, expr: AddExpression) -> Any:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def visit_multiply(self, expr: MultiplyExpression) -> Any:
        pass

# 计算访问者
class CalculatorVisitor(ExpressionVisitor):
    def visit_number(self, expr: NumberExpression) -> float:
        return expr.value

    def visit_add(self, expr: AddExpression) -> float:
        left_value = expr.left.accept(self)
        right_value = expr.right.accept(self)
        return left_value + right_value

    def visit_multiply(self, expr: MultiplyExpression) -> float:
        left_value = expr.left.accept(self)
        right_value = expr.right.accept(self)
        return left_value * right_value

# 打印访问者
class PrintVisitor(ExpressionVisitor):
    def visit_number(self, expr: NumberExpression) -> str:
        return str(expr.value)

    def visit_add(self, expr: AddExpression) -> str:
        left_str = expr.left.accept(self)
        right_str = expr.right.accept(self)
        return f"({left_str} + {right_str})"

    def visit_multiply(self, expr: MultiplyExpression) -> str:
        left_str = expr.left.accept(self)
        right_str = expr.right.accept(self)
        return f"({left_str} * {right_str})"

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== 文件系统访问者模式示例 ===")

    # 构建文件系统结构
    root = Directory("root")

    # 创建文件
    file1 = File("document.txt", 1024, "txt")
    file2 = File("image.jpg", 2048, "jpg")
    file3 = File("script.py", 512, "py")
    file4 = File("data.json", 256, "json")

    # 创建子目录
    docs_dir = Directory("documents")
    images_dir = Directory("images")
    scripts_dir = Directory("scripts")

    # 构建目录结构
    docs_dir.add(file1)
    docs_dir.add(file4)
    images_dir.add(file2)
    scripts_dir.add(file3)

    root.add(docs_dir)
    root.add(images_dir)
    root.add(scripts_dir)

    print("\n--- 大小计算访问者 ---")
    size_visitor = SizeCalculatorVisitor()
    total_size = root.accept(size_visitor)

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "strings"
)

// 访问者接口
type Visitor interface {
    VisitFile(file *File) interface{}
    VisitDirectory(directory *Directory) interface{}
}

// 元素接口
type FileSystemElement interface {
    Accept(visitor Visitor) interface{}
    GetName() string
    GetSize() int
}

// 具体元素 - 文件
type File struct {
    name     string
    size     int
    fileType string
    content  string
}

func NewFile(name string, size int, fileType string) *File {
    return &File{
        name:     name,
        size:     size,
        fileType: fileType,
        content:  fmt.Sprintf("Content of %s", name),
    }
}

func (f *File) Accept(visitor Visitor) interface{} {
    return visitor.VisitFile(f)
}

func (f *File) GetName() string {
    return f.name
}

func (f *File) GetSize() int {
    return f.size
}

func (f *File) GetFileType() string {
    return f.fileType
}

func (f *File) ReadContent() string {
    return f.content
}

// 具体元素 - 目录
type Directory struct {
    name     string
    children []FileSystemElement
}

func NewDirectory(name string) *Directory {
    return &Directory{
        name:     name,
        children: make([]FileSystemElement, 0),
    }
}

func (d *Directory) Add(element FileSystemElement) {
    d.children = append(d.children, element)
}

func (d *Directory) Remove(element FileSystemElement) {
    for i, child := range d.children {
        if child == element {
            d.children = append(d.children[:i], d.children[i+1:]...)
            break
        }
    }
}

func (d *Directory) Accept(visitor Visitor) interface{} {
    return visitor.VisitDirectory(d)
}

func (d *Directory) GetName() string {
    return d.name
}

func (d *Directory) GetSize() int {
    totalSize := 0
    for _, child := range d.children {
        totalSize += child.GetSize()
    }
    return totalSize
}

func (d *Directory) GetChildren() []FileSystemElement {
    return d.children
}

// 具体访问者 - 大小计算器
type SizeCalculatorVisitor struct {
    totalSize      int
    fileCount      int
    directoryCount int
}

func NewSizeCalculatorVisitor() *SizeCalculatorVisitor {
    return &SizeCalculatorVisitor{}
}

func (v *SizeCalculatorVisitor) VisitFile(file *File) interface{} {
    v.fileCount++
    v.totalSize += file.GetSize()
    fmt.Printf("文件: %s (%d bytes)\n", file.GetName(), file.GetSize())
    return file.GetSize()
}

func (v *SizeCalculatorVisitor) VisitDirectory(directory *Directory) interface{} {
    v.directoryCount++
    fmt.Printf("目录: %s/\n", directory.GetName())

    dirSize := 0
    for _, child := range directory.GetChildren() {
        size := child.Accept(v)
        if s, ok := size.(int); ok {
            dirSize += s
        }
    }

    return dirSize
}

func (v *SizeCalculatorVisitor) GetReport() map[string]int {
    return map[string]int{
        "total_size":      v.totalSize,
        "file_count":      v.fileCount,
        "directory_count": v.directoryCount,
    }
}

// 具体访问者 - 搜索访问者
type SearchVisitor struct {
    searchPattern string
    results       []FileSystemElement
}

func NewSearchVisitor(pattern string) *SearchVisitor {
    return &SearchVisitor{
        searchPattern: strings.ToLower(pattern),
        results:       make([]FileSystemElement, 0),
    }
}

func (v *SearchVisitor) VisitFile(file *File) interface{} {
    if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(file.GetName()), v.searchPattern) {
        v.results = append(v.results, file)
        fmt.Printf("找到文件: %s\n", file.GetName())
    }
    return nil
}

func (v *SearchVisitor) VisitDirectory(directory *Directory) interface{} {
    if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(directory.GetName()), v.searchPattern) {
        v.results = append(v.results, directory)
        fmt.Printf("找到目录: %s/\n", directory.GetName())
    }

    // 继续搜索子元素
    for _, child := range directory.GetChildren() {
        child.Accept(v)
    }

    return nil
}

func (v *SearchVisitor) GetResults() []FileSystemElement {
    return v.results
}

// 具体访问者 - 备份访问者
type BackupVisitor struct {
    backupPath    string
    backedUpFiles []string
}

func NewBackupVisitor(backupPath string) *BackupVisitor {
    return &BackupVisitor{
        backupPath:    backupPath,
        backedUpFiles: make([]string, 0),
    }
}

func (v *BackupVisitor) VisitFile(file *File) interface{} {
    backupFilePath := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", v.backupPath, file.GetName())
    v.backedUpFiles = append(v.backedUpFiles, backupFilePath)
    fmt.Printf("备份文件: %s -> %s\n", file.GetName(), backupFilePath)
    return nil
}

func (v *BackupVisitor) VisitDirectory(directory *Directory) interface{} {
    backupDirPath := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", v.backupPath, directory.GetName())
    fmt.Printf("创建备份目录: %s\n", backupDirPath)

    // 备份所有子元素
    for _, child := range directory.GetChildren() {
        child.Accept(v)
    }

    return nil
}

func (v *BackupVisitor) GetBackupList() []string {
    return v.backedUpFiles
}

// 具体访问者 - 类型统计访问者
type TypeStatisticsVisitor struct {
    fileTypes     map[string]int
    fileTypeSizes map[string]int
}

func NewTypeStatisticsVisitor() *TypeStatisticsVisitor {
    return &TypeStatisticsVisitor{
        fileTypes:     make(map[string]int),
        fileTypeSizes: make(map[string]int),
    }
}

func (v *TypeStatisticsVisitor) VisitFile(file *File) interface{} {
    fileType := file.GetFileType()

    // 统计文件类型数量
    v.fileTypes[fileType]++

    // 统计文件类型大小
    v.fileTypeSizes[fileType] += file.GetSize()

    return nil
}

func (v *TypeStatisticsVisitor) VisitDirectory(directory *Directory) interface{} {
    // 遍历所有子元素
    for _, child := range directory.GetChildren() {
        child.Accept(v)
    }
    return nil
}

func (v *TypeStatisticsVisitor) GetStatistics() map[string]map[string]int {
    return map[string]map[string]int{
        "file_counts": v.fileTypes,
        "file_sizes":  v.fileTypeSizes,
    }
}

// 表达式访问者示例
type Expression interface {
    Accept(visitor ExpressionVisitor) interface{}
}

type NumberExpression struct {
    value float64
}

func NewNumberExpression(value float64) *NumberExpression {
    return &NumberExpression{value: value}
}

func (e *NumberExpression) Accept(visitor ExpressionVisitor) interface{} {
    return visitor.VisitNumber(e)
}

func (e *NumberExpression) GetValue() float64 {
    return e.value
}

type AddExpression struct {
    left  Expression
    right Expression
}

func NewAddExpression(left, right Expression) *AddExpression {
    return &AddExpression{left: left, right: right}
}

func (e *AddExpression) Accept(visitor ExpressionVisitor) interface{} {
    return visitor.VisitAdd(e)
}

func (e *AddExpression) GetLeft() Expression {
    return e.left
}

func (e *AddExpression) GetRight() Expression {
    return e.right
}

type MultiplyExpression struct {
    left  Expression
    right Expression
}

func NewMultiplyExpression(left, right Expression) *MultiplyExpression {
    return &MultiplyExpression{left: left, right: right}
}

func (e *MultiplyExpression) Accept(visitor ExpressionVisitor) interface{} {
    return visitor.VisitMultiply(e)
}

func (e *MultiplyExpression) GetLeft() Expression {
    return e.left
}

func (e *MultiplyExpression) GetRight() Expression {
    return e.right
}

// 表达式访问者接口
type ExpressionVisitor interface {
    VisitNumber(expr *NumberExpression) interface{}
    VisitAdd(expr *AddExpression) interface{}
    VisitMultiply(expr *MultiplyExpression) interface{}
}

// 计算访问者
type CalculatorVisitor struct{}

func NewCalculatorVisitor() *CalculatorVisitor {
    return &CalculatorVisitor{}
}

func (v *CalculatorVisitor) VisitNumber(expr *NumberExpression) interface{} {
    return expr.GetValue()
}

func (v *CalculatorVisitor) VisitAdd(expr *AddExpression) interface{} {
    leftValue := expr.GetLeft().Accept(v).(float64)
    rightValue := expr.GetRight().Accept(v).(float64)
    return leftValue + rightValue
}

func (v *CalculatorVisitor) VisitMultiply(expr *MultiplyExpression) interface{} {
    leftValue := expr.GetLeft().Accept(v).(float64)
    rightValue := expr.GetRight().Accept(v).(float64)
    return leftValue * rightValue
}

// 打印访问者
type PrintVisitor struct{}

func NewPrintVisitor() *PrintVisitor {
    return &PrintVisitor{}
}

func (v *PrintVisitor) VisitNumber(expr *NumberExpression) interface{} {
    return fmt.Sprintf("%.1f", expr.GetValue())
}

func (v *PrintVisitor) VisitAdd(expr *AddExpression) interface{} {
    leftStr := expr.GetLeft().Accept(v).(string)
    rightStr := expr.GetRight().Accept(v).(string)
    return fmt.Sprintf("(%s + %s)", leftStr, rightStr)
}

func (v *PrintVisitor) VisitMultiply(expr *MultiplyExpression) interface{} {
    leftStr := expr.GetLeft().Accept(v).(string)
    rightStr := expr.GetRight().Accept(v).(string)
    return fmt.Sprintf("(%s * %s)", leftStr, rightStr)
}

// 使用示例
func main() {
    fmt.Println("=== 文件系统访问者模式示例 ===")

    // 构建文件系统结构
    root := NewDirectory("root")

    // 创建文件
    file1 := NewFile("document.txt", 1024, "txt")
    file2 := NewFile("image.jpg", 2048, "jpg")
    file3 := NewFile("script.py", 512, "py")
    file4 := NewFile("data.json", 256, "json")

    // 创建子目录
    docsDir := NewDirectory("documents")
    imagesDir := NewDirectory("images")
    scriptsDir := NewDirectory("scripts")

    // 构建目录结构
    docsDir.Add(file1)
    docsDir.Add(file4)
    imagesDir.Add(file2)
    scriptsDir.Add(file3)

    root.Add(docsDir)
    root.Add(imagesDir)
    root.Add(scriptsDir)

    fmt.Println("\n--- 大小计算访问者 ---")
    sizeVisitor := NewSizeCalculatorVisitor()
    root.Accept(sizeVisitor)
    report := sizeVisitor.GetReport()
    fmt.Printf("总大小: %d bytes\n", report["total_size"])
    fmt.Printf("文件数量: %d\n", report["file_count"])
    fmt.Printf("目录数量: %d\n", report["directory_count"])

    fmt.Println("\n--- 搜索访问者 ---")
    searchVisitor := NewSearchVisitor("doc")
    root.Accept(searchVisitor)
    results := searchVisitor.GetResults()
    fmt.Printf("搜索结果数量: %d\n", len(results))

    fmt.Println("\n--- 备份访问者 ---")
    backupVisitor := NewBackupVisitor("/backup")
    root.Accept(backupVisitor)
    backupList := backupVisitor.GetBackupList()
    fmt.Printf("备份文件数量: %d\n", len(backupList))

    fmt.Println("\n--- 类型统计访问者 ---")
    statsVisitor := NewTypeStatisticsVisitor()
    root.Accept(statsVisitor)
    statistics := statsVisitor.GetStatistics()
    fmt.Println("文件类型统计:")
    for fileType, count := range statistics["file_counts"] {
        size := statistics["file_sizes"][fileType]
        fmt.Printf("  %s: %d 个文件, 总大小 %d bytes\n", fileType, count, size)
    }

    fmt.Println("\n=== 表达式访问者模式示例 ===")

    // 构建表达式: (3 + 4) * (2 + 5)
    expr := NewMultiplyExpression(
        NewAddExpression(NewNumberExpression(3), NewNumberExpression(4)),
        NewAddExpression(NewNumberExpression(2), NewNumberExpression(5)),
    )

    // 计算表达式
    calculator := NewCalculatorVisitor()
    result := expr.Accept(calculator).(float64)
    fmt.Printf("计算结果: %.1f\n", result)

    // 打印表达式
    printer := NewPrintVisitor()
    expressionStr := expr.Accept(printer).(string)
    fmt.Printf("表达式: %s\n", expressionStr)
}

use std::collections::HashMap;

// 访问者特征
trait Visitor {
    fn visit_file(&mut self, file: &File) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any>;
    fn visit_directory(&mut self, directory: &Directory) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any>;
}

// 元素特征
trait FileSystemElement {
    fn accept(&self, visitor: &mut dyn Visitor) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any>;
    fn get_name(&self) -> &str;
    fn get_size(&self) -> usize;
}

// 具体元素 - 文件
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct File {
    name: String,
    size: usize,
    file_type: String,
    content: String,
}

impl File {
    pub fn new(name: String, size: usize, file_type: String) -> Self {
        let content = format!("Content of {}", name);
        Self {
            name,
            size,
            file_type,
            content,
        }
    }

    pub fn get_file_type(&self) -> &str {
        &self.file_type
    }

    pub fn read_content(&self) -> &str {
        &self.content
    }
}

impl FileSystemElement for File {
    fn accept(&self, visitor: &mut dyn Visitor) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        visitor.visit_file(self)
    }

    fn get_name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.name
    }

    fn get_size(&self) -> usize {
        self.size
    }
}

// 具体元素 - 目录
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Directory {
    name: String,
    children: Vec<Box<dyn FileSystemElement>>,
}

impl Directory {
    pub fn new(name: String) -> Self {
        Self {
            name,
            children: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn add(&mut self, element: Box<dyn FileSystemElement>) {
        self.children.push(element);
    }

    pub fn get_children(&self) -> &Vec<Box<dyn FileSystemElement>> {
        &self.children
    }
}

impl FileSystemElement for Directory {
    fn accept(&self, visitor: &mut dyn Visitor) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        visitor.visit_directory(self)
    }

    fn get_name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.name
    }

    fn get_size(&self) -> usize {
        self.children.iter().map(|child| child.get_size()).sum()
    }
}

// 具体访问者 - 大小计算器
pub struct SizeCalculatorVisitor {
    total_size: usize,
    file_count: usize,
    directory_count: usize,
}

impl SizeCalculatorVisitor {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            total_size: 0,
            file_count: 0,
            directory_count: 0,
        }
    }

    pub fn get_report(&self) -> HashMap<String, usize> {
        let mut report = HashMap::new();
        report.insert("total_size".to_string(), self.total_size);
        report.insert("file_count".to_string(), self.file_count);
        report.insert("directory_count".to_string(), self.directory_count);
        report
    }
}

impl Visitor for SizeCalculatorVisitor {
    fn visit_file(&mut self, file: &File) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        self.file_count += 1;
        self.total_size += file.get_size();
        println!("文件: {} ({} bytes)", file.get_name(), file.get_size());
        Box::new(file.get_size())
    }

    fn visit_directory(&mut self, directory: &Directory) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        self.directory_count += 1;
        println!("目录: {}/", directory.get_name());

        let mut dir_size = 0;
        for child in directory.get_children() {
            let result = child.accept(self);
            if let Some(size) = result.downcast_ref::<usize>() {
                dir_size += size;
            }
        }

        Box::new(dir_size)
    }
}

// 具体访问者 - 搜索访问者
pub struct SearchVisitor {
    search_pattern: String,
    results: Vec<String>,
}

impl SearchVisitor {
    pub fn new(pattern: String) -> Self {
        Self {
            search_pattern: pattern.to_lowercase(),
            results: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn get_results(&self) -> &Vec<String> {
        &self.results
    }
}

impl Visitor for SearchVisitor {
    fn visit_file(&mut self, file: &File) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        if file.get_name().to_lowercase().contains(&self.search_pattern) {
            self.results.push(file.get_name().to_string());
            println!("找到文件: {}", file.get_name());
        }
        Box::new(())
    }

    fn visit_directory(&mut self, directory: &Directory) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        if directory.get_name().to_lowercase().contains(&self.search_pattern) {
            self.results.push(directory.get_name().to_string());
            println!("找到目录: {}/", directory.get_name());
        }

        // 继续搜索子元素
        for child in directory.get_children() {
            child.accept(self);
        }

        Box::new(())
    }
}

// 具体访问者 - 备份访问者
pub struct BackupVisitor {
    backup_path: String,
    backed_up_files: Vec<String>,
}

impl BackupVisitor {
    pub fn new(backup_path: String) -> Self {
        Self {
            backup_path,
            backed_up_files: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn get_backup_list(&self) -> &Vec<String> {
        &self.backed_up_files
    }
}

impl Visitor for BackupVisitor {
    fn visit_file(&mut self, file: &File) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        let backup_file_path = format!("{}/{}", self.backup_path, file.get_name());
        self.backed_up_files.push(backup_file_path.clone());
        println!("备份文件: {} -> {}", file.get_name(), backup_file_path);
        Box::new(())
    }

    fn visit_directory(&mut self, directory: &Directory) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        let backup_dir_path = format!("{}/{}", self.backup_path, directory.get_name());
        println!("创建备份目录: {}", backup_dir_path);

        // 备份所有子元素
        for child in directory.get_children() {
            child.accept(self);
        }

        Box::new(())
    }
}

// 具体访问者 - 类型统计访问者
pub struct TypeStatisticsVisitor {
    file_types: HashMap<String, usize>,
    file_type_sizes: HashMap<String, usize>,
}

impl TypeStatisticsVisitor {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            file_types: HashMap::new(),
            file_type_sizes: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn get_statistics(&self) -> HashMap<String, HashMap<String, usize>> {
        let mut stats = HashMap::new();
        stats.insert("file_counts".to_string(), self.file_types.clone());
        stats.insert("file_sizes".to_string(), self.file_type_sizes.clone());
        stats
    }
}

impl Visitor for TypeStatisticsVisitor {
    fn visit_file(&mut self, file: &File) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        let file_type = file.get_file_type().to_string();

        // 统计文件类型数量
        *self.file_types.entry(file_type.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;

        // 统计文件类型大小
        *self.file_type_sizes.entry(file_type).or_insert(0) += file.get_size();

        Box::new(())
    }

    fn visit_directory(&mut self, directory: &Directory) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        // 遍历所有子元素
        for child in directory.get_children() {
            child.accept(self);
        }
        Box::new(())
    }
}

// 表达式访问者示例
trait Expression {
    fn accept(&self, visitor: &mut dyn ExpressionVisitor) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any>;
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct NumberExpression {
    value: f64,
}

impl NumberExpression {
    pub fn new(value: f64) -> Self {
        Self { value }
    }

    pub fn get_value(&self) -> f64 {
        self.value
    }
}

impl Expression for NumberExpression {
    fn accept(&self, visitor: &mut dyn ExpressionVisitor) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        visitor.visit_number(self)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct AddExpression {
    left: Box<dyn Expression>,
    right: Box<dyn Expression>,
}

impl AddExpression {
    pub fn new(left: Box<dyn Expression>, right: Box<dyn Expression>) -> Self {
        Self { left, right }
    }

    pub fn get_left(&self) -> &dyn Expression {
        &*self.left
    }

    pub fn get_right(&self) -> &dyn Expression {
        &*self.right
    }
}

impl Expression for AddExpression {
    fn accept(&self, visitor: &mut dyn ExpressionVisitor) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        visitor.visit_add(self)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct MultiplyExpression {
    left: Box<dyn Expression>,
    right: Box<dyn Expression>,
}

impl MultiplyExpression {
    pub fn new(left: Box<dyn Expression>, right: Box<dyn Expression>) -> Self {
        Self { left, right }
    }

    pub fn get_left(&self) -> &dyn Expression {
        &*self.left
    }

    pub fn get_right(&self) -> &dyn Expression {
        &*self.right
    }
}

impl Expression for MultiplyExpression {
    fn accept(&self, visitor: &mut dyn ExpressionVisitor) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        visitor.visit_multiply(self)
    }
}

// 表达式访问者特征
trait ExpressionVisitor {
    fn visit_number(&mut self, expr: &NumberExpression) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any>;
    fn visit_add(&mut self, expr: &AddExpression) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any>;
    fn visit_multiply(&mut self, expr: &MultiplyExpression) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any>;
}

// 计算访问者
pub struct CalculatorVisitor;

impl CalculatorVisitor {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl ExpressionVisitor for CalculatorVisitor {
    fn visit_number(&mut self, expr: &NumberExpression) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        Box::new(expr.get_value())
    }

    fn visit_add(&mut self, expr: &AddExpression) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        let left_result = expr.get_left().accept(self);
        let right_result = expr.get_right().accept(self);

        let left_value = *left_result.downcast::<f64>().unwrap();
        let right_value = *right_result.downcast::<f64>().unwrap();

        Box::new(left_value + right_value)
    }

    fn visit_multiply(&mut self, expr: &MultiplyExpression) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        let left_result = expr.get_left().accept(self);
        let right_result = expr.get_right().accept(self);

        let left_value = *left_result.downcast::<f64>().unwrap();
        let right_value = *right_result.downcast::<f64>().unwrap();

        Box::new(left_value * right_value)
    }
}

// 打印访问者
pub struct PrintVisitor;

impl PrintVisitor {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl ExpressionVisitor for PrintVisitor {
    fn visit_number(&mut self, expr: &NumberExpression) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        Box::new(format!("{:.1}", expr.get_value()))
    }

    fn visit_add(&mut self, expr: &AddExpression) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        let left_result = expr.get_left().accept(self);
        let right_result = expr.get_right().accept(self);

        let left_str = left_result.downcast::<String>().unwrap();
        let right_str = right_result.downcast::<String>().unwrap();

        Box::new(format!("({} + {})", left_str, right_str))
    }

    fn visit_multiply(&mut self, expr: &MultiplyExpression) -> Box<dyn std::any::Any> {
        let left_result = expr.get_left().accept(self);
        let right_result = expr.get_right().accept(self);

        let left_str = left_result.downcast::<String>().unwrap();
        let right_str = right_result.downcast::<String>().unwrap();

        Box::new(format!("({} * {})", left_str, right_str))
    }
}

// 使用示例
fn main() {
    println!("=== 文件系统访问者模式示例 ===");

    // 构建文件系统结构
    let mut root = Directory::new("root".to_string());

    // 创建文件
    let file1 = Box::new(File::new("document.txt".to_string(), 1024, "txt".to_string()));
    let file2 = Box::new(File::new("image.jpg".to_string(), 2048, "jpg".to_string()));
    let file3 = Box::new(File::new("script.py".to_string(), 512, "py".to_string()));
    let file4 = Box::new(File::new("data.json".to_string(), 256, "json".to_string()));

    // 创建子目录
    let mut docs_dir = Directory::new("documents".to_string());
    let mut images_dir = Directory::new("images".to_string());
    let mut scripts_dir = Directory::new("scripts".to_string());

    // 构建目录结构
    docs_dir.add(file1);
    docs_dir.add(file4);
    images_dir.add(file2);
    scripts_dir.add(file3);

    root.add(Box::new(docs_dir));
    root.add(Box::new(images_dir));
    root.add(Box::new(scripts_dir));

    println!("\n--- 大小计算访问者 ---");
    let mut size_visitor = SizeCalculatorVisitor::new();
    root.accept(&mut size_visitor);
    let report = size_visitor.get_report();
    println!("总大小: {} bytes", report["total_size"]);
    println!("文件数量: {}", report["file_count"]);
    println!("目录数量: {}", report["directory_count"]);

    println!("\n--- 搜索访问者 ---");
    let mut search_visitor = SearchVisitor::new("doc".to_string());
    root.accept(&mut search_visitor);
    let results = search_visitor.get_results();
    println!("搜索结果数量: {}", results.len());

    println!("\n--- 备份访问者 ---");
    let mut backup_visitor = BackupVisitor::new("/backup".to_string());
    root.accept(&mut backup_visitor);
    let backup_list = backup_visitor.get_backup_list();
    println!("备份文件数量: {}", backup_list.len());

    println!("\n--- 类型统计访问者 ---");
    let mut stats_visitor = TypeStatisticsVisitor::new();
    root.accept(&mut stats_visitor);
    let statistics = stats_visitor.get_statistics();
    println!("文件类型统计:");
    if let Some(file_counts) = statistics.get("file_counts") {
        if let Some(file_sizes) = statistics.get("file_sizes") {
            for (file_type, count) in file_counts {
                let size = file_sizes.get(file_type).unwrap_or(&0);
                println!("  {}: {} 个文件, 总大小 {} bytes", file_type, count, size);
            }
        }
    }

    println!("\n=== 表达式访问者模式示例 ===");

    // 构建表达式: (3 + 4) * (2 + 5)
    let expr = MultiplyExpression::new(
        Box::new(AddExpression::new(
            Box::new(NumberExpression::new(3.0)),
            Box::new(NumberExpression::new(4.0)),
        )),
        Box::new(AddExpression::new(
            Box::new(NumberExpression::new(2.0)),
            Box::new(NumberExpression::new(5.0)),
        )),
    );

    // 计算表达式
    let mut calculator = CalculatorVisitor::new();
    let result = expr.accept(&mut calculator);
    let result_value = *result.downcast::<f64>().unwrap();
    println!("计算结果: {:.1}", result_value);

    // 打印表达式
    let mut printer = PrintVisitor::new();
    let expression_str = expr.accept(&mut printer);
    let expression_string = expression_str.downcast::<String>().unwrap();
    println!("表达式: {}", expression_string);
}

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 责任链模式是一种行为型设计模式，它让你能够将请求沿着处理者链进行发送。收到请求后，每个处理者均可对请求进行处理，或将其传递给链上的下个处理者。责任链模式避免了请求发送者与接收者之间的耦合关系。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 有多个对象可以处理同一个请求，具体哪个对象处理该请求在运行时刻自动确定
  • 在不明确指定接收者的情况下，向多个对象中的一个提交一个请求
  • 可动态指定一组对象处理请求
  • Web过滤器链、异常处理、审批流程、日志处理

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 降低耦合度，发送者和接收者解耦
  • 简化了对象，对象不需要知道链的结构
  • 增强给对象指派职责的灵活性
  • 增加新的请求处理类很方便

缺点：

  • 不能保证请求一定被接收
  • 系统性能将受到一定影响，而且在进行代码调试时不太方便
  • 可能会造成循环调用

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from enum import Enum
from typing import Optional, Any
import logging

# 请求类型枚举
class RequestType(Enum):
    INFO = "INFO"
    DEBUG = "DEBUG"
    WARNING = "WARNING"
    ERROR = "ERROR"
    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"

# 请求类
class LogRequest:
    def __init__(self, request_type: RequestType, message: str, data: Any = None):
        self.request_type = request_type
        self.message = message
        self.data = data
        self.handled = False

    def __str__(self):
        return f"[{self.request_type.value}] {self.message}"

# 抽象处理者
class LogHandler(ABC):
    def __init__(self):
        self._next_handler: Optional[LogHandler] = None

    def set_next(self, handler: 'LogHandler') -> 'LogHandler':
        """设置下一个处理者"""
        self._next_handler = handler
        return handler

    def handle(self, request: LogRequest) -> None:
        """处理请求的模板方法"""
        if self.can_handle(request):
            self.process_request(request)
            request.handled = True
        elif self._next_handler:
            self._next_handler.handle(request)

    @abstractmethod
    def can_handle(self, request: LogRequest) -> bool:
        """判断是否能处理该请求"""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def process_request(self, request: LogRequest) -> None:
        """处理请求的具体实现"""
        pass

# 具体处理者 - 控制台日志处理器
class ConsoleLogHandler(LogHandler):
    def can_handle(self, request: LogRequest) -> bool:
        return request.request_type in [RequestType.INFO, RequestType.DEBUG]

    def process_request(self, request: LogRequest) -> None:
        print(f"[CONSOLE] {request}")
        if request.data:
            print(f"[CONSOLE] Additional data: {request.data}")

# 具体处理者 - 文件日志处理器
class FileLogHandler(LogHandler):
    def __init__(self, filename: str = "app.log"):
        super().__init__()
        self.filename = filename

    def can_handle(self, request: LogRequest) -> bool:
        return request.request_type in [RequestType.WARNING, RequestType.ERROR]

    def process_request(self, request: LogRequest) -> None:
        print(f"[FILE:{self.filename}] {request}")
        # 实际实现中会写入文件
        with open(self.filename, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(f"{request}\n")
            if request.data:
                f.write(f"Data: {request.data}\n")

# 具体处理者 - 邮件通知处理器
class EmailNotificationHandler(LogHandler):
    def __init__(self, email_address: str):
        super().__init__()
        self.email_address = email_address

    def can_handle(self, request: LogRequest) -> bool:
        return request.request_type == RequestType.CRITICAL

    def process_request(self, request: LogRequest) -> None:
        print(f"[EMAIL:{self.email_address}] CRITICAL ALERT: {request}")
        # 实际实现中会发送邮件
        self._send_email(request)

    def _send_email(self, request: LogRequest):
        print(f"Sending email to {self.email_address}")
        print(f"Subject: Critical System Alert")
        print(f"Body: {request.message}")

# 更复杂的审批流程示例
class ApprovalRequest:
    def __init__(self, amount: float, description: str, requester: str):
        self.amount = amount
        self.description = description
        self.requester = requester
        self.approved = False
        self.approver = None

    def __str__(self):
        return f"Request: ${self.amount:.2f} for {self.description} by {self.requester}"

class ApprovalHandler(ABC):
    def __init__(self, name: str):
        self.name = name
        self._next_handler: Optional[ApprovalHandler] = None

    def set_next(self, handler: 'ApprovalHandler') -> 'ApprovalHandler':
        self._next_handler = handler
        return handler

    def handle(self, request: ApprovalRequest) -> None:
        if self.can_approve(request):
            self.approve(request)
        elif self._next_handler:
            print(f"{self.name} cannot approve ${request.amount:.2f}, forwarding to next level")
            self._next_handler.handle(request)
        else:
            print(f"Request for ${request.amount:.2f} cannot be approved by anyone in the chain")

    @abstractmethod
    def can_approve(self, request: ApprovalRequest) -> bool:
        pass

    def approve(self, request: ApprovalRequest) -> None:
        request.approved = True
        request.approver = self.name
        print(f"✓ {self.name} approved: {request}")

# 具体审批者
class TeamLeaderHandler(ApprovalHandler):
    def can_approve(self, request: ApprovalRequest) -> bool:
        return request.amount <= 1000

class ManagerHandler(ApprovalHandler):
    def can_approve(self, request: ApprovalRequest) -> bool:
        return request.amount <= 5000

class DirectorHandler(ApprovalHandler):
    def can_approve(self, request: ApprovalRequest) -> bool:
        return request.amount <= 20000

class CEOHandler(ApprovalHandler):
    def can_approve(self, request: ApprovalRequest) -> bool:
        return request.amount <= 100000

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== 日志处理责任链示例 ===")

    # 创建处理者链
    console_handler = ConsoleLogHandler()
    file_handler = FileLogHandler("system.log")
    email_handler = EmailNotificationHandler("admin@company.com")

    # 构建责任链
    console_handler.set_next(file_handler).set_next(email_handler)

    # 创建不同级别的日志请求
    requests = [
        LogRequest(RequestType.INFO, "Application started", {"version": "1.0.0"}),
        LogRequest(RequestType.DEBUG, "Processing user request", {"user_id": 12345}),
        LogRequest(RequestType.WARNING, "High memory usage detected", {"memory": "85%"}),
        LogRequest(RequestType.ERROR, "Database connection failed", {"db": "primary"}),
        LogRequest(RequestType.CRITICAL, "System is down!", {"downtime": "5 minutes"}),
    ]

    # 处理请求
    for request in requests:
        print(f"\nProcessing: {request}")
        console_handler.handle(request)
        print(f"Handled: {request.handled}")

    print("\n=== 审批流程责任链示例 ===")

    # 创建审批链
    team_leader = TeamLeaderHandler("Team Leader")
    manager = ManagerHandler("Manager")
    director = DirectorHandler("Director")
    ceo = CEOHandler("CEO")

    # 构建审批链
    team_leader.set_next(manager).set_next(director).set_next(ceo)

    # 创建不同金额的审批请求
    approval_requests = [
        ApprovalRequest(500, "Office supplies", "Alice"),
        ApprovalRequest(2500, "New laptop", "Bob"),
        ApprovalRequest(15000, "Team building event", "Charlie"),
        ApprovalRequest(50000, "New server infrastructure", "David"),
        ApprovalRequest(150000, "Office renovation", "Eve"),  # 超出所有人权限
    ]

    # 处理审批请求
    for request in approval_requests:
        print(f"\nProcessing: {request}")
        team_leader.handle(request)
        if request.approved:
            print(f"Final result: Approved by {request.approver}")
        else:
            print("Final result: Request denied")

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "os"
)

// RequestType 请求类型
type RequestType int

const (
    INFO RequestType = iota
    DEBUG
    WARNING
    ERROR
    CRITICAL
)

func (r RequestType) String() string {
    switch r {
    case INFO:
        return "INFO"
    case DEBUG:
        return "DEBUG"
    case WARNING:
        return "WARNING"
    case ERROR:
        return "ERROR"
    case CRITICAL:
        return "CRITICAL"
    default:
        return "UNKNOWN"
    }
}

// LogRequest 日志请求
type LogRequest struct {
    RequestType RequestType
    Message     string
    Data        map[string]interface{}
    Handled     bool
}

func NewLogRequest(requestType RequestType, message string, data map[string]interface{}) *LogRequest {
    return &LogRequest{
        RequestType: requestType,
        Message:     message,
        Data:        data,
        Handled:     false,
    }
}

func (l *LogRequest) String() string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("[%s] %s", l.RequestType, l.Message)
}

// LogHandler 抽象日志处理器接口
type LogHandler interface {
    SetNext(handler LogHandler) LogHandler
    Handle(request *LogRequest)
    CanHandle(request *LogRequest) bool
    ProcessRequest(request *LogRequest)
}

// BaseLogHandler 基础日志处理器
type BaseLogHandler struct {
    nextHandler LogHandler
}

func (b *BaseLogHandler) SetNext(handler LogHandler) LogHandler {
    b.nextHandler = handler
    return handler
}

func (b *BaseLogHandler) Handle(request *LogRequest) {
    if b.CanHandle(request) {
        b.ProcessRequest(request)
        request.Handled = true
    } else if b.nextHandler != nil {
        b.nextHandler.Handle(request)
    }
}

// ConsoleLogHandler 控制台日志处理器
type ConsoleLogHandler struct {
    BaseLogHandler
}

func NewConsoleLogHandler() *ConsoleLogHandler {
    return &ConsoleLogHandler{}
}

func (c *ConsoleLogHandler) CanHandle(request *LogRequest) bool {
    return request.RequestType == INFO || request.RequestType == DEBUG
}

func (c *ConsoleLogHandler) ProcessRequest(request *LogRequest) {
    fmt.Printf("[CONSOLE] %s\n", request)
    if request.Data != nil {
        fmt.Printf("[CONSOLE] Additional data: %v\n", request.Data)
    }
}

// FileLogHandler 文件日志处理器
type FileLogHandler struct {
    BaseLogHandler
    filename string
}

func NewFileLogHandler(filename string) *FileLogHandler {
    return &FileLogHandler{filename: filename}
}

func (f *FileLogHandler) CanHandle(request *LogRequest) bool {
    return request.RequestType == WARNING || request.RequestType == ERROR
}

func (f *FileLogHandler) ProcessRequest(request *LogRequest) {
    fmt.Printf("[FILE:%s] %s\n", f.filename, request)

    // 实际实现中会写入文件
    file, err := os.OpenFile(f.filename, os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY, 0644)
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Printf("Error opening file: %v\n", err)
        return
    }
    defer file.Close()

    file.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s\n", request))
    if request.Data != nil {
        file.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Data: %v\n", request.Data))
    }
}

// EmailNotificationHandler 邮件通知处理器
type EmailNotificationHandler struct {
    BaseLogHandler
    emailAddress string
}

func NewEmailNotificationHandler(emailAddress string) *EmailNotificationHandler {
    return &EmailNotificationHandler{emailAddress: emailAddress}
}

func (e *EmailNotificationHandler) CanHandle(request *LogRequest) bool {
    return request.RequestType == CRITICAL
}

func (e *EmailNotificationHandler) ProcessRequest(request *LogRequest) {
    fmt.Printf("[EMAIL:%s] CRITICAL ALERT: %s\n", e.emailAddress, request)
    e.sendEmail(request)
}

func (e *EmailNotificationHandler) sendEmail(request *LogRequest) {
    fmt.Printf("Sending email to %s\n", e.emailAddress)
    fmt.Println("Subject: Critical System Alert")
    fmt.Printf("Body: %s\n", request.Message)
}

// ApprovalRequest 审批请求
type ApprovalRequest struct {
    Amount      float64
    Description string
    Requester   string
    Approved    bool
    Approver    string
}

func NewApprovalRequest(amount float64, description, requester string) *ApprovalRequest {
    return &ApprovalRequest{
        Amount:      amount,
        Description: description,
        Requester:   requester,
        Approved:    false,
        Approver:    "",
    }
}

func (a *ApprovalRequest) String() string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("Request: $%.2f for %s by %s", a.Amount, a.Description, a.Requester)
}

// ApprovalHandler 审批处理器接口
type ApprovalHandler interface {
    SetNext(handler ApprovalHandler) ApprovalHandler
    Handle(request *ApprovalRequest)
    CanApprove(request *ApprovalRequest) bool
    Approve(request *ApprovalRequest)
}

// BaseApprovalHandler 基础审批处理器
type BaseApprovalHandler struct {
    name        string
    nextHandler ApprovalHandler
}

func (b *BaseApprovalHandler) SetNext(handler ApprovalHandler) ApprovalHandler {
    b.nextHandler = handler
    return handler
}

func (b *BaseApprovalHandler) Handle(request *ApprovalRequest) {
    if b.CanApprove(request) {
        b.Approve(request)
    } else if b.nextHandler != nil {
        fmt.Printf("%s cannot approve $%.2f, forwarding to next level\n", b.name, request.Amount)
        b.nextHandler.Handle(request)
    } else {
        fmt.Printf("Request for $%.2f cannot be approved by anyone in the chain\n", request.Amount)
    }
}

func (b *BaseApprovalHandler) Approve(request *ApprovalRequest) {
    request.Approved = true
    request.Approver = b.name
    fmt.Printf("✓ %s approved: %s\n", b.name, request)
}

// TeamLeaderHandler 团队领导处理器
type TeamLeaderHandler struct {
    BaseApprovalHandler
}

func NewTeamLeaderHandler(name string) *TeamLeaderHandler {
    return &TeamLeaderHandler{
        BaseApprovalHandler: BaseApprovalHandler{name: name},
    }
}

func (t *TeamLeaderHandler) CanApprove(request *ApprovalRequest) bool {
    return request.Amount <= 1000
}

// ManagerHandler 经理处理器
type ManagerHandler struct {
    BaseApprovalHandler
}

func NewManagerHandler(name string) *ManagerHandler {
    return &ManagerHandler{
        BaseApprovalHandler: BaseApprovalHandler{name: name},
    }
}

func (m *ManagerHandler) CanApprove(request *ApprovalRequest) bool {
    return request.Amount <= 5000
}

// DirectorHandler 总监处理器
type DirectorHandler struct {
    BaseApprovalHandler
}

func NewDirectorHandler(name string) *DirectorHandler {
    return &DirectorHandler{
        BaseApprovalHandler: BaseApprovalHandler{name: name},
    }
}

func (d *DirectorHandler) CanApprove(request *ApprovalRequest) bool {
    return request.Amount <= 20000
}

// CEOHandler CEO处理器
type CEOHandler struct {
    BaseApprovalHandler
}

func NewCEOHandler(name string) *CEOHandler {
    return &CEOHandler{
        BaseApprovalHandler: BaseApprovalHandler{name: name},
    }
}

func (c *CEOHandler) CanApprove(request *ApprovalRequest) bool {
    return request.Amount <= 100000
}

func main() {
    fmt.Println("=== 日志处理责任链示例 ===")

    // 创建处理者链
    consoleHandler := NewConsoleLogHandler()
    fileHandler := NewFileLogHandler("system.log")
    emailHandler := NewEmailNotificationHandler("admin@company.com")

    // 构建责任链
    consoleHandler.SetNext(fileHandler).SetNext(emailHandler)

    // 创建不同级别的日志请求
    requests := []*LogRequest{
        NewLogRequest(INFO, "Application started", map[string]interface{}{"version": "1.0.0"}),
        NewLogRequest(DEBUG, "Processing user request", map[string]interface{}{"user_id": 12345}),
        NewLogRequest(WARNING, "High memory usage detected", map[string]interface{}{"memory": "85%"}),
        NewLogRequest(ERROR, "Database connection failed", map[string]interface{}{"db": "primary"}),
        NewLogRequest(CRITICAL, "System is down!", map[string]interface{}{"downtime": "5 minutes"}),
    }

    // 处理请求
    for _, request := range requests {
        fmt.Printf("\nProcessing: %s\n", request)
        consoleHandler.Handle(request)
        fmt.Printf("Handled: %t\n", request.Handled)
    }

    fmt.Println("\n=== 审批流程责任链示例 ===")

    // 创建审批链
    teamLeader := NewTeamLeaderHandler("Team Leader")
    manager := NewManagerHandler("Manager")
    director := NewDirectorHandler("Director")
    ceo := NewCEOHandler("CEO")

    // 构建审批链
    teamLeader.SetNext(manager).SetNext(director).SetNext(ceo)

    // 创建不同金额的审批请求
    approvalRequests := []*ApprovalRequest{
        NewApprovalRequest(500, "Office supplies", "Alice"),
        NewApprovalRequest(2500, "New laptop", "Bob"),
        NewApprovalRequest(15000, "Team building event", "Charlie"),
        NewApprovalRequest(50000, "New server infrastructure", "David"),
        NewApprovalRequest(150000, "Office renovation", "Eve"), // 超出所有人权限
    }

    // 处理审批请求
    for _, request := range approvalRequests {
        fmt.Printf("\nProcessing: %s\n", request)
        teamLeader.Handle(request)
        if request.Approved {
            fmt.Printf("Final result: Approved by %s\n", request.Approver)
        } else {
            fmt.Println("Final result: Request denied")
        }
    }
}

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fs::OpenOptions;
use std::io::Write;

// 请求类型枚举
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum RequestType {
    Info,
    Debug,
    Warning,
    Error,
    Critical,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for RequestType {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            RequestType::Info => write!(f, "INFO"),
            RequestType::Debug => write!(f, "DEBUG"),
            RequestType::Warning => write!(f, "WARNING"),
            RequestType::Error => write!(f, "ERROR"),
            RequestType::Critical => write!(f, "CRITICAL"),
        }
    }
}

// 日志请求
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct LogRequest {
    pub request_type: RequestType,
    pub message: String,
    pub data: Option<HashMap<String, String>>,
    pub handled: bool,
}

impl LogRequest {
    pub fn new(request_type: RequestType, message: String, data: Option<HashMap<String, String>>) -> Self {
        LogRequest {
            request_type,
            message,
            data,
            handled: false,
        }
    }
}

    manager.set_next(Box::new(director));
    team_leader.set_next(Box::new(manager));

    // 创建不同金额的审批请求

docs.title: 1.简介
docs.text: 迭代器模式是一种行为型设计模式，它提供了一种方法来访问聚合对象中各个元素，而又不暴露该对象的内部表示。迭代器模式将遍历行为从聚合对象中分离出来，并将其封装到一个迭代器对象中。

docs.title: 2.使用场景
docs.text:
• 需要访问一个聚合对象的内容而无需暴露它的内部表示
  • 需要支持对聚合对象的多种遍历
  • 需要为遍历不同的聚合结构提供一个统一的接口
  • 集合遍历、数据库结果集遍历、文件系统遍历

docs.title: 3.优缺点
docs.text:
优点：

  • 支持以不同的方式遍历一个聚合对象
  • 迭代器简化了聚合类
  • 在同一个聚合上可以有多个遍历
  • 增加新的聚合类和迭代器类都很方便

缺点：

  • 由于迭代器模式将存储数据和遍历数据的职责分离，增加新的聚合类需要对应增加新的迭代器类

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Any, List, Optional, Iterator, Generic, TypeVar
import random

T = TypeVar('T')

# 抽象迭代器
class Iterator(ABC, Generic[T]):
    @abstractmethod
    def has_next(self) -> bool:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def next(self) -> T:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def reset(self) -> None:
        pass

# 抽象聚合
class Aggregate(ABC, Generic[T]):
    @abstractmethod
    def create_iterator(self) -> Iterator[T]:
        pass

# 书籍类
class Book:
    def __init__(self, title: str, author: str, isbn: str, year: int):
        self.title = title
        self.author = author
        self.isbn = isbn
        self.year = year

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"《{self.title}》 - {self.author} ({self.year})"

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return self.__str__()

# 具体聚合 - 书架
class BookShelf(Aggregate[Book]):
    def __init__(self):
        self._books: List[Book] = []

    def add_book(self, book: Book) -> None:
        self._books.append(book)

    def remove_book(self, book: Book) -> None:
        if book in self._books:
            self._books.remove(book)

    def get_book_at(self, index: int) -> Book:
        return self._books[index]

    def get_length(self) -> int:
        return len(self._books)

    def create_iterator(self) -> Iterator[Book]:
        return BookShelfIterator(self)

    def create_reverse_iterator(self) -> Iterator[Book]:
        return BookShelfReverseIterator(self)

    def create_random_iterator(self) -> Iterator[Book]:
        return BookShelfRandomIterator(self)

# 具体迭代器 - 正向遍历
class BookShelfIterator(Iterator[Book]):
    def __init__(self, bookshelf: BookShelf):
        self._bookshelf = bookshelf
        self._index = 0

    def has_next(self) -> bool:
        return self._index < self._bookshelf.get_length()

    def next(self) -> Book:
        if not self.has_next():
            raise StopIteration("没有更多书籍")
        book = self._bookshelf.get_book_at(self._index)
        self._index += 1
        return book

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._index = 0

# 具体迭代器 - 反向遍历
class BookShelfReverseIterator(Iterator[Book]):
    def __init__(self, bookshelf: BookShelf):
        self._bookshelf = bookshelf
        self._index = bookshelf.get_length() - 1

    def has_next(self) -> bool:
        return self._index >= 0

    def next(self) -> Book:
        if not self.has_next():
            raise StopIteration("没有更多书籍")
        book = self._bookshelf.get_book_at(self._index)
        self._index -= 1
        return book

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._index = self._bookshelf.get_length() - 1

# 具体迭代器 - 随机遍历
class BookShelfRandomIterator(Iterator[Book]):
    def __init__(self, bookshelf: BookShelf):
        self._bookshelf = bookshelf
        self._indices = list(range(bookshelf.get_length()))
        random.shuffle(self._indices)
        self._current = 0

    def has_next(self) -> bool:
        return self._current < len(self._indices)

    def next(self) -> Book:
        if not self.has_next():
            raise StopIteration("没有更多书籍")
        index = self._indices[self._current]
        book = self._bookshelf.get_book_at(index)
        self._current += 1
        return book

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._current = 0
        random.shuffle(self._indices)

# 树节点类
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, value: Any):
        self.value = value
        self.children: List[TreeNode] = []

    def add_child(self, child: 'TreeNode') -> None:
        self.children.append(child)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return str(self.value)

# 树结构
class Tree(Aggregate[TreeNode]):
    def __init__(self, root: TreeNode):
        self.root = root

    def create_iterator(self) -> Iterator[TreeNode]:
        return TreeDepthFirstIterator(self.root)

    def create_breadth_first_iterator(self) -> Iterator[TreeNode]:
        return TreeBreadthFirstIterator(self.root)

# 深度优先迭代器
class TreeDepthFirstIterator(Iterator[TreeNode]):
    def __init__(self, root: TreeNode):
        self._stack: List[TreeNode] = [root] if root else []
        self._original_root = root

    def has_next(self) -> bool:
        return len(self._stack) > 0

    def next(self) -> TreeNode:
        if not self.has_next():
            raise StopIteration("没有更多节点")

        node = self._stack.pop()
        # 逆序添加子节点，保证左子树先遍历
        for child in reversed(node.children):
            self._stack.append(child)

        return node

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._stack = [self._original_root] if self._original_root else []

# 广度优先迭代器
class TreeBreadthFirstIterator(Iterator[TreeNode]):
    def __init__(self, root: TreeNode):
        self._queue: List[TreeNode] = [root] if root else []
        self._original_root = root

    def has_next(self) -> bool:
        return len(self._queue) > 0

    def next(self) -> TreeNode:
        if not self.has_next():
            raise StopIteration("没有更多节点")

        node = self._queue.pop(0)  # 从队列头部取出
        # 添加所有子节点到队列尾部
        for child in node.children:
            self._queue.append(child)

        return node

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._queue = [self._original_root] if self._original_root else []

# Python风格的迭代器适配器
class IteratorAdapter:
    def __init__(self, iterator: Iterator[T]):
        self._iterator = iterator

    def __iter__(self):
        self._iterator.reset()
        return self

    def __next__(self):
        if self._iterator.has_next():
            return self._iterator.next()
        else:
            raise StopIteration

# 分页迭代器
class PagedIterator(Iterator[T]):
    def __init__(self, data: List[T], page_size: int = 10):
        self._data = data
        self._page_size = page_size
        self._current_page = 0
        self._total_pages = (len(data) + page_size - 1) // page_size

    def has_next(self) -> bool:
        return self._current_page < self._total_pages

    def next(self) -> List[T]:
        if not self.has_next():
            raise StopIteration("没有更多页面")

        start_index = self._current_page * self._page_size
        end_index = min(start_index + self._page_size, len(self._data))
        page_data = self._data[start_index:end_index]

        self._current_page += 1
        return page_data

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._current_page = 0

    def get_current_page(self) -> int:
        return self._current_page

    def get_total_pages(self) -> int:
        return self._total_pages

# 使用示例
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== 书架迭代器示例 ===")

    # 创建书架并添加书籍
    bookshelf = BookShelf()
    books = [
        Book("设计模式", "GoF", "978-0201633610", 1994),
        Book("重构", "Martin Fowler", "978-0201485677", 1999),
        Book("代码大全", "Steve McConnell", "978-0735619678", 2004),
        Book("程序员修炼之道", "Andrew Hunt", "978-0201616224", 1999),
        Book("算法导论", "Thomas H. Cormen", "978-0262033848", 2009),
    ]

    for book in books:
        bookshelf.add_book(book)

    # 正向遍历
    print("正向遍历:")
    iterator = bookshelf.create_iterator()
    while iterator.has_next():
        book = iterator.next()
        print(f"  {book}")

    # 反向遍历
    print("\n反向遍历:")
    reverse_iterator = bookshelf.create_reverse_iterator()
    while reverse_iterator.has_next():
        book = reverse_iterator.next()
        print(f"  {book}")

    # 随机遍历
    print("\n随机遍历:")
    random_iterator = bookshelf.create_random_iterator()
    while random_iterator.has_next():
        book = random_iterator.next()
        print(f"  {book}")

    # 使用Python风格的迭代器
    print("\nPython风格遍历:")
    for book in IteratorAdapter(bookshelf.create_iterator()):
        print(f"  {book}")

    print("\n=== 树遍历迭代器示例 ===")

    # 创建树结构
    root = TreeNode("A")
    b = TreeNode("B")
    c = TreeNode("C")
    d = TreeNode("D")
    e = TreeNode("E")
    f = TreeNode("F")
    g = TreeNode("G")

    root.add_child(b)
    root.add_child(c)
    b.add_child(d)
    b.add_child(e)
    c.add_child(f)
    c.add_child(g)

    tree = Tree(root)

    # 深度优先遍历
    print("深度优先遍历:")
    dfs_iterator = tree.create_iterator()
    while dfs_iterator.has_next():
        node = dfs_iterator.next()
        print(f"  {node}")

    # 广度优先遍历
    print("\n广度优先遍历:")
    bfs_iterator = tree.create_breadth_first_iterator()
    while bfs_iterator.has_next():
        node = bfs_iterator.next()
        print(f"  {node}")

    print("\n=== 分页迭代器示例 ===")

    # 创建大量数据
    data = [f"Item {i}" for i in range(1, 26)]  # 25个项目

    # 创建分页迭代器，每页5个项目
    paged_iterator = PagedIterator(data, page_size=5)

    while paged_iterator.has_next():
        page = paged_iterator.next()
        print(f"第 {paged_iterator.get_current_page()} 页 (共 {paged_iterator.get_total_pages()} 页): {page}")

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "math/rand"
    "time"
)

// 抽象迭代器接口
type Iterator[T any] interface {
    HasNext() bool
    Next() T
    Reset()
}

// 抽象聚合接口
type Aggregate[T any] interface {
    CreateIterator() Iterator[T]
}

// 书籍结构
type Book struct {
    Title  string
    Author string
    ISBN   string
    Year   int
}

func (b Book) String() string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("《%s》 - %s (%d)", b.Title, b.Author, b.Year)
}

// 书架结构
type BookShelf struct {
    books []Book
}

func NewBookShelf() *BookShelf {
    return &BookShelf{books: make([]Book, 0)}
}

func (bs *BookShelf) AddBook(book Book) {
    bs.books = append(bs.books, book)
}

func (bs *BookShelf) RemoveBook(book Book) {
    for i, b := range bs.books {
        if b.ISBN == book.ISBN {
            bs.books = append(bs.books[:i], bs.books[i+1:]...)
            break
        }
    }
}

func (bs *BookShelf) GetBookAt(index int) Book {
    return bs.books[index]
}

func (bs *BookShelf) GetLength() int {
    return len(bs.books)
}

func (bs *BookShelf) CreateIterator() Iterator[Book] {
    return NewBookShelfIterator(bs)
}

func (bs *BookShelf) CreateReverseIterator() Iterator[Book] {
    return NewBookShelfReverseIterator(bs)
}

func (bs *BookShelf) CreateRandomIterator() Iterator[Book] {
    return NewBookShelfRandomIterator(bs)
}

// 正向迭代器
type BookShelfIterator struct {
    bookshelf *BookShelf
    index     int
}

func NewBookShelfIterator(bookshelf *BookShelf) *BookShelfIterator {
    return &BookShelfIterator{bookshelf: bookshelf, index: 0}
}

func (bsi *BookShelfIterator) HasNext() bool {
    return bsi.index < bsi.bookshelf.GetLength()
}

func (bsi *BookShelfIterator) Next() Book {
    if !bsi.HasNext() {
        panic("没有更多书籍")
    }
    book := bsi.bookshelf.GetBookAt(bsi.index)
    bsi.index++
    return book
}

func (bsi *BookShelfIterator) Reset() {
    bsi.index = 0
}

// 反向迭代器
type BookShelfReverseIterator struct {
    bookshelf *BookShelf
    index     int
}

func NewBookShelfReverseIterator(bookshelf *BookShelf) *BookShelfReverseIterator {
    return &BookShelfReverseIterator{
        bookshelf: bookshelf,
        index:     bookshelf.GetLength() - 1,
    }
}

func (bsri *BookShelfReverseIterator) HasNext() bool {
    return bsri.index >= 0
}

func (bsri *BookShelfReverseIterator) Next() Book {
    if !bsri.HasNext() {
        panic("没有更多书籍")
    }
    book := bsri.bookshelf.GetBookAt(bsri.index)
    bsri.index--
    return book
}

func (bsri *BookShelfReverseIterator) Reset() {
    bsri.index = bsri.bookshelf.GetLength() - 1
}

// 随机迭代器
type BookShelfRandomIterator struct {
    bookshelf *BookShelf
    indices   []int
    current   int
}

func NewBookShelfRandomIterator(bookshelf *BookShelf) *BookShelfRandomIterator {
    length := bookshelf.GetLength()
    indices := make([]int, length)
    for i := 0; i < length; i++ {
        indices[i] = i
    }

    // 随机打乱
    rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())
    rand.Shuffle(length, func(i, j int) {
        indices[i], indices[j] = indices[j], indices[i]
    })

    return &BookShelfRandomIterator{
        bookshelf: bookshelf,
        indices:   indices,
        current:   0,
    }
}

func (bsri *BookShelfRandomIterator) HasNext() bool {
    return bsri.current < len(bsri.indices)
}

func (bsri *BookShelfRandomIterator) Next() Book {
    if !bsri.HasNext() {
        panic("没有更多书籍")
    }
    index := bsri.indices[bsri.current]
    book := bsri.bookshelf.GetBookAt(index)
    bsri.current++
    return book
}

func (bsri *BookShelfRandomIterator) Reset() {
    bsri.current = 0
    // 重新随机打乱
    rand.Shuffle(len(bsri.indices), func(i, j int) {
        bsri.indices[i], bsri.indices[j] = bsri.indices[j], bsri.indices[i]
    })
}

// 树节点结构
type TreeNode struct {
    Value    interface{}
    Children []*TreeNode
}

func NewTreeNode(value interface{}) *TreeNode {
    return &TreeNode{
        Value:    value,
        Children: make([]*TreeNode, 0),
    }
}

func (tn *TreeNode) AddChild(child *TreeNode) {
    tn.Children = append(tn.Children, child)
}

func (tn *TreeNode) String() string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("%v", tn.Value)
}

// 树结构
type Tree struct {
    Root *TreeNode
}

func NewTree(root *TreeNode) *Tree {
    return &Tree{Root: root}
}

func (t *Tree) CreateIterator() Iterator[*TreeNode] {
    return NewTreeDepthFirstIterator(t.Root)
}

func (t *Tree) CreateBreadthFirstIterator() Iterator[*TreeNode] {
    return NewTreeBreadthFirstIterator(t.Root)
}

// 深度优先迭代器
type TreeDepthFirstIterator struct {
    stack        []*TreeNode
    originalRoot *TreeNode
}

func NewTreeDepthFirstIterator(root *TreeNode) *TreeDepthFirstIterator {
    stack := make([]*TreeNode, 0)
    if root != nil {
        stack = append(stack, root)
    }
    return &TreeDepthFirstIterator{
        stack:        stack,
        originalRoot: root,
    }
}

func (tdfi *TreeDepthFirstIterator) HasNext() bool {
    return len(tdfi.stack) > 0
}

func (tdfi *TreeDepthFirstIterator) Next() *TreeNode {
    if !tdfi.HasNext() {
        panic("没有更多节点")
    }

    // 从栈顶取出节点
    node := tdfi.stack[len(tdfi.stack)-1]
    tdfi.stack = tdfi.stack[:len(tdfi.stack)-1]

    // 逆序添加子节点，保证左子树先遍历
    for i := len(node.Children) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
        tdfi.stack = append(tdfi.stack, node.Children[i])
    }

    return node
}

func (tdfi *TreeDepthFirstIterator) Reset() {
    tdfi.stack = make([]*TreeNode, 0)
    if tdfi.originalRoot != nil {
        tdfi.stack = append(tdfi.stack, tdfi.originalRoot)
    }
}

// 广度优先迭代器
type TreeBreadthFirstIterator struct {
    queue        []*TreeNode
    originalRoot *TreeNode
}

func NewTreeBreadthFirstIterator(root *TreeNode) *TreeBreadthFirstIterator {
    queue := make([]*TreeNode, 0)
    if root != nil {
        queue = append(queue, root)
    }
    return &TreeBreadthFirstIterator{
        queue:        queue,
        originalRoot: root,
    }
}

func (tbfi *TreeBreadthFirstIterator) HasNext() bool {
    return len(tbfi.queue) > 0
}

func (tbfi *TreeBreadthFirstIterator) Next() *TreeNode {
    if !tbfi.HasNext() {
        panic("没有更多节点")
    }

    // 从队列头部取出节点
    node := tbfi.queue[0]
    tbfi.queue = tbfi.queue[1:]

    // 添加所有子节点到队列尾部
    for _, child := range node.Children {
        tbfi.queue = append(tbfi.queue, child)
    }

    return node
}

func (tbfi *TreeBreadthFirstIterator) Reset() {
    tbfi.queue = make([]*TreeNode, 0)
    if tbfi.originalRoot != nil {
        tbfi.queue = append(tbfi.queue, tbfi.originalRoot)
    }
}

// 分页迭代器
type PagedIterator[T any] struct {
    data        []T
    pageSize    int
    currentPage int
    totalPages  int
}

func NewPagedIterator[T any](data []T, pageSize int) *PagedIterator[T] {
    if pageSize <= 0 {
        pageSize = 10
    }
    totalPages := (len(data) + pageSize - 1) / pageSize
    return &PagedIterator[T]{
        data:        data,
        pageSize:    pageSize,
        currentPage: 0,
        totalPages:  totalPages,
    }
}

func (pi *PagedIterator[T]) HasNext() bool {
    return pi.currentPage < pi.totalPages
}

func (pi *PagedIterator[T]) Next() []T {
    if !pi.HasNext() {
        panic("没有更多页面")
    }

    startIndex := pi.currentPage * pi.pageSize
    endIndex := startIndex + pi.pageSize
    if endIndex > len(pi.data) {
        endIndex = len(pi.data)
    }

    pageData := pi.data[startIndex:endIndex]
    pi.currentPage++
    return pageData
}

func (pi *PagedIterator[T]) Reset() {
    pi.currentPage = 0
}

func (pi *PagedIterator[T]) GetCurrentPage() int {
    return pi.currentPage
}

func (pi *PagedIterator[T]) GetTotalPages() int {
    return pi.totalPages
}

// 使用示例
func main() {
    fmt.Println("=== 书架迭代器示例 ===")

    // 创建书架并添加书籍
    bookshelf := NewBookShelf()
    books := []Book{
        {"设计模式", "GoF", "978-0201633610", 1994},
        {"重构", "Martin Fowler", "978-0201485677", 1999},
        {"代码大全", "Steve McConnell", "978-0735619678", 2004},
        {"程序员修炼之道", "Andrew Hunt", "978-0201616224", 1999},
        {"算法导论", "Thomas H. Cormen", "978-0262033848", 2009},
    }

    for _, book := range books {
        bookshelf.AddBook(book)
    }

    // 正向遍历
    fmt.Println("正向遍历:")
    iterator := bookshelf.CreateIterator()
    for iterator.HasNext() {
        book := iterator.Next()
        fmt.Printf("  %s\n", book)
    }

    // 反向遍历
    fmt.Println("\n反向遍历:")
    reverseIterator := bookshelf.CreateReverseIterator()
    for reverseIterator.HasNext() {
        book := reverseIterator.Next()
        fmt.Printf("  %s\n", book)
    }

    // 随机遍历
    fmt.Println("\n随机遍历:")
    randomIterator := bookshelf.CreateRandomIterator()
    for randomIterator.HasNext() {
        book := randomIterator.Next()
        fmt.Printf("  %s\n", book)
    }

    fmt.Println("\n=== 树遍历迭代器示例 ===")

    // 创建树结构
    root := NewTreeNode("A")
    b := NewTreeNode("B")
    c := NewTreeNode("C")
    d := NewTreeNode("D")
    e := NewTreeNode("E")
    f := NewTreeNode("F")
    g := NewTreeNode("G")

    root.AddChild(b)
    root.AddChild(c)
    b.AddChild(d)
    b.AddChild(e)
    c.AddChild(f)
    c.AddChild(g)

    tree := NewTree(root)

    // 深度优先遍历
    fmt.Println("深度优先遍历:")
    dfsIterator := tree.CreateIterator()
    for dfsIterator.HasNext() {
        node := dfsIterator.Next()
        fmt.Printf("  %s\n", node)
    }

    // 广度优先遍历
    fmt.Println("\n广度优先遍历:")
    bfsIterator := tree.CreateBreadthFirstIterator()
    for bfsIterator.HasNext() {
        node := bfsIterator.Next()
        fmt.Printf("  %s\n", node)
    }

    fmt.Println("\n=== 分页迭代器示例 ===")

    // 创建大量数据
    data := make([]string, 25)
    for i := 0; i < 25; i++ {
        data[i] = fmt.Sprintf("Item %d", i+1)
    }

    // 创建分页迭代器，每页5个项目
    pagedIterator := NewPagedIterator(data, 5)

    for pagedIterator.HasNext() {
        page := pagedIterator.Next()
        fmt.Printf("第 %d 页 (共 %d 页): %v\n",
            pagedIterator.GetCurrentPage(),
            pagedIterator.GetTotalPages(),
            page)
    }
}
